articleTitle: Evaluation of load carrying capacity of a PC girder bridge using model updating techniques
abstract: Load carrying capacities of exciting bridges need to be properly assessed for the safe operation and efficient maintenance of bridges. Conventionally, the load carrying capacities of bridges have been evaluated from proof loading tests with test trucks by measuring static and dynamic responses, such as deflections or strains under known loading conditions. However, it is very hard to carry out loading tests on the expressway bridges with a large amount of traffic, since full or partial block of traffic during the tests may cause not only inconvenience to drivers but also increase of the logistic cost and time. To overcome these difficulties, an alternative method is proposed using ambient acceleration data without traffic control. The proposed method consists of ambient vibration measurement, experimental modal analysis, correction of the initial finite element (FE) model based on the identified modal properties, and estimation of the load carrying capacity using the updated FE model. The proposed method has been verified through field tests on a decommissioned prestressed concrete girder bridge by comparing with the results of the conventional truck loading tests.

articleTitle: Effects of Cu-dopant on properties of CdTe thin films
abstract: Polycrystalline CdTe films were deposited on glass substrates by RF magnetron sputtering. The structural, optical and electrical properties of the CdTe films and Cu doping effects on the properties of the CdTe films have been investigated by means of X-ray diffraction, UV-Vis Spectroscopy, and Hall effect measurement.

articleTitle: Simulation research on University Timetabling Problem based on new immune GA
abstract: University Timetabling Problem (UTP) approach based on a new immune GA is presented in this paper. The method introduced a new immune GA to UTP research according to the characteristics of UTP. Firstly, an optimization mathematical model of UTP is established and the framework structure for solving UTP is founded. Secondly, a new immune GA method is applied to improve the traditional design scheme, which includes a new binary code scheme, initial population design scheme, fitness function design scheme, immunization strategy, adaptive crossover probability and adaptive mutation probability design scheme. Lastly, the simulation results and analysis are presented, which testify our proposed approach can satisfy multiple constraint conditions and resolve UTP more effectively.

articleTitle: Globalized probability based lane detection with non-unique B-spline model
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a robust lane detection method. This method uses the globalized probability of boundary (gPb) algorithm as boundary detector and non-unique B-spline (NUBS) as the road model. The gPb algorithm combines the local information, like brightness, color and texture features, with global information derived from spectral partitioning and is robust against shadow, and illumination varying in road boundaries detection. NUBS model is flexible enough to model the most of roads, include highways and rural ways, while taking account of the perspective effect. This method contains three main steps: first, we use gPb to detect the boundaries of the objects in the resized captured images, and then, take use of the parallel property of the road boundaries in ground images to find the knot sets of NUBS model for two sides of the road boundaries. Finally, we make the knots as initial boundaries and push them to the more accuracy boundaries in the canny edge map image using the snake algorithm.

articleTitle: Dynamic bandwidth schedule in multi-wavelength access network based on OFDM-PON
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm of dynamic bandwidth schedule (DBS) is proposed to achieve multi-granularity dynamic bandwidth allocation in multi-wavelength optical access network based on OFDM-PON. By the DBS, bandwidth of different granularities can be assigned efficiently.

articleTitle: Structure and stability of small cadmium-carbon clusters: A density functional study of CdCn(n=2−12)
abstract: We have studied the structures and electronic properties of CdC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> (n=2-12) using the density functional theory. We have found that the linear isomers or near linear isomers are most stable for CdC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>(n≤9) clusters with the exception of CdC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> cluster and the cyclic structures have the lowest energy for CdC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>(n=6, 10-12)clusters. The reactive energy and the free energy difference of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>+Cd→CdC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> display that the n-even clusters are more stable than the n-odd ones.

articleTitle: Determining priority method adopted to select the substation site
abstract: How to accurately choose a substation site to substation future development has great significance. This paper will establish a mathematical model in the composition of the comparable value indicators transformed from factors impact through a substation site selection to synthetically evaluate a substation site plan to be more accurate to choose the programs to make the subjective factors minimize the loss, the model mainly uses the method of determining priorities to determine the factors' order, then assign them to transform. An engineering example is given to illustrate the specific use of the model.

articleTitle: Cyclic vectors in the Zygmund space
abstract: In this note we show that f is cyclic in the little Zygmund space Z<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = {f∈H(D):lim<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">|z|→1-</sub>(1-|z|<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>)|f"(z)|=0} if and only if f has no zeros in the closed unit disc.

articleTitle: Review of the research on mechanical properities of broken rock in the deep mining
abstract: With the booming domestic economy and increasing demand for energy, shallow resources are declining and the domestic mining resources have entered a deep coal mining. During the coal mining, the common method of natural cross-fall method in the mining is adopted generally. The broken rock formed by the cross of immediate roof cross bears the load of the main roof and other various rock. In which the broken rock in deep high stress, high osmotic pressure, high moderate special environment, along with the mechanical properties of deep rock was different from the mechanical behavior of the shallow rock. This paper analyses the stress state, deformation and seepage-creep of deep broken rock, and prospect the research trend of deep broken rock.

articleTitle: Relativistic danger for spacecraft from fast satellites of the solar-system planets
abstract: Apparent relativistic shift of the solar-system planets' satellites observed from the Earth is computed using mathematical tools of the quaternion relativity theory capable to solve many non-inertial motion problems. It is shown that neglecting the effect in preliminary calculations of spacecraft orbits may entail difficulties in reaching the goal of the space missions.

articleTitle: A semilocal convergence theorem for Newton-type method under γ-condition in Banach space
abstract: A third-order Newton-type method was recently studied [M. T. Darvishi and A. Barati, Appl. Math. Comput 187(2007), pp. 630–635] to solve systems of nonlinear equations. In this paper, we aim to study the semilocal convergence property of the method. Assuming the nonlinear operator F is twice differentiable and satisfies γ-condition, we establish a semilocal convergence theorem for the Newton-type method. We also present the error estimate. Furthermore, several examples are given to show the application of our results, with comparison to other semilocal convergence theorems.

articleTitle: Additional load on structures due to installed wind turbines
abstract: Installing wind turbines on buildings is a new way of wind energy utilization in recent years. Additional loads due to installed wind turbines will be acted on the structure and therefore affect the local or global behavior of the structure. Taking a small wind turbine as an example, a simplified method to calculate the additional load is proposed in this paper. It will provide a reference for further structural analysis of buildings integrated with wind turbines.

articleTitle: 4*4 transfer-matrix method for defect mode splitting in magnetic photonic crystal
abstract: Using the 4*4 transfer-matrix method go through the transmittance formula of one dimensional magnetic photonic crystal with and without external magnetic fields, respectively. Numerical simulation results show that defect-mode splitting critically depend on the magneto-optical gyrotropy factor and defect mode in right-hand and left-hand circularly polarized move toward lower and higher frequency in the present of a magnetic field, respectively. Our results prove out the fact that the defect mode splits into two modes under the external magnetic fields and with the increase of the magnetic field strength the two peaks separate to both sides. Considering the dispersion of the light, we get the same conclusion, which present an effective way to new type of tunable filters.

articleTitle: Computational unsteady forced convection over a stretching sheet with magnetic and radiative physical effects to the fluid flow field
abstract: A heat transfer for steady two-dimensional forced convection with magnetic hydrodynamic flow (MHD) with radiative effect of an incompressible fluid over an unsteady thermal forming stretching sheet has been studied. The parameters M and R which are used to represent the dominance of the magnetic effect and radiative effect have been presented in governing equations. The similar transformation and an implicit finite-difference method have been used to analyze the present problem. The numerical solutions of the flow velocity distributions, temperature profiles, the wall unknown values of f′(0) and θ ′(0) for calculating the heat transfer of the similar boundary-layer flow are carried out as functions of the unsteadiness parameter (S), the Prandtl number (Pr), the radiative parameter (R) and the magnetic parameter (M). The effects of these parameters have also discussed. At the results, it will produce greater heat transfer effect with a larger Pr, R and S but a larger M will reduce momentum and heat transfer effects.

articleTitle: The design of the space structure about ecological land utilization on subsidence of coal exploitation in Xintai city
abstract: On the base of the discussion of the ecological reclamation of subsidence of coal exploitation, the optimization structure of plane and perpendicularity on subsidence area of coal exploitation in Xintai city are differently designed.

articleTitle: Hperspectral remote sensing information extraction of geothermal resources, Lintong, Shaanxi
abstract: Using hperspectral remote sensing information method to extract geothermal resources information, choosing different objects feature parameters and classification methods, such as false color composite and enhanced processing, single-band pseudo-color image synthesis, spectral angle mapping, linear spectral unmixing, extracting geothermal energy information, achieved good results.

articleTitle: Study of stabilization based on static output feedback for a kind of non-linear discrete singular large-scale control systems
abstract: The static output feedback stabilization for non-linear discrete singular large-scale control systems is investigated by using generalized Lyapunov function method. According to the bound limit parameter of interconnecting terms and non-linear terms, some sufficient conditions for determining the asymptotical stability and unstability of the corresponding singular closed-loop large-scale systems are given while subsystems are regular, causal and R-controllable. At last, an example is given to show the application of main result.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between saturated permeability coefficient and factor of safety of bedding slope under the condition of reservoir water level fluctuation
abstract: Reservoir water level change will change the seepage field dramatically. Saturated permeability coefficient is one of the most fundamental and important calculation parameters of slope seepage and stability analysis. This paper aims at establishing the relationship between Saturated permeability coefficient and factor of safety of bedding slope under the condition of reservoir water level fluctuation. Based on saturated-unsaturated seepage theory, seepage fields of one bedding rock slope with different Saturated permeability coefficient under the condition of water level fluctuation were calculated by finite element method, the factor of safety of the slope under the condition of water level fluctuation were calculated by Morgenstern-Price method, and then the relationship between the factor of safety and saturated permeability coefficient of rock and soil mass of the bedding slope under the fluctuation of the reservoir water level, which provides a references to stability analysis of bedding slopes in Three Gorges Reservoir Area.

articleTitle: Self-Produced Scrap Steel used in production for high efficiency flux-cored wire
abstract: In the paper, powder of flux-core wire was produced with self-produced scrap steel as the main raw material and water-atomization technology was employed. As a result the scrap steel is used more sufficiently and properly. A type of ultra thick flux-cored wire with diameter of 6mm was designed. "Inter twist connection" and "inner wire" technologies were adopted in the wire above, which make arc heat distributed uniformly and the wire melted synchronously, so the welding performance was improved. This ultra-thick flux-cored wire has a high deposition rate. A kind of ultra-thick cored wire of 600MPa class which can meet the quality requirements of national standards is produced successfully by scrap steel.

articleTitle: Externalities of network game consumption
abstract: With sustainable development of China's social economic and increasing competitive pressures, the consumptive external problem of network game as the representative of addictive products becomes more and more prominent and also makes the great challenge on the national public security and public health. Under the assumption of rationalinality, this paper focused on the existence of the network game consumption externalities. Based on the Becker-Murphy model of rational addiction and method of dynamic optimization, we discussed the impact of the group pressure on total utility with optimal consumption path, and the results showed that existence of the externalities of network game consumption depended on the consumer's value of the status of friends loop.

articleTitle: Design of a common gateway between LonWorks and serial bus
abstract: LonWorks has become a dominated fieldbus in building automation applications, especially in the last decade. There are many devices in buildings with none-LonWorks interface which also need to be horizontally integrated into LonWorks network, just as the devices with LonWorks interface, and a gateway is competent for the task. But traditional gateways have some limitation and drawbacks, and they may penalize the system performance of the whole building automation. We present a new approach with a common gateway unit (CGU) to solve the problems and meet our requirements. The three parts of the CGU hardware are addressed in the paper firstly, and each block diagram of each unit is introduced. Then overall software process is given, and three main units: configuration process, command process module, and variables updating module are illuminated in detail. We especially optimize the data access procedure between CGU and common serial devices, and the system access cycle is reduced considerably. In the end, a real CUG implementation is shown.

articleTitle: An improved image edge detection algorithm based on fuzzy sets
abstract: An improved image edge detection algorithm based on generalized fuzzy sets is proposed in order to overcome the shortcomings of the traditional algorithm. A new membership function is reconstructed in this paper, and it maps the image from space domain to fuzzy domain. The image is processed by enhance operator. Finally, the fuzzy membership value is transformed with inverse operation, and the image's edge gray value is got. The results show that the improved algorithm effectively reduces the computation and improves the image quality. Therefore the improved algorithm in this paper is more effective.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for parameters estimations of Multivariate Mixed Weibull Distributions with censoring data
abstract: Multivariate Mixed Weibull Distributions play an important role in life time data analysis. In this paper, by using the new algorithm, the maximize likelihood estimation is obtained for the multivariate mixed Weibull model under the normal stress life time test with complete sample data or censored samples. The iteration formulae are given in the paper. Simulation results show the performance of estimation.

articleTitle: Cointegration analysis and error correction model about consumption and income of urban-rural residents in Shaoxing city
abstract: This paper using the time series data from 1986 to 2009 in Shaoxing, make an empirical research about consumer and income relationship of urban and rural residents from the dynamic changes of long-term and short-term perspective by using cointegration test and error correction model, purpose to study and compare consumer behaviors of urban and rural residents in Shaoxing.

articleTitle: Algorithm for JPEG2000 rate control based on number of coding passes
abstract: Post-compression rate-distortion optimization (PCRD-opt) algorithm in JPEG2000 needs to calculate rate-distortion slope of every truncation point, and increases the cost of computation and storage as well. A new algorithm is proposed for JPEG2000 rate control, which truncates the code stream by the number of coding passes and needn't to calculate rate distortion slope. Compared with the standard post-compression rate-distortion optimization algorithm, experimental results show that the proposed algorithm reduces the total encoding time with negligible loss in power signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR).

articleTitle: An improved forest management planning method based on “3S” technology
abstract: Facing-slope measurement from topographic maps was the traditional method used to divide sub-compartment for forest management division. However, the sub-compartment, which usually covers a large area and contains multiple forest types, can not be divided accurately and intuitively. Therefore it is not easy to operate in forestry management practice. An improved forest management planning method based on 3S technology with considering the reality of forest management was proposed in this paper. Firstly, forest function regions were distinguished based on digital topographic map. Secondly, the stands were divided in every sub-compartment based on high spatial resolution images by visual interpretation method in ArcGIS software. Thirdly, many neighboring sub-compartments with same geographical characteristics were combined into one operating area which was convenient for operating management forest. Then stands with the same management mode in one operating area were merged. Finally, compiling computer program to implement the aim of inputting some attribute information to generate other attribute information automatically. The approach put forward in this paper not only allows the forest management sophisticated, targeted but also easy to practice and implement.

articleTitle: Design of embedded streaming media player based on J2ME
abstract: This article designs of a cross-platform streaming media player based on J2ME (Java 2 Micro Edition) platform in the embedded system, introduces the jitter buffer and the disorder treatment strategy. To improve the capability of realtime playing, the player uses hardware decoding. With the JNI (Java Native Interface) technology, the implementation, connecting with the local codes, is convenient.

articleTitle: Effect and propagation of water level fluctuations in a sloping sandy beach—Unsaturated porous media
abstract: In coastal processes, the strong water movements due to short periodic waves (such as sea swell) can induce irregular water level fluctuations in the swash zone and within the sandy beach. The measured water level fluctuations with very complex entry water level fluctuations in a wave canal with a sloping sandy beach were analyzed by using 7 capacitive sensors. Numerical simulations have also been implemented in order to complement the experimental water level signal analyses. In this paper, numerical test of single harmonic wave with same computational domain and porous media properties as the experiment is conducted to understand the effect and propagation of the water level fluctuations in the unsaturated porous media. The key coupling parameter of the macro (sea water) porous and micro (sloping sandy beach) porous media in the Richards equation model is identified by the numerical test of single harmonic wave, which is the basis to simulate the complex numerical simulation with experimental boundary conditions.

articleTitle: A new method for assessment of GIC using Geomagentic Indices
abstract: The change of electric field caused by geomagnetic storm generates Geomagnetically Induced Current (GIC), which take negative effect on the safe operation of power systems, thus it is extremely important to assess GIC. Trichtchenko and other scientist have established classical simple linear regression of GIC and Geomagentic Indices by analyzing character of Geomagentic Indices and GIC. Since classical simple linear regression demands strictly on random variable, it is hard for common models to meet the demand. So in this article, it introduces the model of quantile regression, which, compared with the classical one, could not only reflect the full information of GIC, but features of the distribution of GIC.

articleTitle: The analysis of building vibration induced by the road traffic
abstract: The environmental vibration induced by road traffic is studied on an actual building. The field measurement is implemented. The vibration data on ground and top floor are acquired to analyze the affect of vibration on the building. A dynamic numerical model of the building is built using ANSYS. The measured ground acceleration is inputted as the excitation to calculating the vibration response on the top floor. The results show that the dynamic model is feasible. On this basis, two control methods which are setting shear wall and installing diagonal brace, are proposed to reduce the vibration of building. The analysis result of vibration reducing effects indicates that the method of installing shear wall is better.

articleTitle: The existence and uniqueness of mild solutions for semilinear impulsive neutral fractional integrodifferential equations with nonlocal conditions in the α -norm
abstract: In this paper, existence and uniqueness of mild solutions for semilinear impulsive neutral fractional integrodifferential equations with nonlocal conditions in the α -norm are investigated by using Banach contraction principle and a fixed point theorem for condensing maps.

articleTitle: A new bit-rate control scheme in Basic Unit layer on H.264
abstract: The paper focuses on rate-control scheme for H.264 and proposes an improved scheme on Basic-Unit layer, which consists of two steps. Firstly, the new scheme takes account of the relative MAD-complexity of Basic-Unit (BU) and modifies the original scheme of average-allocating-bits in BUs. Secondly, considering the scene-change, it modifies the liner prediction model of MAD. The tests prove that the improved scheme on Basic-Unit layer can predict MAD more accurately and get better subjective quality with PSNR slight raise by about 0.4db.

articleTitle: A novel video summarization algorithm
abstract: This paper presents a new genetic algorithm based method for video summarization. We pick out the least similar images from original video by measuring the differences with the technique of color histograms. Based on this reduced set, fitness function is defined for genetic algorithm to search the optimized frames. Experimental results show that the proposed method can capture more information than the traditional method and avoid redundancy. Moreover this algorithm has a distinct advantage in terms of time.

articleTitle: Study on the ice-induced vibration of concrete structure in environment of seawater corrosion
abstract: The three ice-structure interaction models were established according to collision dynamics theory. The numerical simulations of the interaction between sea ice and the structure were implemented by using the explicit dynamic analysis software ANSYS/LS-DYNA, according to the bi-axial strength criterion of concrete established by indoor test in environment of seawater corrosion. The simulated propagation of cracks in ice sheet, ice forces and structure displacement responses were presented using ice sheet with a certain constant speed moving to the structure. The simulated results show that the different kinds of vibration are produced by the structure with different figures interaction with moving ice sheet. The column structure tends to have a steady vibration which is harmful to their safety severely. A vibration of large amplitude of column structure is produced by moving ice sheet at the lower speed. The values of ice force applying on rectangular structure, which are not sensitive to the variation in the ice velocity, are far greater than ones on triangle structure.

articleTitle: Simulating the effect of electric warming concrete layer in ANSYS
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the electric warming pavement with full-light concrete as heat insulation layer. Model is built in ANSYS to simulate the improvement that electric warming layer bring to the temperature field of pavement when the environment temperature drops rapidly, and is compared with the result of tests to verify the accuracy of theoretical analysis, then we search the suitable preheating time to resist the rapid drop of environment temperature.

articleTitle: Development of multifunctional network camera used in underground based on ARM9
abstract: In order to solve the disadvantages of poor signal quality, short transmission distance about analog camera and images, sounds, environmental parameters not being combined in the existing mine monitoring equipment, a kind of multifunctional network camera used in underground based on the ARM9 series micro-processing chip i.mx27 is designed in this paper. The system can achieve image acquisition under low-light environment through low-light CCD image sensor; it can complete voice acquisition and processing through MIC and audio codec; it can access environmental parameters by RS-485 interface or wireless communication module with Mini PCI-E interface; it can implement the remote transmission about the information of video, audio, environmental parameters through Ethernet in mine. The low-voltage (≤3.3V) design of the system power not only conform the intrinsic safety demand, but also realize the low power consumption (4.5W) of the device. The experiments show that the multifunctional network camera based on ARM9 is in conformity with the intrinsic safety demand and realizes the functions of video monitoring, audio monitoring, environmental parameters accessing and network remote transmission. Hence, it will play an important role on the monitoring of mine security production and have the higher application value.

articleTitle: The study of start-up process of automobile wastewater treatment by EGSB reactor
abstract: This paper studied the start-up process of integrated wastewater of automobile production. It supplies basic for start up process quickly of EGSB reactor in the future and ensure the reactor run stably. Control temperature of the reactor is 35±2°C . Anaerobic granular sludge for the test is from sewage treatment plant of Jiujiang distillery. The result is anaerobic granular sludge gradually be acclimated successfully in 59 days and finished start-up process of integrated wastewater of automobile production, the organic load (by the value of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cr</sub>) is 4.03kg/(m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>·d) and COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cr</sub> removal rate is more then 80%.

articleTitle: Subjective assessment of noised stereo images
abstract: 3D imaging has been a wide research area in recent years, and the related quality assessment is also a hot research field. Our main work is to compare the impact of right view quality and disparity map quality on perceived stereo depth sense. Original right image and disparity map are impaired by additive gauss noise with different noise density respectively. Then two groups of stereoscopic images are obtained. One includes original left image and noised right image, and the other is original left image and synthesized right image using noised disparity map. Experimental results reveal the relationships between PSNR value of the two groups of stereoscopic images and the perceived depth.

articleTitle: Computer graphic technology in product design expression
abstract: This paper introduces the principles of product design expression, discusses the application of computer graphic technology in product design expression and presents three product design expression methods, which are two-dimensional expression, three-dimensional expression and virtual scene technology.

articleTitle: Design of wireless burglar alarm based on MCU
abstract: For to steals, robs and so on accidents to carry on the effective monitor and the warning, unified using the MCU AT89C51 controlling technology and the infrared detection technology, one kind of wireless burglar alarm has been designed, it including hardware and software two parts; The hardware part is composed by the infrared sensor, send and receive module ,MCU, acousto-optic warning and so on; The software part is composed of the main program and music subroutine. With C or the assembly language compilation source program, carries on the translation and the debugging in the Keilc51 platform, after downloads to the MCU AT89C51 chip, and this MCU and other primary devices welding on the PCB board according to designa circuit. On electricity, closed-cycle control switch, when some people intrude in the infrared launch area, has the acousto-optic warning, indicated that has achieved the design requirements.

articleTitle: Study to process of urban sprawl using spectral mixture analysis
abstract: The surface feature of urban areas is complex, there is always serious mixed pixel problem of remote sensing image. Traditional classification information extraction methods of urban will produce significant errors. Spectral Mixture Analysis (SMA) has brought hope for high-precision information extraction of urban, this paper studied urban expansion process of Shenyang in 1992-2007 based on SMA. We chose three scenes of Landsat TM/ETM+ remote sensing images of 1992, 2001, 2007, and obtained urban impervious surfaces (ISA) based on SMA, the expansion of urban space was divided into four directions (Northwest, Northeast, Southwest , Southeast). We analyzed the urban expansion process using the difference of ISA results of different years. The results show that ISA change area of low value is always larger than that of high value in the urban expansion process, it means the urban development is a gradual process; urban sprawl direction of Shenyang is mainly to the northwest, northeast and southwest between 1992-2001, to the northeast and southwest direction between 2001-2007. Take 1992-2007 as a whole year range, urban sprawl direction of Shenyang is mainly to the northwest, northeast and southwest, the sprawl area of southeast direction is small. The development of society that accelerating the urbanization process of Shenyang.

articleTitle: Decay of the solution of the nonlinear Kortewey de Vries-Benjamin Ono Burgers equation
abstract: In this paper, we study the asymptotic behavior of the solution to Korteweg de Vries-Benjamin Ono Burgers (Kdv-Bob) equation . It will be proved that L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> norms of the solution tend to zero at certain decay rates as t → ∞, which follow the prior L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> integral estimates and Fourier transform. The standard argument relies on a technique that involves the splitting of the space into time-dependent subdomains.

articleTitle: Solving the definite integration with Haar wavelet
abstract: This paper combines Haar wavelet with operator matrix effectively, discreting the integrand properly, So to those integrations which are not easily obtained the antiderivatives are transformed into the product of constant matrices, while the product of matrices can be achieved directly by MATLAB. Therefore we can obtain the result easily; Four examples are given to demonstrate the simplicity, clarity and powerfulness of the new method.

articleTitle: On compactly supported wavelets when N=7
abstract: Constructions of compactly supported wavelets, whose scaling functions are supported on [0, 7], are studied. Some observations are given for filters relative to these wavelets. For example, if the values of each elements of filters are not in [−0.8, 0.8], relative wavelets will be not good, and generally if the absolute values of one or two elements of filters are larger than 0.5 but smaller than 0.8 while others are relative small, the relative wavelets may be good.

articleTitle: Singular solution of the variable coefficient nonlinear Schrödinger equation
abstract: In this article, two types of transformation are applied to gain three interesting singular potential functions of the variable coefficient nonlinear Schrodinger (VCNLS) equation. Meanwhile, the corresponding concrete expressions of the VCNLS equation are obtained. Through making application of the known soliton solutions of the standard nonlinear Schrodinger (NLS) equation and the two types of transformation, three singular solutions of the VCNLS equations are obtained. The singular solutions in this paper have some similarities with rogue wave and nonautonomous soliton solution.

articleTitle: Exact solutions of traveling wave in three nonlinear Schrödinger Equations
abstract: In this paper, the accurate solutions of coupled traveling waves are founded in three nonlinear Schrodinger Equations with anisotropism. We introduce the undetermined function F(ξ) in the calculation with our codes aided by maple package. Besides, according to the calculation cases, their movement and transmission characteristics are analyzed under the solitary wave input conditions, and finally the new methods of the traveling wave accurate solutions for tri-helix chain protein motion model are revealed.

articleTitle: Design of health monitoring displacement alarm value of Pingsheng Bridge tower with consideration on environment condition
abstract: Displacement monitoring is an important part of long-term health monitoring system of Pingsheng Bridge, and rational design of displacement monitoring alarm value is essential for evaluating health condition and stress performance. The paper is combined with norms to build health monitoring finite element model of Pingsheng Bridge, it takes into account the influence of environmental changes such as temperature, humidity, wind speed and the like on the alarm value considering environmental change, and measurement proves that displacement warning is reasonable and effective. Pingsheng Bridge Health Monitoring displacement monitoring system is established through combining with characteristics of GPS RTK, the system is processed according to the measured data, thereby realizing real time alarm of bridge line shape health state.

articleTitle: An improved historical simulation method to estimate the amount of refined oil retail value at risk VaR
abstract: Value at risk, an effective measurement of financial risk, can be used to forecast the risk associated with amount of refined oil. In this paper, an improved Historical Simulation Approach, HSGF is proposed, which is based on a former approach, HSAF. By comparing it with the HS,HSAF and HSGF approach, this paper give evidence to show that HSGF has a more effective forecasting power in the field of amount of refined oil risk management.

articleTitle: The application of “3 + 1” teaching mode in college physics experiment teaching
abstract: According to the general problems of college physics experiment teaching, we have proposed “3 + l” teaching mode of college physics experiment teaching, expounding the teaching links and its carryover effect. Being aimed at the problem of traditional teaching, we put forward the corresponding proposal after comparing “3 + l” teaching mode of college physics experiment teaching with the traditional teaching.

articleTitle: An approach on liver medical image segmentation based on quad tree
abstract: In this paper we present a medical graph cuts based quad trees segmentation method. Our method is a combination of quad trees decomposition and curve fitting method that improved the shortcomings of the original method. Consequently, it has the following advantages: (1) It has the ability to fill holes that modify the original method defect. (2) Our method guarantees continuity and lead to smooth contours. From experiment results we can know the feasibility and advantages of the method; it is suitable for the actual liver segmentation. Our method also can be the foundation of the subsequent diagnosis.

articleTitle: Boundedness for multilinear commutators of Calderón-Zygmund operator on Hardy spaces
abstract: In this paper, the multilinear commutators of Calderón-Zygmund operator is discussed, and obtain that this kind of multilinear commutators is bounded on Hardy type spaces.

articleTitle: Analysising efficiency in China and foreign insurance firms based on utility Malmquist index
abstract: This paper based on utility theory, use expected utility maximization principle, combined with the Malmquist index to find the optimal efficiency of decision making unit and apply it to analysis the efficiency change in China and foreign property insurance companies in China from 2008 to 2009. The results indicate that this method is also suitable for the insurance industry. What's more, the utility index of China property insurance companies is significantly higher than foreign property insurance companies property insurance companies, the utility approach fits closer to the practice than the input approach and can give more reasonable economic explanation.

articleTitle: Consolidation analysis of composite ground with partially penetrated weak drainage columns considering disturbance
abstract: Based on equal strain assumption, considering the gradual variation of compression modulus and horizontal permeability of disturbed soils, we turned composite ground with partially penetrated weak drainage columns into an equivalent double-layered ground and had an analytical solution. The consolidation behavior of composite ground with partially penetrated weak drainage columns was subsequently investigated in consideration of disturbance.

articleTitle: Quality management of rural and urban planning
abstract: Rural and urban planning encompasses applied, natural, social sciences and the initial study by people from all involved disciplines. The inter-discipline human resource and geographic information system management integration can help resolve conflict while working toward a common project goal in community, quality management, rural and urban development. Quality management can be made easier through the adaptation of GIS information technologies for integration management of professional resources to elevate the disciplines standards in engineering, surveying, planning, design, construction and supervision.

articleTitle: Music identification with KD-tree and melody-line
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel approach for music identification with KD-tree and melody-line. In our method the process has three stages. Firstly, we use the features extracted from training data set to built a KD-tree. Secondly, features extracted from the music in the database, are quantified through the KD-tree into words. Then the words are stored. Meanwhile, the melody-line is also extracted from the music and also stored as a string. Thirdly, when the user gives a fragment song, features are extracted and then quantified the same way in the second stage, so is melody-line. We score the archive according to TF IDF scheme and get the best matches. String macthing of melody line is applied to re-arrange the orders of the best matches. Our contribution also includes a new kind of feature, MFCC Peaks, to acquire an efficient and accurate retrieval. The results of our experiments demonstrate that the accuracy of top5 is 98.54% while the top5 is 99.52%. We also compare our approach with Shazam algorithm and get higher accuracy among all six types of music.

articleTitle: Comprehensive application of environment simulation method in school building design
abstract: Architecture design for green building should be favorable to positive cycle of ambient ecological environment and enhancement of both the local climate and high living environmental quality. The paper presents the optimization methods of architecture in accordance with the results of environment simulation of noise reduction effects and influence on ventilation. In the case of a middle school's design, there are contradictions in solving the problems of noise and ventilation. With adjustments of design and continuous simulations, paper achieves best results. In addition, the paper conducts an indoor luminous environment simulation for classroom, finding problems in usual design method and proposes optimal solutions.

articleTitle: Urban water property management systems and investment countermeasures in Henan Province
abstract: Based on analysis of the present urban water property management, the urban water business investment and structure in Henan Province were studied, which include government, bond, stock, foreign and civil investment, etc. Secondly, the problems existed in the development of cities in Henan Province were analyzed to put forward the main causes of water supply enterprise loss. Finally, the countermeasures of water property reformation and development of cities were studied. The results should play reference value in realization of scientific city planning, improvement of water property policies and water supply and drainage standard, development of multi-investment channels for urban water supply and drainage as well as promotion of urban water supply and drainage and water business market.

articleTitle: An empirical research on the relevance between the growth and tendency of investing of Chinese private-owned listed companies
abstract: In this paper we researched the relationship between the growth and tendency of investment of Chinese private-owned listed companies through empirical method. The result showed evidences that the historical growth of these companies put weak effect on their tendency of investment toward the future. On the other hand, these companies' investments didn't form obviously positive growth in their operating results. These evidences showed that these private-owned listed companies' decision-making of investment were still short of moderatity, high-quanlity and rationality.

articleTitle: Three-level atom in an electromagnetic wave of circle polarization
abstract: We study a three-level atom interacting with an electromagnetic wave of circle polarization, and work out the wave function, the energy values and momentum values of the atom by solving Schrodinger equation.

articleTitle: Performance of a STBC-OFDM system on frequency-selective fading channels
abstract: This paper presents a new technique that is accomplished by a combination of STBC and OFDM technologies, which can reduce Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI). Random inter-leaver introduced into the STBCOFDM system can improve the performance of system under multi-path fading channel and get a reasonable robustness.

articleTitle: Hierarchical linear model and its research on hierarchical characteristics of rainfall
abstract: Hierarchical linear model mainly analyze the effects in different levels and the variance changes of random effects to explore more information and results. In this paper, we do linear regression of monthly rainfall in Beijing area between 1996-2009 with hierarchical linear model. In this way it not only considers the factors affecting the rainfall, but also takes into account the cyclical and seasonal differences in rainfall. By means of a two-layer model, the accuracy of the rainfall regression is improved a lot, and the differences in monthly rainfall are made a good explanation. The results show that, season variability accounts for about 55% of the monthly rainfall variability; Variance of monthly rainfall decreased by 46% when adding the four factors (temperature, sunlight, humidity and air pressure) to level 1; Once fixed the season effects, only a little variance of slope 3(humidity and rainfall) and slope 4(air pressure and rainfall) are not explained.

articleTitle: Study on vibration viscosity coefficient and rheology behavior of concrete
abstract: Developing the research of the construction rheology of cement concrete is the key technology for concrete design and construction. Vibration Viscosity Coefficiens of freshly mixed concrete in different mixing ratio are measured in this paper. The correlation curve of concrete slump and vibration structure viscosity coefficients is obtained. Reasonable values of vibration viscosity coefficients will be selected to meet the the requirements of vibrator slipform construction for concrete materials.

articleTitle: A P2P VoD system based on Scalable Video Coding and Network Coding
abstract: In this paper, we present the design of an unstructured peer-to-peer (P2P) streaming system employing Scalable Video Coding (SVC) and Network Coding (NC). The proposed design enables the customizations of video streams to support heterogeneous receivers, high churn rates, and quick adaptation to network and peers dynamics. Peers with various network conditions, displays and computational capabilities in this P2P streaming system can enjoy different video qualities during the same streaming period. In order to combine the two techniques SVC and NC, a novel packetization method and a new coding scheme is discussed in detail. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme yields a superior visual quality, smoother streaming rates, as well as robustness against high churn rates.

articleTitle: Mapping the variation of Poyang Lake area based on multi-temporal MODIS imagery
abstract: The objective of this paper was to map the spatial and temporal variation of Poyang Lake area in ten years. To achieve this, in total, 460 scenes of 8-day composite images (500-m spatial resolution) during 2001-2010 from the MODIS sensor were used. To improve the accuracy in retrieving the temporal change of lake area, cloud contamination in each image was reduced by the Savitzky-Golay filter. Then, NDVI for each image was calculated and applied to retrieve the lake area by a threshold classification method. The probability of the spatial change of the lake area was calculated subsequently, and the map of the spatial variation of Poyang Lake area was produced, finally. The result showed that statistic on annual area of Poyang Lake had no significant variation during the period of 2001-2010. But the largest lake area was observed in 2010, which is 1397.17 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, while the smallest was observed in 2004, which is 931.57 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. For the seasonal variation of the lake area, the water level of Poyang Lake was highest in summer, while it was lowest in winter. According to the local investigation, the temporal and spatial variation of Poyang Lake could be attributed to the change of precipitation, irrigation, aquaculture and cultivation practices around the study area. However, it concluded that the multi temporal MODIS had advantages in monitoring the spatial and temporal change of lake area, as well as in monitoring the risk of flooding in similar large water areas.

articleTitle: The mathematical optimization model of base materials for taxues cuspidata green branch cutting and rhizogenesis
abstract: The main research of this paper was on the effects of different microcuttage matrixes of taxue cuspidata upon rootting and seeding. Simplex-gravity mixing design was used to optimize microcuttage matrixes. Fifteen kinds of matrixes formula was obtained by combining four ingredients that were garden soil, river sand, sawdust and slag respectively. The growth condition of cutting shoot was investigated by quantitative analysis for root length, root number and root rate, and relevant models were established. In the meantime, the fitting root rate equation, fitting root length equation, fitting root number equation of different matrixes were achieved. Through analysising factor main effect of matrix formula model and optimizing matrix formula, the optimal matrix formula of microcuttage and rooting was obtained, which was mixed 62.07% garden soil and 37.93% river sand. This study provide theoretical guidance and technical support for factory fast breeding of taxue cuspidate.

articleTitle: Apparent shear stress in symmetric-straight compound-channel flows
abstract: Apparent shear stress, which is presented in forms of roughness ratio, width ratio and depth ratio between main channel and flood plain, is quite important in the compound channel flows with the behaviors of momentum transfer on control works for both soil material and contaminate transports. The analytical solutions of apparent shear stress for symmetric-straight compound channel flows both in main channel and flood plain are derived and compared with the results of experimental and numerical outputs. The acceptable tendencies and agreements are presented. The significances of the ratios on roughness, width and depth are discussed for the characteristics of apparent shear stress.

articleTitle: M-ary modulation schemes of UWB communication system based on orthogonal hermite pulses
abstract: The paper analyzes M-ary modulation schemes of time hopping ultra-wideband (TH-UWB) system. Based on the performance analysis of the two conventional multiple modulation schemes TH PPM and TH PAM, a combined modulation scheme (TH OPPM-BPSM) is analyzed. By introducing the modified Hermite polynomial (MHP) orthogonal pulses, three transmission schemes are analyzed through computer simulations under additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel with mutipath effect. From the simulation results, it can be seen that the TH OPPM-BPSM system performance is similar to the TH PPM system, and better than the TH PAM system.

articleTitle: On strong lifting splits
abstract: An ideal I of a ring R is called enabling in R if for any a and e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = e ∈ R, the condition a−e ∈ I implies that a−f ∈ I for some f<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = f ∈ Ra. If the above idempotent e is always chosen so that e = 1, then I is called weakly enabling in R. In this note, a counterexample is given to show that I[x] need not be enabling in R[x] provided that the ideal I of a ring R is enabling in R, answering a question of M. Alkan, W.K. Nicholson, and A.C. Ozcan in the negative. Moreover we show that for any nil ideal I of a ring R, I[x] is enabling in R[x] if and only if I[x] is an exchange general ring if and only if I[x] is a clean general ring, and if and only if the Koethe's Conjecture has a positive solution.

articleTitle: The application of ArcGIS and SketchUp in the virtual campus construction—Case of Shanxi Normal University
abstract: With the development of technology, three dimensional GIS has been used in many fields. Virtual Campus is one of good applications. Shanxi Normal University was taken as the example, using SketchUp and ArcGIS in order to establish three-dimensional virtual campus, study the methods of building DEM models, 3D landscape modes and image processing. The user can view 3D-scene and make some basic spatial analysis. It will be played an important role in development planning, scientific management and the school outside image.

articleTitle: An analytical geometrical model for quasi onedimensional graphene nanomaterials
abstract: We construct an analytical geometrical model for quasi one-dimensional (1D) graphene nanomaterials. The general carbon nanoscrolls (CNSs) model is characterized by a Archimedes spiral line with two construction parameters, the interlayer distance t and the inner radius. Graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) and carbon nanotubes (CNTs) are included in the model for two special cases. A set of analytical expressions are derived for all the coordinates of carbon atoms in a supercell under a three-dimensional (3D) coordinate system. This general geometrical model can be further used to first-principles calculations and simulations of material properties.

articleTitle: Noncontact displacement monitoring of stay cables using videogrammetric method
abstract: For large-scale civil engineering structures, such as cable-stayed bridges, it is difficult to find fixed reference point to measure the vibration displacement, an important parameter for structure safety evaluation in construction and operation. Therefore, it is favorable and necessary to develop a remote noncontact displacement monitoring method for civil engineering structures. Videogrammetric method is an important non-contact method using video-photos to get space information. This paper investigates the digital image processing technology to detect the vibration displacement of structures. We collect videos on target points on the monitored structure, convert them into a series of digital image frames, calibrate the pixel-distance sensitivity, select a speckle on the image frame, locate the speckle using digital speckle correlation method (DSCM) in each image frame to get the coordinate data of the speckle, and finally obtain the vibration displacement of the target points. In this way, we can carry out the continuous monitoring of dynamic displacement and modal analysis of the structures. After introducing the principle of this method, the one-dimensional vibration displacement of a target object excited by a vibration platform is monitored using the videogrammetric method, and verified by comparing the results with a displacement meter. A stay cable scaled from the longest cable-stayed Sutong Bridge is setup for further test. The cable vibration displacement is monitored using the videogrammetric method. The vibration frequencies are obtained from the FFT transformation of the displacement monitoring data, agree well with the theoretical results. It is proved that the present videogrammetric method is effective and feasible for noncontact displacement monitoring of stay cables and other civil engineering structures.

articleTitle: Effect of glass fiber reinforced cement (GRC) and styrene-butadiene emulsion on the property of cement mortar
abstract: The compressive, flexural strength and splitting tensile strength of cement mortars modified by glass fiber reinforced cement (GRC) (0-3% mass fraction) or/and styrene-butadiene emulsion (0-8% mass fraction) at the ages of 3, 28, 90 days were tested, and the impact performance for 28 days cement mortar was also studied. According to this experimental conditions and the results of this study, it can conclude that the fiber can greatly improve the impact property and flexural strength of the styrene butadiene emulsion modified cement mortar. And the more content of fiber, the better effect get in general.

articleTitle: Spin transport through a double quantum-dot system with tunable magnetic field
abstract: The spin transport in a double quantum-dot system with tunable magnetic field was investigated by non-equilibrium Green function method. For two unidentified quantum dots (QDs), it is found that in comparison with the situation without magnetic field on the QDs, the average spin occupations separate with the increase in the magnetic field, which resemble the behaviors as observed in a single-dot system, however, the magnetic field applied on them is only the tenth of that on single dot system. On the other hand, for two identified QDs, the magnetic field has profound effect on the current for different spins in the QDs. Especially for different magnetic fields, the threshold voltage for up spin shifts higher as the difference increasing, while it for down spin is lower. In addition, the spin polarization of current presents correspondingly novel performances, such as, an unexpected dip. It is suggested that the system is a favorable candidate for spintronic devices or external field detectors.

articleTitle: Analysis of fatigue crack growth in RC beams
abstract: In this work, a fatigue crack propagation model developed using dimensional analysis for plain concrete is used in conjunction with the steel closing force to predict the crack growth behavior of reinforced concrete beams. A numerical procedure is followed using the proposed model to compute the fatigue life of RC beams and the dissipated energy in the steel reinforcement due to shake down behavior. Through a sensitivity study, it is found that the structural size is the most sensitive parameter on which the crack growth rate is dependent. Furthermore, the moment carrying capacity of an RC beam is computed as function of crack size by considering the effect of bond slip.

articleTitle: A microwave-induced hydrothermal reaction for the dechlorination of polychlorinated biphenyls
abstract: Microwave heating has been widely accepted in accelerating chemical reactions. A microwave-induced hydrothermal reaction was developed and tested for its effectiveness in the decomposition of polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) in this study. Three simple reactants participated in the microwave-induced hydrothermal reaction, namely iron powder, NaOH and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O. Under microwave heating, NaOH and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O absorbed microwave energy by space charge polarization and dipolar polarization, and the absorbed energy initiated the hydrothermal reaction. X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis found Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/NaFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and confirmed the occurrence of microwave induced hydrothermal reaction, during which hydrogen was released. The newly produced hydrogen was used for the dechlorination of PCBs. The effects of important factors on the dechlorination degree were investigated, and the dechlorination mechanism was suggested.

articleTitle: Research on college physical education teaching methods in multimedia environment
abstract: The application of multimedia teaching, remote network teaching and other technologies has been extensive in other disciplines, but the use of computer technology in sports teaching needs improvement. Therefore, how to combine computer network technology with the characteristics of PE teaching is particularly important. PE teaching can become more vivid and direct by adopting computer network technology. Its diversified, integrated and interactive features play an important role in improving teaching efficiency, arousing student's enthusiasm, reforming traditional teaching concept, teaching methods and teaching modes. Through literature review, expert interview and logic analysis, the article makes related researches on college PE teaching under the computer network environment, and provides theoretical reference to realize the teaching goal.

articleTitle: Modeling characteristic analysis of digital simulation confucius temple based on new media aesthetic context
abstract: Confucius temple is the festival temple for confucius who was the founder of Confucianism.But also the publicity sites of Confucian culture. All of the confucius temple have to show the Confucian aesthetics' characteristics by civil engineering shape of beauty.Newmedia digital aesthetic characteristics of the ancient buildings shape begins to show from the integration of digital technology.The paper describes the characteristics of the new media context which explained the traditional temple plastic arts and the content of culture. Production process of digital confucius temple and the characteristics of the process' aesthetic. Purpose of the research is to provide theoretical support and the method of preservation, display and dissemination of Confucian Temple. Through to Creating a virtual space and aesthetic forms of interaction between people and architecture. Digital simulation confucius temple based on new media aesthetic context will satisfy people's aesthetic experience.

articleTitle: Discussion on low-carbon urban planning technologies and strategies of mountain towns of Western Hubei based on urban ecology
abstract: This paper analyzed the characteristics of carbon sources and carbon sinks of Western Hubei urban, combined with the features of low-carbon city, and revered to the law of urbanization underdevelopment mountainous town of western Hubei. We combined low-carbon technology urban planning with the theory of urban ecology, and tried to increase income and decrease expenditure, and strengthen self-repairing function of urban ecosystem by the follows: Town planning policy guidance and support, Rational distribution of urban spatial structure, Construction of Urban infrastructure and Energy-saving building. From all aspects to control, reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions. In order to ensure their stability and sustainability, the virtuous circle of ecology, economy and society, protect the city healthy and sustainable progress.

articleTitle: Application of strut-and-tie model in design of concrete structural engineering
abstract: Features and establishing method and the state of the art of strut- and-tie models are briefly introduced, the current research areas in domestic and foreign are pointed out. The purpose of the proper and system strut- and-tie models are established by scientific and technical persons so that the strut and -tie model is applied better in design of concrete structural engineering.

articleTitle: FPGA based Frame Packing Decoder for Diamond DMD
abstract: The latest HDMI1.4a Specification standardizes 3D formats, which conform the HDMI devices to be universal with each other. These 3D formats cover most of the consumer electronic 3D devices such as 3D blue-ray player, 3D game machine, 3D set-top box, etc. However, there is still no ASIC solution to Full-Support HDMI1.4a 3D formats presently. In this paper, a low-cost solution based on FPGA has been proposed to support the display of Frame Packing 3D format on DLP projector. Frame Packing is one of the main 3D formats defined by HDMI1.4a, and it is commonly adopted by the 3D blue-ray players and game machines.

articleTitle: The ecological concept in Yunnan vernacular architecture and settlement
abstract: With the development of economy, mainkaind is facing a severe test in solving the problems of environment and development. The sustainable living environment becomes a great research project. The multiple forms of yunnan traditional dwellings and environment reflect the balanced development of residential houses ,cultural background and natural ecology, forming regional context and system. This article elaborates on the layout of Yunnan settlements, architecture form, as well as the ecology of natural architecture materials, so as to put forward the ecological perspective using traditional houses for reference. It also can be taken for example on modern architectural and environmental design and open new realms of living environment consciousness.

articleTitle: The optimization of security algorithm selection for wireless communications in UMTS
abstract: In UMTS (Universal Mobile Terrestrial System), the algorithms used in encryption and integrity protection for data transferred on the radio link are various [1], from which one optimized algorithms shall be selected by RNC (Radio Network Controller) to use. The selecting procedure is followed as: SGSN (Service GPRS Support Node) sends the list of allowed algorithms to RNC in order of preference according to the operator's policy, one with encryption algorithms and the other with integrity protection algorithms; RNC selects the highest preference algorithm from the list of allowed algorithms that matches any of the algorithms supported by the MS (Mobile Subscriber ). The paper does a research on the existing algorithm selection procedure, presenting its potential problems, and putting forwards the optimization solution.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Reflectance Characteristics for corn canopy in different fertilization in irrigated area of Hexi corridor, Northwest China
abstract: Diagnosis of crop growth and nutrient status is critical for prediction of agriculture yield and quality at Growth stage, one experiments, in 2010 were conducted to find out corn canopy spectral characters in different fertilization non-destructively measurement and for assessing nutrition status non-destructively at Zhangye irrigated area of Hexi corridor northwest China. The results revealed that the spectral differences are clear for the canopy and leaves of corn under different fertilizer levels in near infrared region, and the canopy spectral reflectance are similar in the visible region. In the different growth stage, the hyperspectral reflectance of the canopy level are different, and that of the canopy is highest at heading stage and lowest at seven-leaf stage in near infrared region and in the shortwave and the spectral variation trend is reverse, meanwhile, that is highest at seven-leaf stage. And the reflectance in visible region is not notable in grown stage. Canopy spectral reflectance difference is obviously in infrared and the shortwave region; this indicates the possibility to identify the fertilizer type using the hyperspectral reflectance data.

articleTitle: Study on land consolidation project to improve residential environment A case study of Shishi town, Fushun County, Sichuan province in China
abstract: Residential environment improvement is the important part in new rural construction. Land consolidation can bring great fortune for rural development, thereinto, the land consolidation project to improve residential environment is the most important tasks in the study of land consolidation project at present. This paper takes the land consolidation project in Shishi town, Fushun County, Zigong city, Sichuan province (Zhumi village and Maitu village) for example, then analyzes and evaluates the residential environment improvement effect of land consolidation project.

articleTitle: Addressing low-carbon city construction in climate change mitigation and prevention in China
abstract: As the population of China becomes more urbanized, cities will continue to expand, unknowingly igniting the multi-dimensional vulnerability of human settlements. Sustainable urban settlement requires serious manifestation in the form of low-carbon city construction. The growing urbanization trend, especially in mountain areas and in coastal areas, makes the search for policy solutions acute. Climate change and accelerating urbanization demand urgent formulation and implementation of rational adaptation strategies supported by good governance, urban planning and management, including the application of new building codes and other appropriate laws designed to ensure minimal greenhouse gas emissions.

articleTitle: The Global Interval Type-2 Fuzzy C-Means clustering algorithm
abstract: The Interval Type-2 Fuzzy C-Means clustering algorithm (IT2FCM) is one of the algorithms for clustering based on optimizing a target function, which is sensitive to initial conditions. Aiming at this problem, we propose the Global Interval Type-2 Fuzzy C-Means (GIT2FCM) clustering algorithm which is not only independent on any initial conditions by dynamically increasing cluster center, but also achieves optimal clustering purposes by global search. Experiments show that the Global Interval type-2 Fuzzy C-Means clustering algorithm has better experiment results by overcoming sensibility to initial value, and improves the accuracy of clustering.

articleTitle: Distributed geographic information data sharing by service aggregation
abstract: With the demand for geospatial information applications developing, more and more departments own their spatial data and business logic capabilities in the form of web service publishing. Based on geographic information sharing platform and dynamic service aggregation ideas, we launch a service aggregation model combining OGC standards and REST-style services. Through the service aggregation model, it makes heterogeneous tile data of distributed storage display seamlessly, achieves function sharing of Web Feature Service.

articleTitle: Study on the status of subgrade engineering in permafrost region during the early operation of the Qinghai-Tibet railway
abstract: The Golmud-Lhasa section of the Qinghai-Tibet railway (QTR) is 1,142 Km long, of which 550 Km is in permafrost region. Studies on the status of subgrade engineering in permafrost region are complicated by the intervention of temperature and water and railway operating conditions. Based on in-site investigation and monitoring during the early operation of the QTR, we studied the status of subgrade engineering from three aspects, subgrade deformation, geothermal changes and hydrothermal conditions, and proposed solutions to subgrade cracks to ensure railway safety and conservation.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on outdoor thermal environment based on lumped parameter model
abstract: Simulating the outdoor thermal environment of Exhibition Center in Taizhou with the improved lumped parameter model to quantitatively analyze the contribution ratio of underlying surface materials, green and shading types for lowering the heat island intensity. The results show that tree shading improving the thermal environment is the most obvious, the second is water.

articleTitle: Improved coherence-enhancing diffusion with hybrid diffusion tensor
abstract: Coherence-enhancing diffusion (CED), based on analysis of oriented structures, has been extensively used in image processing. This diffusion filtering can keep some junctions and close broken linear structures, but it also destroys crease points and deforms nonlinear structures. In this paper, we proposed an improved algorithm for CED based on analysis of structure tensor and Hessian matrix. This approach can not only denoise and enhance linear structures such as edges, but also preserve nonlinear structures such as creases. Experiments with fingerprint image show that the improved CED outperforms classical CED.

articleTitle: A forward certificateless ring signature scheme
abstract: Certificateless public key cryptography reduces the difficult problem of key management in traditional public key cryptography,it also eliminates the key-escrow problem of identity-based cryptography and also preserves all of its advantages. A the lowest calculating time forward secure ring signature scheme is proposed,it can resist forgery attacks from the secret key generation center and can meet with the requirements of unconditional anonymity of signers, it can resist forgery attacks as the secret keys of signer is revealed ,so it is suitable to the application of high security and anonymity.

articleTitle: The design and calculation on strength tests of 500kV guyed transmission tower under static wind load
abstract: Guyed transmission tower is a common form used in transmission lines. The unreasonable design can cause the components of the guyed transmission tower instability, or even falling tower accidents in the subsequent operation and maintenance. It will lead to a lot of danger, long time outage and utilization rate of equipment not meeting the requirements to use free-standing tower replace guyed transmission tower, In the case of electricity demand exceeding supply, the outages reform of 500kV transmission lines is especially difficult. We find out the causes of the tower components instability and the tower pour accidents based on guyed transmission tower test, and puts forward corresponding solutions.

articleTitle: Research on the teaching reform of the courses of engineering graphics and computer drawing for application-oriented undergraduate
abstract: The article has analyzed engineering graphics and computer drawing two course reciprocities in Application-oriented Undergraduate, proposes two curriculum organic synthesis educational reform measure. The practice indicated that the engineering graphics and computer drawing curriculum unify the educational reform is more advantageous in the student stimulates the study interest and the enhancement study efficiency, is advantageous in raising student's spatial imagination, Reading and drawing ability Knowledge of integrated applied abilities. The teaching effect is good.

articleTitle: Fractal characteristics of land use struture dynamic changes in urban fringe area-A case study of the extended south area of Guangzhou
abstract: Over the past two decades, with the rapid urbanization in Guangzhou, urban fringe area has been experiencing drastic land use changes. In this paper, taken the extended south area of Guangzhou as a typical urban fringe area example, land use structure and fractal model of the study area in 1990, 1995, 2000 and 2005 have been established from Landsat TM images by adopting GIS and RS technology. Dynamic degree, fractal dimension and stability index of the main land use types in each year are calculated. The results show that: from 1990 to 2005, land use of the extended south area of Guangzhou was experiencing significant changes under the strong forces of urbanization of core area in Guangzhou. According to the changes characteristics of land use, two phases of change can be interpreted: First, from 1990 to 1995, the structure of land use was changing drastically. In this period, the increase of construction land and decrease of farmland are the dominant processes, which greatly increased the fractal dimension and decreased the stability index. Second, from 1995 to 2005, changing speed of land structure was slowing down, farmland and forestry started to increase, along with the increase of fractal dimension and stability index became slighter, regional structure change of land use started to present a positive tendency.

articleTitle: The choice of wavelet bases in electrocardiogram compression algorithm
abstract: This paper is associated with the choice of wavelet bases in electrocardiogram compression. The integer-to-integer wavelet transform in the algorithm, the zero-tree coding and the adaptive arithmetic coding in electrocardiogram is used. The wavelet library is composed of nine wavelets. The MIT-BIH arrhythmia database is used to test the algorithm. The experiment results show that it can significantly reduce the signal distortion by selecting optimal wavelet bases for each segment electrocardiogram in compression algorithm.

articleTitle: The preservation of historical villages in China With Ruyayang village in Ningbo as an example
abstract: In history, ancient post-road, water transport, religion center and rich clan always can bring prosperity to local area. Taking Ruyayang as an example, this paper analyze its historical environment, historic building, streets, and other historic sites detailedly to get the core value of the historic village. Small-scale and centralized management are the traits of villages. Based on those characteristics, This paper expounds the meaning, aims, principles, and contents of the historical village's planning. Faced with the loss of village vitality, the aging of population, ancient architecture desolation, negative villagers, local culture's dying out and other difficulties. This article point out some strategies, solutions and suggestions to preservation and develop the historical villages.

articleTitle: Research of P2P traffic identification based on traffic characteristics
abstract: The P2P traffic plays a important role in promoting the Internet applications. Meanwhile, P2P has also caused network congestion and safety problems because of resource occupation. To ensure the network run properly, it is necessary to have a control over the P2P traffic. However, with the emergence of dynamic port and SSL technology, P2P traffic identification has become even more challenging. This paper briefly introduces the main technologies of P2P traffic identification including the routing ways such as port scanning, deep packet inspection and transport layer identification, and makes a heavy weight on the analysis about the reasons of low efficiency of the technique based upon P2P traffic characteristics. Finally, this method shows high efficiency of P2P traffic identification in the test experiment.

articleTitle: Stochastic resonance image processing based on a new piecewise hybrid model
