abstract: In this paper, we put forward a new piecewise hybrid system, and explore the methods for processing image data with the principle of stochastic resonance so as to improve the quality of images with noise. We focus on studying the influence caused by model parameters on the output histogram of the system, and through the method of numerical simulation, we put the periodic signal, image signal without noise and image signal with noise into the new stochastic resonance system respectively to find the changes and influence of the new model to the input signals. The result shows that the proposed model is effective for improving image quality with reasonable parameters.

articleTitle: Study on quantitative evaluation of development engineering value of lake tourism resource
abstract: Evaluation on development engineering value of lake tourism resource has been becoming an important part of the study of lake tourism, it is foundation for the lake tourism development, and it is also a level measurement for the development potential of lake tourism resource. The evaluation is not just limited to distinct values of lake, but also concerns the regional environmental quality and development conditions which decide the value of tourism development. In this paper, on the basis of the full definition of lake tourism and lake tourism resource, and the characteristics of lake tourism resource, we construct evaluation index system of development engineering value of lake tourism resource, by the methods just as Delphi method, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, which contains twenty-four specific indexes, then determines the weighting of each index quantitatively. At the same time according to different values the tourism resource has been divided into four different development grades to establish a method for tourism resource appraisal. The study can provide technical support and instruct references for the scientific and rational development of lake tourism resource.

articleTitle: Study on web-based stream media courseware make for college self-regulated learner
abstract: This paper first analysis the type of courseware for college web-based self-regulated learning, then choose streamauthor as the tool for making the courseware for web-based self-regulated learners, and introduce how to do, last analysis the courseware must to be integrated with the existing network education resources.

articleTitle: Solution of Schrödinger equation with time-dependent potential in non-commutative phase space
abstract: In this paper, the Schrodinger equation of time-dependent potentials has been studied in noncommutative phase space. As an example, the analytical solution of time-dependent harmonic oscillator has been obtained.

articleTitle: A note on three comparison principles obtained by X.Wang, G.Wang and X.He
abstract: In this note, we first give three counterexamples to the comparison principles obtained by X. Wang and J. Zhang (in Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics 234 (2010) 3261–3267), by G. Wang, G. Song and L. Zhang (in the same journal 225 (2009) 602–611) and by X. He, J.Xie and G. Chen (in International Journal of Mathematical Analysis 3 (2009) 1997–2007), respectively. Then we suggest and show corrected versions of the comparison principles.

articleTitle: Charming village landscape, sweet daily life-Take rural tourism planning in Xichang, China as an example
abstract: Rural spaces are no longer associated purely with agricultural commodity production but are seen as locations for the stimulation of new socio-economic activity. In this case, Xichang was taken as an example of rural tourism planning. We analysed the advantage of natural resources and categories and culture. The idea is that “festival activities + sightseeing holiday + rural leisure + fitness regimen” is the suitable mode for Xichang rural tourism. Moreover, it are four main function subarea that northern historical and cultural touring area, rural central flavor swim area, southern folk customs experience area, and ring lakeside water rest resort area. The four function subarea make sure the abundant tourism space and charming village landscape. Furthermore, an integrated system of tourism production might be ensure the income of local residents that is the source of sweet life.

articleTitle: The automorphism and simple quality of the generalized Virasoro-like Lie algebra
abstract: In this paper, an infinite dimensional Lie algebra is studied and the infinite dimensional of Lie algebras appear in the fields of conformal theory, mathematical physics, statistic mechanics and Hamilton operator. The infinite dimensional Lie is popularized of Virasoro-like Lie algebra. Isomorphisms, morphisms, ideal of the infinite dimensional Lie algebra are studied.

articleTitle: The study on middle east railway architectural complex' systematic protection
abstract: The Middle East railway is in order to plunder and tsarist invasion of China and controlling the far .The east and in the Chinese territory of building a railway. In 1899, the Middle East Railway construction for the twins began in 1901, double the castle stood, built five Stand, Ann west station was built in 1902, Syria, was built in 1903 standing edges of hezekiah Stand, in the same year July 14, the Middle East railway was completed and opened to traffic for business, Minnesota Via the twins county within the territory of the five, xi, double castle, hezekiah, blue edges Stand. The whole territory north as a bridge, south to pull well, was 54 railways anti easy-restoration degree Kilometers. The period of the republic of Middle East railway line called south regional; Change the puppet For BeiMan railway jing-bin lines; After the founding of the northeast railway, instead Long term. More than 100 years, because of bad, add various kinds of natural disaster Harm, man-made destruction and other reasons, the twins buildings facing built Middle East railway Repair, structure built aging, tilt collapse, use environment, and is bad Reform the danger such as broken down. Especially in recent years national large-scale construction iron Network, double track laying, high speed railway, the construction of the Middle East along the railway to build Build or grilled drop, or reconstruction, a direct threat to the Middle East railway among the deposit In. Add in heilongjiang province social economy development level in the long run, lag behind State, a serious lack of funds, and the Middle East railway complex whole protection It is imperative to work.

articleTitle: Study of IP core based on precision time protocol
abstract: This paper describes a design idea of Precision Time Protocol IP core, which is different from traditional method of software implementation. Design gives prominence to adopt digital logic circuit to achieve getting of precision time stamp, synchronization algorithm and quartz oscillator frequency-compensated algorithm and state-transfer controlled algorithm, And make use of oscillator's divided frequency adjusted to reduce influence of oscillator's frequency-excursion and circumstance factor to precision and stability of synchronization. The result of the function test indicates that it has higher synchronization precision than software implementation.

articleTitle: Class-preserving Coleman automorphisms of finite AQTI-groups
abstract: A subgroup H of a finite group G is called a QTI-subgroup if C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</inf>(x) ≤ N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</inf>(H) for any 1 ≠ x ∈ H. Let G be an AQTI-group, i.e. a group all of whose abelian subgroups are QTI-subgroups. It is shown that every class-preserving Coleman automorphism of G is an inner automorphism. As an immediate consequence, we obtain that the normalizer property holds for such groups G.

articleTitle: An improved clustering for action recognition in online video
abstract: A new method for human action recognition in online video sequences using Latent Dirichlet Markov Clustering (LDMC) is proposed. Video sequences are represented by a novel “bag-of-words” representation, and each frame corresponds to a “word”. LDMC builds on Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) and Latent Dirichlet Allocation, and it overcome their low recognition rate, robustness and high computational complexity. A collapsed Gibbs sampler is designed for offline learning with unlabeled training data, and a new approximation to online Bayesian inference is formulated to enable human action recognition in new online video sequence in real-time. The strength of this model is demonstrated by unsupervised learning of human action categories and detecting salient actions in one complex and crowded public scenes.

articleTitle: Application of morphological method in the informal living space analysis
abstract: Within the context of the thoughts of city regular construction and development, grasping the growth mechanism of spontaneous evolution of informal living space and the corresponding development strategies of effective control and conduct make it possible for us to explore another possibility of humanized thought and sustainable development of living space in terms of development of urban residential construction. This article is an actual example investigation on informal living space of Wuhan, by researching the actual state of a specific crowd, dynamic development space structure and identifiable system of space form, expecting to think about the structural forms problems of urban informal living space from the perspective of the morphologic, providing new ideas of urban renewal for corresponding areas.

articleTitle: Intelligent network system research and construction program
abstract: The paper firstly introduces the basic conception of intelligent network and the four-layer network structure of intelligent network, then analyzes the three key technologies in intelligent network with emphases, including control of call management, realization of charge system and security management of intelligent network platform. On the basis of this, a device layout scheme of intelligent network platform is proposed, and a scheme in which intelligent network links network management center, charge center, business hall and third-party database is designed.

articleTitle: Applications of Internet resources in college English teaching
abstract: With the development of the Internet in China, it is possible for us to apply Internet resources to improve college English teaching. This paper summarizes the Internet resources appropriate for college English teaching, illustrates the advantages of applications of Internet resources and provide suggestions about how to apply Internet resources in college English teaching.

articleTitle: Photocatalytic degradation of rhodamine B by TiO2/SBA-15 nanocomposites
abstract: The TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SBA-15 composites with various titania contents were prepared by loading titania into the SBA-15 molecular sieves via a sol-gel method. The prepared TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SBA-15 composites were characterized by XRD, N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-adsorption, and UV-vis techniques. It is shown that titania crystalline type is anatase phase. The BET surface area and pore volumes of the composites decrease with the increase of titania loading, while average crystal size of anatase phase particles increases with increasing titania loading. The photocatalytic degradation of rhodamine B was used as a probe reaction to evaluate the photoactivity of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SBA-15 composites. Experimental results indicate that the degradation of rhodamine B over the composites followed first-order reaction kinetics, and the composites exhibited higher photoactivity. The photocatalytic activity of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SBA-15 composites depend on the adsorption ability of the composites and the photocatalytic activity of titania loaded in SBA-15 molecular sieves.

articleTitle: Prediction of household food retail prices based on ARIMA Model
abstract: Predictions of retail prices of household foods bear positive meanings in enhancing the living standard of residents. In our paper, first we subdivided the 41 kinds of household food into 5 subcategories basing on trends of their price movements during 2010 to 2011: Smoothly Rising, Rising with Fluctuations, Stable, Horizontal Fluctuating and Concave. Next, we structured separate ARIMA models for each subcategory, and applied such models to predict the prices of the respective subcategories in April and May of 2011. The results suggest that the ARIMA models can produce good simulations and predictions of the retail prices of foods: that the prices of all subcategories of household foods basically preserve an upward trend. The paper concludes with advice on relative policies by the author based on the results obtained, with reference values to the concerned government divisions and relevant parties.

articleTitle: Determination of optimum parameters of A2N two-sludge system
abstract: The experiment dealt with the best anaerobic, anoxic running time with using denitrification and phosphorus removal technology in SBR, at the same time, under the optimal anaerobic/anoxic time combination, the effect of the system on removal of contaminant was also investigated. The results showed that the best anaerobic, anoxic running time was 90min and 180min. The system optimal sludge age was 22d.

articleTitle: Two decades variation about ionospheric parameters foF2, foE and M3000F2
abstract: The rules of ionosphere is important in the study of space weather, here three series of ionospheric vertical sounding stations locating in different latitude are selected, in the comparison of the time variations of Δ foF2, Δ foE, Δ M3000F2 during score years of two stations locating in the nearly same latitude, some rules have been found, some of which are not only attributed to the sun but also attributed to the troposphere.

articleTitle: P2P-based video conferencing security management strategy
abstract: A peer-to-peer (P2P) architecture for video conferencing has great prospects for development. The security of the system, however, poses a set of significant challenges. In order to ensure the transmission security of the information of the video conferencing system P2P-based, in this paper, we report a set of new security architecture, and establish the corresponding security management strategy by introducing security levels, encryption algorithms and the strategy tree.

articleTitle: Simulation of actual runoff using remote sensing driven distributed hydrological model
abstract: In this paper, a remote sensing-drived distributed water balance and water transport model (RSWB/WTM) based on WBM/WTM (Water balance model/Water transport model) model is developed. Using precipitation and evaportranpiration data retrieved from remote sensing, the monthly discharge of three hydrological stations (Fuping, Zhongtangmei and Zijingguan) in Baiyangdian Lake Basin was simulated. Then the accuracy of the model was evaluated using Nash and Sutcliffe model efficiency coefficients (E (NS)) and R2. The E (NS) for all stations is above 0.54, among which Zhongtangmai and Zijingguan are larger than 0.62. The R2 are 0.56, 0.64 and 0.64 for Fuping, Zhongtangmei and Zijingguan respectively. In recent years, human activities have affected the natural water balance in Baiyangdian largely, thus the accuracy of the model was much influenced. It is also affected by the quality of the remote sensing retrieved data. It is hoped that the RSWB/WTM model and its application in Baiyangdian basin can provide a useful tools for the water resource assessment based on remote sensing data.

articleTitle: Enlightenments of architectural space to modern landscape architecture
abstract: In the early 20th century, landscape design relatively delayed in the modernism process as compared with architectural design. By a comparative study on the documents and works, it can be found that it is of great significance that modernism architecture enlightens modern landscape design on the concept of “space”. The article also clarifies the enlightenments of architectural space on the means of modern landscape design.

articleTitle: Establishment of warning system of greenhouse rose diseases based on visual C++
abstract: Though the use of mixed programming of Visual C++ language and Matlab software, it realizes the optimization of the warning system of BP neural network model that is based on genetic algorithm. This system can not only quickly query into the diseases incidence about rose powdery mildew, downy mildew, gray mold, it also can predict index of the disease inflection rate of greenhouse rose diseases. It provides convenient operation for the user, and the system has features like good openness, independence etc. It provides technical support and solutions for early warning and forecast of greenhouse rose diseases.

articleTitle: Model parameter identification of discharge structure based on HHT
abstract: The application of Hilbert-Huang Transform method for modal parameters identification to hydraulic structure is investigated in this paper, according to measurement data of the response time histories under discharge excitation. To avoid mode mixing, the signal is band-pass filter firstly. Then the natural frequencies and modal damping ratios of the arch dam are identified using HHT method in combination with measurement. The results are demonstrated that HHT is effective to extract a more intensive two-order of the arch dam for hydraulic structures.

articleTitle: Study of face detection technology based on Davinci platform
abstract: A face detection method is presented based on Davinci platform. This paper adopts Adaboost algorithm to locate face, which is operated on TI TMS320DM6446. The results indicate that the method presented has good accuracy and quick speed for realtime application.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of tide flat topography evolution based on optic flow method
abstract: The aim of this study is to examine the feasibility of the optic flow method in motion of tide flat in the Yellow sea of China. The Landsat TM image is used in construction of optic flow. First,the TM image is registered and corrected. Second, the HS method is applied in optic flow construction. Last, analysis of optic flow results shows that optic flow is a good method for representing motion trend. Generally, this experiment demonstrates that the accuracy of the method is acceptable. It is a promising alternative to describe the change of tide flat topography.

articleTitle: The research of ecological pattern construction based on ecological infrastructure valuation
abstract: Opportunities and strategies for sustainable development have been significantly challenged by global climate change, the recent economic recession and the rapid urbanization. One of the most critical issues for China and the World continues to be demand for limited resources and the determination on how to create a sustainable approach of planning and management. With the emergence of the concept of ecological infrastructure (EI) in 1980s, greater attention has been given to an integrated and systematic solution to regional and urban ecological and environmental problems. In view of the policies energy saving and emission reduction and environmental impact assessment and the vision of building of low-carbon city and eco-city, the strategy of ecological infrastructure has been played an important approach to the ecological pattern construction. This paper proposes a four-step ecological pattern construction approach to develop synthetic solutions to the regional ecological and environmental problems based on theory of ecological infrastructure. Taking the Jiujiang city of Jiangxi province as an example, the study demonstrates how to use ecological infrastructure as a method to guide and frame ecological pattern construction.

articleTitle: Current situation analysis and rehabilitation method research of a tumulus
abstract: For the structure safety, the rehabilitation necessity and the repair particularity of one thousand years tumulus, based on current condition investigation and mechanical performance testing of composition materials, the finite software, ANSYS, was used to simulate analysis on the stress of the repair conditions. Considering the analysis results and the using function, the method of low pressure osmotic grouting was used to rehabilitate the main structure of tumulus, and the way of using pile structure in close layout was selected to prevent leakage of grave.

articleTitle: Acquisition and preprocessing of hand vein image
abstract: Hand vein biometric identification technology has become a new research direction in domestic and international identification system. The set of hand vein image acquisition devices was designed and the light source parameters were optimized according to the image mean and standard deviation. Image preprocessing algorithm was used to further improve the image quality. Threshold method was used to remove the image background, and the image gray was normalized. It is show that the high-quality images can be obtained by using Optimized parameters acquisition device and image preprocessing procedure. The image acquisition system and pre-processing algorithm provide a good platform for further vein image feature extraction and matching.

articleTitle: Researches into regional ecological service values based on land use changes: A case study of Kongming Township, Qionglai City
abstract: Based on the case of Kongming Township, Qionglai City, this paper analyzes the changes of land use in the research area between 1996 and 2008; moreover, with the Costanza method and in combination with Xie Gaodi's ecosystem services value coefficient, the regional ecosystem services values are assessed and their coefficients of sensitivity are analyzed. The results show that the land use changes between 1996 and 2008 have damaged the ecosystem service functions of that region; the ecosystem services value decreased from RMB 359.80 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> yuan in 1996 to RMB 348.78 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> yuan in 2008, down by RMB 11.02 × 105 yuan; the coefficients of sensitivity - CS of value coefficient of land use type are all less than 1, indicating that the ecosystem services value lacks flexibility to the ecosystem service coefficient. Comparatively, the changes of the total value of ecosystem service are the most sensitive to the changes of forest land and then to the cultivate land; they are the least sensitive to the changes of transportation land.

articleTitle: The pupil location based on the Laplace operator and region-growing
abstract: In this paper we present a pupil location method based on the Laplace operator and region-growing. Firstly, it finds a point in the pupil by gray summing operator for ensuring the beginning point of region-growing in the pupil, then it adopts Laplace operator to sharpen the image and reduce the interference of eyelash and eyelid for region-growing. Thirdly it ensures the pupil area by region-growing method and gets binary image. Finally in the binary image it uses Hough transform in certain area to fit the pupil edge. 756 eye images comprising an eye image database are located, our algorithm reaches 100% at accuracy. What is more, it ensures the robustness of location.

articleTitle: Invariant features for dice recognition across illumination
abstract: A system is proposed for the recognition of the dot numbers on dice in general table game settings. Different from previous dice recognition systems which use a single top-view camera and work only under controlled illumination, the proposed one uses multiple cameras and works for uncontrolled illumination. The proposed system exploits the local invariant features robust to illumination variation and good for building the homographies between multiple viewpoints. The homographies can enhance coplanar features and weaken non-coplanar features, giving a way to segment the top surfaces of the dice. A coarse-to-fine search with a shape-dependent local descriptor is designed to identify the dots on the segmented top surfaces and recognize their spatial distribution patterns. Experiments show that the proposed system can achieve a superb recognition rate for various uncontrolled illumination conditions.

articleTitle: An auto way to categorize image
abstract: Auto categorizing is very important in computer image recognition technology. Texture is one of the keys to resolve it. Similar to human's rational intelligence is one of way to approach auto category. In this paper, we describe the common texture by analysis and term in categories theory. It means categories are useful for textures and image recognition. The combination of categories and neural network is worth to research which will gradually reveal the unity way of human's percept and rationality.

articleTitle: Discussion on the interior design
abstract: Along with the raising level of social material, people put forward higher request of living space environment. Interior design changed from the initial blind design to personalized design. With concise design principle, interior design makes a holistic design in order to express the resident's life connotation and to create a comfortable and cozy living environment. Based on a residential interior decoration, this paper introduces the integration and split of Chinese living space from design to details of design.

articleTitle: A study on “Every Village Bus” utilization and person consciousness in ShangHai city
abstract: This paper selected a part of Xujing No.3 buses' users and residents along the site as respondents. During two-year's operation, the problems and deficiencies of Xujing No.3 bus can be found out and its users' personal property, characteristics and other conditions may be comprehended by questionnaire surveys and field visits. This paper consist of three parts: fistly, we introduce paper's background and purpose;Secondly we analyse bus utilizaition from viewpoint what are users' attribute analysis and the classificatory morphological analysis and the elaborate effects of Xujing No.3 bus; finally we analyse bus users evaluate Xujing No.3 bus.

articleTitle: The research and practice of social learning
abstract: This paper describes the concept of social learning, analysis the characteristics of social learning, and discusses the Learning Decentralization and its impact of training department of the organization, proposed the “Training as a service” concept, from the point of view on learning theory, discuss the deep reason of how social learning increase the effectiveness of study; Then, from a sociological point of view, this article discusses the advantages of the enterprise to create social study circles and promote the informal learning.

articleTitle: Energy-saving design in architectural decoration
abstract: Unreasonable designs in Architectural decoration tend to produce environmental pollution in many ways. It is important to make research into the building materials, understand the requirements of energy-saving design. In order to realize the energy-saving design of architectural decoration, the procedures including quality testing, choosing and designing of environment-friendly materials should be should be emphasized, and investment in environmental protection increased and environment-friendly production encouraged.

articleTitle: Uniqueness of a nontrivial solution for third-order nonlinear p-Laplacian m-point eigenvalue problems on time scales
abstract: In this paper, we study the uniqueness of a nontrivial solution for third-order nonlinear p-Laplacian m-point eigen-value problems on time scales. We obtain several sufficient conditions of the uniqueness of nontrivial solution. Our approach is based on the Leray-Schauder nonlinear alternative. A example to demonstrate our main result is also given.

articleTitle: An audio classification and speech recognition system for video content analysis
abstract: Audio can provide useful information for video content analysis. Audio classification and speech recognition for video content analysis is proposed in this paper. Firstly, audio data from video stream is extracted. Secondly, the audio frames are classified into silence, speech and music based on rules and Support Vector Machine(SVM) algorithm. Finally, an automatic speech recognition(ASR) system is applied for speech-to-text conversion. The experimental result on CCTV_NEWS of TRECVID shows that our approach is effective.

articleTitle: A method research on atmosphere molecule extinction optical depth
abstract: To achieve the accurate atmosphere aerosol extinction optical depth in area of climate and image inversion, the calculation of atmosphere molecule extinction optical depth was researched. A solving model for atmosphere molecule extinction optical depth was established, and every sub-model was simulated. Compared the results calculated by the model and the results calculated by PcModWin, relative error is within 5%. That provides the model for atmosphere molecule extinction optical depth is feasible and the model will be a foundation for engineering.

articleTitle: The anylysis of the royal garden feature of Parhae — Take the east garde of Shang Jing palace for an example
abstract: Parhae was built by the minority regime during the Tang Dynasty of China, Which had a good reputation for being the “Prosperous City of Sea East”. The key culture of the Tang Dynasty is embodied by the city, the architecture and the garden cultures, and as the main cultural factors of the Parhae culture, which also interpret the rich regional cultural feature. With the royal garden of Bohai Shangjing palace-east inner garden as the research subject, garden methods such as the garden art language, the space, the view are analyzed by the theoretical knowledge of architecture archaeology and landscape architecture in detailed, in order to reveal the art feature and level of the royal garden of Parhae.

articleTitle: Gasification as a new thermal processes of sewage sludge utilization
abstract: Disposal of wastewater treatment sludge is a pressing environmental problem in nowadays, which is aggravated by its accumulation around the world. The imposition of more stringent legislation governing the disposal and utilization of sewage sludge, coupled with the growth in its generation and the loss of traditionally accepted disposal routes, has prompted a drive for alternative uses for sewage sludge. Considering the chemical composition of sludge, some new thermal processes of treatment have recently been considered by researchers. Thermal gasification is one innovative method that could be of significant interest. This paper seeks to review the published research in this field: it covers the characteristics of sewage sludge, the principle of gasification; the applications of sewage sludge in gasification process; the tar elimination and fate of heavy metals in biomass gasification processes.

articleTitle: Effect of cavitation shape and hydrodynamic drag property of submarine launching missile of water depth
abstract: In this paper, the underwater motion procession of a submarine vertically launched missile from the tube in deep water was simulated by multiple flow cavitations model and dynamic mesh technique. The pressure drag coefficient cures between the numerical results and literature data was compared. The numerical results are perfectly consistent with the literature data, thus the accuracy of the numerical method is proved. The shoulders cavitations shape of the different degree of water depth were given. The relationship between the cure law of pressure drag coefficient, friction drag coefficient and total drag coefficient and the times was obtained. Finally the effect of between cavitation shape, pressure drag, friction drag and total drag and the different degree of water depth was achieved.

articleTitle: Study of generalization of fractal neural network
abstract: By the definition of fractal, the BP network is proved to be a fractal whose fractal dimension ranges from 2.5 to 5. The relationship between generalization and learning rate of the BP network and the relationship between generalization and fractal dimension of weights are researched in this paper. The results present that the generalization of BP network becomes better with the increasing of the learning rate and the generalizations of the constant learning rate and the variable learning rate are almost identical if the initial learning rate is greater. On the basis of these results, the maximum iteration time of BP network training can be predicted to raise the efficiency of the BP network learning and decrease the useless iteration times. In addition, the results also show that the best generalization appears in the fractal dimension range from 3 to 4.

articleTitle: Angular-displacement measurement with the digital-speckle correlation method
abstract: When coherent light is reflected off a rough surface, the scattered wavelets are perceived in the observation plane in the form of intensity. The strength of the intensity variations in the speckle pattern relies on the dynamics of the object as well as the optical system between the object and CCD (Charge-Coupled Device) detector. By advantages of digital speckle correlation method and statistical properties of rough surface, angular displacement based on ABCD matrix is presented. The relation between the surface rotating angle and cross correlation coefficient is realized in experiment. Furthermore, the speckle patterns captured by computer are calculated using curve fitting method. It shows that the algorithm can increase the accuracy effectively.

articleTitle: The selection model on schemes of knowledge leakage risk control in alliance
abstract: In this paper we first analyze various methods of knowledge leakage risk control and their costs and benefits in knowledge alliance. Then employ game theory to establish the selection model on schemes of knowledge leakage risk control in alliance. After analyze the process, strategies and outcomes of the partners in knowledge alliance, the premises and conditions of selecting different knowledge leakage risk control scheme are put forward.

articleTitle: A new web service customization platform
abstract: This paper introduces an application customization platform by which users can package internet information resources as web services. The platform also creates a new UI layout markup language as well as an UI layout algorithm. The mobile client generates web services UI automatically based on user-defined UI layout style, and run the web services.

articleTitle: Heuristic Gradient based Multicast routing policy for dynamic network
abstract: IP multicast technology is employed in many distributed real-time applications such as IPTV services, live video-teleconferences, etc. In this paper, we formulate the Gradient based Multicast Policy problem, and propose a heuristic gradient based multicast routing algorithm. In the algorithm, routing policy is adaptive to the network states based on the gradient and multicast group members can join or leave a multicast session dynamically. Simulation results show that our algorithm can not only reduce the probability of congestion during the routing but also have low total cost of the multicast tree.

articleTitle: Distance perception synthesis in 3D audio rendering using loudspeaker array
abstract: Distance perception plays an important role in 3D audio rendering. From listener's perspective, sound intensity and direct-to-reverberant energy ratio (DRR) decrease while the distance between the listener and source increase. Though implementing changes in intensity is quite easy, providing realistic changes in direct-to-reverberant energy ratio is quite demanding. In this paper, we proposed a new method to produce room reflections in sound field based on Wave Field Synthesis technique. By introducing image method into Wave Field Synthesis, we derived the mathematical driving function of secondary source and proved the corresponding DRR decreases with increasing distance. We applied the proposed and traditional driving function to our loudspeaker array respectively. Compared to the method with changes only in sound intensity, our method can offer more authentic distance perception of sound source in rendered sound field. It will be a good supplement of 3D audio rendering.

articleTitle: Development of GIS based noise simulation model: A case study of Mumbai India Development of GIS-NSM
abstract: Urbanizing country like India, the transportation sector is growing rapidly, which has led to overcrowded roads and traffic noise pollution. In the present study, a GIS based Noise Simulation Model has been developed to generate noise level scenario of Malad Zone in Mumbai, India. The study area comprises: road network, traffic volume and various mechanical component like Sewage Pumping Station (SPS) and Waste Water Treatment Facilities (WWTF). In this development, commutative noise simulation for point and mobile sources of noise was considered. The model has been calibrated with observed noise levels and correlation was found to be 0.81.

articleTitle: Critical shear span ratio of bend and shear cracking of masonry wall
abstract: Critical shear span ratio of bend and shear cracking of brick wall is studied in order to determine and control configuration of bend and shear failure of masonry bearing walls subjected to horizontal action. The concept of critical shear span ratio between bend and shear cracking is set forth firstly, and the analysis principle of critical shear span ratio of plain brick wall is dissertated. Furthermore, different parameters of average axial compressive stress and shear strength etc. of brick wall are adopted in the range of storey number, height and material strength, and critical shear span ratio of rectangular plain brick wall is calculated by means of FEM. The analyses indicate that critical shear span ratio of plain brick wall in masonry structures is 0.35-0.5; the influence of average axial compressive stress and shear strength of masonry wall on critical shear span ratio is trifling; critical shear span ratio is used to not only determine configuration of initial cracking but also deduce final elasto-plastic failure and provide a basis for controlling failure configuration of masonry walls.

articleTitle: The integrality of architecture and Furniture Design—Analysis of famous architects' furniture works
abstract: Form of architecture and furniture in the presence is very different, but there are many processes on the design in common, both have related functions, shape, style, scale, proportion, materials, structure and so on, sharing many similar architecture and furniture design principles and rules, with a strong internal relationships. The analysis of some 20th century famous architects' furniture works shows us the integrality of architecture and furniture design not only in the form, but also in the design concept.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: A mass-spring model for real time cloth deformation
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"A Mass-spring Model for Real Time Cloth Deformation"
by Liu Zhengdong and Shang Shuyuan
in the Proceedings of the International Conference on Multimedia Technology (ICMT), July 2011, pp. 2845-2848

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper duplicates significant amounts of content from the original paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"A Mass-spring Model for Real Time Deformable Solids"
by Tzvetomir Vassilev and Bernhard Spanlang
in the Proceedings of the East West Vision Conference, January 2002


This paper presents a mass-spring model for real-time simulation of volume preserving deformable solids. A new type of springs that show collective behavior was developed called “support springs”, which model the “matter” inside the object and make it preserve its volume without the need of explicit volume computations during the simulation as it is done in conventional methods. Comparing the volume during simulation with the initial volume of the deformable solid demonstrates the accuracy of our approach. Experiments on different geometry show the low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Safety monitoring of steel space truss demolition project of fire-damaged tall building
abstract: Nowadays steel space truss structure becomes an increasing trend, but its fire resistance performance, especially in practical project, is seldom researched. The residual bearing capacity of fire-damaged space truss structure, the force-bearing condition of member bar used in fire-damaged space truss, and the accuracy of conventional temperature field analysis method are all hot spot issues to be solved. This paper, based on a steel space truss demolition project of fire-damaged tall building, elaborates the adopted method of cutting steel member bar, and meanwhile verifies the security and efficiency of that cut technology as well as the accuracy of the finite element analysis by comparing monitoring data with finite element analysis. Additionally, this paper discusses a specific analysis of eccentric force in member bar which encountered during demolition process, and proposes the solution.

articleTitle: Landscape ecological planning of hydropower construction area
abstract: As a result of the ecological crisis on human settlements in hydropower construction region, landscape ecology theory and method are used to seek a solution. By analyzing and researching the contradiction between the construction in hydropower area and protection of landscape ecology, ecological planning objectives in construction area are proposed. Furthermore, ecological restoration measures and landscape ecological planning strategy are provided.

articleTitle: Solutions and symmetry reductions of the radially symmetric non-Newtonian polytropic filtration equations
abstract: This paper discusses a class of radially symmetric nonlinear diffusion equations, known as non-Newtonian polytropic nitration equations. It is shown that the equations admit certain types of second-order conditional Lie-Backlund symmetries. As a result, exact solutions and symmetry reductions of the resulting equations are obtained. The behavior of extinction and blow-up to many of the solutions are also described.

articleTitle: The application of Web technology in the interactive distance education
abstract: A number of factors drive colleges and universities to enforce distance education programs as part of the range of services that they provide to students. Development and popularization of computers and Web technologies are changing traditional instruction paradigms. Modern higher education is experiencing structural changes in terms of composition of the student populations, learning paradigms, and curricula design. This paper deals with diverse teaching and learning methods in the interactive distance instruction. It appears that the temptation of distance education will continue to entire institutions of higher learning. Colleges and universities are wild about to diversify their services and enhance student access and sources, especially when these institutions find it difficult and costly to build more classrooms and on-campus residences. A rational assumption is that the distance education will continue to grow and evolve.

articleTitle: Graphics and data web publishing for local thermal power plant management information system
abstract: A method was proposed for graphics and data web publishing for local thermal power plant management information system based on AJAX. SVG was used as the Web publishing and display format. In order to solve the problem of information's real-time dynamic refreshment, AJAX was elected as the asynchronous communication mechanism. The application results show that this method has the advantages of saving network bandwidth, reducing transmission delay and the transmission information is more safe and reliable. It's feasible and available.

articleTitle: New exact soliton solutions and periodic-wave solutions to a mKP-equation via the Fan sub-equation method
abstract: The extended Fan sub-equation method is used to construct exact traveling wave solutions for a mKP-equation. As a result, many new explicit traveling wave solutions are obtained which include general soliton solutions, triangular periodic-wave solutions and Jacobi elliptical function solutions.

articleTitle: Analyses of internal force and shear span ratio of transverse masonry wall under horizontal action
abstract: Internal force and shear span ratio of transverse walls in the brick structure subjected to horizontal action is studied in order to control configuration of bend and shear failure of masonry bearing walls. The modality and characteristic of transverse seismic walls are analyzed firstly together with the calculating model and analysis method and of shear span ratio of plain brick wall, the equivalency method of height of abnormal section is brought forward on the basis of equal shear area and equal flexural module between rectangular section and abnormal section of member. Furthermore, different stiffness and location of coupling wall-beam or wall-slab of brick wall are adopted in the storey range, and internal force or shear span ratio of wall is calculated by means of FEM. The analyses indicate that equivalent shear span ratio of bearing wall in the masonry structure of six storeys is below 0.7; the influence of stiffness of coupling wall-beam on equivalent shear span ratio is prominent; it is very important to control stiffness of coupling wall-beam and shear span ratio for dominating failure configuration of masonry walls.

articleTitle: Initial value problems of nonlinear singular discrete systems with delay
abstract: In this paper, the existence theorem of solutions of initial value problems for nonlinear singular discrete systems with delay have been established by monotone iterative technique combined with the method of upper and lower solutions. Moreover the solution is obtained as limits of monotone sequences. Each member of these sequences is a solution of linear singular discrete systems which can explicitly be computed.

articleTitle: Techniques and methods of geological hazard monitoring based on GNSS
abstract: GNSS is currently a major techniques and methods of geological hazard monitoring. The research of GNSS-based geological hazard monitoring system can provide some reference comments to Geological hazard monitoring and prevention. This article summarizes GNSS-based geological hazard monitoring system design by analysis of GNSS system structure and its key technology. Comprehensive analysis indicates that GNSS technology has considerable advantages. It can supply multi-function, multi-demand, multi-level monitoring data to different monitoring objectives for the geological hazards, and it is conducive to real-time monitoring and early warning projects. The current GNSS-based geological hazard monitoring system also need reinforcement of compatible, data integration and usability ,and continue to gradually form advanced, practical and comprehensive real-time monitoring and analysis system based on GNSS.

articleTitle: A novel method for image feature fusion based on MADM
abstract: Single type of feature can hardly describe the abundant image information completely. Any kind of image features being used in image retrieval has its advantages and disadvantage. Different features can be combined with others in order to improve the retrieval effectiveness. This paper proposed a novel method which is dynamic, easy to extend and operate simply. This method is based on MADM (Multiple Attribute Decision Making), uses subjective and objective weighting method and uses TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) to generate the final result set. This method fuses features at the time of the retrieval and use parallelization to reduce the cost. Experimental results show that this method can fuse features effectively and can improve the retrieval effect.

articleTitle: The analysis of the parameter involving in the shift technique for nonsymmetric algebraic Riccati equations
abstract: The minimal positive solution of nonsymmetric algebraic Riccati equations arising from transport theory, can be obtained by computing the one of two vector equations. Some existing methods such as simple iteration method, converge slowly in the singular case, but this drawback can be improved with the shift technique. When using the shift technique, a parameter will be used. In this paper, the parameter's effects on the convergence rate of four existing methods for solving the vector equations and its optimal value in a given interval is given. Numerical results are presented to demonstrate theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Schrödinger equation with combined power-type nonlinearities and harmonic potential
abstract: This paper discusses a class of nonlinear Schrodinger equation with combined power-type nonlinearities and harmonic potential. By constructing a variational problem and the so-called invariant manifolds of the evolution flow, we derive a sharp condition for blow up and global existence of the solution by applying the potential well theory and the concavity method.

articleTitle: Evaluation on soil heavy metals and organochlorine pesticides pollution in main grain producing area based on ArcGIS—A case study of Liaocheng
abstract: With the rapid economic development, the soil environment has been polluted in varying degrees. The quality of the soil in the major grain producing areas affects the food safety and human health. Liaocheng City, the major grain producing areas in Shandong Province, covers an arable land of 70.01 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In order to investigate the heavy metals and organochlorine pesticides pollution institution, the farmland of Liaocheng had been divided into 136 units. One sampling point had been selected in each unit. Firstly, the location of sampling points had been ensured by GPS, and the surface soil of 136 sampling points had been collected. 10 kinds of pollutants had been monitored, which included As, Cd, Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Pb, Zn, DDTs and BHCs. Secondly, the single factor index had been used to evaluate the degree of soil pollution. The results showed that the polluted degrees of all heavy metals and organochlorine pesticides were different. The order of heavy metals pollution was Hg>;Cu>;Cd>;Zn>;Pb>;As>;Ni. The order of organochlorine pesticides pollution was DDTs>; BHCs. Thirdly, all different pollutants indexes had been inputted to ArcGIS. Based on the spatial analyst module in ArcGIS, Ordinary Kriging method had been used to finish the spatial interpolation of every kind of pollutants. At last, the spatial distribution maps of every kind of pollutants had been finished based on ArcGIS. The results showed that the pollution of the heavy metals and the organchlorine pesticides was not so heavily and had little influence upon the food production. By contrast, the soil pollution around the towns was more serious than that far from the towns. The most serious polluted area of the organchlorine pesticides located at Linqing county. Therefore, the areas surrounding all towns and the whole areas of Linqing county should be mainly protected.

articleTitle: Seismic response analysis under longitudinal and lateral excitation of rigid frame bridge subjected to near-fault pulse-like ground motions
abstract: With the near-fault and far-fault pulse-like ground motions recorded by four stations, the seismic response of reinforced concrete long-span rigid frame bridges subjected to near-fault pulse-like ground motions under longitudinal and lateral excitation is studied. And the comparison is next conducted with response of bridge under the far-fault ground motions recorded in the same sites. The response features of concrete rigid frame bridge under two kinds of ground motions are analysed. The results show that the seismic response of near-fault pulse-like ground motions is more significant than of non-pulse-like ground motions in the same peak acceleration. And the advice is given on seismic design bridge in the near-fault area.

articleTitle: Design and simulation implementation of protection algorithms based on Network Coding in mesh networks
abstract: Since people increasingly depend on the communication network in all aspects of social life, they propose the greater demand for network bandwidth and more stringent requirement for network survivability. Based on this idea people proposed the protection algorithm based on the network coding that is a breakthrough in information processing and transmission theory in communication network since it allows the network node to encode the information while the traditional network node can only store and forward the data. This paper proposes a new Network Coding based on P-cycle protection (NCP) algorithm then analyzes the algorithm complexity and performance. The author describes the algorithm in detail of construction and the implementation process.

articleTitle: Piecewise nonlinear fitting method of tunnel surrounding rock displacement and its application
abstract: The displacement prediction of tunnel surrounding rock is an important part in New Austrian Tunnel Method, which is the safety measure during construction and also an important means of reducing material consumption. In recent years, with the construction of road tunnel and railway tunnel developing fast, the large section tunnel projects increase day by day, and the divisional tunneling is constantly applied to the tunnel engineering. The piecewise nonlinear fitting method of surrounding rock displacement is put forward on the basis of the deformation law of surrounding rock of large section tunnel. The study shows that the deformation time-history curves of surrounding rock of the divisional excavation are stepped up and the fitting precision of traditional one function fitting method is lower, the regression curves can't fully reflect the development trend of the data. So the piecewise nonlinear fitting function is created in this paper. Through the application, the prediction accuracy and correlation coefficient is proved higher by using piecewise nonlinear fitting function for surrounding rock displacement prediction, this method can more accurately predict the final value of the deformation of tunnel surrounding rock.

articleTitle: Stochastic resonance of mixed periodic signal in single-mode laser driven by colored noises
abstract: Stochastic resonance (SR) is studied in a gain-noise model of a single-mode, which is driven by two coloured noises and correlated in the form of an e-exponential function. By adopting a linear approximation method, we calculate the laser intensity power spectrum and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). It is found that the traditional SR appears with the change of intensities of the pump noise and quantum noise, moreover, the phenomenon of SR drivened by the coloured noeses is clearer than the white ones. This paper also shows that when the cross-correlation time between two nosise increases to a certain number, the resonance disappears.

articleTitle: Cloud computing environment based on chaotic encryption research information platform client
abstract: This higher education information resources for the current platform security issues, is proposed based on chaotic encryption cloud computing environment information platform client-building programs. This paper first analyzes the cloud based platform for building open to the feasibility of teaching resources, and then make use of chaotic encryption methods to improve client security and help promote the cloud-based University information resource platform-building process.

articleTitle: Low carbon civilization and the university library building culture
abstract: Low carbon civilization is the important contemporary architecture vocabulary, culture is the soul of the building. The library building is in the key position and important public architecture in the university, the library building is a carrier of low carbon concepts and technology, is the sublimation of university library. Low carbon civilization can improve university library building, can direct the culture grade of university library construction progress of technology, the university of library building can rich education character. University of low carbon technology application architecture, should take example by some current energy saving, ecology, green demonstration architecture, adjust measures to local conditions and choice low carbon architectural technology, tailors do low carbon building technology and building function, make a combination of art and the building function to compensate low carbon civilization of the natural beauty in architectural culture.

articleTitle: Multi-layer digital images superposition of high-power micrograph
abstract: The digital images can be obtained by high-power microscope. Because the sample surface is not focused on a plane, it is difficult to obtain high definition digital images by capturing image one time. This paper advances a new multi-layer digital images superposition algorithm. By focusing on sample surface several times, several images on different focal plane can be obtained. Using the image definition criterion function, we can get a clear area for every layer image. All the clear areas in corresponding image is stitched, a high definition image can be obtained by superposing the multi-layer images. The algorithm and implementation of the multi-layer images superposition will be described in this paper. Experiments show that the algorithm and implementation are useful for obtaining high definition digital images by high-power microscope.

articleTitle: The development of audio-visual media in programing the Entrance Guide of audio-visual for freshmen base on FLASH
abstract: With the development of computer technology, the audio-visual media has been widely used in the field of education. At the same time, many problems of multimedia courseware in design field Appear, especially in the combined use of different media.The authors have to choose the Expansion of a system design in making the “Entrance Guide”.

articleTitle: Application of laplace transform in well test interpretation - an example of tahe oilfield cavity-fractured reservoirs in tarim basin
abstract: The oil and gas distribution is controlled by some factors in the cavity-fractured reservoirs, such as multiple reservoir formation, different epigenetic transformation induced destroys, heterogeneity of the reservoir space and so on, which lead to difference in hydrocarbon migration and accumulation and the extremely uneven distribution of reservoir properties. Constrained by the model, conventional analytical solution of well test analysis theory cannot meet such needs to solve the seepage in the cavity-fractured reservoirs. A new well test interpretation model of wells drilled in cavity was presented in the paper and a corresponding mathematical model was built up, Laplace transform and Stehfest reverser method was used to solve the model. The influences of inter-porosity flow coefficient and size of cavity to the bottom pressure response were analyzed, obtained the rules: when the size of cavity is constant, the smaller inter-porosity flow coefficient is, the later the seepage stage will emerge, the size of inter-porosity flow coefficient only affects the duration of early curve; when the size of inter-porosity flow coefficient is constant, the smaller the cavity is, the more obvious seepage stage will reflect. Early curve parallel to the different sizes cavity, the smaller cavity is, the larger the intercept will be. Well test interpretation method for wells drilled in cavity of cavity-fractured reservoirs was presented, practical software was developed. Finally, the new well test model was used to analysis one well test data in Tahe Reservoir and the explanation of well test accorded with the result of geological model and drilling data.

articleTitle: Test study on the seismic behavior of the cavity wall reinforced
abstract: Based on the lateral pseudo-static test on seven cavity walls which have the some masonry type but different reinforcements and constructions, this essay do some research on the position of the initial crack, the fracture morphology development law of the crack, the initial load, the ultimate load of the cavity wall under the horizontal and the vertical compression, in order to provide the test evidence for the determination of economical and effective construction measures for cavity wall. Analytical results show that cavity walls reinforced by the steel meshes covering the whole wall have the greater deformation capacity and the greater ability to resist earthquake than those unreinforced.

Author Keywords: the ability to resist lateral forces

articleTitle: One-step local M-estimates of partial linear models with missing date
abstract: In the case of response data missing, the variable bandwidth and one-step local M-estimates are employed to estimate the unknown function and the unknown parameter in the partial linear models. The estimators of nonparametric componets are given by one-step local M-estimation, and the estimators of parametric components are obtained by one-step local M-estimation and average method. Moreover, the variable bandwidth is inserted to improve the one-step local M-estimation At last, the asymptotical normality of these estimators is established.

articleTitle: Using remote sensing to monitor wetland cover change and succession in Dongting Lake of China during 1993-2010
abstract: This paper illustrates the results of wetland cover change and succession law in Dongting Lake of China using muti-temporal remotely sensed data from 1993 to 2010. The decision tree classification technique was used to extract information from satellite data. Then a series of post-classification methods were applied to obtain better results. Furthermore, we modified the classification results manually to rectify the errors caused by computer automatic classification. So the accuracy of the classification maps was satisfactory. The analysis indicated that woods and grass expansion of Dongting Lake resulted in the reduction of water (including lake-grass and water bodies), mud flat and reeds from 1993 to 2010. The maps between 2002 and 2006 showed dramatic change of the wetland cover. In the period of 2002-2010, regional differences in wetland cover change were obvious in West Dongting Lake and South Dongting Lake, especially West Dongting Lake, in which great changes of woods, reeds and grass had taken place. On the whole, 6.30% of the wetland changed, and 67.84% of that was successive succession. Sediment siltatio and human activity were the two factors that affect the wetland development and succession of Dongting Lake and oxbow of the Yangtze River. The study quantified the patterns of wetland cover change in Dongting Lake for the past four periods that forms valuable resources for wetland administration and decision makers to devise sustainable wetland environmental planning.

articleTitle: Pilot study of low-temperature low-turbidity reservoir water treatment using dual-media filtration with micro-flocculation
abstract: The treatment of low temperature and low turbidity water is a worldwide challenge. Direct filtration with micro-flocculation is a simple and economic method to purity such a source water. This paper investigated the performance of this method to treat a low-temperature and low-turbidity reservoir water in pilot scale. The filter used was a rapid sand filter with quartz sand-Anthracite dual-media, and the coagulant was the polymerization aluminum (PAC). It was found that dual-media was superior for organic removal. The CODMn of effluent was less than 3mg/L, the UV254 removal rate was greater than 50%, and the effluent turbidity was less than 0.5NTU. The suggested PAC dosage was 16mg/L. When the filtration rate was 4m/h, the filter cycle would be 12h.

articleTitle: Multimedia technology research in dredging simulation of cutter suction dredger
abstract: Multimedia technology plays an important role in dredging simulation. The paper briefly presents the main aspects of the multimedia technology used in the dredging simulation of cutter suction dredger, such as construction environment, vessel and its motion, soil cutting, transport in pipeline, sound, vibration and so on, particularly introduces the principles of the key technologies and the relevant skills. The simulation system has been developed and confirmed in the practical application.

articleTitle: Study on the development and suggestions of urban agglomeration in the central region of Jilin Province
abstract: The development of urban agglomerations in developed countries have been successful, the economy of scale is very obvious. Based on the theory and Jilin city group's geographical characteristics , the Changchun City, Jilin, Siping, Songyuan, Liaoyuan, and Nong'an,Jiutai, Gongzhuling and Yitong are designated as the central city of Jilin Province. This paper will study the development status , the main problems and development of countermeasures of the central city group.

articleTitle: Molecular field-free alignment driven by femtosecond laser field
abstract: The field-free alignment behaviors of some molecules driven by the femtosecond laser pulses are theoretically investigated. We detailedly discuss the temporal evolution of the molecular rotational wave-packet under different laser intensities, different laser pulse durations and different molecular rotational temperatures. The results show that the degree of the molecular alignment depends not only on the laser intensity and the laser pulse duration, but also on the molecular rotational temperature. Finally, we demonstrate the feasible approaches to enhance the molecular alignment degree for practical application.

articleTitle: Experimental study on thermal performance of improved open-web roofs with induced ventilation
abstract: The double layer open-web roof structure is a type of heat preservation and insulation roof structures, in particular suitable for medium and large span roof structures. However, the construction procedures for traditional open-web roof structures are rather complicated because of the built-in molds in the cavity. On the other hand, passive ventilation is an effective route to enhance the thermal performance of the building envelope. In this paper, an improved open-web roof structure is presented. The steel tube shear connectors are employed to replace the tubby reinforced concrete shear connectors. The adopted shear connectors have small holes in the middle part of their heights. This improvement not only simplifies the construction procedures, but also enhances the thermal performance for open-web roof structures. In order to verify the effectiveness of proposed new open-web roofs, experiments with temperature measurements were performed for a real roof structure. The measured results show that nearly half of the heat flow is drawn out from the cavity due to the induced ventilation. The proposed new open-web roofs have significant improvement and effectiveness on thermal performances, when comparing with traditional open-web roof structures.

articleTitle: Extracting regions of interest based on visual attention model
abstract: This paper proposed a new approach of extracting regions of interest based on visual attention model, which segmented image regions with the region growing algorithm. According to the physiological characteristics of Human Visual System (HVS), image features were extracted by non-uniform sampling of image and computing "center-surround", which were used to simulate the human visual receptive field properties. Features became multi-scale conspicuity maps, which were combined into a saliency map. The focus of attention (FOA) as seeds of the region growing algorithm was obtained by the "winner-take-all" (WTA) competition. Then the regions of interest were extracted by using the region growing algorithm. The experiment results show that this approach can select suitable seeds automatically and the extraction of regions of interest can be consistent with human visual attention mechanism.

articleTitle: Research & Practice of Networked learning communities model
abstract: In this paper, a kind of three dimensional networked learning communities model was studied, which is composed of technology, social communication and teaching. The characteristics of this system have been described from three dimensions. The construction of human friend environment has been explored, and the realizations of networked learning methods have been explored too. Our researches above expanded the range of this model. Finally the real results of learning community in practice have been explained based on this model.

articleTitle: Estimate at completion for construction projects Using Evolutionary Gaussian Process Inference Model
abstract: The Estimate at Completion (EAC), which is the manager's projection of a project's total cost at its completion, is an important tool in monitoring a project's performance and risk. Executives usually make the high-level decisions on a project but they may have gaps in technical knowledge which may cause error in their decisions. This study employed an EAC estimation model to extract historical knowledge from previous construction projects. References and historical data relating to construction project costs are collected and inputted into the EAC model for it to learn from. This is then combined with recently developed AI techniques to simulate human decision-making behavior in solving management problems. This study combined a new machine learning technology based on statistic principles, Gaussian Process (GP), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to construct an Evolutionary Gaussian Process Inference Model (EGPIM). The model uses GP to determine the relationship between the input and output variables and uses the PSO optimization tool to optimize the hyper-parameters in the data function. The study investigated the application of EGPIM in determining the EAC and calculating the tendency of change in the forecast model monitor. The model provided a reliable trend of EAC estimates, which can aid project managers in improving the effectiveness of project cost controls. The learning results have been validated with real construction project data. The validation results show a better performance of the trained EGPIM model over other AI techniques such as the support vector machine and the Gaussian process.

articleTitle: A video adaptation framework for SVC based on content description
abstract: Due to today's diverse resource constraints and user preferences, video adaptation attracts more and more research interests. A video adaptation framework for scalable video coding (SVC) is proposed in this paper. The content description is acquired off-line, and then a bitstream syntax description is automatic created by a format-specific parser. Finally, video adaptation is implemented based on bitstream analysis and video content description. Experiments show that the proposed framework can acquire output video stream quickly and assure visual quality without loss of coding efficiency.

articleTitle: The cycle length, statistical and key sensitivity properties of a perturbed couple chaotic PRBG
abstract: Chaos-based cryptography has several good properties, such as sensitivity to initial conditions, namely, the so-called butterfly effect. However, chaotic maps implemented by computers with finite precision will lead to dynamic degradation. In this paper a perturbed couple chaotic pseudo-random bit generator with good cycle length and statistical property is used to construct a stream cipher for JPEG 2000 image encryption. The cycle length of the perturbed couple chaotic PRBG is shown long enough for stream cipher, the statistical properties are shown satisfying FIPS 140-1, and the key sensitivity from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> for JPEG 2000 image encryption is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The impact of channel correlation on the performance of polarization divercity combining
abstract: In fact, there is relativity between the two branches of the polarization diversity-receiving antenna, so, this paper analyzes the effect of the channel correlation to the performance of polarization diversity combining, and gives the method of the generation of the correlated channels. The emulation was used to study the performance. In maximal ratio combining of Rayleigh channel, when each branch's average SNR is relatively small compared to the threshold, our results show that the probability that the output SNR exceeds the given threshold grows as the correlation coefficient increases.

articleTitle: Analysis on Eiffel Effect of transmission tower
abstract: According to the influence on Eiffel Effect for diagonal members of curved type tower, by taking the form of a drum tower 500 kV dual-circuits as an example, the linear auto-regressive filter (AR) law principle is adopted, the kaimal spectrum that changes with height is conducted, the wind field is simulated through MATLAB software. Using the ANSYS finite element analysis software, the finite element model of transmission tower is built, the internal force of diagonal members is calculated under stochastic wind load, and is compared with code calculation. It is shown that the practical calculation and the code calculation are different. Predictably, Eiffel Effect on transmission tower brings diagonal members with influence. Therefore, Eiffel Effect should be considered in the tower design, in order to improve bearing capacity of diagonal members and ensure design strength of transmission tower.

articleTitle: Active learning with optimal distribution for image classification
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the issue of building up a training set for the task of image classification at minimal labeling costs. It is a topic that has attracted the considerable attention in the recent years. We propose a novel active learning algorithm with optimal distribution. In order to solve the problems of the noisy distribution and the sampling bias in the actively sampling process, the empirical risk on the selected examples is weighted by density ratio, and then the risk on the test examples is estimated using only unlabeled examples and the marginal label distribution. Finally, the optimal training distribution is derived by minimizing the expected error of the risk. Our approach has been demonstrated on the task of image classification on the difficult benchmark PASCAL VOC 2007 dataset.

articleTitle: A new design method for external cavity structure of tunable semiconductor laser
abstract: It presents a new method that makes use of grating light valve (GLV) in order to adjust minutely output wave-packet in grating external-cavity semiconductor laser. This structure in tunable semiconductor laser based on grating light valve forms grating light valve and blazed grating into confocal structure, Wave-packet selected can backtrack and be exported in the end by oscillating movement in resonant cavity. The tunable external-cavity semiconductor laser based on grating light valve can select at will output or filtrated corresponding wave-packet magnitude. This kind of tunable external-cavity semiconductor laser using characteristic of grating light valve can achieve minutely tuning of output wave-packet and reduce mechanical tuning difficulty

articleTitle: Research of optimum design for plane displacement for curved continuous beam bridge
abstract: In this paper, the main factors that affect the plane displacement of continuous beam were introduced. Combined with the disease of an overpass after the "5.12" earthquake, the major factors that should be considered for designing such a bridge were summarized.

articleTitle: A class of quasi-cubic B-spline with two parameters
abstract: A class of quasi-cubic B-spline base functions with two parameters is presented and the corresponding curves and surfaces defined by the introduced base function in this paper. The curves inherit some characteristic with traditional cubic B-spline curves, and it can represent exactly some quadratic curves such as the arc of circle, arc of ellipse, arc of parabola and some transcendental curves such as sine curve without using rational form. The corresponding tensor product surfaces can also represent precisely some quadratic surfaces and transcendental surfaces, such as sphere, cylindrical surfaces and helix tube. Its shape can be adjusted totally and can interpolate some control points without solving system of equations through changing the value of the parameters. Further more, these curves are C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> continuous totally in proper condition. Examples are given to illustrate that the curve can be used as an efficient new model for geometric design in the fields of CAGD.

articleTitle: Effects of coal pillar and spacing of mined-out area on ground settlement
abstract: There are many factors influencing the ground settlement over mined-out area. In order to study the effect of width of coal pillar and spacing of mined-out area on ground settlement, the Druker-Prager model is chosen, which is suitable to simulate the materials of rock and soil. It is calculated by use of the advanced FEM software of Analysis. The results show the influence law of dimention of coal pillar and spacing of mined out area.
