articleTitle: Daubechies wavelet meshless method of numerical calculation in the electromagnetic field
abstract: In this paper, Daubechies (DB) wabelet scaling functions are used as basic function in function approximation by using DB wavelet properties, neither nodes nor meshes are needed. This method is simple and easy application, combining meshless galerkin method, DB wavelet meshless method is used for numerical calculation in electromagnetic field. The discrete model is established. Numerical example shows that DB wavelet meshless method is effective and stable.

articleTitle: Orbital stability of solitary waves to the generalized Kdv equation with fifth order
abstract: In this paper,the existence of solitary wave solutions to the generalized Kdv equation with fifth-order is treated by applying the new method. The new results of orbital stability are obtained.The theoretical framework is largely based on Grillakis[7] and Souganidis[6].

articleTitle: A novel circular jet flow characteristics of an unconfined low-Reynolds-number binary-mixture
abstract: In this paper, the flow characteristics of an unconfined low-Reynolds-number circular jet with binary mixture is studied numerically. For four different exit velocities with the same exit oxygen concentration, the outlines of concentration fields are like mushrooms with different length and breadth ratio except for a small concave indicating the vortex is almost occurring near the neighborhood in the case of Re=157.6. Furthermore, for three different exit oxygen concentrations with the same exit velocity, the velocities and concentration fields are extremely different. Comparing the results of the circular jets with the slot jets having the same exit conditions, the oxygen have larger spreading range in transverse direction for slot jets. In the future, this study can be extended to the jet flame with gas of different compositions, and low-speed jet system for cooling in computer manufacturing.

articleTitle: Transformation of the new rural construction in the village
abstract: The transformation of the present village of ubiquitous private homestead, lack of policy support, planning and management lag, lack of funds for construction and other issues were analyzed, the overall reconstruction, step by step update, key sections of the regulation approach to the implementation of the reform to meet rural the actual situation, to achieve a market-oriented operation, diversified funding, standardized operation, institutionalization and management effects.

articleTitle: Dust grains in astrophysics
abstract: Eleven years ago, it was fairly clear that dust grains were a state of solid state matter involved in a cycle producing and reprocessing the solid bodies in the Universe mainly from evolved stars, and that this cycle progressively enriched the galactic media with heavier and heavier "metallic" components. The main reecent progresses in the field was that chemistry and dynamics are strongly or weakly coupled depending on the surrounding gas density. First approaches of models including this coupling were built, though a lot of problems already known by people investigating separately dynamics and chemistry appeared still more complicated due to the variety of scales to be considered in self consistent models. However, models matched more or less well up to observations. Now due to the exponentially increasing power of computers and the refinement of observations, a lot of new approaches of grain nucleation and evolution processes on the one side and observations on the other side, and also the subsequent derivations of optical properties at many wavelengths suggest that ways of coupling dynamics to chemistry may be still more complex than expected, all the more since grains have been detected in media very far from any thermo-dynamical equilibrium, in which radiation is a phenomenon also strongly involved. The conclusion is that there is no available general solution and that dominant processes and most important scales must be, at the present time, carefully determined before any computation in order to built reasonable models in each case. If the production of dust by evolved stars is not questioned, other sources may be efficient. New species of "hens" and "eggs" should be taken under consideration.

articleTitle: Mearsuring the prompt emitting regions of short and low-luminosity GRBs
abstract: In this paper, we have measured the prompt emitting regions of 44 low-luminosity and 14 short gamma-ray bursts (GRBs). According to our analysis we suspect that the short GRBs may arise from a smaller radius region based on the typical internal shock model, while the low-luminosity GRBs could be produced by the external shocks, the turbulences or the electromagnetic materials.

articleTitle: Some remarks on nonlinear elliptic operators on Riemannian manifolds
abstract: We study strong maximum principles for singular solutions of nonlinear elliptic operators of second order defined on compact Riemannian manifolds. Then we provide a description of the behavior of the sigular solutions of such a class of elliptic equations.

articleTitle: An algorithm for texture-based Image Retrieval
abstract: With the rapid development of the information age and the wide range of use of multimedia technology, the problem how to solve a large number of efficient management of multimedia information has become an urgent need. In this paper, improvement ideas of the algorithm by analyzing the principle of traditional texture roughness retrieval algorithm is summarized and realized, and improved texture roughness texture has more resolving power and better rotation invariance. Image retrieval results based on the improved texture roughness were better than the original texture.

articleTitle: A method of error correction for power stage in digital class d power amplifiers
abstract: In a digital class D power amplifier, an error is introduced into the input signal being amplified in power stage, due to the effect of power supply noise. A method used to eliminate the error is presented in the paper. This method is adding correction factors to all integrators of Delta-Sigma modulator, and introducing power supply noise to the input of the class D power amplifier and Delta-Sigma modulator. A design example with the method is presented, and the simulation results indicate this method can basically eliminate the error.

articleTitle: Application of an improved fast algorithm in line detection of parts
abstract: In order to solve the problem of Hough Transform for line detection, an improved fast algorithm for the detection of multiple lines had been studied out. Based on the idea of "partially Hough Transform goes first, and then wholly least squares fitting", the influence of quantization error in the digital image has been reduced, so that the straight line can be positioned accurately. Resetting the neighborhood of the detected line by using the minimum distance criterion can solve the problem of the uncertainty of random Hough Transform effectively, as well as the problem that the remaining point set will interfere with the subsequent line detection for multiple lines detection. Some main issues in the algorithm had been analyzed; the relation curve of threshold selection and errors in the detection results has been made. Dealing with some linear parts by this, it shows that the algorithm has high accuracy, timeliness and flexibility.

articleTitle: In-situ monitoring and analysis on the stability of surrounding rock of Qiankeng tunnel
abstract: Qiankeng tunnel of Dongshen water supply project is 322m long. The types of surrounding rock are whole weathering, IV and V class granite. The entire tunnel is under bad geological conditions. Based on the new Austrian tunneling method and considering the field geological conditions, the form of supporting and lining structure, the deformations are monitored for surrounding rock, supporting structure, and lining structure during the construction of tunnel. Various influencing factors on the deformation stability are analyzed including the stress of surrounding rock, surrounding rock structure, unloading effect, deformation mechanism, deformation time space effect and deformation response. This study plays an important role in the construction safety and provides adequate information for the post monitoring.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for extracting character feature points
abstract: A new algorithm for extracting character feature points is put forward in this paper. It first get the number of background regions and the corresponding features through analyzing the discrete circle template segmented by character skeleton, and then obtain the character feature points, finally determine the location of fork point accurately by using the maximum circle criterion. Experimental results show that this new algorithm could extract the feature points in a fast, accurate and robust way.

articleTitle: The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation for online courses
abstract: The article establishes a typical model of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation for online courses, introduces the fuzzy factors in the appraising process of online courses, from course design, Interactive design, navigation tactics, interface design, study motion and so on. The evaluation index system and subordinate function and weight proportion are defined. An example of fuzzy evaluation for online course is presented, which provides a basis of assessment design for quantitatively evaluating online courses.

articleTitle: Computer-based educational game and its application in college English teaching in China
abstract: Many college students as well as youngsters have been addicted to computer-based games, which have negative and positive effects on them. Therefore, how to convert their negative effects into positive impacts has attracted a number of researchers' attention. Designing proper computer-based educational games is a good solution. By investigating college English teaching and college students' playing computer-based games in China, this paper suggests that it is an advisable attempt for college English teachers in China to design computer-based educational games and apply it into college English teaching, and discusses principles and approaches of designing computer-based educational games suitable for college English teaching in China.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of oscillatory zonation patterns in reaction-diffusion systems
abstract: The oscillatory zonation patterns in reaction diffusion systems are numerically simulated by lattice Boltzmann method (LBM). The formation of Liesegang patterns in rectangular enclosures is modeled in the perspective of supersaturation mechanism based on Ostwald's theory. The approach, originated from the microscopic dynamics of cellular automata, includes the essential features of reaction-diffusion systems, and the nucleation and aggregation of reaction products. The oscillatory zonations have been observed from the numerical results of both one dimensional and two dimensional simulations. The local wavelengths of the quasi-periodical precipitation in the Liesegang patterns are characterized by the Jablczynski spacing law and the width law. The interactions between the waves of the precipitation have been identified. The LBM provides a feasible approach to simulate the pattern formation of Liesegang band in reaction-diffusion systems.

articleTitle: Rational solutions and rogue wave solutions of the classical Boussinesq system
abstract: By using the Wronskian technique, rational solutions of classical Boussinesq system are derived in this paper. Some of them are rogue wave solutions with singularity at point (x = 0, t = 0).

articleTitle: Urban VIS design and urban cultural image investigate primary explosion of Yantai VIS design
abstract: Based on the series problems that occurred to current China's city vision image design, This paper analysis the reasons of the monotonous and superficial of the city image design and also put forward the necessity of urban VIS design. This paper take Yantai VIS design as breakthrough point, On the basis of field investigation and system research, find the disadvantage of urban visual identity which from the basic identity system including city logo, city logotype, city house color etc, to identification system, for example:public space system, environmental visual leading system, etc. Combined with the current design of the outstanding urban VIS case of VIS design ideas and visual image design of Yantai City Enlightenment, sought by the city to reflect the urban design of VIS's spiritual, cultural, urban planning department to provide a reference design theory and practice mode.

articleTitle: The technology study of nature sampling method in three-phase inverter
abstract: The paper studied the sinuosidal pulse width modulation(SPWM) principle of natural sampling method, and built a model and gave simulation results in the Matlab / simulink. The simulation results showed that the SPWM of natural sampling algorithm was right. Then the natural sampling algorithm was applied to the control method for three-phase inverter. At the same time the paper built the model and gave simulation results, and the simulation results was fully consistent with the theoretical analysis. Therefore, the conclusion showed that the SPWM of nature sampling algorithm could been successfully applied to the control method for three-phase inverter, and laid the foundation for the future research of control method.

articleTitle: A constraint preconditioner for discretized time-harmonic Maxwell equations
abstract: In this paper, we establish a new type of constraint preconditioner for solving symmetric, indefinite saddle point system arising from Maxwell equation in mixed form and study the spectral properties of the related preconditioned matrix. By comparing the performance of the constraint preconditioner presented in this paper and block diagonal preconditioner established in [1], we numerically verify the accuracy and practicability of the constraint preconditioner.

articleTitle: The countability of induced R(L)-fuzzy topological spaces
abstract: In this paper, We prove that that the weight, character, density and Lindelof degree of (L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sup>, δ) are equal with those of (R(L)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sup>,ω(δ)),and that (L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sup>, δ) is a Lindelof space if and only if (R(L)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sup>, ω(δ)) is a Lindelof space. We also comepare (L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sup>, δ) and (R(L)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sup>, ω(δ)) in respects of dense set.

articleTitle: Fabric defect detection based on wavelet reconstruction
abstract: Fabric defect detection is an important part of quality inspection of textiles. Through the relevant theoretical analysis, the fabric image is decomposed by the use of DB wavelet. Then, sub-graphs of wavelet decomposition are selected reconstruction, which effectively inhibit the normal texture information. On this basis, the reconstructed image is morphological filtering to determine the location and area of defect. Experimental results show that the detection method is effectiveness to most defects.

articleTitle: The development and utilization of the underground space in the areas of fast urbanization in the center of China —A case study of Zhengzhou city
abstract: Based on the problems aroused by fast urbanization, the paper analyses the necessity and feasibility of developing underground space in Zhengzhou, proposing that in the utilization of underground space some measures such as holistic planning, varied forms and integrative development should be taken to achieve the intensiveness, economization and efficiency development of the city.

articleTitle: Seismic response analysis on small-radius curve ramp-bridge
abstract: The urban overpass has developed rapidly with the acceleration of city construction. Ramp-bridge is different from other bridges about construction and stress. In this paper comparative analysis the result by establish finite element model aim at feature of ramp-bridge-cross slope, longitudinal, slope, curvature and stiffness of pier.

articleTitle: Euler deconvolution method of gravity anomaly based on wavelet analysis
abstract: In this paper, we applied wavelet analysis to Euler deconvolution, getting more accurate position and depth of gravity anomaly source. Traditionally, the derivation of gravity anomalies mainly adopts the Fourier transform and difference quotient method. Wavelet analysis method is demonstrated to have the characteristics of high accuracy and strong anti-interference through the spreadsheet of step model in theory. High-precision derivatives of gravity anomaly, which can be achieved by wavelet analysis, improved the convergence and accuracy of Euler deconvolution. In practice, the method also gets some achievements.

articleTitle: The application of synthetic features in image retrieval
abstract: With the development of multimedia technology and the coming of information era, people have been frequently exposed to a lot of image information, so how to effectively organize, manage and retrieve large image database has been an urgent demand. The related problems of synthetic features in image retrieval were investigated from the importance and concept of Content-based image retrieval. Finally, the thought and methods of Content-based image synthetic features retrieval was summed up by adopting color, texture, shape and other characteristics of the integrated features of the image.

articleTitle: The lateral shift of reflected homogeneous electromagnetic wave at the interface of conductive media
abstract: The lateral shift of reflected electromagnetic wave is derived at the interface of conductive media by the phase shift of reflected electromagnetic wave, and a numerical computing example of a low frequency wave is given. The results show that the shift increases with the increasing of incidence angle, and when the incidence angle approaches 90°, the reflected wave will propagates for a long distance before returning to the first medium.

articleTitle: Adaptive IRC algorithm to overcome inter-cell interference in uplink LTE system
abstract: The effect of noise can be effectively overcome using maximal ratio combining (MRC) algorithm as uplink detection algorithm without interference or in weak interference, but the performance is poor under the strong interference. And noise can be overcome by using interference rejection combining (IRC) algorithm under the strong interference, but noise can't be eliminated on condition that there is no interference. The advantages of two algorithms are combined very well in improved algorithm which is proposed in this paper. The switchover of these two algorithms is changed adaptively by judging the strength of interference. Using MRC algorithm without interference or in weak interference and using IRC algorithm in strong interference, the error rate will be reduced, thus performance of system will be improved.

articleTitle: An algorithm based on bilinear interpolation of converting 2D video to 3D video
abstract: The reason why we can see stereoscopic impression from 3D(three-dimensional) video is that the left eye image and right eye image are different, which generates the visual parallax. Research shows that a large number of 3D information hidden in 2D(two-dimensional) video. One of the important information is depth of field information, but the depth of field information hidden in the 2D frame images. Bilinear interpolation is able to effectively improve the performance of depth of field. Combining this algorithm and using parallax reinforcement technology to process the original 2D video can produce 3D video.

articleTitle: Vector form intrinsic finite element-overview, recent progress and future developments
abstract: This paper presents the features and applications of a new numerical method named vector form intrinsic finite element method (VFIFE). Differences between vector form intrinsic finite element and traditional finite element method are summarized firstly. Then it reviews the applications of this method in engineering and research fields, finally, the imperfect aspects of the method are supplemented. Existing studies show that this method can analyze and predict the discontinuous behaviors such as large deformation, fracture, collision more accurately in a great many fields including numerical simulation of fire response of structure, bridge seismic and performance of FRP confined concrete structures and so on.

articleTitle: Combined transform image denoising based on morphological component analysis
abstract: Wavelet transform is well suited for the effective (sparse) representation of the image smooth region. Curvelet transform can get better approximation of the linear singular for two-dimensional or higher-dimensional function, and is the sparsest representation for the image with linear singular part and the edge region. This paper proposes a combined transform image denoising algorithm based on morphological component analysis (MCA). The MCA method is used to separate the image into natural scene and linear singular structure. Curvelet transform threshold denosing is used in linear singular structure while wavelet transform deals with smooth part. This algorithm makes full use of respective advantages of the wavelet transform and curvelet transform. Experiment results show that the algorithm can better maintain the details characteristics in dealing with the image with linear singularity, and it has a better denosing performance for image than a simple wavelet thresholding or curvelet thresholding.

articleTitle: The formation process and the requirements of street space usage
abstract: This study analyze the formation process and the requirement of various usage of road space after the introduction of the regulation on road space usage through the case studies of two types of road at Xi'an city. As the results, the following are made clear.1) the various form of activities appear on the street as a public space, based on people's various and indispensable activity needs. 2) These various form of activities on street space have been connived though it is illegal as for juridical because the system of self-management in the district exists.

articleTitle: The application of project teaching in computer basic course teaching for college students
abstract: This paper elaborates how to make full use of teaching conditions, implement project teaching method in Computer Basic Course in order to intensify students' application skills. It also expounds on the steps of project design and class implement in the chapter of "Internet network application" by using the specific case "Network Music Appreciation." It puts an emphasis on the teaching characteristics of "learn from the process, teach during the process," fully illustrating the idea that computer application should serve for both study and work.

articleTitle: Wavelet based adaptive solution of wave equation multiresolution simulation of wave propagation
abstract: A modified interpolation wavelet-based adaptive-grid scheme is proposed for simulating elastic vector wave propagation in media with sharp transition of physical properties. Here, post processing approach is used to filter spurious oscillations from solution. Finally a 2D vector wave propagation is simulated in a layered media.

articleTitle: The characteristics of evolution of Theravada temple in Yunnan province, China
abstract: Theravada temple is famous in its abundant types and distinct characteristics. The paper focuses on the development proceeding of Theravada temple in Yunnan and sum up the characteristics of evolution, which are discussed and analyzed in critical and ecological ways. Firstly, Theravada temple is homology with Theravada temple in Southeast Asian and develops in different flow. Secondly, it complies with local customs and adapts the natural and social environment. It is possible to say that Theravada architecture is the production and testimony of the Dai phylum culture circle.

articleTitle: JPEG decoding algorithm optimization based on multi-core processor
abstract: Multi-core programming becomes a research hotspot in recent years, as traditional serial programs cannot give full play to the performance benefits of multi-core processor. In this paper, we proposed an optimized approach of JPEG decompression based on multi-core processor, which is an instance of producer-consumer model with implement of list structure. It was shown that the approach improved JPEG decompression performance in terms of decoding time.

articleTitle: Higher all-derivable points on nest algebras
abstract: Let N be a complete nest on a (real or complex) Banach space X such that each N ∈ N complemented in X whenever N_ = N. A sequence of additive mappings D = (d<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i∈N</inf> from algN into itself is called higher derivable mapping at zero point if equation for any A, B ∈ algN with AB = 0. In this paper, we will show the following results: d<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>(I) = c<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>I for some c<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> ∈ F if D is higher derivable mapping at zero point. In particular, if d<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> (I) = 0, then D is higher derivation.

articleTitle: Seismic conceptual design of interchange ramp-bridge
abstract: The construction and stress of ramp-bridge is deferent from other bridges. Seismic conceptual design for bridges on interchange ramp is researched, some problems such as type-selection and seismic constructional details of such bridges were discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Controlling the motion of charged particles by modulating the system parameters
abstract: We investigated a chain of charged particles coupled by a harmonic nearest neighbor interaction with a transversal degree of freedom in a two-dimensional asymmetric potential, based on the application of a crossed static and harmonic fields. We found we can control the velocity of the chain to an optimized value by adjusting the system parameters, such as coupling strength, the winding number, and so on. When adiabatically increasing the coupling strength, the existence of the resonance platform of 2ω indicates the resonance between the motion of the chain and the periodic force. The coverage parameter θ and winding number ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0 y</inf> also play a key role in the control.

articleTitle: The blow-up property for a localized reaction-diffusion system
abstract: This paper deals with the blow-up property of the positive solution for a reaction diffusion system with localized terms u<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> − Δu = e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">mu(0,t)+nν(x,t)</sup>, ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> − Δν = e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pu(x,t)+qν(0,t)</sup> under null Dirichlet condition. The blow up set and blow up rates are obtained.

articleTitle: Edge detection approach based on directionlet transform
abstract: Due to possessing the multi-direction anisotropic basis functions, directionlet transform can capture the inherent geometrical feature of the image. A directionlet transform -based edge detection approach is proposed in this paper. In the approach, we filter along any two directions with two slopes to capture abundant edge information. In addition, we use the multiscale characteristics of directionlet transform. Combine the advantage of small and large scales to get the desirable edge. The experiments indicate that the proposed approach outperforms wavelet and any other traditional approaches.

articleTitle: The probability prediction of storm surge disaster along south-east coasts of China
abstract: The research of long-term risk analysis method of typhoon induced storm surge disaster is always a compelling topic of marine science and engineering. Traditional approach is using univariate probability model based on yearly maximum sampling to describe the characteristics parameters of typhoon and water level. According to the probability analysis results, samples can be generated by using Monte Carlo method and long-term risk of storm surge disaster with some return period is calculated. In this paper, a double layer multi-objective probability model based on multivariate compound extreme value distribution is proposed. The annual typhoon frequency and correlations among different key parameters of typhoon are considered in the new model. This model is applied to the long-term risk analysis of typhoon induced storm surge disaster along the coast of China and it indicates reasonable results.

articleTitle: Applying three-dimensional visualization technology in the area of remote sensing geological mapping
abstract: 3S (Remote Sense, GIS, GPS) technology advances to the regional geological surveys have found widespread application. Especially the remote sensing geological mapping which integrate remote sensing and GIS technology. As the supplement and improvement for traditional geological mapping methods, it plays important role of the large-scale regional geological survey. Based on comparative analysis of DEM interpolation methods, the writer design the two-way mixed function interpolation which is used to process the DEM data accessed openly. It accuracy to match with remote sensing data. Direct3D-based software designed GeoModeling. It uses DEM and remote sensing image after processing to establish remote sensing three-dimensional landscape models, and uses three dimensional visualization technology to assist remote sensing geological mapping work.

articleTitle: Time-sensibility analysis of the rubber powder modified asphalt mixture by dry mixing method
abstract: In this paper, using dry mixing method blended with rubber powder, through the Marshall stability test, the Marshall immersion test and the trabecular bending test, we respectively analyze the high-temperature stability, the water stability and the low-temperature performance of the rubber powder modified asphalt mixture. On the basis, it is also discussed that time sensibility of the rubber powder modified asphalt mixture by dry mixing method.

articleTitle: Research on screw chiller which has high outlet temperature and its performance
abstract: The high outlet temperature chiller is very important equipment for an independent temperature and humidity control system. Improvement of small inner volumetric ratio screw compressor and heat exchanger optimization, with the reliable oil return methods obtain a suitable screw chiller has high outlet temperature. Performance test of temperature variation with COP & IPLV are carried out on a unit. It could provide the help to the design of these systems.

articleTitle: An experimental comparative study on three classification algorithms on unknown malicious code identification
abstract: Dynamic behavior analysis is the direction of unknown malicious code identification. Taking API function called by malicious code as the research object during the peiriod of it being implanted and running, applying three classification algorithms: Decision Tree C4.5, NaiveBayes and Minmum Distance Classification to the identification of unknown malicous code, this paper compare and analyse their performances. The experients result show that, according to practical identification demand, choosing different identification algorithm will have a great effect on identification of unknown malicious code.

articleTitle: An implementation of DTN testbed based on DTN2
abstract: Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) was developed as a proposal for Interplanetary Network (IPN) communication at first. Its primary objective is to support the interconnection and intercommunication in highly stressed network environments including intermittent connectivity, large and/or variable delays, heterogeneous transmission rate, and high bit error rates. DTN researchers have relied heavily on simulation for research. The research object of this paper is to construct a DTN testbed, offer a real experiment environment for research like routing algorithm and DTN application development. This research construct a multiple nodes DTN experiment environment among Linux machines by using the DTN2 implement public released by DTNRG (DTN Research Group), and successfully accomplish different transmission experiments. The experiment simulates intermittent connective network of three-endpoint, we successfully accomplish one transmission experiment base on this DTN testbed. In addition, we selected HBSD as an external routing protocol, and added it to the experimental platform. Using the external routing protocol we successfully accomplish another transmission experiment. The DTN constructed using DTN2 implement is basically finish all BP functions.

articleTitle: Architectural design on natural ventilation
abstract: Buildings should be designed with controllable natural ventilation. In this paper, the author puts forward a set of architecture designing process based on analyzing the purpose and strategy, in order to use the design strategy of natural ventilation not only qualitatively but also quantitatively.

articleTitle: Insight into gross compositions cracking of crude oil based on simulated experiments in opened system
abstract: Cracking simulated experiment on gross compositions of crude oil was carried out. The geochemical analysis results show that gross compositions of crude oil have a similar variation feature with the increasing thermal stress, high carbon number hydrocarbons cracked to form low carbon number hydrocarbons, high temperature cracking products are composed of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1–5</inf> hydrocarbon gas, benzene and its homologues. However, there is subtle difference reflected by the different temperature of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1–5</inf> hydrocarbon gas generation. For saturated hydrocarbons, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1–5</inf> hydrocarbon gas can be detected at 550°C, but for the aromatic hydrocarbons, non-hydrocarbon and pyrobitumen, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1–5</inf> hydrocarbon gas can be determined at 400°C.

articleTitle: The small device design of convex lens concentrating light and hermocouple generating electricity
abstract: The article provides a small device design of convex lens concentrating light and hermocouple generating electricity. According to the principle of thermocouple measuring temperature, when a thermoelectrical generates potential, the device can convert the potential to electricity.Hot end uses convex for focus light to heat and cold end uses water cooling. In order to generate large potential,the thermocouple is in series with ohers.And adopt the scattering shape to arrange. Meanwhile, we use DC millivoltmeter to measure the electric potential. lt has the advantages of simple device space small, optical energy little wasting, saving investment, and low operation fare. What's more,it's good for keeping sustainable development as saving energy and environmental protection.

articleTitle: SIFT method for paper detection system
abstract: Traditional detect method could not deal well with the problem of paper zooming. This paper introduces scale invariant feature transform to the paper detection system. The hardware of paper detection system consists of digital signal processor and complex programmable logic device. The hardware can accomplish image acquisition and processing. The software of this system use SIFT method to detect the papers. Compared to the traditional method, this algorithm deals better with detection process.

articleTitle: A new rate control method for video transcoding
abstract: Rate control algorithm has great impact on the quality of video transcoder. This paper proposed a new rate control method which is based on the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients distributing model. This algorithm can get better performance than traditional video buffering verifier (VBV) based rate control methods.

articleTitle: The integrated spatial planning for Taichung science park community and leisure development
abstract: Over the past few decades, science parks were highlighted as the outcome of policy under tendency of global specialization. However, it lacked comprehensive concept of spatial planning and resulted in the necessity of urban replanning as way to guide the fusion with surrounding natural and humanity environment. This research focuses on the fast growing T.C.S.P. (Taichung Science Park) as case study, bases on the viewpoint of integrated spatial planning, explores main issues and strategies for its community development and spatial planning by adopting the mixed research methods.

articleTitle: Evolution and enlightenment: Modern Chinese urban communities
abstract: Over the 60 years since 1949, Chinese urban communities, with the transformation of social economic system, have gone through the evolution from Legal community and work-unit community to a new type of community. Fundamental changes have taken place in its construction motivation mechanism, organization structure, social relationship between members and the spatial form. Reviewing theories and methods of the present urban community planning that place more emphasis on the technology than the society, multi-field and multi-perspective theories and methods are formed to adapt to the community development under the new situation, which take the spatial organization as the core and borrow from the related disciplines such as sociology and management.

articleTitle: A defect-correction method based on equal-order finite elements for the incompressible flows (I)
abstract: A defect-correction method based on equal-order finite elements for the incompressible flows with a high Reynolds number is considered. This new finite element method satisfied inf-sup stability and enjoys tow prominent features: stabilization of convection-dominated flows, and decrease of computation time by constructing a linear residual correction algorithm in each correction step. Continuous equal-order finite elements for both velocities and pressures, and a backward Euler method for the time approximation are used. The stability and convergence of the velocities are proved. The error estimation results show that one-step correction improves first-order spatial accuracy of velocities regardless of the Reynolds number.

articleTitle: Wideband spectrum sensing with coexistence of strong and weak primary signals
abstract: In cognitive radio applications, the cognitive users should find the spectral hole before it access to the spectrum band licensed to primary users. In order to improve spectral efficiency, wideband spectrum sensing is required for cognitive radio systems. In several environments, some weak primary users (such as microphone signal) are coexisting with strong primary users. In these cases, the weak primary signals may not be detected, and the cognitive user will collide with the primary users. To solve this problem, in this paper, we propose exploiting orthogonal projection technique to sense both the strong and weak primary signals. Finally, the proposed algorithm is verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: The shift from private gardens to urban public landscape
abstract: Xiao Garden, a famous garden of Yangzhou in 18th century, was originally a nursery for Chinese herbaceous peony that had been famous since 10th century. The land of the nursery was bought by Chen Meng-xing, a secluded member of Imperial Academy in 1716. Chen transformed the nursery into a private garden for clan use. The private garden was then turned into one of the three famous places for literati' gathering in Yangzhou. In the middle of 18th century, the name of Xiao Garden was changed to ‘Xiao-yuan-hua-rui’. During that time, the garden was a key place along the landscape between Hong Bridge and Ping-shan Hall. The change of Xiao Garden from an economic nursery to an aesthetic private garden, such a process appears ubiquitous in the transformation of gardens of Jiang-nan. The rapid change from a private garden for clan to a scenic spot opening to city residents, however, occurred only in Yang-zhou of the middle of 18th century. How was a private garden built, transformed and integrated? What was transformed in its spatial structure? Whether the historical changes to Xiao Garden present any rules? Yet, the historical Xiao Garden no longer exists. This article integrates historical texts and pictorial records to represent the spatial structure of Xiao Garden in different periods. It hopes to identify the inherent rules of landscaping activities that transformed Xiao Garden.

articleTitle: Cost optimization of Gamma distribution accelerated burn-in
abstract: The burn-in process is operated under severe (stress) conditions involving high temperature, voltage, etc. and the product's residual life depends on the burn-in stress level and the length of burn-in period. Accelerated burn-in before shipment will reject poor-quality products and improve product reliability within a warranty period. Accelerated burn-in saves time but may cost more. In this paper, our goal is to find the appropriate testing parameters to minimize the total of testing, manufacturing, quality and reliability costs. The upper and lower bounds for the optimal burn-in time are derived. It is assumed in our work that the failure pattern follows Gamma distribution and the burn-in process is operated under approximately the same environment as that of the early operating life of the product.

articleTitle: Studies on sensitivity of Microcystis aeruginosa to four kinds of antibiotics
abstract: Microcystis is the most common dominant species in bloom-forming cyanobacteria, which are influenced by some environmental factors. Among these factors, epiphytic bacteria are one of the important biotic factors for Microcystis growth. In this paper, four kinds of antibiotics (penicillin, chloramphenicol, polymyxin, rifampin) were used to inhibit epiphytic bacteria of Microcystis aeruginosa, aiming to study sensitivity and growth condition of Microcystis aeruginosa under different antibiotics concentration. Results showed that lethal concentration sequence of these antibiotics for Microcystis aeruginosa was as following: penicillin (100µg/mL) > chloramphenicol (10µg/mL) > polymyxin (1µg/mL) > rifampin (0.1µg/mL). Under the lethal concentration, no significant differences were observed in algal growth curves among control and treatment groups (P >0.05), thus influences of epiphytic bacteria on the growth of Microcystis aeruginosa were not obvious.

articleTitle: An identification method on unknown malicious code based on the good or Evil index of API
abstract: This paper puts forward a algorithm based on the good or evil index of API(AGEI) to identify unknown malicious code, it can judge whether the code is malicious or not by a judgement threshold based on the degree of good or evil related API which is catched when the code execute. The experiments result shows that the proposed identification method achieves a good effect on unknown malicious code detection.

articleTitle: A strategy of real-time animation of clothed body movement
abstract: Runtime animation of clothed body has great potential in the applications of many areas, such as virtual fashion, game and 3D movies. In order to enable a quick preview of the clothed body movement, this paper proposes a strategy to generate real-time animation of clothed body movement, which is more fast and convenient than the previous methods. The experimental results show the animation of clothed body movement with realistic performance can be achieved by this proposed strategy.

articleTitle: The portable flue gas analyzer based on the ARM
abstract: In the analysis of domestic and international status of portable flue gas analyzer, based on ARM-based portable flue gas analyzer overcome the traditional electrochemical sensor life and cross-interference and other shortcomings, and the spectral analysis method applied in the flue gas while accurate measurement of multiple gas components. The flue gas analyzer is designed to use the spectrometer of using acquisition circuit CCD to change the light signals into electrical signals, build ARM-based hardware platform and uC/OS-II software platform, the electrical signal data processed to calculate the concentration of gases. ARM-based portable flue gas analyzer belongs to an embedded system with portable, intelligent, miniaturized features.

articleTitle: Influence of structure-soil interaction on seismic responses of bridge
abstract: Through the analysis of seismic responses of large-span arch bridge, the influences of interaction between structure and soil on the seismic responses are studied. In the study, three models of the structure-soil interaction are used, including m-method, p-y curve method and modified p-y curve method considering detachment of structure and soil. The results show that the displacements calculated by the two methods with p-y curves are larger than that of m-method by 40 % to 60%, while the results of two p-y curve methods are close. So p-y curve method should be adopted in analysis of seismic responses of bridges when the interaction between structure and soil is considered.

articleTitle: Searching metadata in Spatial Data Infrastructures for urban planning at local level
abstract: Geographical information is a key resource for urban planning and management of public law. Spatial Data Infrastructures (SDI) enable cooperation and sharing of geospatial data, but the open and distributed character of these infrastructures is a factor that hampers the interaction and contribution from the citizen to those data. This paper presents a proposal supported by Terminological Ontologies, seeking to minimize some problems related to semantics at the search for information in metadata catalogs in a SDI, at a local level.

articleTitle: Research on model data exchange method between different structure CAD systems
abstract: A novel data exchange method based on neutral semantic feature conversion was proposed in this paper. A neutral semantic feature converter was used as transfer station, and modeling information of different systems would be transformed into a kind of unified data message format, and feature dependency graph was used to represent feature modeling information. Mapping relations between heterogeneous CAD systems' commands were implemented using heterogeneous semantic conversion based on this method. System implemented in this paper indicated that synchronous collaborative system of heterogeneous CAD proposed can make users work in a environment of real-time collaborative, and can improve product quality and reduce product design cycle.

articleTitle: A study on octagon building repairing and seismic strengthening technic
abstract: The status of a octagon building on Xiamen Gulangyu island is described in this paper. The existing problems and reasons on its architecture and structure are pointed out, including its foundation, brick wall, brick column, concrete floor, and concrete beams etc. The analysis of earthquake-resistant ability shows that the whole building can't satisfy the new standard for seismic appraisal of buildings. It needs to be repaired and strengthened in the appropriate design method. A new seismic strengthening plan is proposed to make full use of the original components and consolidate them in order to enhance their strength without changing the profile of the building. The structure seismic calculation demonstrates that the strengthened building is safe and stability under the new Code for seismic design of the building.

articleTitle: Frequent oscillation criteria for three-order neutral variable delay dynamic equations with positive and negative coefficients on time scales
abstract: This paper is concerned with a class of three-order neutral variable delay dynamic equations with positive and negative coefficients on time scales. By making use of frequency measure, some new oscillatory criteria are established. And an example is considered to illustrate our main results.

articleTitle: On soliton and multi-soliton solutions of the (2+1)-dimensional Zakharov equation
abstract: In this paper we study the soliton and multi-soliton solutions of the (2+1)-dimensional Zakharov equation(ZE) with a = b = −1. The first kind of soliton or soliton-like solutions of the ZE are obtained by Lou's method. By carefully choosing the arbitrary functions in the resulting linear partial differential equation, explicit soliton solutions may be obtained. The second kind of solutions obtained are a vast kind of multi-soliton solutions. A special ansatz is proposed for getting these multi-soliton solutions.

articleTitle: FLAC3D numerical analysis on surrounding rock mass stability of the underground cavities
abstract: Based on the simplified structure of rock mass, FLAC3D numerical modeling technique is used to analyze systematically the distribution features of filed, strain field and plastic zone in the surrounding rock mass of the underground cavities after the excavation. And, the variable regulations of stress filed, strain field and plastic failure zones in the surrounding rock mass of the underground cavities are summarized. The main results can be taken as the basic data and the theoretical proofs to evaluate cavities stability and guide the correct excavation.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of repairable system with arbitrary structure
abstract: In this paper, a general repairable system that the components have different failure rate and repair rate is studied. It is assumed that the repair rule of the failed components in the system is “last-come-first-served”, and every component after repair is “as good as new”. Then, by using Laplace transform method, the unified state probability formulas of the general repairable system are derived; and some system reliability indices (or its Laplace transform), including the availability, the mean time to first failure, reliability, and rate of occurrence of failures, are obtained analytically. Moreover, the bounds of reliability indices are discussed since exact formulas are very complex. The results are shown that the determination of the maximum number of failed components such that the system can still work and the number of different cases that i components fail but the system still works are sufficient to derive the bounds of reliability indices.

articleTitle: Analysis on urban construction land changes and influential factors of Yangtze River Delta urban agglomerations
abstract: Being the carrier of urban economic activities, urban construction land also has its ecological service value. As a result, it is paid more and more attention to research on urban construction land changes and its influential factors in recent years. This research takes urban construction land of 15 cities in Yangtze River Delta as objects, and aims at analyzing rules of urban construction land changes and the influential factors between 2000 and 2008. In the process of researching, some statistical methods are adopted, such as multiple linear regressions constructing model and cluster analysis. The results are that, (1) the urban construction land of the whole Yangtze River Delta increases largely, and the increasing speed is very fast. (2) The trend of increasing speed drops slowly, and takes on difference in different stages. (3) The differences of construction land changes are obvious among the 15 cities in Yangtze River Delta. (4) The correlation coefficients are the biggest between urban construction land and urban population, and bigger between the urban construction land and fixed assets investment. Growing of population and increasing of fixed assets investment are the important driving force to the changes of urban construction land.

articleTitle: The survey of Tangyin Historic Town of FuZhou, Jiangxi Province
abstract: Based on the estuary town of Jiangxi Province on the development and evolution, analysis of the socio-economic, physical geography, the humanities on the role of the ancient town, and the mouth of the ancient town of space shape, construction, architectural, decorative arts, To find that the cultural integration in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River in Jiangxi Province and the residential construction and the characteristics of the actual have a far-reaching significance.

articleTitle: Expected hitting times for simple random walks on wheel graphs
abstract: By using the electrical network approach, explicit formula for the expected hitting times for simple random walks on wheel graphs is obtained.

articleTitle: An analysis on building craft in Yin Zao Fa Yuan: To “Ti Zhan” as example
abstract: Yin Zao Fa Yuan is a book written by Yao Chengzu, and mainly reflects the building craft of Xiangshan Gang. It is a good point of penetration to analyze the craft in the book by taking the "Ti Zhan" for example. "Ti Zhan" is a keynote regulation about curved roof of Xiangshan Gang's building craft. There is close relationship between Yin Zao Fa Yuan, Xin Bian Lu Ban Yin Zao Zheng Shi and Lu Ban Jing Jiang Jia Jing through comparing the curved roof making methods in these books.

articleTitle: A study on training of rural teachers based on E-Learning
abstract: The problem of rural education is the key problem of Chinese education in future, the development of rural teachers is the central problem. The Chinese governments have adopted series strategies to train rural teachers in many ways, but the effects are barely satisfactory. How to improve the rural teachers' professional level quickly and widely is an era proposition. The attributes of E-Learning are appropriate to the reality lives of rural teachers, so it is an alternative and advanced model of rural teachers training. This paper describe the characters of E-Learning, and put forward four operative strategies.

articleTitle: Monitoring of airplanes in infrared image
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method of monitoring airplanes in infrared image. First classification of airplanes is implemented. Recognition of aircraft conditions can be realized. Changes of airplanes including types, quantity and states can be obtained compared with the used data. Based on the result, a set of warning conditions are generated. It can be concluded that such an approach is effective for monitoring airfield dynamics.

articleTitle: Two different machine assignment methods for steelmaking and continuous casting
abstract: Scheduling difficulties and parallel machine alternative characteristics are centred upon machine assignment problems in steelmaking and continuous casting (SCC) scheduling process. Two different machine assignment methods: dynamic programming and rule-based, are proposed so as to select the better machines for furnace charges. The mathematical models of machine assignment are built up based on the two methods, two rough schedules are formed by solving above two models. Two feasible schedules are produced by using the same conflict elimination mathematical model for machines conflict possible in the rough schedules, and comprehensive evaluation index are established. The both methods are simulated using actual production data from a large steel plant. The two experimental results are evaluated by comprehensive evaluation index. The applicable condition and disadvantages of the both methods are gave through comparing to the simulation results. Powerful support is provided to select rational machine assignment methods for further application in engineering.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of writing function of binocular vision manipulator
abstract: In this paper, a kind of writing function robot of 4-DOF binocular vision manipulator GRB3044 is set up with flexible algorithm that can allow a common robot to write at high accuracy. The mathematical model of writing function robot is built based on the forward and inverse kinematics, and then the methods of determining workspace and the best connected writing region in workspace are given during which maximal area method, horizontal traverse and longitudinal traverse are adopted. Geometry algorithm is proposed to compensate the errors caused by manipulator writing on the basis of error analysis, which improves the position accuracy of the manipulator by 66.7% in horizontal direction and 51.5 times in vertical direction.

articleTitle: Concrete deterioration under alternate action of chemical attack environments
abstract: By micro-and macro-observations, this paper reveals the deterioration mechanisms of concrete under alternate action of carbonation and sodium sulfate solution attack (C-SA), and meanwhile, the single sodium sulfate solution attack (SA) is also done as comparison. The studies indicate: in both cases, the main attack product is ettringite, only in the first layer of case SA some gypsum is checked, and the thaumasite form of sulfate attack is not initiated in case C-SA; compared with single sodium sulfate solution attack, although the carbonation layer mitigates the extent of sulfate attack in limited exposure period, but the alternate action of carbonation and sulfate attack still leads to strength degradation to some extent. The effect of carbonation on sulfate attack for longer exposure period deserves further research.

articleTitle: The study on mitigating seismic pounding of the highpiers bridge
abstract: In this paper, the anti-pounding dampers were installed in longitudinal and transverse directions of a high-pier bridge's pounding locations (expansion joints), under multi-excitation considering the traveling wave effect, doing comparative analysis of the seismic response of the bridge with high-pier between with and without the anti-collision damper which is set on pounding location. anti-collision damper can be effective in preventing collisions between deck beams and between deck beam and block, and the displacements of the bridge piers is limited, internal forces of piers' ends greatly reduced, reducing the damage to piers, which will help to improve the overall seismic performance; but setting collision damper would also adversely affect the bridge with high-pier, increasing the possibility of damage to the deck beams, uncertainty of bearing reaction.

articleTitle: Practice and research on multilevel teaching-based computer fundamental course
abstract: Through summing up the research of other scholars, the definition of multilevel teaching was given. As an example, the implementation and outcomes of computer fundamental course of Business College of Beijing Union University was deeply studied. This paper introduces the background, the scheme, and the specific process for classified teaching. Different objectives were determined, different teaching methods were adopted, and different contents were chosen. Compared with the stratified entrance exam and the final exam scores, the results of the multilevel teaching were deeply analyzed and studied. At last, some still existed problems were put forward and should be solved in the future.

Author Keywords: Business College of Beijing Union University

articleTitle: Temporal and spatial characteristics of county level economic disparities of Baiyin region during the period of 1994–2008
abstract: The regional economic discrepancy has always been acting as a very important part of the region-economy research. Taking county level of Baiyin as the study unit, the temporal characteristics of the regional economy disparity of Baiyin was analyzed through calculating the standard deviation, extreme difference, coefficient of variation and RHL of per capita GDP of different counties and districts from 1994 to 2008. Using the principal component analysis and cluster analysis, the spatial characteristics of the regional economic disparity of 2008 was also analyzed by constructing a comprehensive economic index system which includes fourteen economic indices. The results show: Firstly, the absolute discrepancy of regional economy of five counties (districts) shows an enlarging trend in Baiyin, and this trend mentioned above was speeded up espacially after 2003. The polarization of regional economy was becoming more and more obvious. The standard deviation and extreme difference of per capita GDP increased to 13646.70 yuan and 37007.00 yuan in 2008 from 2819.13 yuan and 7684.00 yuan in 1994 respectively, enlarging 3.84 times and 3.82 times respentively. Secondly, the relative discrepancy of regional economy slightly reduced in Baiyin in the last 15 years. Thirdly, based on the scores of comprehensive economic strength, three counties and two districts of Baiyin was divided into three types of economic areas, namely, more developed, middle developed and less developed.

articleTitle: The design of smart window control system based on GSM network
abstract: For the smart windows system requirements of intelligent home, we have designed a kind of control system for smart window. The core of this control system is the microcontroller STC12C5410AD, The system can realize transmission of wireless data through the GSM module and infrared remote control; realize measuring of environmental parameters through several sensors; realize flexibly driving of DC servo motor through the program. The system has the characteristics of simple circuit, low cost, stability Reliability.

articleTitle: Application of performance management in managing post-training teachers of educational technology
abstract: Recently much attention is paid to the training of teachers' educational technology in primary and middle school. However, researchers know little about managing post-training teachers, which makes the outcome of the training unobvious. Based on the situation, the paper advocates grafting performance management of company into managing post-training teachers' of educational technology; then it mainly explains the feasibility and architecture of performance management applied to manage post-training teachers in primary and middle school. At last, based on relatively theoretical researches and applications abroad, the paper sums the problems that maybe happen to apply performance management to post-training teachers' of educational technology in primary and middle school, for further consideration.

articleTitle: Simple singlet fermionic dark-matter model under the new results of dark matter search
abstract: The simple singlet fermionic dark matter (DM) extension of standard model (SM) is studied in this paper, we study this model more completely, we consider that the dark matter mass in a much wide range, and we have studied the influence of mixing angle θ in this model. We also update the value of ƒ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Ts</inf> from the recent lattice simulation to give a more accurate spinindependent elastic dark matter-nucleon scattering cross-section. We find that WMAP and CDMS, XENON experiments together give a stringent constraint to this model, the coupling constant in the dark sector must be much small in case of that mass of DM is light, when DM is heavy light Higgs may be excluded. The Higgs decay is also studied in some benchmark points.

articleTitle: The strategy of serivce migration based on WSRF in Grid GIS
abstract: In the distributed architecture of Grid GIS, the key part is to share spatial information resources, these resources include spatial data resources and spatial service resources. This paper will research the spatial service resources sharing in Grid GIS environment, and put forward a strategy of service migration based on WSRF by this strategy, and combined with the stateful resource of grid service, implement spatial service resources sharing between different nodes under different users.

articleTitle: On the application of corpus in data-driven form-focused English vocabulary teaching
abstract: With the development of computer science, the emerging of corpus provides convenience for the English teaching, especially English vocabulary teaching. But the existing research of English vocabulary teaching has been focusing on how to memorize words theoretically from cognitive linguistics perspectives. This paper introduced the method of the data-driven form-focused vocabulary teaching by concordancing and also explored and analyzed the effects of this teaching method by comparing it with the traditional one in an experiment.

articleTitle: On the earth rotation with GPS and VLBI observations
abstract: In this paper, first of all, VLBI observations (NGS format) are used to estimate the earth rotation parameters (ERP). Secondly, the NGS data related GPS observations by the GPS stations co-located with the above VLBI stations are used to estimate the ERP. Thirdly, their results are respectively compared with IERS 08 C04, which shows that the result of GPS cannot get the precision of VLBI stations of equal number. So, 22 GPS stations distributed evenly are chosen to estimate the ERP, the result of which shows that the precision of ERP estimated by GPS has not only been improved a lot, but also it can almost achieve precision of ERP estimated by the VLBI when the number of GPS stations is added to 80.

articleTitle: Global existence and finite time blow-up for a degenerate reaction-diffusion system with non-local sources
abstract: This paper concerns with a nonlinear degenerate parabolic system coupled via non-local sources, Sub-jecting to the null Dirichlet boundary condition. The main aim of this paper is to study conditions on the global existence and blow up in finite time of the solutions. The results depend crucially on the difference q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> -mn and on the domain Ω∈ R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on the subdivision visualization algorithm of complex bridge structure
abstract: The capacity that computer can solve more complex post-processing problem is gradually increased. The demand for section internal force of 3D solid model on engineering is also gradually increased. In view of this, this paper mainly analyzed the following several aspects. Firstly, proposed subdivision algorithm of the key sections in finite element model. Three subdivision algorithms for subdividing the solid model are obtained after describing the realization ideas and the solutions to the various difficulties. Secondly, put forward the subdivision methods of large-scale solid elements. After investigating the three subdivision algorithms, the most effective subdivision algorithm is given to do the subdivision of the solid model. Lastly, proposed the stress interpolation methods of the nodes in the subdivided sections. The stress of the intersection points used to calculate the internal forces of sections can be obtained after linear interpolating the stress of the adjacent nodes. This paper indicates that it can deal with the key methods of the section internal force calculation after using the subdivision algorithm.

articleTitle: Some results on decision of basic groups and basic semigroups in partial multiple-valued logic
abstract: Completeness theory of function sets in multiple-valued logic includes three famous problems, that is to decide all precomplete classes in complete k-valued logic functions , partial k-valued logic functions and unary k-valued logic functions, respectively, where k>;1. In this paper, for the third problem, some results on the decision problem of basic groups in partial multiple-valued logic are present; meanwhile, it is proved that the precomplete classes which include non-trivial unary semigroup are fully determined by singular semigroup.

articleTitle: Scaling and simulation on measuring regional economic disparities based on grid spatial scaling effect analysis
abstract: The measurement of regional economic disparities is a scientific issue, closely related with scale. Based on Geographical information system (GIS) technology, selecting Lorenz curve, GINI coefficient and THEIL coefficient as the measuring index, this paper discusses the spatial scaling effect using grid method by up scaling. The main findings are as follows: With the increase of spatial grain in size, GINI coefficient and THEIL coefficient both present a decreasing tendency and the degree of downward bending of Lorenz curve is also decreasing, which all show regional economic disparities decrease. With the first 3-7 increase of spatial extent, GINI coefficient and THEIL coefficient change greatly and they are no obvious regularity. Since then, the measuring results tend to stabilization with the increase of spatial extent. On the large scale, the whole spatial rule is easy to find, but the details on the small scale are omitted. Meanwhile, on the small scale, the micro rules are easy to find, but the macro rule cannot be presented. Therefore, the suitable scale in the study of regional economic disparities can be determined by the specific research purpose and research object.

articleTitle: Resource scheduling based on cooperative particle swarm optimization in trusted computing environment
abstract: In trust-based network computing environment, in order to establish a harmonious network environment, and enhance the network resources sharing utilization, resources scheduling research faces more problems than ever before. A resource scheduling algorithm, using cooperative particle optimization and putting task completion price and overall system trust benefits as optimized object, is proposed based on the trust model proposed by Internet-based Virtual Computing Environment (iVCE). Simulation results indicate that the algorithm has obvious performance advantage in the aspects of whole system credibility and resource utilization rate than other classic scheduling algorithms. The algorithm can realize rational scheduling of network resources, and optimize the system performance in trusted computing environment.

articleTitle: Design and realization of automotive data recorder hardware circuit based on C8051F020
abstract: Dynamic performance parameter is the important information of automotive motility. In this paper, a automotive data recorder which based on C8051F020 is designed. With this data recorder, parameter such as automotive speed and temperature can be monitored dynamic. Moreover, its precision and stability are excellent. With the hardware circuit, signals of various transducers are collected and disposed. In addition, data display and storage functions are realized and some alarm functions are designed. With the ISP (in system programming) characteristic of C8051F020, update of software system can be realized expediently.

articleTitle: Optimal estimation of parameters for a three-species food chain model
abstract: A three-species food chain model was considered. The parameters of the model are estimated by adjoint data assimilation method. The results showed the method is valid. This method has potential application to a wide variety of models in biomathematics.

articleTitle: Automatic video object segmentation based on spatio-temporal information
abstract: A novel video moving object segmentation algorithm based on spatio-temporal information is proposed in this paper. In temporal information extracting, the value of background noise variance is estimated by histogram fitting to overcome the shortcoming of setting the value by experience, then the significance test is applied to threshold the difference image and extract the moving areas, furthermore, a symmetrical difference method is adopted to achieve accurate moving object mask. In spatial image information extracting, an improved multi-scale watershed algorithm based on viscous morphological gradient correction and edge value merging is employed to get spatial regions which can solve over segment problems greatly. Finally, video object are extracted by performing double threshold ratio operation on spatial and temporal results. Experimental results validate the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A parallel immune genetic algorithm Based on simulated annealing
abstract: On the base of analyzing genetic algorithm's advantages and disadvantages and in terms of the biological immunity concept, we proposed one new algorithm-A parallel immune genetic algorithm based on simulated annealing. The immunity algorithm uses the way of vaccination vaccine and uses the question's prior knowledge, to speed up the algorithm convergence rate effectively. At the same time, to prevent "precociously" phenomenon occurrence, it has used the simulation annealing operator, so it can guarantee the optimization process toward the direction of global optimum and use the mind of parallel computing to make the potential parallelism of genetic algorithm be fully reflected. The theoretical analysis and the simulation results indicated that this algorithm can raise the convergence rate and the stability effectively.

articleTitle: The applied study of the combining multimedia teaching with traditional teaching in the operative procedure teaching
abstract: In this study, in order to improve the teaching effects in clinical medicine courses, multimedia teaching and traditional teaching were combined in operation programme in nursing major. One hundred and two undergraduates majoring in nursing were distributed randomly into two groups, i.e., the case group and the control group. The case group was administrated in traditional teaching method, while combined teaching method was applied to the case group. The results indicated that the combined teaching method being a useful and effective teaching method, was worthy of spreading.

articleTitle: The reclamation potential assessment of the damaged land by Wenchuan earthquake
abstract: Through several field surveys about Wenchuan earthquake stricken area, according to land damaged characteristics and the local basic conditions, it is concluded that the reclamation of damaged land in Wenchuan earthquake is restricted by natural conditions,basic conditions and social-economic conditions which are related with various factors or targets. In light of analytic hierarchy process, assessment system of land reclamation potential in Sichuan earthquake stricken area is established to obtain the critical value of reclamation potential.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on de-icing method for coupled transmission tower-line system
abstract: For the disaster brought by the transmission line regulation, a new de-icing method is presented in this paper. It is supposed that the ice and transmission line are combined closely when there is no external loads, the composite structure of ice-transmission line is set up with the finite element analysis software SAP2000, the 500KV cat-head tower used in the practical projects is applied, then the coupled model of the composite structure-tower is set up. The composite structure can be applied to exciting loads, the frequency of which is close to the natural frequency of ice, the model of which is simulated by the finite element analysis software SAP2000. The natural frequency of ice is far from that of the transmission line. Based on the resonance theory, the ice occurs to deform and crush, finally the ice divorces from the conductors under the function of the exciting load, but those transmission lines are still very safe, the analytical solution can be obtained and the new de-icing method for transmission line based on the theory of resonance is got. It is suitable for the transmission line to de-ice through the computation of the concrete example. It can be concluded that the de-icing method based upon resonance theory is feasible.

Author Keywords: the composite structure of ice-transmission line

articleTitle: Donor impurity states in a quantum well under magnetic fields: A non-variational approach
abstract: We present an efficient method for calculation of the impurity binding energy in a quantum well (QW) under the magnetic field. The calculations were performed for both ground and excited states. The dependences of binding energies versus impurity position and magnetic field are presented for GaAs/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.7</sub>As QW.

articleTitle: Strain monitoring of the Super long prestressed foundation beam
abstract: The exhibition hall of Hefei lakeside international convention center is shaped surface space grid and tube truss structure.in order to balance the horizontal force caused by the long span steel roof, the foundation beam with a span of 76.3m adopts bonded prestressed concrete beam, which is the longest span in China. In order to meet the design requirements to ensure the prestressed beams, using strain monitoring system to track and monitor the Strain rate of the prestressed beams and the steel strand. The results show that: For the similar design of prestressed concrete beams in this project, the need to consider calculating the Bearing capacity of the beam and crack computation of the tension before imposing beams prestressed tension; ordinary one end of tensioning prestressed concrete beam method is not suitable for the long prestressed girder which must be used at both ends of tension; the rule of the stress losses is not the same as the conventional prestressed concrete beam, it is necessary to revise the formula to adapt for calculating such long prestressed beams.

articleTitle: A Bayes thresholding method based on edge protection strategies
