articleTitle: A stochastic method for calculating the collision and agglomeration in an electrostatic agglomerator
abstract: The present study developed a stochastic model to simulate collision and agglomeration between bipolarly charged particles based on the classical Euler/Lagrange approach. The particle initial charge was sampled from the charge distribution by statistical analysis. Collision was determined by comparison of collision probability and a random number. The effect of particle charge on collision and agglomeration was embodied in the agglomeration criteria. Whether a coagulation event occurs or not was determined by comparison of particle's adhesive and repulsive energy. The effect of collision and agglomeration on the particle charge distribution and diameter distribution were investigated.

articleTitle: Reflection on plan and architecture design of new countryside in Ningbo
abstract: The plan and architecture design of new countryside will often have an influence on the country civilization and the integration of rural and urban areas. By reflecting on this aspect, this paper analyzes the significance and problems of plan and design for the new countryside in Ningbo. Taken the reform and reconstruction of rural housing in Caojia Village as an example, this paper attempts to explore the principle and an reasonable pattern for the layout and design of new countryside, that is all the design and plan should inherit the traditional country civilization and be fully incorporated into the urban development.

articleTitle: Theoretical investigation on heats of formation for derivatives of 1,2,4-triazole
abstract: Heats of formation (HOFs) for the derivatives of 1,2,4-triazole in gas at 298 K were determined for the first time using isodesmic reactions at B3P86/6-311G** level. The performance of employed theory level and isodesmic reactions for calculating HOFs was first verified to be accurate to within 1.6 kcal mol<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> by a test molecule system. The data of HOFs indicate that energetic materials with high positive HOFs can be obtained by introducing nitro, nitroamino group substituting at N atom.

articleTitle: Polar optical phonon modes of a wurtzite ZnO/MgZnO multi-shell spherical quantum dot
abstract: Based on the macroscopic dielectric continuum model and Loudon's uniaxial crystal model, the phonon modes of a wurtzite quasi-O-dimensional (QOD) multi-shell spherical quantum dot (QD) are derived and studied. Via solving Laplace equations under the spheniodal coordinates, the analytical and unified phonon states and dispersive equations are derived. Numerical analysis on a wurtzite three-layer ZnO/Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O/MgO QD is performed. The two-mode behavior of Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O ternary compounds is taken into account. The frequency ranges of the full phonon modes of the ZnO/ Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O /MgO QDs are analyzed and discussed. It is found that there are two types of dispersive phonon modes, i.e. quasi-confined (QC), and the interface optical (IO) phonon modes coexisting in QOD wurtzite ZnO/ Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O/MgO QD structures. Moreover, the QC modes also have three types of forms, i.e. QC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup> (vibration waves located in the central ZnO material), QC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ii</sup> (vibration waves located in the Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O material) and QC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i-ii</sup> (vibration waves located both in the ZnO and Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>O materials). The IO modes appear only in one frequency range. The QC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sup> modes exist in two frequency ranges, while the QC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ii</sup> and Qc<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i-ii</sup> modes may appear in three frequency ranges. The analytical phonon states and dispersive equations obtained here are quite useful for further investigating Raman spectra of phonons and other relative properties of wurtzite multi-shell QOD QD systems.

articleTitle: Stability of pile foundation in karst
abstract: In karst terrain, base rock surface is undulate and space of karst cavity is various. When pile foundation is used in karst, it is necessary to consider the stability issues of pile foundation. Based on the interrelation of pile and surface characteristics of the base rock and karst cavity position, the stability issues of pile foundation in karst may be divided into two kinds. One is the stability issue of the cavity roof between the bottom of pile and karst cavity under the loading. The other is the stability of covered karst free-body when the bottom of pile is located near the free-plane. Through using the three dimension finite element method (3D FEM), the computer simulation and the multiple linear regression method, this paper analyzes the two kinds of stability issue and discusses factors of the stability. The equation of the critical value of safe roof thickness is given, and the size of karst cavity and the design loading of pile are also included. The equation of the critical loading of pile located near the free-plane is given, and the thickness of soil above, the friction coefficient, obliquity and highness of structure plane and the obliquity of free-plane are also included. Engineers can use these equations to design pile foundation in karst conveniently. These equations are validated by using many engineering examples in China and the results indicate that these equations are applicable.

articleTitle: Soft infrastructure as a new potential for urban development in Taipei City
abstract: The fashion industry has created employment opportunities in the service class worldwide since last quarter of 20th Century. The fashion industry has created local and global networks among fashion clusters in different cities; moreover, cities can exchange information and knowledge of fashion to each other through dialogue of dynamic fashion clusters and networks. Over the last decade, Taiwan's central government has promoted the Cultural and Creative Industries (CCIs) as a national development policy. However, Taiwan still struggles with issues related to cultural policy and urban development. This study examines strategic planning and cultural policies as soft infrastructure that can promote urban economies. As a cultural industry, service sector is an important part of the fashion industry that is included in cultural policy. This study is focused on aspect of fashion professionals. Fashion professionals determine the distribution of fashion networks and clusters in Taipei City, Taiwan. A geographic information system is used to obtain data for the fashion industry in Taiwan. This study offers suggestions for how soft infrastructure can be utilized to create Taipei as a fashion capital.

articleTitle: Face recognition at-a-distance using texture, Sparse-Stereo, and Dense-Stereo
abstract: This paper proposes a framework for face recognition at a distance based on texture, Sparse-Stereo, and Dense-stereo reconstruction. We develop a 3D acquisition system that consists of two CCD stereo cameras mounted on pan-tilt units with adjustable baseline. In this paper we introduce our stereo-based indoor/outdoor environment and different ranges human faces database. Also, we propose a front-to-end system of 3D face reconstruction and recognition. We first detect the facial region and extract its landmark points, which are used to initialize the face alignment algorithm. The fitted mesh vertices, generated from the face alignment process, provide point correspondences between the left and right images of a stereo pair; stereo-based reconstruction is then used to infer the 3D information of the mesh vertices. Also the dense 3D is reconstructed for the cropped stereo pair based on graph cut approach. We perform experiments regarding the use of different features extracted from these vertices for face recognition. The cumulative rank curves (CMC), which are generated using the proposed framework, confirm the feasibility of the proposed work for long distance recognition of human faces.

articleTitle: Effects of different sand burial depths on seedling growth of three psammophytes
abstract: Effects of sand burial depth on seedling growth of three dominant annual herbaceous plants in Horqin Sandy Land were studied. Nine treatments of sand burial depth were designed, growth characteristics including survival rates, seedling height, total biomass and its allocation were measured. The results showed that shallow burial depth stimulated the survival rates of three species, however, severe sand burial is fatal to plants. The upper threshold limit of Setaria viridis and Corispermum macrocarpum seedlings to sand burial stress is 100% of their height, Agriophyllum squamosum seedling has the strongest adaptability to sand burial, can even survive when the burial depth reached to 10 cm higher than its height. The response of seedling height and biomass among three species is different, contrary to Corispermum macrocarpum, seedling height of Setaria viridis and Agriophyllum squarrosum were stimulated in shallow depth. Compare with the other two species, Agriophyllum squarrosum allocated more to roots, this may be one of its adjustment mechanism to sand burial.

articleTitle: Analysis of land cover patterns in Panyu District based on TM image
abstract: By adopting GIS method and landscape ecology theory, the land cover landscape map for Panyu District is generated from Landsat-TM images captured in 1990, 1995, 2000 and 2005. Based on the quantitative study of LUCC, we use the landscape pattern indices to reflect the change mechanism of land cover in Panyu District, therefore to provide a basis for further study in ecological effects. It shows that the structure of land cover was in a development adjusting period from 1990 to 1995, followed by an increasing tendency toward maturity after 2000 accompanied by urbanization process. During the study period, the land use fragmentation and complexity of Panyu District have increased, natural effects on land cover changing diminished gradually by increasing influences of human factors.

articleTitle: Retraction Notice: Impact of magnetization field/torsion field on the formation of hexagonal water crystal
abstract: In this paper, the morphology growth of hexagonal water crystal under effect of magnetization field and “torsion field” was investigated. In order to conduct the experiment, we use permanent magnets having their own “torsion field” according to the study of A. I. Veineik [1] to consider how the proportion and the shape of hexagonal water crystal appear with different strength of magnetic field divided into three ranges: under 1500 gausses, from 1500 gausses to 3000 gausses, and over 3000 gausses. The experimental results revealed a remarkable difference between treatment water and no treatment one. The higher proportion of hexagonal water crystal happened in water samples treated with “torsion field”, from 1 to 4 successful samples in 30 samples. Otherwise, This difference also occurs in the three-range of magnetic field strength which was under 1500 gausses, from 1500 to 3000 gausses and over 3000 gausses, respectively. Moreover, in the range of over 3000 gausses, we conducted the experiments with different treatment time with “torsion field” to investigate the appearance rate of hexagonal water crystal according to the change of time in 12 hours, 24 hours and 48 hours, respectively. Under observation, when the strength of magnetic field was under 1500 gausses, the hexagonal water crystal was not perfect. Conversely, these hexagonal water crystals in the range of from 1500 to 3000 gausses were more perfect and complicated than those in the smaller range. For the rest part of the range, the proportion of hexagonal water crystal decreased or seldom appeared with different time of “torsion field” treatment. These empirical results proved that the “torsion field” of permanent magnets effect to the hexagonal water crystal formation.

articleTitle: The application of multimedia technology in college English teaching
abstract: With the development of modern education technology, multimedia technology greatly improves teaching efficiency and quality of college English teaching. This article focuses on the application of multimedia technology in college English teaching, explores its principles, advantages, limitations and feasible strategies, hoping to make better use of its advantages and bring its potential into full play.

articleTitle: Numerical calculation and analysis on diffusion property of sediment particle cloud in the water
abstract: Based on the Eulerian-Lagrangian method, a three dimensional numerical model has been developed by using the modified ks parameterization for the turbulence in fluid phase and Lagrangian method for the solid phase. The model has been verified by using measured variation of diffusion properties of sediment particle cloud in the water, such as the vertical frontal position Z<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub>, longitudinal width L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> and longitudinal frontal position Xp Finally, the variation of the turbulent kinetic energy of sediment particle clouds during the diffusion process in the water is studied by using this verified model. The numerical results show that the turbulent kinetic energy of sediment particle cloud is affected by the speed of cross-flow velocity, the size of initial volume of sediment cloud and the difficult particle size.

articleTitle: A new fast fractal coding method for the detection of microcalcifications in mammograms
abstract: Microcalcifications in mammograms can be considered as early signs of breast cancer. A new fast fractal image coding method for the detection of microcalcifications in the ROIs of mammograms is proposed in this paper. Sankar improved the conventional fractal image coding method, but not thoroughly enough. It is modified in the proposed method that both range and domain blocks are classified; two adaptive thresholds are presented which are used for the binaryzation before which the restored image is median filtered. According to this study, the proposed method, comparing with the Sankar's method, has higher detection speed and detection performance.

articleTitle: A practical algorithm for image spherical surfacing and its implementation on Symbian platform
abstract: The custom-features have been more and more incorporated in mobile phones nowadays, and displaying a personalized image on a mobile phone becomes a trend along with the advancement of entertaining functions being embedded. In this paper, an alternative spherical surfacing algorithm is proposed, and its mathematical modeling is built, the mapping function and interpolation are derived. The proposed spherical surfacing technique is implemented on Symbian platform with a given image on mobile phone, indicating the effectiveness of the algorithm developed. Brief discussions are made in the end of this paper.

articleTitle: On the Z2 index of global attractor for odd dynamical systems and application
abstract: In this paper, by applying Z<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> index, we are concerned with the geometry of global attractor for odd dynamical systems, we extend the results in [1] for p-Laplacian to general odd dynamical systems, to be precise, we firstly prove that the global attractor for odd dynamical systems is symmetric if it exists, and then the lower bound of Z<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> index of the symmetric global attractor is estimated. As application, we consider the Z<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> index of global attractors for reaction-diffusion equation with polynomial nonlinearity of odd power terms.

articleTitle: From making form to finding form: A new method of building form design
abstract: Traditional building form design methods have a clear and static target, but this article would discuss that nowadays the method of building form design changes from Making Form to Finding Form. Finding Form is a new method that architects do not have a clearer target, but there is a logical chain that contact with a variety of architectural elements of quantization. So this method can deal with very complicated architectural problem. And this paper also argues that Digital Technology is a key tool that supports the method of Finding Form. Because there are two advantages of digital tools: first, it can express architectural problem dynamically; Second, it can contact Form and Information closely.

articleTitle: Research and application of global illumination in tower simulator with Cascaded Light Propagation Volumes
abstract: To obtain higher efficiency and better visual veracity in complex, dynamic, real-time tower simulator scenes, we present a method named Cascaded Light Propagation Volumes of global illumination in this paper, which is based on the GPU-programmable rendering pipelines, then rendering the real-time global illumination. In the process of representing the spatial distribution of light in the tower simulator scenes, we use some techniques like reflective shadow maps, spherical harmonics and virtual point lights to actualize this method. At the same time, by using the nested lattices, we simplify the large scenes' complexity and make the real-time rendering more efficient. Through analyzing the experimental results, we could prove that this method can generate the global illumination quickly in the tower simulator and has high efficiency and better realistic compared with Ray tracing method and pre-computed radiance transfer (PRT) method.

articleTitle: Planning method and case study on developing low-slope hilly land
abstract: Due to sensitive ecology, high capital cost and complex utilization technology, low-slope hilly land development faces planning challenges, which is an important choosing as urban construction. Taking Datian Machinery & Cast Industry City as an example, the paper suggests deciding landuse evaluation, industrial organization, vertical design, layout pattern based o and GIS technology, which is complemented with the principles in land consolidation engineering method.

articleTitle: Landslide hazards on engineered slopes during periodic wet spells: Case of Singapore
abstract: Damages to roads, infrastructure, and property due to slope failures during heavy rainfall events in urban Singapore are well-documented. This study highlights repeated failures on engineered slopes in response to cycles of wet and dry spells to show a close relationship between the frequently occurring cyclic weather phenomena and a natural geomorphic event that has the potential of becoming a hazard in urban areas. In view of this hazard potential of engineered slopes, attention needs to be focussed on managing it to reduce inconvenience, and possible disruption to the urban system.

articleTitle: Study and implementation LOD algorithm based on geometric feature
abstract: Based on LOD algorithm of triangle collapse, an optimal triangle collapse algorithm is proposed and LODs of 3-D model is generated. And more, interpolating algorithm between different LODs is brought forward and smooth transition between different levels of detail of model is accomplished.

articleTitle: Development of remote positioning and control system based on SCM and SIM508
abstract: A remote positioning and control system based on SCM and SIM508 was studied and tested in this paper. The experiment results show that the terminal's GPS data was transmitted to monitor and control center by GPRS network. At the meantime, the control information from monitor and control center was transmitted to the terminal by GPRS too. Because of the wide range of GPRS network, this system can position and control at very long distance in real time. The technology can be used in automatic cruise, unmanned exploration, rescue and guidance of weapon and so on.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the influence of structural planes to stability of tunnel surrounding rock
abstract: It is hard to avoid passing through the structural planes such as faults, joints and bedding planes in tunnel construction. All of these geological defects make a critical influence of the stability of underground excavations. Under actual condition, surrounding rock failure is difficult to be observed and studied. In this paper, RFPA(Realistic Failure Process Analysis), a numerical simulation software is used to study the instability and failure mechanism of tunnel surrounding rock under the influence of structural planes. Five faults at different position are tested in the simulation and the process of rock failure and the character of acoustic emission are recorded. The results show that when these models start to produce acoustic emission, these phenomena first generate at the position of fault. Since the presence of faults, deformation of surrounding rock will be different with the location of faults.

articleTitle: A new SVM Chinese text of classification algorithm based on the semantic kernel
abstract: Popular Chinese text classification algorithms are mostly based on word frequency statistics features, ignoring the characteristics of Chinese text between the semantic relevance. To further improve the Chinese text classification results, the paper presents a new semantic-based kernel of SVM algorithm for Chinese text classification, through simple idea and smaller implementation costs. Experiments show that compared with traditional SVM algorithm, the algorithm in the Chinese text classification efficiency and accuracy has significantly improved, with good classification results.

articleTitle: Basis theorem for degenerate affine Hecke algebras
abstract: We prove the basis theorem for degenerate affine Hecke algebras by finding their Groebner-Shirshov bases and the corresponding standard monomials.

articleTitle: Study on deformation of Mu-Zhu-Ping slope due to the rise of Reservoir water level
abstract: Mu-Zhu-Ping slope, located on the right bank of the estuary of the primary tributary Mo-Dao River on the left bank of Qing-Jiang Shui-Bu-Ya Reservoir region in Hubei province, China, is mainly composed of loose deposit of Quaternary system. On May 10th in 2007, when Shui-Bu-Ya Reservoir water level rose to 289m, the front part of the slope was collapsed locally, so it is significant to study on the stability of Mu-Zhu-Ping slope. At first, three-dimensional geology generalization model was established according to the topographic and geologic conditions of Mu-Zhu-Ping slope. And then, based on coupled fluid-solid theory, the Fluid-Solid Coupling calculation was made on different water levels by the ABAQUS finite element software. According to the calculation, the results show that displacement in the front of slope was larger along with reservoir water level rise. When water level reached to 289m, the phenomenon of deformation and slumping was occurred locally in the front of slope. When water level is 360m, it was that deformation zone was formed in the front of slope while the stability at the central and upper part was better. When water level reached to 400 m, the instability would be happened in the front part of the slope locally because two larger deformation area was generated in the front of slope, and plastic path at the bottom of the slope was cutting thought thus the global stability of the slope was poor. The achieved results can provide a foundation for the further analysis of the stability of Mu-Zhu-Ping slope.

articleTitle: Wave vectors of light beams in anisotropic crystals
abstract: Starting with the introduction of wave vectors of light beams in anisotropic crystals, we examine the relationship between wave vector and electric displacement vector. Based on the fact that the two wave vectors with different magnitudes and directions in a crystal can be solved by the determinantal equations of the wave differential equations an ambiguity in representation of birefringence phenomena is pointed out and a way to free of the ambiguity is set forth.

articleTitle: Noise elimination algorithms for terrestrial 3D laser scanning data based on LS fitting
abstract: In order to avoid the influence on the founding of DEM, noise elimination is an important step for data processing after acquisition. Based on Least Squares theory, reference plane and partial planes are fitted separately. By comparing the relative position of each other, obvious noises are eliminated. Then, second filtering is carried out based on the distance from scattered data points to fitting plane. To prove the feasibility of noise elimination algorithms, experiments are taken, and the outcome indicates that the method is appropriate for gently area, and effect is remarkable.

articleTitle: Research on network security measures of digital library in university
abstract: Digital libraries are important information base establishment in university. The securities of its existence and service are paid attention continually. Thinking of the requests of security for digital resources, those factors of affecting digital library securities were discussed deeply, and countermeasures of security for university digital library.

articleTitle: The thinking about the architecture design teaching under the background of rapid urbanization
abstract: Wally Grace as the assistant secretary-general of UN had said that urbanization is probably the incomparable rosy future for human, also may be an unprecedented disaster. So the future will be depended on what we do today [1]. At present Chinese economic sustains rapid development, the process of urbanization accelerates. At the same time it needs lots of architectural design talents. This paper first analyses the current situation of architecture design teaching and sustainable development, then discusses about establishing a sustainable development architectural design teaching mode so that we can better cope with rapid urbanization in China.

articleTitle: The study of micromechanics models to epoxy resin composites filled by nano-rubber particles
abstract: Nanocomposites are provided with outstanding properties different from ordinary material—reinforcing and toughing, which have great potential and prospects. This paper has carried on some mechanics experiments of epoxy resin filled by nano-rubber particles through MTS, and have gained their mechanics properties. In the meanwhile, the basic theory and formulas of micromechanics are presented, and are applied to various rubber-reinforced epoxy resin composites to predict the overall modulus. At last, theoretical predictions are compared with experimental data for isotropic composites, it is found that experimental results are all higher than the Hashin-Shtrikman bounds for two-phase isotropic composite materials, so it is necessary for further take the nanoeffects of nanorubber particles into account.

articleTitle: Maximum principles for inhomogeneous equation
abstract: A class of inhomogeneous semilinear elliptic equations is considered. The Hopf maximum principles are used to deduce that certain functions defined for solutions of the equation attain a maximum on the boundary of the demain or at a critical point of the solution. Dirichlet problem and Neumann problem are considered also. These maximum principles may be used to determine bounds for quantities of interest in some physical problems. Our results generalize and deepen those from corresponding work in [5, 6].

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of local flow characteristic around spur dikes
abstract: Based on vorticity and stream function method, the flow characteristic around spur dike is analysed in condition of various length, width, discharge and space. It shows that the width and the discharge effect little on local velocity filed, the range of back water area expands with the length increasing, while the space between spur dikes keeps non-linear relationship with the length of circulating region and scour depth.

articleTitle: Tailored finite point methods for solving Poisson and biharmonic problems
abstract: We study a tailored finite point method (TFPM) for solving the Poisson's equation, and extent the application for TFPM to the biharmonic problem. The solution's basis functions for the TFPM are constructed by some hyerbolic functions and trigonometric functions. Some truncation error calculations are given. Numerical tests are given on problems containing the L-shaped domain. The tests compare TFPM with a software package, and suggest that TFPM gives a good numerical solution.

articleTitle: On the periods of polar motion with VLBI observations
abstract: In this paper, the polar motion series is obtained by processing the 09-10 VLBI data downloaded from IVS. The precision of the polar motion series is also been estimated. In order to extracting the periodical components of the polar motion series, the spectrum analysis method of FFT is applied to the polar motion series after interpolating and wavelet de-noising.

articleTitle: Fangzi district in Weifang industrial value research and protection
abstract: With China's economic development, industrial restructuring and the impact of the market economy, many old industries were forced to close, which was led to a lot of old industrial buildings to be idle or abandoned, including the buildings with many value. The determination and protection research on the value of these industrial heritage promote the development of industrial heritage. Many changes have taken place in Fangzi District during the German Occupation periods and because of its historical and cultural values the left industrial heritage was drew large attention. This paper aims to give several recommendations about its protection after field research.

articleTitle: Multi-resolution quad-tree based algorithm for real- time visualization of massive terrain dataset
abstract: Three-dimensional terrain visualization is an important issue of the virtual battlefield. The rendering fidelity is very low because of the impact of the terrain property information in a specific application environment. The quad-tree of multi-resolution was designed to organize the terrain data. The effect of terrain feature was imported to reconstruct node evaluation function, which can make the quad-tree visualization suitable for more application situations. It can ensure the lowest distortion of the terrain feature in an application situation. The method to eliminate cracks based on index template boundary algorithm was presented. It realizes the seamless transition during the rendering process for a large amount of data mesh. The experimental results show this algorithm improves the roaming efficiency and the visualization effects for the large-scale terrain rendering.

articleTitle: Analysis and evaluation on energy consumption of new residences' building envelope in Wuhan
abstract: According to the analysis on the current residential energy consumption status and the characteristic of widely used analysis methods of energy consumption, we choose a scientific method of energy consumption analysis that is suitable for Wuhan, i.e. BIN method(simplified calculation method of energy consumption). Choosing six representative residential projects, our analysis and evaluation focus on the energy consumption level of windows, roof and wall. At the same time, evaluate different technical solutions for individual energy saving measures, choose the lowest energy consumption solution, And some countermeasures were provided for the promotion of the energy-saving residence in terms of energy consumption.

articleTitle: Control elements analysis & countermeasures in construction project management
abstract: Progress, cost and quality are these main control elements for project management. How to find the optimal solution between progress and cost by the promise of quality assurance, and effectively control them in the process of project management? This will bring tremendous benefits for project.

articleTitle: Photodetached electronic wave packet dynamics near metal surface in electric field
abstract: The quantum wave packet dynamics of the photodetached electron in electric field near a metal surface are studied in the time domain. The evolution of wave packet for different manifold eigenstates is investigated analytically. It is found that the surface electronic wave packet can be modulated by the laser pulse initial momentum and electric field. In addition, by the many-body GW approximation, we determine the influence of the external field on the surface state lifetimes. This phenomenon is attributed to Stark effect-the shift in energy due to the electric field. With the femtosecond time resolved two-photon photoemission technique, it is possible to directly observe the electronic dynamics of wave packets near the metal surfaces. The correspondence between classical and quantum mechanics is shown explicitly in our model.

articleTitle: Comparison research on the performance of DTN route protocol and Ad hoc route protocol
abstract: DTN network as a new type of wireless network operation mode can be widely used in the frequently divided and interrupted environment of wireless network. It can complete data transmission and switch through a way of “storage - carry - forward”. The DTN network is very similar with Ad hoc network in application environment and software design but in the routing algorithms application cost, QoS, etc. they both have advantages and disadvantages. To get more optimal routing protocols of the combination of DTN and the Ad hoc, in this paper we simulate and compare the Epidemic protocol of the DTN network and AODV protocol of the Ad hoc network in the case of different communication radius and different node numbers, thus arrive the characteristics of different routing protocols in different situation. It will provide a basis for the combination of the Ad hoc network protocol and the DTN network protocol.

articleTitle: Two different type parts parallel two repair equipment repairable system research and Bayesian estimation
abstract: This article from the increase of repair equipment to reduce system downtime, thereby increasing the efficiency of the system to study the two dissimilar units and two repairable equipment reliability, and find the Bayesian estimate.

articleTitle: 3D Computation of Wasio Landslide and the stress distribution of deep piles
abstract: Based on three dimensional analyses of the Wasio Landslide, Nagasaki, Japan, authors compared the calculated 2D and 3D stress distribution with measured loading in deep piles of the landslide. The 3D stress distribution have identical pattern with measured loading while the 2D stress distribution do not accord with the measured loading. The calculated sliding direction and sliding vector have great influence in the pattern of stress distribution. The sliding direction in 2D stability analysis is the same direction with main section and it can calculate the maximum stress for pile design only. Authors proposed a 3D stress analysis method which can calculate stress distribution of every pile in the different position of landslide.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of the SIFT-based improved algorithm on azimuth recognition
abstract: The implementation of azimuth recognition technology for current mobile phone platform is mainly based on hardware (such as gyroscopes) and software (such as compass). Those related methods have shortcomings or limitations. This article proposes an improved algorithm based on SIFT to implement azimuth recognition. This method uses the camera to obtain image data, matching with the data in the information base. Meanwhile, this method combines with GPS and image processing technology. The experimental results show that the method is feasible. It also shows good performance in both accuracy and real-time.

articleTitle: Identification and extraction of topic elements for Chinese interactive text
abstract: This paper is based on identification and extraction of topic elements for Chinese interactive text. A topic segmentation method based on time sequence is achieved. Then a novel identification and extraction algorithm of topic elements is proposed. Firstly, noise filtering and Chinese word segmentation on the original corpus are executed. Secondly, the identifying and extracting method in group of mixed turn is used to extract the topic elements, such as time, place and figure. Finally, performance evaluation of identification recall, identification accuracy and extraction accuracy are achieved. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The research of Computer Network Maintenance Fashion Arrangement Algorithm
abstract: This paper proposes a mathematics model in solving the arrangement of computer network maintenance fashion and designs the Method of Computer Network Maintenance Fashion Arrangement Algorithmic (TMCNMFAA). It analyzes the restrictions existing in TMCNMFAA, provides the update strategy of pheromone when false searching path is found, and calculation method in inspiriting value of function. The results of experiment show that TMCNMFAA provides a good solution in arranging the time of computer network maintenance. It is able to adopt itself with the change of computer network arrangement. When the dimension of change ranges in a certain category, TMCNMFAA can still provide a good solution.

articleTitle: Viscosity-Splitting scheme for concentration equation of miscible displacement with solute absorption in porous media
abstract: A lot of chemical reagents have been used to improve recovery ratio in petroleum exploitation, this process refers to solute absorption problem. On the condition of incompressible fluid, its mathematical scheme can be put in the form which is coupling nonlinear partial difference equations about pressure, concentration, and solute concentration absorbing on the media surface. This paper introduces the miscible displacement problem first and then gives one operator-splitting method: Viscosity-Splitting method and its error analysis.

articleTitle: 3D model reconstruction refinement from multiple images
abstract: 3D model reconstructions have attracted various attentions in recent years. In this paper, we present a mechanism to reconstruct 3D model through the refinement of corresponding points using 3D patches. The NCC values between patches in the reference image and that in the visible image are used to estimate the best corresponding points and, hence, the better camera parameters. A more realistic 3D model can be reconstructed using this mechanism.

articleTitle: Effects of climate change on China building climate demarcation
abstract: The building climate demarcation standard currently being used is based on the weather data of 1951–1985, which was issued in 1993. China's weather has changed significantly with the changes of the global weather and the increase of urban heat island effect. Temperatures in most cities in China have changed much in comparison with the temperature during the years of 1951–1985 and 1986–2008. In order to see the effects of climate change on building climate demarcation, the same parameters and conditions as were previously used have been adopted to classify building climate zones within the recent 30 years of weather data of 1979–2008. The meteorological data used in this paper is from the American National Climate Data Center (NCDC), which is reported to NCDC by meteorological bureaus of different countries and are proved to be reliable. We found that the building climate demarcation boundaries have been moved quite remarkably, and some locations have moved from one zone to adjacent areas of neighboring zones. The regionalization boundary may have shifted with the largest displacement of 1°30′ in latitude. This change has been discovered in every zone, which covers the large or average sized cities. In this paper, we have addressed some suggestions for practical building climate demarcation.

articleTitle: Learning distribution metric for object contour tracking
abstract: A new approach to tracking using active contour model is presented. Suppose that the class of objects to be tracked is characterized by a probability distribution, we tackle the active contour tracking problem by learning a suitable distance measure between distributions. A cross bin criterion for comparing distributions in quadratic form is adopted in this paper for active contour tracking, in which the measure matrix is learned and updated on-the-fly based on convex optimization. We model the image energy by the distance between the foreground distribution and the model one, divided by the distance between the background distribution and the model one. The experimental results have demonstrated the effectiveness and robustness of our method.

articleTitle: Damping identification using weighted fitting of Frequency-response-function (WFF) method
abstract: Modal identification is usually a necessity for structural damage identification and health evaluation. However, the modal damping is difficult to be accurately identified. Even though some new damping identification methods arise in recent years, it is difficult to apply these methods in engineering practice due to their complexity in theory and computation. This paper presents a frequency-domain modal identification method-Weighted Fitting of Frequency-response-function (WFF) Method. The principle and methodology of this method is first addressed. The target functions are defined as the differences between the measured and computed frequency-response-functions (FRFs) multiplied by appropriate weightings for different excitation frequencies. The modal parameters, modal frequency and damping, are obtained by the FRF fitting that leads to the minimum value of the target functions. The modal identifications for single- and multi-degree-of-freedom structure responses exited by band-limited white-noises with measurement noises are conducted to verify the effectiveness of this method. Then this method is applied to modal identification of a box-gird railway bridge with a passing train. Compared with half-power-bandwidth method, this method is shown to be simple and reliable for the accurate identification of the modal damping.

articleTitle: Mechanism study on cracking of expansion rock
abstract: The weight and length of three directions of calcareous mudstone after infiltrated with water in different period of time were measured by using electronic balance and vernier caliper. The results show that the calcareous mudstone expansion strain is proportional to volume and mass water content. It was showed from the rock SEM picture that the structure of expansion rock was loose when infiltrated with water, and the intensity was also reduces. The mechanism of expansion rock cracking was studied. When the expansion stress inside of rock overtook the tensile strength or compressive strength, the rock produced craze, even disintegration.

articleTitle: Kirchhoff index of hexagonal Möbius graphs
abstract: We study the Kirchhoff index on hexagonal Möbius graphs HM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>. Due to the Laplacian polynomial decomposition theorem, the Laplacian spectrum of HM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> consists of the Laplacian spectrum of cycle C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2n</inf> and eigenvalues of a symmetric quasi-tridiagonal matrix L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</inf> of order 2n. Finally, an evident formula for Kirchhoff index of HM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> is given in terms of the index n.

articleTitle: The issue discussion of regional international logistics integrated information service platform building
abstract: In recent years, the information construction of logistics of our country steps into the fast-developing way. It is to improving enterprise's logistics information handling capacity of promotion, accelerating the market response speed, extending and serving, raising the operation efficiency of the logistics, reducing the cost of logistics plays an enormous role. In the existing foundation of our country, however, the comparatively complete and meeting the market demand information platform was not exist. So there are very great demands on comprehensive information platform on the market. On the basis of the realistic demand, this text described the analysis that several questions that should notice in the integrated information service platform construction of the regional international logistics have carried on the system, and explained the shut-down technology involved in this platform of construction.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of multiple virtual management platform in multimedia classroom based on cloud storage
abstract: Current computer aided teaching core as computer technology has been widely used, however, almost all of schools public service platform are still run as fat client model, that situation lead to variety of problems in uses and management. This thesis is proposing use cloud storage technology for multimedia classroom building, combination of network and virtualization technologies to set out the solution strategy on the formation of a high-performance PC cluster management, security, stability and easy maintenance.

articleTitle: The experience summary and security risk monitor implement of deep foundation pit in metro half-blanket system
abstract: According to engineering implementation of using half-blanket system metro station construction in Beijing Metro Line 9, the third party monitoring scheme and risk management and control condition were introduced in this paper, a preliminary summarization had been made on monitoring experience and risk characteristics of this construction method, and puts forward suggestion of further perfect monitoring system.

articleTitle: The research of information security experimental teaching platform based on Webquest
abstract: In order to provide a comprehensive and higher practicality experiment with a certain realistic background for students majoring in Information Security.This paper developed a experimental teaching platform for information security based on Webquest, intended to train the students the integrated use ability of the knowledge for information security through the real attack environment and the teamwork, Web search and other diverse ways with task-oriented. In practice, students can finally complete the building significance of information security, and At the same time train their ability to solve the practical problems.

articleTitle: Stability of slope which locates on reservoir region and the corresponding influence mechanisms induced by fluctuation of water level
abstract: Numerical analysis performed on a vertical slope subjected to influence induced by fluctuation of water level show that both the rate and type of water level fluctuation are essential factors for slope stability. A conceptual framework illustrates the influence of the different model boundary conditions distribution to slope stability. Relationships between factor of safety (FOS) and boundary condition are obtained from this numerical model. Since the influence mechanism has been discovered in this paper, we can get insights into the development of slope stability which locates on typical place such as reservoir region. Based on some known knowledge and a minimum assumed factor of safety (FOS), controlled work can be applied to the rate of water level fluctuation for a real constructure.

articleTitle: Problems and countermeasures in the use of Computer Aid Instruction in university graphic design teaching
abstract: The use of Computer Aid Instruction in university graphic design teaching has been a main teaching way in modern educational technology, and changed traditional university photography model. By improving the vision and interest, the students can grasp the technology of graphic design preferably. Problems and countermeasures in the use of Computer Aid Instruction in university graphic design teaching have been studied in this paper, in order to find a better way to develop the university graphic design education.

articleTitle: The layout for the complex of Buddhist temples in Mt. WuTai of ShanXi
abstract: The Buddhist shrine, WuTai Mountain in Shanxi, is one of the remarkable world heritages with the distinctive cultural landscape made by the various layouts for the complexes of the Buddhist temples. As a result of the different ways of the layout, the natural characters are more definite due to the existence of the temples, on the other hand, the complexes of the temples become more vivid as positioned following the undulating hills. By analysing and summing up the characteristics of the layouts, we can figure out the patterns of them for the Chinese traditional religious architectures and enlighten the contemporary master planning as well.

articleTitle: The Dynamic key and implementation of Rijndael algorithm
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the so-called new encryption algorithm of dynamic key, making even a single fixed key encrypt the same plaintext twice,which the two are different ciphertexts if the time difference, so that chosen plaintext attacks and known plaintext attacks have become infeasible.

articleTitle: Construction mechanics analysis of the conjugation between Beijing metro line 4 and line 2
abstract: Depending on the background of the civil air joint stage in Xizhimen subway station, this paper makes a numerical simulation on variable section conjugation engineering under complicated condition. The main contents are summarized below: (1) The analysis on stress changes of transitional structure. (2) The analysis on stress changes of the existed tunnel conjugation structure. (3) The analysis on crown settlement of new tunnel and the existed tunnel, and the analysis on differential settlement between new tunnel and the existed tunnel.

articleTitle: Existence of positive solutions of m-point boundary value problems for three order dynamic equations on time scales
abstract: This paper uses Leggett-Williams fixed point theorem to study existence of positive solutions for a class of mixed three order m-point boundary value problem, and the result are new. At the end of paper??we give an example of main result.

articleTitle: Auction-based WLAN bandwidth allocation in game strategy perspective
abstract: Surge in WLAN development leads to urgent demand for more efficient bandwidth allocation methods. In this paper, two novel auction-based time-slotted WLAN bandwidth allocation models are established, namely the Combination of Single-slot Second-Price Sealed Auction (CoSSPSA) and the Multi-slot Vickrey Auction versus Homogeneous Objects (MVAvHO). In these models, each user is assigned to a bidding group which is represented by its bidder. Being assigned virtual credit budget, bidders compete for each slot in every bidding trial or all slots in one bidding trial, according to the bidding rule of adopted allocation model. Game formulation is then introduced to analyze the revenues of all auction participants as well as revenue of the whole allocation system. The bidding strategy formula for each single bidder is thereafter derived from the game formulation and each bidder adjusts its bids to attain the optimal revenue calculated from the bidding strategy formula. By means of synthesis of all participants' bidding strategies, the system efficiency values for both allocation models are computed. The allocation pattern is therefore formed.

articleTitle: Research and application of conductor and transmission line fitting mechanical property test system
abstract: This article describe the basic principles, components and functions of conductor and electric power fitting mechanical property test system. Testing the damping properties of spacer with this system, the results shows that the system principle is correct, the structure novel, the function is complete, the metrical data is accurate and reliable and the test result can be obtained rapidly. The system provides a brand-new testing method for the mechanical property test of conductor and transmission line fitting. It also provides the reliable technical for the research, design, produces and selects about conductor and transmission line fitting.

articleTitle: A fast Reed-solomon decoder using step-by-step algorithm
abstract: This paper proposes a low-complexity decoding method for Reed-solomon codes which combines a modified step-by-step decoder with 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>-QAM system. Conventional step-by-step method has complexity computation of iteration-calculation of testing the error values by a factor of (2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>-1).

articleTitle: Discussion on cultural relies conservation planning of old building and “revolutionary former site”
abstract: Cultural relies conservation planning is an important method to protect cultural relies. As a new planning style, there are many questions have not be resolved. Considering different types of protected monuments, we should attach different importance to the conservation planning of them. This article discusses the differences between them on planning thinking and delineation of conservation area.

articleTitle: Solutions of the (2+1)-dimensional high-order Broer-Kaup equation
abstract: In this paper we first revisit the Painlevé integrability of the (2+1)-dimensional high-order Broer-Kaup equation. Then we get soliton and multi-soliton solutions by both the standard truncation of Painlevé analysis and Conte's truncation of Painlevé analysis. Two Bäcklund transformations are obtained. A much more general kind of multi-soliton solutions are gotten by a special ansatz, which we will describe in detail in the paper.

articleTitle: 1090ES signal generator simulation design
abstract: Through studying the 1090ES (Mode S Extended Squitter data link) parameters and using the visual simulation tools "MATLAB" produced based on PPM encoding, PCM modulation 1090ES signal. the design modulates the signal of the carrier frequency using 1090MHz for OOK (On Off Keying). Analog signal out of the 1090ES as a virtual source can provide the basic waveform parameters support for the receiver system design; supplying the 1090ES signal decoding board to perform the basic function test; Thereby it reduces the 1090ES signal decoding board system during the actual measurement of costs and shortens the development cycle. This signal has very perfect practical value.

articleTitle: Research on the dynamic evolving distribution of transportation infrastructure in China
abstract: This paper analyzed the dynamic evolving distribution of transportation infrastructure of 31 provinces in China by the kernel density function method and markov chain method. The results showed that: the distribution of transportation infrastructure gradually changed from “twin peaks” shape into “only peak” shape, and the polarization gradually disappeared, but the difference of transportation infrastructure level in each region was still great. From the markov chain, the long-term stability distribution of transportation infrastructure in each province still dispersed in five types of space, and a great many of provinces were in the middle class, but the density differences of transportation infrastructure in each province will gradually narrow.

articleTitle: Evaluation of on-ramp signal control strategy for Beijing expressways
abstract: Because the distance between on-ramp and off-ramp ranges from 100m to 1000m in Beijing expressways, traffic congestions generated at these "bottlenecks" had been observed frequently. In this paper, on-ramp signal control strategies are tested under 3 kinds of traffic flow states and 19 kinds of road network structures in VISSIM. The control efficiencies in different traffic scenarios are discussed, results indicate that only applying on-ramp signal control is an ineffectiveness way to enhance road capacity.

articleTitle: Multimedia teaching techniques are the effective fair education approach
abstract: This article focus on issues, points out the core problem is differences of instructors during in a variety of expressions of education unfair. The article regarded multimedia teaching techniques as the effective approach to the equitable education, also lists measures to achieve the approach.

articleTitle: New method for input-output equation of spherical four-bar mechanism
abstract: A new method for the input-output equation of spherical four-bar mechanism is given in this paper. Firstly D-H method is used to construct the closed-form equation and unitary matrices are introduced to the close-form equation to find the input-output equation, which only contain the variables of input angle and output angle. Thus the left variables can be solved after the input angle and output angle are substituted to the close-form equation. A numerical example and simulation software are given to verify the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Time-varying control laws with guaranteed persistence for a class of multi-species chemostat models with different removal rates
abstract: In this paper, a class of chemostat models with N species compete for a limited nutrient with different removal rates is investigated. First, three assumptions are given to guarantee the existence of stabilizable periodic trajectories. Then a time-varying feedback for dilution rate and input substrate is designed, so that a positive trajectory of the chemostat model is globally asymptotically stable.

articleTitle: The analysis of the aged facilities condition in urban centers
abstract: As the population aging process speeds up in China, many cities have to face an important problem how to make the aged have a happy life. The supply-demand situation of the facilities for the aged is the material base. This article analyzes the supply and demand on the facilities for the aged, explores the problems of the facilities for the aged supply, then provides some methods that get out of the aged facilities morass.

articleTitle: Deposition of PbO thin films and its X-ray photoconductive properties
abstract: Lead oxide is a promising candidate for direct conversion of X-ray due to its high X-ray photoconductivity. High resistance lead oxide thin films were fabricated by direct current magnetron sputtering. X-ray diffraction and Atomic force microscope were used to characterize the crystalline structure and surface morphology of the thin films. X-ray photoconductivity was characterized by a homemade X-ray photoconductor measurement system. The effects of oxygen flow rate and annealing temperature on the microstructure and X-ray photoconductivity properties of the PbO thin films were also studied. XRD results showed that the crystal structure of the films dependent on oxygen flow rate and annealing temperature. Moreover, it is found that tetragonal PbO is superiors for X-ray detection than orthorhombic PbO.

articleTitle: Direct georeferencing of ADS40 using calibrated POS data
abstract: The ADS40 is airborne three-line-push broom imaging sensor integrated with POS, which developed by L. H. Corporation. Due to the accuracy of POS, especially the accuracy of orientation cannot meet the requirement for large scale mapping. This paper provides mathematical model for POS data calibration using a few GCPs. The experiment result verified that the accuracy of the direct Georeferencing using calibrated POS data and bundle block adjustment is very close.

articleTitle: Protection of prestressed high strength concrete pipe pile from large-scale excavation of deep foundation pit
abstract: Based on a construction case, this paper elaborates the series of measures taken in the large-scale excavation of deep foundation pit to prevent the fracture of prestressed high strength concrete pipe pile and the good effects achieved in the construction practice.

articleTitle: The iterative solution for fourth-order boundary value problem with integral boundary conditions
abstract: This paper investigates a fourth-order boundary value problem with integral boundary conditions. The existence of iterative solutions is obtained via the lower and upper solutions method.

articleTitle: Isovist topology analysis in scenic spot planning
abstract: Isovist analysis is the important analysis method in the scenic spot planning. The traditional isovist analysis is based on the line of sight and the viewshed of sight in GIS, which is ground on the single point of sight. The main problem of this kind of isovist analysis is short of the relation with the structural composition of the scenic spot, such as the trail organization and the architecture location selection. The topology analysis is the main tool of the social networks analysis. In the paper, we select Q analysis, which is one method of the topology analysis, as the analysis tool to combine the isovist analysis of GIS with the social networks analysis, and put forward to the concept of sight structure of isovist quantification analysis method on the example of Baizhangji-feiyun lake scenic spot, Wenzhou, Zhejiang province. In brief, we could integrate the single isovist view or isovist with Q analysis so that we could relate the single isovist with the whole landscape structure, which could help us confirm the suitable location of landscape architecture.

articleTitle: X-ray diffraction second derivative spectrum of Tibetan medicine based on the spline interpolation method
abstract: The program using for obtaining the second derivative spectra from the X-ray diffraction patterns is gotten, based on the software MATLAB. By using this program, the second derivative fingerprints of standard sample SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and snow Rhodiola can be obtained. The results show that the program can not only effectively solve the diffuse XRD pattern analysis of Plants Tibetan medicine, but also has the function of zooming.

articleTitle: Detect saliency to understand a photo
abstract: Visual saliency is an extremely hot topic in image and video processing. Our paper addresses a novel method for saliency detection, which conveys the photographers' idea of a scene. It consists of analyzing the photo elements like color, depth-of-field (DOF) and composition. We use the color spatial distribution feature to calculate the initial saliency. A simple but efficient classifier is trained to discriminate the low DOF image. For this kind of images we find the focal area to refine the initial saliency. The saliency map will be further adjusted by an image composition analysis step to generate the final output. We compare our framework with state-of-the-art algorithms. Experimental results show that, our method out-performs the previous methods in many cases, especially in the low DOF situation.

articleTitle: Research on inheritance of vernacular architecture in Zhang guying Village
abstract: Vernacular architecture is a live culture of life exists, there has great significance to protect, plan well and show these rich cultural heritage. Based on full investigation of the zhang guying village and understanding the meaning of vernacular architecture, this paper has analyzed the state of conservation of vernacular architecture in zhang guying village, including state of conservation of ancient architectural complex and some pubic vernacular architecture, such as chamber, ancient temples, ancestral halls, stage, roadway and patio. At the same time, this paper has proposed that the inheritance of vernacular architecture in zhang guying village should take repair and reference as the main method of inheritance to recover outstanding vernacular architecture and extend the spirit of place, under the guidance of the principle of highlighting authenticity and maintaining continuity.

articleTitle: Wormhole routing optimization algorithm based on virtual channel switching
abstract: The quality indicators of network transmission service such as traffic throughput, latency, fault-tolerant rate are directly affected by NoC routing algorithm. This paper presents wormhole routing optimization algorithm based on the virtual channel switching. The optimization algorithm is based on the combinations of the virtual channel transmission mechanism and routing algorithm. The virtual channels are designed for input and output normally, in addition, there is one virtual channel for packets turning specifically. The TWF strategy applied to NoC is able to crack the network loop and eliminate network deadlock. It is shown in the simulation results that the optimization algorithm is feasible and improves the throughput, packet latency significantly.

articleTitle: Human body modeling method based on FFD
abstract: The example-based method for generating realistic, controllable human models was presented. Users are assisted in automatically generating modifying an example body data by controlling the parameters provided. The examples from the Poser and 3D Max is preprocessed as templates. The modeling method learns from these examples the correlation between the parameters and the body geometry. After this learning process the synthesizer translates the mesh of vertices to the generation of appropriate shape and proportion of the body geometry through free-form deformation method. Finally, we demonstrate our modifier synthesizer for more subtle manipulations of example models. On any synthesized model, the underlying bone and skin structure is properly adjusted. By allowing automatic modification from a set of parameters, our approach may eventually lead to the automatic generation of a variety of population models.

articleTitle: Discussion of domestic urban spatial layout based on the foreign theories of urban development
abstract: The domestic economy has been developing very fast, which gears up the developing of cities, and brings lots of problems to the cities. This essay introduces the foreign theories and research directions of the developing of cities. It analysis the status quo of domestic urban spatial layout, and discovers problems and defects of it, and furthermore, brings up methods and patterns to improve the domestic urban spatial layout, by balancing distribution of resources, rationalizing the design of transportation, sustaining the ecological environment, intensifying the land utilization, as the pattern of domestic city development in the future.

articleTitle: Research on economy efficiency by complex coal seam mining
abstract: Complex coal mining economic research is an important factor for method determining. Based on the Muchenjian mine reverse "S" coal mining as the research object, we established different schemes of piecewise mining coal economic model of the 5# coal seam and analyzed the economic benefits of the different mining schemes. Considering the influence of the three main factors that coal production, the time value of money and the service life of mining equipment, on coal production cost of coal seam mining 5.Then we make economic benefit analysis and finally determine that we will adopt the pseudo sharp inclined section of flexible shield support mining method in heavy pitch section and tilt segment using prone pseudo inclined dense pillar mining method in inclined section. This conclusion of this paper may provide a new thought for the complex coal seam mining.

articleTitle: Collaborative filtering methods based on user relevance degree and weights of recommend-items
abstract: The way to measure similarity among users is a key factor affecting accuracy of recommendation algorithm. A similarity measuring algorithm based on degree of correlation among users and weighting of recommended items is proposed to improve less marking aspects between users and lower prediction accuracy of traditional similarity measuring algorithms. The method can solve the non-convex problem generated by non-exclusive parameters in the objective function by introducing an adjusting parameter of similarity and alternatively optimizing the relative parameters using least squares. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective in improving the accuracy of whole system and the prediction accuracy of recommendation items.

articleTitle: Research on planning and design in mountain village of Hebei province
abstract: Along with the depth of the process of urbanization, more and more attention have been paid to the new rural construction, while the planning and design of village is an important component during the constructing. As the mountain village has its geographical complexity and particularity, which is impossible to implant the planning and design method of plain village completely. In terms of this research, it will explore the appropriated planning and design method according to the analysis of researches based on its mountain villages' characteristics and problems of Hebei province.

articleTitle: An autostereoscopic projecting system based on parallax barrier and lenticular sheets
abstract: In order to realize autostereoscopic 3D projecting display with higher brightness and larger size, a technique of autostereoscopic 3D projecting using parallax barriers and lenticular sheets is proposed.The parameter design of lenticular sheets and parallax barriers is investigated. First, projection distance of projector array is confirmed according to eye's resolution,then the strips' character of lenticular sheets is analysed by zemax in four-view situation,thickness and parameters of strips of lenticular sheets are confirmed. Finally, the width of slit and pitch and viewing distance and etc of parallax barriers are confirmed according to parameters of strips of lenticular sheets. Data analysis indicate that the brightness of our four-view image is increased three times because of using lenticular sheets instead of parallax barriers comparing with the autostereoscopic 3D projector using two parallax barriers plates. Parameters design of parallax barriers and lenticular sheets are finished, the feasibility and advantages of the 3D display of projecting are confirmed theoretically.

articleTitle: A research on geometric precision correction with high accuracy and high performance
abstract: As an important step in the process of remote sensing, geometric precision correction, also known as the most complicated and intensive part in calculation, rectifies the geometric distortion of original remote sensing images caused by various factors by using ground control points. Therefore, the accuracy and processing speed of geometric precision correction have direct effect on the subsequent flows in most remote sensing applications. As for accuracy, the polynomial model and the multi-quadric function model are respectively introduced and then Gopfert model which is the smart combination of these two models is put forward. Speaking of capability, after analyzing various links of geometric precision correction and conventional parallel mode, the asynchronous parallel mode based on parallel I/O and I/O hidden strategy is given to optimize the parallel of Gopfert calculation on the cluster environment. All tests that were done indicate that the method mentioned above greatly improves both the accuracy and the function of geometric precision correction, which can be extensively used in project processing.

articleTitle: Research on technology of building exterior in old housing renewal system
abstract: Building energy conservation and fire safety are both important to us in the old housing renewal. More and more energy saving buildings in the fires caused the loss of the lives and property. For different external wall insulation system, construction of the fire science technology appropriately and strengthen the overall transformation of the system is an effective way to solve the energy conservation and fire safety of old housing renewal. In this paper, the main object of study is the “exterior renewal of existing building”. Find out the integrated solutions for energy conservation, fire protection, decoration and other issues. Provide the theoretical guidance and technical support for our comprehensive renewal in our country.

articleTitle: A task scheduling algorithm Based on μC/OS-II system
abstract: Embedded systems' Real-time and multi-mission capability largely depends on its task scheduling mechanism, based on the research of many existing real-time task scheduling algorithm and μC/OS-II's own characteristics, we proposed a new task scheduling algorithm which integrates dynamic priority and static priority and create a new scheduling mechanism.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence and Raman analysis of ZnO microwires synthesized by chemical vapour deposition
abstract: ZnO microwires have been synthesized by a simple chemical vapour deposition method. The morphology and optical properties were investigated by scanning electron microscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman spectrum, respectively. The strong ultraviolet emission with the weak deep-level emission observed in the photoluminescence spectrum indicates that the ZnO microwires have good optical properties with limited structural defects. In the Raman spectrum, the intense E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> modes indicate that the ZnO microwires have perfect wurtzite structure. Additionally, the red shift of the Raman peaks can be attributed to the lattice distortion and piezoelectric effect of the nanostructures.

articleTitle: Statistical inference for the mixed accelerated life testing with progressive censoring
abstract: This paper investigates statistical inference for the mixed accelerated life tests with progressively censored data from the exponential distribution. Based on type II progressively censored data, the maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) of the parameters for Exponential distribution and acceleration equation are obtained. Furthermore, we derive the confidence intervals of the parameters by using bootstrap methods. Besides, the estimators of the failure rate, the reliability function and mean life are also given at normal stress level. We also derive the approximated unbiased estimation of failure rate and mean life. Finally, we present an example to illustrate all the methods of inference discussed here.

articleTitle: Subjective evaluation of the optimal size and proportion of windows of office buildings
abstract: Size and proportion of windows are important issues that architects and designers need to consider in office buildings design. There are many factors affecting these two elements of office windows including energy consumption, aesthetic consideration, view, lighting and ventilation etc. And users' subjective satisfaction on windows is another item should be respected but not enough attention is paid by designers nowadays. This study tries to find out the optimal size and proportion of office windows based on the subjective elevation of office employees in Guangzhou, a major city in southern China.

articleTitle: Some results on C-automorphisms of finite nilpotent by nilpotent groups
abstract: In this paper, C-automorphisms of finite nilpotent by nilpotent groups are discussed. We first present a criteria for a C-automorphism of a nilpotent by nilpotent group to be an inner automorphism. As an application of our result, we prove that C-automorphisms of semidirect products of cyclic by nilpotent groups are inner automorphisms. We also prove that under some additional conditions C-automorphisms of extensions of nilpotent groups by cyclic 2-groups are inner automorphisms. As immediate consequences of our results, we obtain that the normalizer property holds for such groups.

articleTitle: Saliency dectection using spatial features and spectral residual
abstract: A saliency detection algorithm using spatial features and spectral residual is proposed in this paper. Feature maps including intensity, chromatic opponencies and motion are extracted from image and video, and pre-segmented. According to the segmentation results, saliency detection algorithm using spatial features and spectral residual is used to detect salient regions. Finally, the first-order entropy of the feature saliency map is used as weights to get the final saliency map. The proposed method takes global and local image contrast into account and achieves good results.

articleTitle: Research on historical memories and space forms' dual construction
abstract: The dual construction, which includes historical memories and space forms, is involved in a design of renewing traditional blocks. Space forms are carriers of historical memories, and the expression of the former is meanwhile oriented from building ways and materials.
