Exampled by block located at Xuzhou's former municipal Party committee in old urban area and combined with Kenneth Frampton's Tectonics theory, the paper, in the perspective of historical memories, establishes perceived order based on time axis from Republic of China to the Cultural Revolution. In the space form perspective, the paper builds construction order by inner relationship between construction, material and space form. With the help of perceived order and construction order, converting from idea to reality cautiously and explicating infectious space form under a specific history, thus we can realize the dual construction which combines the historical memories and space forms.

articleTitle: Study on mechanism analysis of rain-wind-induced vibration and resistance measures
abstract: Stay cable is one of the main components of cable stayed bridge to bear loads. Due to its large flexibility, small quality and small damping, various of harmful vibrations could happen easily under the external excitations. Rain-wind-induced vibration is the strongest form of vibrations. Through the establishment of Dof theoretical model of rain-wind-induced vibration and the analysis of vibration frequency and aerodynamic damping of cable, the occurrence mechanism of rain-wind-induced vibration is revealed. The vibration control measures for this kind of vibration are also established to support the ensurance of bridge operation.

articleTitle: A new anisotropic diffusion model for image denoising
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new algorithm for image denoising. Our method is an anisotropic diffusion model, and it is based on variation and partial differential equations. The new model not only overcomes the shortcoming of TV model, which does not fully comply with the morphologic principles of image processing, but also overcomes the shortcoming of ALM model, which depends on gradient information alone to determine the speed and direction of diffusion. Numerical results show that our model can maintain the main features of the image. The denoising effect of our model is better than some traditional models. The main feature of our new model is making the processed image retain edge feature and corner information of the image.

articleTitle: Inversion of point source on a class of wave equation
abstract: A numerical procedure is presented to handle a class of inverse point-wise source problem of wave equation. The goal is to study its numerical solution based on the uniqueness and stability of reconstruction of the position of each point source and its combination coefficient. Some numerical examples using the proposed numerical procedure are presented.

articleTitle: Hybrid model by RS_RBF evaluate the investment risks of High-tech projects
abstract: In order to resolve the redundant information in High-tech project evaluation, a high-tech investment risk evaluation model combining a rough sets RS and the RBF neural network is presented. First using the rough set's powerful numerical analysis capabilities, this model does the attribute reduction on the evaluation index which reduces the training data of RBF neural network and simplifies the network structure. Then this model trains the data after reduction using the RBF neural network. Last applying this model to the High-tech project evaluation, the simulation results show that compared with the RBF neural network model, the hybrid model can achieve more satisfactory results such as speeding up the network operator speed, minimizing the evaluation error, and improving the evaluation precision.

articleTitle: Study recovering of image with MATLAB
abstract: Degradation model of image is established. Permissive revivification method and constraints revivification methods are used to analyze recovering of image. On this basis, images are adopted Lucy-Richardson method, blindness convolution method, constrained least squares filtering and Wiener filtering method to recover. And then, the results are analyzed and compared. The results show that the recovering of image is applied Wiener filtering method with more definition.

articleTitle: Research on method of feature extraction and recognition of traffic condition from video
abstract: Route guidance information has great significance for reasonably utilizing road network resources and reducing traffic congestion. This paper proposes the image preprocessing method for traffic videos, including the background construction and adaptive image segmentation. Based on the in-depth analysis of the parameters used in road condition describing, the paper suggested the features of occupation ratio and speed of traffic stream in the observing region to characterize road traffic states, and presented the feature extracting method whose feasibility was then analyzed and demonstrated. Finally, the automatic road condition recognition was achieved based on fuzzy decision, and a higher coincidence rate was obtained.

articleTitle: Consistent CMT solutions before the 2010 Maule, Chile earthquake
abstract: In this paper, we define the angle between P, B, and T axes of focal mechanisms and three stress axes of tectonic stress field as the consistent parameter, to research the dynamic changes of stress field in earthquake preparation area before great earthquake. We mainly studied the change of the consistent parameter before the 2010 Maule, Chile earthquake using the CMT solutions. The result shows that the consistent parameter decrease before the earthquake, and the area of the lower consistent parameter in coincided with the distribution of aftershocks. It should be a phenomenon of predictive significance. When the accumulated earthquake examples are sufficient, uniform judgment criteria and prediction principles can be stipulated.

articleTitle: Robust thinning algorithm without artefacts for pattern recognition and 3D plant modelling
abstract: We present a novel thinning algorithm to automatically extract skeletons from images without artefacts. It is well known that the major problem of existing thinning algorithms is the generation of artefacts such redundant branches due to noises in images. In this approach, we propose to use oriented Gaussian filters to classify ridges and edges, and to determine principal directions. As oriented filters are low-pass filters in the principal directions, they are robust to noise and insignificant extremities. The thinning process of the proposed algorithm is guided by principal directions, thus it can remove edge points without the interference from noise and insignificant extremities. As a result, the extracting skeletons of elongated shapes is smooth and without redundant branches. Experimental results show that the proposed approach is able to handle noise and insignificant extremities to generate smooth skeletons of objects, and also is able to automatically extract 3D structures of cereal plants.

articleTitle: Analysis of thermal stresses caused by hydration heat and temperature of the mass beam
abstract: The building of the SPF animal research centre in Taichang, Jiangshu is reinforced concrete frame structure. The longest beam of the building is 83 meters and the sizes of the beam sections are very large. The beams we called are mass beams. When we design the building construction, we need to think about the influence of the temperature because of the mass concrete. In this paper, using the finite element method, Analyses the heat distributions of the mass beam made by hydration heat and temperature, calculates the thermal stress caused by the heat. To find the influence of the sizes of the beam section, we design four beam subassemblies with different sections, analyze and compare the differences of their heat distributions in each beam and the thermal stress in the same place. This paper aimed to find the distributions of the cracks in the mass concrete beams and to provide the theory evidences on reinforced concrete design.

articleTitle: Study on four seasons-vertical distribution characteristics of fluorine in water and soil in Western Jilin Province
abstract: Vertical distribution characteristics of fluorine in Western Jilin Province in four seasons are analyzed by indoor experiments with typical field site samples. The migration and transformation regularity of fluorine was researched and the influence factors are analyzed too. According to the results, climate variation such as evaporation and precipitation, and the characteristics of aeration zone are the main two factors. Vertical distribution of fluorine varies obviously. There are obviously two peaks from the depth of 0 to 240 cm. and the second one is higher than the first one. Meanwhile, the concentration of fluorine in unsaturated zone is the maximum in July and minimum in February. The concentration of fluorine in surface soils is the maximum in winter, followed by spring, fall and summer. The results show that the concentration of fluorine in surface soil decreases by temperature. In addition, its concentration in unsaturated zone of alkaline soil is higher than in corn field. We analyzed all s samples in surface, and the depth of 40 cm, 80 cm, 120 cm, 160 cm, 200 cm, 240 cm. The variation regularity of is different in the three investigated field sites.

articleTitle: Digital image encryption based on Gauss-Markov random encryption matrix
abstract: To solve the problem of encryption matrix is difficult to construct, a novel encryption matrix constructing algorithm is proposed in this paper. First, a stochastic sequence is generated by Gauss-Markov process. Then, convert the elements of this sequence into integers and multiple the selected matrices with determinant D=1 each other by using tensor production method. Thus, we can construct some high order encryption matrices and use it in real world application. The encryption instance and theoretical analysis show that the proposed algorithm can produce encryption matrices with high security, and have good random characteristics and autocorrelation to meet the requirement of cryptography.

articleTitle: The distributed multistage spatial index tree based on R-Tree and linked list in Grid GIS environments
abstract: In order to improve the performance and efficiency of management and retrieval parallel retrieval of a spatial mass data under the grid GIS environment, this paper presents a new parallel spatial index DMSR-Tree(Distributed Multistage Spatial R Tree) structure established with the parallel spatial indexing mechanism in the grid environment. This spatial index structure with the multistage index mechanism of the global, domain, node and spatial data for foundation makes full use of the good qualities of the R-Tree and linked list structure combining the classic grid computing methodology. The new parallel spatial index is constructed to meet the needs of parallel grid computing about the management and retrieval magnanimous spatial data by improving the index structure of organization and storage. Appling the index to the grid GIS platen-MapGIS Grid Server verify the DMSR-Tree structure reasonable, performance efficiently of characteristics and satisfy the requirement of data resource supervision and search in the grid GIS environment.

articleTitle: Application in light steel composites in floors
abstract: Light steel construction is often designed to maximise the benefits of interactions with other materials and this paper reviews examples of composite applications of light steel components in flooring. New forms of steel-timber composite “plyweb” floor joists and steel-gypsum composite floor joists are investigated. Design recommendations are presented for lightweight floors, as influenced by interactions with boards, which include both static and dynamic criteria.

articleTitle: One-dimensional ternary photonic crystals with left-handed medium
abstract: The energy and defect mode properties of one dimensional ternary photonic crystals with left-handed medium (LHM) were investigated by transfer matrix method. It was demonstrated that the transmission became tunable, depending on the thickness and the refraction index of the slabs deeply: as the thickness of LHM slab in the structure became wider, the Bragg gap shifted toward higher frequency, in sharp contrast to its shifted toward lower frequency as a result of widening the thickness of positive-index-material slab. Moreover, it was found that the defect mode is sensitive to the thickness of the defect layer and it could be controlled by changing the thickness of the defect layer.

articleTitle: Multiplicative band semirings and distributive lattices
abstract: In this paper, we investigate multiplicative semirings with identity element. From the algebraic properties of lattices and distributive lattices, we study some properties of multiplicatice semirngs with identity. We show that if S, which is a semirings with identity, is a multiplicative band semiring if and only if S is a distributive lattice. Finally, we obtain a representation theorem for distributive lattices.

articleTitle: To compare the development of two science parks under different innovative strategies
abstract: This study aims to compare and analyze two science parks development and policy tools, through the development process, the environment and strategies, under different policy tools by way of qualitative research.

articleTitle: Global existence and blow-up for a parabolic system with nonlocal sources
abstract: This paper deals with the global existence and the blow-up properties of the nonnegative solutions to a semilinear parabolic system with nonlocal sources, subjected to null Dirichlet boundary conditions. By using the upper-lower solution method, the sufficient conditions on the global existence and blow-up in finite time of the nonnegative solutions are obtained.

articleTitle: Network technology scheme research of intelligent power utilization information collection EPON system
abstract: This thesis analyzes the pilot project of intelligent power consumption information collection EPON system of power fiber to the home. It develops its research about the network technology solutions and principle, and discussed the Networking technology scheme from the technological superiority of the system, system structure, network model, installation principles, the requirements of ONU and OLT selection. It points out that information collection system cooperated with EPON technology use optical fiber to every meter and home, including some business about electricity information collection, intelligent power utilization “two-way” interaction, “three nets fusion” and so on. It is the inevitable requirement to construct strong power grid and the inevitable choice to promote social resources sharing.

articleTitle: Tracing optimal solution TOSA for global placement
abstract: TOSA method is a new technique for faster time to improved SA. TOSA method traces optimal elements for reduce ineffective select in the simulated Annealing process. But TOSA take the uneven results in quality. In this paper, we propose a new technique that traces optimal solution in the SA process for high quality. We applied the method to the simple global placement problems, and found that it achieved more than 17% better solution as the best case than TOSA.

articleTitle: The study of stress concentration factor of tubular joints on coastal pile foundation
abstract: Welded steel tubular joints are widely used on pile foundation of coastal wind power generation and offshore platform. A model is set up and thin-shell finite element analyses have been conducted for joints typical of those used in coastal and offshore structures. Six degrees of freedom constraints and loading, calculate the stress distribution of the tubular joints in a variety of load based on ABAQUS. Especially on the complex geometric modeling- stress concentration factor (SCF) through the thickness and around the intersection of the tube. Using the database of finite element analysis results, the curve for the SCFs under six loading cases of the intersection can be derived. The result is reliability in a certain accuracy and it establishes foundation to get an equation of the stress concentration factor.

articleTitle: Transformation of implicit method to explicit method in solving vibration equation
abstract: It was proved that implicit method could be transformed to explicit method in solving vibration equation. The transformation of constant acceleration method to explicit method was detailed described. The paper disclosed the relationship between implicit method and explicit method, which provided a clue of finding a new explicit method with high precision and high computation efficiency.

articleTitle: Speech visualization of some Mandarin compound-finals
abstract: On the basis of the study of some compound finals in Chinese Mandarin, we propose a novel method for their speech visualization, which depends on the trajectory trends of the first three formants Fl, F2 and F3, and the relative relationships of these formants among different compound finals. The results of the subjective test show that a high recognition rate is achieved with the method.

articleTitle: A distributed top-k query algorithm integrated k-Cone structure for DHT overlay networks
abstract: The top-k query algorithm is a useful tool to lookup the best k results from candidate dataset for inquiring action. However, majority top-k query algorithms are applied to client/server networks rather than distributed networks specifically DHT overlay networks. This paper thinks about this problem to design a distributed top-k query algorithm for DHT overlay networks. It first constructs a unique k-Cone structure. And then designs a distributed top-k query algorithm for DHT overlay networks. Finally, an effective offset degree method is also applied to a collection of simulating experiments for verifying efficient as well as reliable of designed algorithm in different network scales. Luckily, a series of experiments give a fact that this distributed top-k query algorithm is a kind of efficient and reliable query algorithm in DHT overlay networks.

articleTitle: Planning for integrating rail transit and urban space—An interface-based research framework
abstract: The existing model of “planning for integrating rail transit and urban space” assumes that both urban space and rail transit are able to achieve their full potential and ignores the fact that the integration between the two can never be perfect. As a result, the existing model cannot reflect the nonlinear interactions between rail transit and urban space. This paper points out that the nonlinear interaction between rail transit and urban space is derived from the social interest reformation process while the “proposed” rail transit “embedded into” urban space, nevertheless the social interest is formed in “existing” urban space with long history. Based on this understanding, it is demonstrated that the interface can be an effective analysis tool for the process analysis, and an interface-based research framework for rail transit and urban space integration can be established. The merit of this framework is that studies of individual systems are no longer necessary, only the process and results of the coupling between rail transit and urban space need to be examined.

articleTitle: Forestry Management Information System based on flexible workflow and GIS technology
abstract: The Forestry Management System is an important part of establishing digital forestry. On account of the complexity and fickleness of forestry business process, this essay explores the application of workflow technology in the Forestry Management System First of all, this essay introduces WFMC (workflow management Coalition)-based workflow Meta model The following part explains the characteristics of flexible workflow system in detail, and defines a flexible workflow model, at the same time, and applies the object-oriented modeling approach to develop a distributed Forestry Management System model Finally, this essay describes the structure of the system. By taking use of the model, we have developed a series of Forest Administration FDA applications, and achieved good social and economic effects.

articleTitle: Measurement and estimation on sound insulation performance of the walls and floors in Taiwan's dwelling-housings
abstract: Countries in the world all build laws and regulations were been request on sound insulation performance of building structure. At present, the building technical regulations haven't set provisions for sound insulation standards but adopting the way of listing structures. Therefore, to follow the CNS trend of ISO standards for architectural acoustics, this study made a field survey by using ISO 140–4 and 140–7 measurement standards to measure the sound insulation performance of dwelling-housings, and compared that with sound insulation standards of building codes of various countries. The results showed the field sound insulation performance of the wall between rooms of row housing conform to the requirements for sound insulation standards in part countries, while the field sound insulation performance of dwelling-housings structures of floors that included base concrete floors, cement mortar and tiles can't conform to the requirements for sound insulation standards of any country.

articleTitle: Slope stability analysis and appraise of Dong-Gang combined pumphouse
abstract: Slope is a natural geography widely exists in the world. Reforms of the nature also lead to vast artificial slopes. Under the effect of inner force and various external loads, the stress-strain relationship of the slope is continuously changing and leads to kinds of destabilizing accidents. Accidents of slumping spread across the world, bringing in great loss to many countries and districts. Therefore, it is an important content of rock and soil engineering to study the stability of slopes. In this paper, combined with the engineering example, We introduce the method for slope stability analysis, and analyze the stability of the slope according to excavation grade ratio of 1∶1.5. Considering the factor of water and earthquake, it calculates the stability factor and broken mode under four kinds of work conditions, and puts forward some solutions.

articleTitle: The effect of cloud on the target detection in atmosphere
abstract: The target-background contrast has important application in many fields. Since cloud covers about 50% the gound surface and have important influence to the radiative transfer, it is necessary to taking into account the influence of cloud in the computing process of the target-background contrast. In the paper, the effect of the optical properties of cloud models to the target-background contrast was processed on the plane parallel assumption and the probability of cloud free light of sight (PCFLOS).

articleTitle: Analysis of bed load simulation methods of long reach movable-bed model of the Yellow River
abstract: Based on the overall conclusion of current research results of bed load simulation methods, the bed load simulation method of long reach movable-bed model of the Yellow River is explored in this paper. It deems that, when designing the movable-bed model, it should choose corresponding model similitude law according to the erosion and deposition characteristics of the simulated reach. When simulating the erosion and deposition characteristics of most about deposition and less exchange between suspended load and bed load in reservoirs, the total sediment load model similitude law brought out by Dou Guoren may be adopted into design; when simulating sediment-laden river like the Yellow River with the characteristics of easy scouring and silting, the model similitude law brought out by Zhang Hongwu et al may be adopted. Model practices prove that it is feasible.

articleTitle: An approach for underwater dim targets detection via power spectrum of back-scattering noise
abstract: The backward scatter that occurred with underwater light spreading is very strong, and it can occur a serious background noise in underwater imaging which causes underwater image fuzzy. So it is difficult to detect underwater dim targets. The traditional methods of underwater dim targets detection have some limitations on image contrast, gray scale or size of target, and so on. We deduced the model of back-scattering noise by studying the characteristics of underwater image in this paper. And then we used the model to detect the underwater dim targets.

articleTitle: Metropolitan division of industry layout and rationalization—Take Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei metropolis circle for example
abstract: With the background of global economic integration, deepen of industrial cooperation, promoting the development of economy by cooperation within regions gradually has become the hot focus of research. Globally, Tokyo urban circle and New York city circle have became the most developed and the most active economic center in the world, with its connection and development have already arrived at the most advanced level. Its ability of impetus has also radiated beyond borders, promoted the progress and development of global economy. In China, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei metropolis circle plays a crucial role for economic development, but judging from the current situation, the basic characteristics of the industrial development pattern can be summed up as the identical industrial structure, low-level repetitive construction and malignant competition, which are the constraints for growth of metropolis circle. The key to solve the problem is the industrial layout and the rationalization division.

articleTitle: Assessment of construction quality based on information entropy
abstract: Construction project quality, the basis of construction, is crucial process to survive and grow for construction. In order to assessment the construction quality scientifically, provided a good method for the work of competent administrative department of construction quality management, this paper constructed a construction quality assessment indexes system according to the construction quality management related theories. We confirmed the weight of each index quantitatively by means of information entropy according to an established index system. Then, we defined the elements of an assessment matrix and a quality assessment model for construction project was set up. An example is analyzed with the system, it can improve the validity and the precision of evaluation. Consequently, it can reflect the quality level of construction project.

articleTitle: The value and protection of spontaneous block of Hanzheng-Street in the view of heritage protection
abstract: Hanzheng Street is in full demolition, and soon will be razed to the ground. From the perspective of protection of cultural heritage this paper interprets the meaning of spontaneous block of Hanzheng Street as an informal neighborhoods that developed under formal society. Through excavating the historical, social, and cultural value of spontaneous neighborhoods of Hanzheng Street, it explores the shape and content of the bottom-up growth, then it refines intrinsic characteristic space order and enduring wisdom, thus to point out the cultural Heritage Properties of Hanzheng Street, and propose building a protection system of “street space for texture, spatial pattern of self-built, mode of production and life”. Meanwhile, it is for this unique system to explore the wide significance of protection and value of the spontaneous block of Hanzheng Street.

articleTitle: The upper limit of parity violation of gravitational field
abstract: We discussed the probability of parity violation of gravitational field, and deduced the motion function of a particle in the parity-violating gravitational field. Compared with the result of gravitational experiment, we found an upper limit of the possible parity violation of gravitational field.

articleTitle: Some aspects of processing, analysis, and control of signals as one-dimensional time series
abstract: The paper considers some issues of processing, analysis, and visual control of parameters of noisy signals. The considerable attention is paid to processing, analysis, and monitoring of periodic signals.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of nonlinear transmission lines for amplification of short pulses
abstract: Pulse propagation on nonlinear transmission lines (NLTLs), which are transmission lines with regularly spaced Schottky varactors, is experimentally investigated for the amplification of short pulses. We recently found that the soliton developed in an NLTL experiences an exponential amplitude growth, when it couples with an existing voltage edge. Using a test NLTL, we successfully demonstrate the pulse amplification through time-domain measurements. The voltage edge becomes steeper as it travels further, because the nonlinearity leads to the shock formation. This steep edge contributes to the pulse amplification even for the presence of the large parasitic resistance of inductors.

articleTitle: Enhance the thermal stability of PMMA by predecomposing its defect structures in a continuous polymerization process
abstract: This paper presents a novel idea that PMMA with high thermal stability may be produced by predecomposing way to remove the chains with head-to head linkages or unsaturated ends during a high temperature continuous polymerization, and, which tested by a pilot continuous polymerization equipment and thermogravimeter (TGA). The result shows that the idea is feasible and efficient, when the reaction and devolatilization steps were carried out at 155 and 300 °C, the chains with the head-to-head linkages or unsaturated ends in free radically polymerized PMMA can be removed completely. The obtained PMMA has an onset temperature of thermal degradation higher than 310

articleTitle: Primary investigation of the 3d GIS based on OpenGL_ES
abstract: This article is mainly about the possibility of the combine of GIS and OpenGL_ES, and together with the significant of the combination. Along with study progress of the OpenGL_ES, the author put an emphasis focus on two functions as lighting and texture parts, which reflects the drawing ability of 3d modling. Then there has a very systematize test and verify programs. Based on that to make sure that there has a very innovacant development space.

articleTitle: Research on lateral performance of hybrid structure based on post-beam construction and light wood frame construction
abstract: In recent years, the hybrid structure based on post beam constructions and light wood frame constructions appears both at home and abroad. This kind of structures not only possesses the characteristics of post- beam constructions, such as nice aesthetic view, flexible design, but also has the features of light wood frame constructions, including light weight, ease of workmanship and high earthquake resistance and enough durability for long period of years. In this paper, lateral performance of the post-beam constructions, the light wood frame constructions and the hybrid structure is compared experimentally. The comparison of load-bearing capacity and energy dissipation indicates that the frame has enhanced the lateral load bearing capacity of the hybrid structure.

articleTitle: On the solvability of time varying linear differential equations of second order
abstract: Time varying linear differential equations of second order can been transformed into the solvability of time-varying linear differential equations of second order by employing reversible constant linear transformation and reversible time varying linear transformation. The solvability of time-varying linear differential equations of second order is studied, and some sufficiency conditions are presented. Finally, two examples are given to illustrate the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Certain new class of multivalent functions associated with Generalized Hypergeometric Functions
abstract: The Generalized Hypergeometric Functions is used here to introduce a new class of Multivalent functions is in the open unit disc. We provide sufficient coefficient conditions, extreme points, integral means inequality and radius of close-to-convexity, starlikeness and convexity for the class.

articleTitle: Internet access technology based on the embedded devices
abstract: This paper describes how to implement embedded Internet access technology based on microcontroller. It designs a hardware architecture and software programming for embedded web application. Instead of full-featured TCP/IP, it makes use of simplified TCP/IP protocol because of limited storage space in the microcontroller and unnecessary function based on embedded Internet. The flow of data processing on web server is described in detail. The partial program code for embedded web server is written out in the last part of thesis.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of bulk material pressure on square silo wall
abstract: In this paper, the numerical simulation of silo wall pressure response under the earthquake loads is carried out. The initial static pressure values both on the bottom wall and the sidewall of the models according to the angle, but the dynamic response under the earthquake loads did not differ significantly. The pressures with different wall dips under dynamic loading increase substantially the same value, and this increase in value comparing to the initial static pressure is not obvious. Granular surface collapse during the loading period, in addition, a slip surface is generated in the granular internally.

articleTitle: Peelable GaAs mircotips grown by one-step selective liquid phase epitaxy
abstract: We present a simple one-step selective liquid-phase epitaxy (LPE) method to prepare peelable GaAs pyramidal microtips for compact scanning near-field optical microscopy (SNOM). A high Al content AlGaAs thin layer, as an etching sacrificial layer, is firstly selectively grown in periodic square windows of SiO2 mask deposited on GaAs substrate, and then GaAs is grown on the AlGaAs layer to automatically form peelable pyramidal microtip array. After the growth of the microtip array, the wafer is immersed into concentrated HCl solution at ice-point temperature to selectively etch off the AlGaAs layer and separate the microtips from the substrate. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images show that the microtips grown and peeled by this method are similarly high in quality with the peelable microtips prepared by two-step growth process we have reported before, but the one-step growth process is simpler and cheaper.

articleTitle: The study of the instruction strategy on armored equipment major courses based on virtual reality technology
abstract: Aiming at the teaching problems of major courses on armored equipment, this article sets forth the instruction strategy, which sets up the instruction situation referencing the usual training task in armored and mechanized army based on desktop virtual reality system to improve the learning enthusiasm of students. The instruction strategy is executed through 'subject' combined with 'question', and is designed on three aspects: visual cognition design, interactivity design and virtual situation learning, which are aligned with the desktop virtual reality system.

articleTitle: Completing odd-shaped junctions in imperfect line drawing
abstract: The common imperfect line drawing has both missed lines and needless lines. Some common odd-shaped junctions and the methods about how to manage them are listed in this paper. A detailed discussion on the process of line drawing labeling and deleting is given with examples. Finally, the imperfect line drawing is transformed into a proper line drawing.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic damage process for steel frame structure due to strong earthquakes
abstract: To accurately describe the dynamic damage process of steel structures under strong earthquakes, an improved two parameter damage model was proposed by considering the effect of hysteretic deformation amplitude on accumulative damage energy dissipation. The parameters are determined through an incremental dynamic analysis and damage analysis on a 9-story benchmark steel model due to strong earthquakes. Comparative analyses for steel structure under the strong earthquakes are carried out using Park model and the proposed damage model, and the rationality of the proposed model has been verified.

articleTitle: The MPEG video stream design method based on the multimedia resource database
abstract: The video streaming in the multimedia resource database,running in the campus network, its core is the video streaming technology application based on the MPEG format (including MPEG-1, MPEG-2, and MPEG-4, etc). By the design and calculation about the video of MPEG format in the multimedia resource database,this article has provided a design method that the video streaming system of MPEG format in the multimedia resource database is appropriate transmission system, and the system is running in the actual campus network.

articleTitle: The application of multimedia technique in college aerobics teaching
abstract: Multimedia technique provides new teaching method and effective condition for improving the width and depth of teaching. In physical education, multimedia-assisted teaching can stimulate students' creative thinking and leading role, with the characteristics of both group and individual considered. The advantages of multimedia technique in aerobics teaching are discussed, and some suggestions are proposed in the specific application according to the present situation.

articleTitle: Fuzzy mathematics assessment in the evaluation of air quality
abstract: The traditional evaluate method can not deal with the evaluation of the air quality with fuzzy information, the degree of air pollution has a fuzzy concept, it means that the fuzzy mathematics theory can be used to evaluate the air quality. As the praxis of fuzzy mathematics, fuzzy mathematics assessment is prevalent used in many fields, for it is a simple mathematical model that can be easily used by us. Fuzzy mathematics assessment has advantage to solve the complex problem which has many different factors. Using it to evaluate the quality of water can get an objective result. It's known to US all that sandstorms and the dust and gases from volcanoes pollute the earth's atmosphere naturally, but the most serious kind of air pollution comes from human beings. It's significant to constrain human activities and prevent air pollution by grasping situation of air quality scientifically.

articleTitle: BAF-SCAD for advanced wastewater nitrogen removal
abstract: This paper used a novel technology, BAF-SCAD, for the advanced nitrogen removal of wastewater after con. BAF stood for biological aerated filter and SCAD meant sulfur-ceramic autotrophic denitrification. The experimental results show that the BAF-SCAD system was successfully started after 2.5 months' starting up. With a NaHCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> dosage of 1 g/L, the BAF-SCAD system effectively removed the pollutants. Excellent nitrogen removal was achieved by nitrification in the BAF and denitrification in the SCAD. When the concentrations of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N, TN in the influent were 10-20mg/L, 8-16mg/L, 25-30mg/L respectively, the concentrations of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N in the effluent were below lmg/L and the TN was 1-3 mg/L. The removal efficiency of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N was above 95% and the removal efficiency of TN was above 90%. The COD removal efficiency of BAF was between 20%-30% while COD in the effluent of SCAD increased slightly. The results showed a promising new approach for the biological denitrification of the secondary effluent of municipal wastewater treatment plant under low carbon source.

articleTitle: Exponential stability of Cohen-Grossberg neural network with time-delays and variable coefficient
abstract: A model describing exponential stability of Cohen-Grossberg neural network with time-delays and variable coefficient is considered by means of Lyapunov functionals and analysis technique of differential inequality. Some sufficient conditions for existence and exponential are given. In the process of proof, we extend the limitation of Lyapunov function and make the result more general. So we expand some results.

articleTitle: Research on Component-based protocol for satellites network
abstract: Satellites network will be part of the next generation communication networks infrastructures with the development of the satellites technology. The characteristics of satellites network and their negative effects on the design, research and maintenance of satellites network protocol are discussed. Component-based techniques are put forward to solve these negative effects for the satellites network protocols design, and then, a satellites networks protocol component model is designed based on the Component-based techniques. The service functions of the crucial components are designed in the end. The satellites networks protocol component model can facilitate the design and development of satellite network protocols, improve the flexibility and reusability of protocol, and fulfill the application needs of the satellites network.

articleTitle: Research and application of the WebGIS based on ArcIMS and Ajax
abstract: The advantages of using the Ajax technology in WebGIS, such as updating pages without refreshing, balancing the server and client load, updating the map dynamically, which improving user's experience. ArcIMS because of its cross-platform supports multiple development languages, and good scalability has become the most popular WebGIS platform. In this paper, we analyze Ajax technology and ArcIMS,and bring forward a developing approach for WebGIS based on Ajax and ArcIMS, moreover the method has been applied to the development of internet bar control and supervisory system. Experiment illustrates that the program implements the browser and asynchronous interaction between the WebGIS servers, so that the best performance of the entire state of WebGIS.

Author Keywords: Internet bar control and supervisory system

articleTitle: Study on Harbin Middle East railway staff residential building outdoor elements characteristics
abstract: This essay analysis the rich architectural outdoor residential component of Harbin Middle East railway staff residential building, focusing from the window type and window decorations, the entrance and the door fighting, roof and eaves, gables and corner stone, a porch and greenhouse. The article explained Harbin Middle East Railway staff residential building outdoor elements embodied characteristics.

Author Keywords: Middle East railway staff residential building

articleTitle: A modified conjugate gradient algorithm for optimization problems
abstract: A modified conjugate gradient algorithm is presented, which possesses the sufficient descent condition without any line search. The global convergence with the weak Wolfe-Powell (WWP) line search rule is established for nonconvex function under suitable conditions. Numerical results show that the given method is interesting.

articleTitle: Review on biosorption of heavy metals by activated sludge
abstract: The occurrence of heavy metals in our water resources is of continued concern for the health and safety of consuming public. The existing conventional water treatment plants may only partially remove heavy metals, a large fraction of the metals are released to the aquatic environment. Recently, activated sludge emerged as an eco-friendly bioadsorbent, is effective and low cost material option on the removal of hevy metals. This paper discusses the various parameters effected biosorption of heavy metals, such as temperature, pH, biomass concentration, concentrations of initial metal and other factors, etc‥ In particular, the removal mechanism is emphasized because of its importance in understanding the reaction between the microorganisms and the metals.

articleTitle: Bayes inference for loss and risk function of Exponential distribution based on progressively type-II censoring
abstract: The Bayes estimators for the loss and risk function of parameter of Exponential distribution are obtained based on progressively type II censored samples under a new loss function which proposed by Rukhin. The conditions of Bayes estimators being conservative are also given.

articleTitle: Design of data collection and transmission system based on AD7865
abstract: This paper introduces a high-speed multi-channel data collection system based on AD7865 which can transmit data to PC by USB interface chip CY7C68013. Not only focusing on the character of the AD7568, this design but also complete the work of interface circuit and the programming of the whole system centered on the FPGA EP1C6Q240C8. By controlling the variation of the signal from analog to digital, the system achieves the point of the high-speed multi-channel data collection and real-time monitoring, it can be primly used in photoelectric detection system.

articleTitle: Local environment recognition based on multi-sensor data fusion
abstract: As autonomous robot, possessing visual and range information acquisition capability is very crucial to explore unknown environments reliably, SIFT (Scale Invariant Feature Transform) algorithm is a powerful tool in detecting objects under various imaging conditions, robot can use the recognized object as landmarks to navigate and localize itself. The laser scanning data is not sensitive to noise and lightness of the environment, most of the robots use laser rangefinder for its navigation and localization. This paper presents a method to recognize local environment based on data fusion, experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of distributed information retrieval
abstract: A distributed information retrieval of information retrieval is one of the important research direction. With the rapid growth of WEB information, information is more and more, this information can not be processed. So how to only part of data retrieval, this is distributed information retrieval needs to solve one of the major problems. This paper focuses on the distributed information retrieval, distributed information retrieval, this search engine analysis, to the search engine's analysis of all kinds of search engine is analyzed, and then their respective advantages and disadvantages, at the end of the development of distributed information retrieval technology prospects described.

articleTitle: Positive research on features of Wuhan spatial development since 1990s
abstract: Cases of Wuhan urban land development from 1992 to 2008 as a basic research platform are chosen to analyze the process of Wuhan urban spatial expansion, and to interpret the overall form and development process of Wuhan urban space from the positive analysis. Based on the above, the features of Wuhan Spatial Development can be concluded as a powerful force to concentrate to the heart, based on the growth process of the edge of downtown the axis and differentiation of different functions of spatial concentration in certain geographical clusters.

articleTitle: The application of point cloud data plane fitting in the Guishan Han Tomb modeling
abstract: This paper uses the point cloud data plane fitting method to model the Guishan Han Tomb, and obtains its three dimensional model and the measurement results by the calculation to the mathematical model. The results show that the accuracy of this modeling method is high, and can obtain the accurate Guishan Han Tomb three dimensional model and the parameters.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of marine sediment quality based on attribute recognition model with entropy weight and GIS
abstract: An attribute recognition model with entropy weight has been introduced in the paper, and then the model, combined with GIS, is applied to evaluate the surface sediment quality in Weihai bay. The results show that the overall quality of surface sediment in Weihai bai is good but there also exists a gradual deterioration tendency from outer sea to the west coast. The model, with clear physical meaning and objective determining weights, can not only recognize and classify the evaluation objects, but also score and sort them, which would be useful to improve the resolution of evaluation results and provide more reliable details for environmental management and decision-making.

articleTitle: Surcharse precompression processing technique of the A Port cargo area for the low infiltration & deep thick silty
abstract: Lianyungang Jingangwan international logistics park is constructed in the coastal soft soil, the freight traffic loads is large, high demands is must to the Port cargo area, For consultation in the soft soil in the economy of Port cargo area works, "Plastic drainage board and preloading" are used to processing the soft soil of the A Port cargo area, combined with the researches, Proved this method is reasonable and effective, We not only guaranteed the quantity of the reconstruction project, and the cost is lower that the budget, In this article we will share our experiences and techniques.

Author Keywords: soft soil of Port cargo area

articleTitle: Design of multimedia network courseware for Building Materials of civil engineering
abstract: This paper illustrates the design of multimedia network courseware for Building Materials from four aspects as Exploiture Aims, Design of Structure, Designing Standards and Main Characteristics of Courseware. According to the characteristics of the course, we established the Designing Standards for the courseware and introduce an innovative section as experiments simulation to settle the lack of practice for engineering course.

articleTitle: Text watermarking algorithm based on the stroke of Chinese characters
abstract: By marking Chinese characters which have the specified number of strokes, this paper introduces a text watermarking algorithm based on the stroke of Chinese characters. Experimental results show that the algorithm has a greater watermarking capacity, stronger robustness and best imperceptibility. At the same time, the algorithm has good robustness against the format attack, and can identify the attacks of deleting and adding characters.

articleTitle: Study on affecting factors of biosorption of MoO42− by Pseudomonas Pseudoalcaligenes
abstract: Affecting factors of biosorption of MoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> by Pseudomonas Pseudoalcaligenes were studied, influences of biosorption by pH, temperature, coexisting metal ions and additional glucose were tested. The test results showed that the best pH for biosorption was 7, the best temperature for biosorption was 30°C~50°C, the balance time of biosorption was 40~60min. Influence by coexisting metal ions was significant. Organic nutrients not only failed to promote biosorption of MoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup>, but reduced the amount of biosorption.

articleTitle: Existence of three positive periodic solutions of nonlinear neutral functional differential equations with impulses and delays
abstract: By using a fixed point theorem in cones, some sufficient conditions are established for the existence of three positive periodic solutions for a kind of nonlinear neutral functional differential equations with impulse and state dependent delays.

articleTitle: Design and practice of single-chip computer motion-picture styled LED displaying control system
abstract: This paper describes a cost-effective motion-picture styled LED displaying controlling system based on single-chip computer, including hardware structure equipped with a mother control board, a sub-control board and displaying driving circuits. Moreover, this paper also provides with a detailed software design flow-chart. A new generation of MCU is selected which is manufactured domestically. It is characteristics of high speed, low dissipation and super high anti-interference. It's command system is compatible with 8051. Moreover, a SPI is chosen between the mother board and the SD card to make the communication even sampler and more efficient. In addition, the communication between the mother board and it's sub-mother board is achieved by a Half-duplex styled 485.

articleTitle: Simulation calculation of twice-tension prestressed steel in continuous girder bridge
abstract: In order to reduce the creep effect of the long-span prestressed bridge, a new construction method of twice-tension prestressed steel is adopted, and by using the finite element analysis software, modeling is conducted to the one girder and four spans of a continuous girder bridge in a real project, calculation of various aspects such as the displacement and deformation and internal force on cross section and loss of prestress were made in different construction phases; in this way, the feasibility of this construction method is made, and data for calculation is prepared for the promotion of this tensioning scheme.

articleTitle: Research on groundwater level prediction of Naoli river basin based on Elman wavelet neural networks
abstract: By combining Elman neural network with wavelet analysis, this paper establishes Elman-wavelet network model. The paper also presents the training process of Elman-wavelet network model, and applies the model to groundwater-level prediction of Naolihe basin. Numerical results derived demonstrate the model has high prediction accuracy, fast convergence and good prediction results.

articleTitle: Positive symmetric solutions to a class of four-point boundary value problems
abstract: In this paper, several existence results of positive symmetric solutions are obtained for a class of two-order four point boundary value problems with p-Laplacian. Existence criteria which ensure the existence of triple positive solutions are established.

articleTitle: Study on damage mechanism of SESAM in high power ultrafast laser
abstract: With the development of ultrafast laser to high power and high pulse energy, it is necessary to study damage mechanism of Semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) and high threshold SESAM. Damage mechanism of SESAM in high power ultrafast laser is theoretically analyzed and experimentally observed in this paper. The damage mechanism on surface of SESAM is studied by heat imaging of SESAM in working high power ultrafast laser with thermal imager and the SESAM surface damaged by high power femtosecond laser pulses is also analyzed. Both heat damage of SESAM and the influential factors are studied in this paper.

articleTitle: The classical solution for a class of time fractional differential equation
abstract: In this paper the damped oscillating equation is considered with the damping term generalized to a Caputo fractional derivative. The order of the fractional derivative about time is V(0 <; V <; 2) . The series solution is obtained to the corresponding initial-bounded problem. Then we give the conditions under which the series solution is classical.

articleTitle: Research of digital media based interaction design case study: Interaction design of virtual home furnishing display
abstract: Interaction design plays a very important part in the digital media industry. This paper will take the interaction design of virtual home furnishing display as an example and analyze the multiple approaches and relevant design principles applied to this particular field, so that we can give some guide instructions to the interaction design of the home furnishing display platform.

articleTitle: Low-carbon urban planning of the resource-based cities
abstract: The resource-based cities play a very important role in the economic development in our country. In this paper, the current present situation of resources cities and the requirements of the urban construction were analyzed. The ideas of transforming from resource-based cities to low-carbon cities and building sustainable development have become popular since their first appearance. Based on the advantageous status, some suggestions are put forward for the sustainable development of resource-based cities, for example, it would be wise for us to construct low-carbon urban cities comprehensively taking the following into consideration: spatial planning, industry planning, transportation planning and energy planning.

articleTitle: Design on real-time video transmission system based on data repeater gateway of heterogeneous network
abstract: To the question of the real-time video transmission in heterogeneous network, designed a data repeater gateway of heterogeneous network. The technology of layered buffering and P2P was adopted for resulting the difference between transmission speeds of heterogeneous network and improving the transmission efficiency. The system was implemented with ARM 10 platform, which was proven can meet the real-time video transmission.

articleTitle: A study on the multimedia-based teaching model of college oral English
abstract: Along with the development of network technique, multimedia technology has been widely applied in college English teaching This article explores the construction of a new multimedia-based teaching model of college oral English, and emphasizes its features, elements and teaching strategies in order to optimize oral English teaching and improve the student's communicative ability.

articleTitle: Analytic solutions of dark-dark spatial soliton pair in biased serial PV-PR crystal
abstract: Based on the theory of separate optical soliton pair which is formed in a biased series photovoltaic photorefractive crystal circuit, we derive the dynamical coupled evolution equations, and we get the analytic solutions of the dark-dark soliton pair under low amplitude conditions. We also investigate the interaction of these soliton pair.

articleTitle: Optimization planning decision-making mechanism to build urban spatial characteristics in China
abstract: Under the background of present urban spatial characteristic in china gradually been lost, the influence about the current planning decision-making mechanism to the urban spatial characteristics has been studied. From the view of normative studying . Not only did it describe three dimensions of urban spatial characteristics, but also analyzed the main cause which the economic system reform, multiple main body participation, and the complexity of decision-making influenced urban spatial characteristics. Finally, allowing for a series of planning decision problems, such as the separation of duty and right in decision-making process, the discontinuities in decision-making process, the wrong value of the main decision-maker, the single main participant, It put forward four optimization measures in order to shape the city features.

articleTitle: GKJ and clustering based algorithm for collision detection on deformable body
abstract: this paper proposed a collision detection method for deformable body based on clustering algorithm and GKJ algorithm. This method first divide triangle meshes into convex hulls formed by multiple clusters; then utilizes GJK algorithm to solve the convex hull collision detection problem. The proposed method can increase detection efficiency, solve penetration problem, which happens when one body is small compared with triangle mesh, and provide freedom to set collision detection precision. Real-world applications provided feasibility and reliability of using this method in solving deformable body-to-body multi-points collision detection problems. It is valuable for researches in fields including 3D gaming, visual reality, physical simulation and others.

articleTitle: An application of numerical model for storm surge analysis in Lianyungang
abstract: Lianyungang faces threats from typhoon storm surge. The potential storm surge induced by typhoon needs to be studied. The ADCIRC hydrodynamic model has been applied on analysis of storm surge in the coastal of Lianyungang. The atmospheric driving forces of storm surge model (pressure and wind fields) have been simulated by Fujita-Takahashi model. The calibrated ADCIRC model is applied to simulate the potential surge setups generated by typical typhoons. The simulated results in the paper can be served for coastal engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation and analysis of the real estate investment environment base on AHP (analytic hierarchy process)
abstract: As the rapid development of economy and the high returning of real estate investment, investment of real estate market grows faster. Recently there is supposed a prosperity phrase in both supply and demand field. Real estate industry, as an important investment area is influenced by its diversification, demutualization, marketing custom of the investment and socialization of the investment which decide that the real estate investment; thus real estate is quite different with other investment. Compared with other industries, real estate demands more on environment for its great value, long period and fixed location; further, it is more easily to be influenced by economy, environment and the macro control policies. All those mentioned demonstrate the practical meaning to this paper.

articleTitle: Analyzing 2D temperature field problems in the improved element-free Galerkin method
abstract: This paper presents an improved moving least-square (IMLS) approximation in which the orthogonal function system with a weight function is used as the basis function. The IMLS approximation has a greater computational efficiency and precision than the existing MLS, and does not lead to an ill conditioned system of equations. By combining the element-free Galerkin (EFG) method and the IMLS approximation, IEFG is derived. There is a numerical example solved using this method. It demonstrated the method has a greater computational efficiency and precision, and it is simple and effective.

articleTitle: The application of data origin authentication to video multicast communication
abstract: We apply a kind of data origin authentication algorithm that is robust against data packet loss and injection to the video multicast communication. In this algorithm, we combine the efficient packet-injection resistant multicast source authentication protocol (EPJRSA) with the Signature Amortization using Rabin's Information Dispersal Algorithm (SAIDA) to make sure that both the data and the authentication message cannot be maliciously deleted or forged by the adversary. To evaluate our technique's security, we use two different models to simulate the adversary's attack in multicast communication channel.

articleTitle: A priori bounds for periodic solutions of higher order functional differential equation
abstract: A priori bounds are established for periodic solutions of a higher order functional differential equation with delay. By means of these bounds, an existence theorem for periodic solutions can be obtained by means of Mawhin's continuation theorem. Our work generalizes the known result.

articleTitle: Stress test and finite element analysis of a 10×104 m3 crude oil tank
abstract: The large crude oil storage tank with a capacity of 10×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> has been widely used in China currently. In order to obtain the stress distribution in the wall board, bottom board, big fillet weld and manhole, and to verify the rationality of tank design, a stress test which combining the method of static resistance strain test (SRST) and optical fiber strain test (OFST) is conducted during water filling test for the tank. Software ANSYS is employed to construct a three-dimensional (3d) space finite element model under hydraulic test loading. And then theoretically calculated and measured values are compared and a good agreement between them is achieved.

articleTitle: Effects of three relativity effects on Kα X-Ray
abstract: Applying relativity theory and quantum mechanics, a formula calculating wavelength of the K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub> X-ray is obtained considering three different relativity effects which are spin-orbit coupling, kinetic energy relativity effect and potential relativity effect. The wavelengths from 11 elements to 90 elements have been calculated and the effects of each effect on X-ray spectrum have been studied. Calculation values agree with experimental data. Results show that Kinetic Energy Relativity Effect will widen the energy gap, largen the transition frequency and shorten the wavelength, while the Spin-Orbit Coupling Effect has the counter-effect. Relativistic Effect is proportional to the square of Z and affect distinctly to the elements with large atom number.

articleTitle: The locating suitability analysis of urban fixed shelters based on OWA method
abstract: The main content studied in this paper is the locating suitability analysis of urban fixed shelter based on the ordered weighted averaging (OWA) method of GIS multiple-criteria evaluation.Use the center of a coastal city as an example, through collecting and processing related images, calculating the factor weights coefficients and the order weights coefficients, finally confirm the locating suitability image of the urban fixed shelters via OWA method, and the screening work of fixed shelters has been done according to the theoretical basis above.

articleTitle: Human detection based on Curvelet transform
abstract: A method in Curvelet transformation for human detection is proposed in this paper. First, the curvelet coefficient was obtained by conducting the second curvelet transform for images. Then several statistical characteristics were computed from each sub-band coefficient. Finally, according the possibilities of the statistical features chosen by AdaBoost weak classifiers, some reasonable statistical measures were chosen as the final edge feature vector. The experimental results on INRIA and MIT human database showed that CTD increased the detection accuracy comparing to HOG.

articleTitle: Knows the quantum computer
abstract: I am a researcher in Whole Science. There are practically two views concerning quantum computer: the first is of Pouling Science; the second is of Whole Science which is possessed by me. The wider the differences of these opposing views in computers are, the more people can get from it. The assumption is as follows: bring computer and quantum computer into Whole Science and Pouling Science respectively, and to carry out logical analysis. The result is: in computer, the expression of the number is fixed, while in quantum computer, the expression of the number is not fixed. Being fixed and not fixed are the opposing views of two kinds of computers.

articleTitle: The effects of local density of states to Purcell factor in Surface plasmon polaritons
abstract: Surface plasmon polaritons is a kind of electromagnetic oscillation coupled with the undulation of charge intensity, which is excited at the interface between metal and dielectric. With the properties of near-field enhancement and short wavelength, surface plasmon polaritons play an important role in nano photonics. We use an unambiguous definition to represent the local density of electromagnetic states(LDOS) near the interface of metallic surfaces, which has relationship with Purcell factor. We then calculate LDOS and Purcell factor at different heights above a semi-infinite sample of various metallic materials and have the conclusion that Ag is more suitable for designing Single photon sources.

articleTitle: Toward an integration approach of science park and urban development: Software design for urban planning supporting system
abstract: Since Taiwan's science park development in 1980, it has not only successfully boosted Taiwan's industrial cohesion and upgraded traditional industries simultaneously but also promoted local development around the park. It speeds up population concentration, environmental planning and land utilizing development, thereby affecting the development model of the city. However, the population growth the demand for land brought about by rapid urbanization cannot be expected. SP-DRAM model was refined in this paper through DRAM / EMPAL distribution model prototype and added a new variable model based on the development characteristics of Taichung area to conduct the population growth of Taichung for transforming a variety factor of Taichung Science Park and urban development into all useful information available for decision makers. Due to the complicated formula operation, there is large amount of data required. This study further develop the software supporting systems to enable both the database and software be apply on calculating urban planning and development assessment to promote the presentation of urban planning through concretized number information.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation based on crisis prevention management of fuzzy analysis
abstract: The crisis prevention management evaluation system mainly includes effective warning mechanism, effective internal coordination mechanism, effective cooperation between the government and cooperation mechanisms between countries, developing the professional organization ability, dealing with various crises effectively, establishing a social support system, absorbing the participation of citizens and community, and setting up the “joint production” mechanism. It considers each system as a first grade index and there are 5 first grade indexes and 12 secondary indexes. The fuzzy mathematics theory discusses the combination of qualitative and quantitative comprehensive evaluation model of the crisis prevention management, provides theoretical support for improving the government crisis management level evaluation and increasing the whole social emergency management level.

articleTitle: Correspondence with category Latent Dirichlet Allocation for image annotation
abstract: We present correspondence with category Latent Dirichlet Allocation (corr-c-LDA), a novel probabilistic topic model for the task of image and video annotation. The heart of our annotation model lies in introducing the class label information and assuming the dependence relationships between class label and image feature, as well as class label and annotation words. Instead of modeling the image and annotation words in the formulation of correspondence LDA, our model models the image with class label and annotation words, and tries to avail category information to promote image annotation. We demonstrate the power of our model on 2 standard datasets: a 1791-image subset of UlUC-dataset and a 2400-image LabelMe dataset. The proposed association model shows improved performance over several existing models as measured by F measure.

articleTitle: Study on the similarity comparing and knowledge push of SQL code
abstract: The lexical and syntax of SQL statement was analyzed in this paper. Firstly, the abstract syntax tree (AST) of SQL statement was established, then, the similarity between the produced AST and the object code in database was analyzed to get the Similarities and differences, finally, the differences knowledge was pushed out. The establishment process of automatic evaluation modeling of database was described in this research, which is provided a basis for further study.

articleTitle: The application of surfactants in water determination of calcium and magnesium
abstract: The unstability of EBT indicator solution results in the inaccuracy of the determination of calcium and magnesium. In this paper, surfactants are applied in EBT indicator solution, through spectrophotometric method, a stable EBT solution is obtained, and the precision of calcium and magnesium determination in water was improved. Moreover, surfactant PVA is used to determine calcium in the water of high content magnesium, this can avoid the adsorption of magnesium hydroxide to calcium and improve the accuracy.

articleTitle: A study of construction force of the work plateform steel-pipe piles in the deep sea foundation
abstract: Through the study of construction force of the work plateform steel-pipe piles on the Sanmenkou crossing sea bridge, the load-bearing calculation methods of the steel-pipe piles in the deep sea foundation were determined, the contents ,the methods and the major factors in analyzing the strength and stability at the stage of the construction and use were determined.

articleTitle: Development of industrial Ethernet data acquisition modules
abstract: Industrial Ethernet data acquisition modules based on Rabbit2000 are developed. The embedded microprocessor Rabbit2000 is designed to be the heart of the module, which features an integrated Ethernet port. The processor is connected with the integrated Ethernet controller RTL8019 to achieve process control variables or equipment to be connected to an industrial Ethernet network and then provide for Internet-enabled systems to be built easily. The data acquisition module comprises of analog input and digital input/output channels, as well as EIA232 and EIA485 serial interface circuit. The built-in program written in Dynamic C can implement process data acquisition and industrial field device control.

articleTitle: The application of intelligent remote monitoring platform under Windows on physical theory education
abstract: Based on the quality of school teaching room management issues, a remote monitoring system has been developed with Delphi. You can see the state of any one computer in the room through the screen capture. You can send a warning message to the user under the illegal operation. This paper introduced the serial communication interface and the method of achieving remote monitoring equipment based on TCP/IP on the local area network, on the same time, the real-time requirements, functional requirements and design and implementation of the overall program have been discussed. As a teaching aid in physical theory education process, the application of intelligent remote monitoring platform will promote the standardization and scientific of teaching.

articleTitle: Study on an algorithm for the optimal path in urban traffic
abstract: The shortest path problem is a principal issue in the applications of GIS. After the analysis of the existing shortest path searching algorithms, and with a view to the actual state of the urban traffic, a new local shortest path searching algorithm based on GIS was proposed. And a most economical urban traffic path searching algorithm was introduced. Finally, a preliminary model of the optimal urban traffic path searching algorithm was developed on the basis of the above-mentioned conclusions.

articleTitle: The study of the index models used in extraction of water body based on HJ-1 CCD imagery
abstract: A new index mode for extraction of water body with HJ-1 satellite CCD imagery Normalized Difference of RVI and NDWI(NDRW) which combined both RVI and NDWI values is purposed in this paper based on analyzing the spectral characteristics of water in HJ-1 satellite CCD imagery and the advantages and disadvantages of three the most frequently used indexes, which are Ratio Vegetation Index(RVI), Normalized Difference Vegetation Index(NDVI) and Normalized Difference Water Index(NDWI). Not only are the extraction results of water body based on NDR W and other 3 index compared qualitatively, but also the accuracy of extraction of water body is analyzed quantitatively with the contrast value, the overall accuracy and the Kappa coefficient. The extraction result of water body of ETM+ image by using Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI) is used as the reference image. The test results show that the NDRW index mode can be used to distinguish water and artificial construction land which are difficult to do so for other indexes. The water information is highlighted effectively and accuracy of extraction of water body is improved compared to the other 3 indexes.

articleTitle: Dpq chaos for subshifts of finite type
abstract: Given 0 ≤ p ≤ q ≤ 1, a dynamical system is said to be D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sup> chaotic, if there is an uncountable set in which any two different points have trajectory approaching time set with lower density p and upper density q . In this paper, we show that if a subshift of finite type has positive topological entropy then it is D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sup> chaos for any 0 ≤ p ≤ q ≤ 1 .

articleTitle: Study on the technology of reinforcing ultrahigh subgrade of low liquid limit clay by grouting wall method
abstract: Based on the case of reinforcement engineering design for highly-filled subgrade to be antiskid and settlement-reducing with low liquid limit clay in the gully development zone of intermountain fault basin in Jinan's Round-city Expressway, and on the compaction grouting test on experimental section and grouting effect detection, the relationship among grouting amount, grout diffusion radius and soil void ratio, grouting pressure, slurry water-cement ratio is discussed. A design scheme of reinforcing highly-filled subgrade in the method of grouting wall is put forward in this paper. The data from the long-term observation of the open road settlement and current situation of slope stability of roadbed verified the feasibility of this technology.

articleTitle: Some aspects in reaction-diffusion systems by numerical approach
abstract: In this workshop, we study various types of solutions for reaction-diffusion systems of activator-inhibitor type. A typical example is FitzHugh-Nagumo equations. In numerical computation, we use method of lines to approximate partial differential equation by a system of ordinary differential equations. Based on numerical studies, we investigate a number of properties for the traveling fronts and traveling pulses of FitzHugh-Nagumo type systems.

articleTitle: AVS decoder optimization based on cache
