abstract: To enhance the running efficiency of AVS decoder in the embedded platform, an optimized method was proposed based on the LIP cache, the program code is divided to 4 modules, the capacity of each module is smaller than the capacity of LIP, change the traditional processing pattern by order aiming to single macro block, make every program module process the data of one macro block row in turn, thus reduce 4 × M × (N-1) code washout. The experiment result show the method based on LIP cache enhances the efficiency of processor reading program code, makes the decoder speed enhance 20%.

articleTitle: Design and development of the monitoring system for traffic signal controller based on WEB technology
abstract: In this paper, some problems faced by domestic traffic signal controllers are analyzed, and comes to a conclusion that it is very in need to develop a monitoring system for traffic signal controller based on WEB technology. The structure of monitoring system is divided into four layers and the specific design method of each layer is exposited in detail, the system function realized is also illustrated meanwhile. Test shows that the traffic signal controllers can be effectively monitored and managed by this system with good real-time. As the system is B/S structured, it is easy to upgrade and maintain and also can be used to monitor other underlying devices of the intelligent transportation system (ITS).

articleTitle: Continuous wave light injection effect in upstream traffic TDM-PON
abstract: High capacity time division multiplexed passive optical network (TDM-PON) is an emerging fiber access network that deploys optical access lines between a carrier's central office (CO) and a customer sites. In this investigation, we demonstrate and analyze the continuous wave (CW) upstream effect in TDM-PONs.Besides, we also propose and design a protection apparatus in each optical network unit (ONU) to avoid a CW upstream traffic in TDM-PONs due to sudden external environment change or ONU failure. When an upstream CW injection occurs in TDM access network, the protection scheme can stop the CW effect within a few ms to maintain the entire data traffic.

articleTitle: A document multi-watermarking based on document characteristics
abstract: A multiple watermarking which is applicable to English-Chinese electronic documents of common format is proposed based on document characteristics. Both robust and fragile watermarking are embedded to ensure copyright protection and content authentication. Feature extraction based on word frequency is built to extract feature from host document. Zero-watermarking is introduced into design of robust watermark to ensure transparency and better watermarking capacity. Fragile watermark is constructed by the SHA-1 hash function to be highly sensitive to tamper. Both robust and fragile watermarks can be extracted blindly. Experimental results show that this algorithm has better transparency and tampering sensitivity, and it is robust against attacks of entities such as cutting, copying, pasting, reversing.

articleTitle: A simple digital recording method of historic building in Tibet
abstract: Digital information technology could integrate all aspects of information about architectural heritage and establish a historic building digital file that includes date, text, image, 3D model and other type. It is convenient to the daily virtual preserve and protect of architectural heritage. This paper presents that in a short time, less labor and low-cost operating condition, utilizing laser range finder aided with photographic record to get the basic data of building, and then applying Google SketchUp 3D modeling software to reconstruct space model and texture mapping model of historic building, finally it import the SketchUp 3D model with map information Multipatch to GIS system integrated, realizing the rapid digital record about the appearance form, color tones and state of building. Take the Paba Temple of Jilong County in Tibet for example, this paper studies the digital recording method is based on fast mapping of historic building and rapid modeling what could achieve both speed and fidelity effectively, and especially at the high altitude area, limited working condition in Tibet, it could better show its superiority.

articleTitle: Applications of surface-layer improvement technique in land reclamation with dredger soil
abstract: Dredger soil once was treated as waste and abandoned to the appointed sites or the nearby ocean, which had resulted in serious environment pollution and high costs. Since the viewpoint of “Utilize Dredger soil Valuably” was proposed in 1980s, dredger soil has been used as the hydraulic fill material in reclamation works, which can meet the requirements of land expansion and avoid the dilemma of seeking the special sites to deposit vast dredger soil. However, most of the new hydraulic fill soil is the floating or fluid mud and has high water content but little bearing capacity, so it is difficult for the traditional treatment methods to improve the ultra-soft foundation. Based on the improvement mechanism of vacuum preloading, the surface-layer improvement technique without sand cushion was developed and has been applied successfully in practices. The applications showed that the surface-layer improvement technique without sand cushion improved the bearing capacity of ultra-soft foundation substantially.

articleTitle: The primary energy use and emissions of housing sector in Taiwan
abstract: Housing sector is one of the important greenhouse gases (GHGs) emissions which result global warming. In order to trace the energy use before and after primary energy factor of electricity adjustment, this paper analyzed the primary energy factor of electricity of the end user in Taiwan from 1982 to 2009 first. Then the compositions of the primary energy use and emissions in Taiwan housing sector were analyzed. The share of electricity use in total energy use of the housing sector was 64.2% at 2009 before primary energy factor of electricity adjustment. By using primary energy factor of the electricity demand of the year as adjustment, the share of the primary energy use of the electricity increased as 84.4%. Results of the research also showed that the annual log growth rate of the primary energy use induced by electricity use was 6.45% in Taiwan housing sector from 1982 to 2009. The total primary energy use of the housing sector in 2009 was about 5.7 times of which in 1982. Respect to emission factor of the housing sector, the research showed that the annual log growth rate of GHG Emissions of the housing sector was 7.81% from 1982 to 2009. The total GHG Emissions of the housing sector in 2009 was about 8.25 times of which in 1982. The shares of emissions from electricity in housing sector were 59.6% in 1982, and 86.6% in 2009. These results showed that the use of electricity was one of the major sources of the housing emissions growth this period.

articleTitle: A scheme of embedded video surveillance system software architecture design
abstract: This article describes the embedded video Surveillance system software architecture. Five-layer structure is used and strategy pattern is introduced in order to reduce the complexity of the module, so that it can support a variety of algorithms to meet requires of embedded system developers and have maintainability, scalability, reusability.

articleTitle: Mobile audio coding using lattice vector quantization based on Gaussian mixture model
abstract: In the paper, we describe a new lattice vector quantization algorithm based on Gaussian mixture model applied in mobile audio coding. In the algorithm, we uses Gaussian mixture model to classify the immittance spectral frequency parameters of the input signal to the divided M different Gaussian component according to probability density of different lattice vectors. And then for each Gaussian component, we will design a lattice vector to quantize the corresponding signal. Also, we adopt an optimal bit allocation algorithm based on the rate-distortion theory of the input signal. We demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithm in the application of speech spectrum quantization in mobile audio coding. Experiments on encoding multiple audio test sequences show that the quantitative method that we present provides rather good performance and less storage space with moderate increase in computation complexity when compared with conventional quantization scheme used in AMR-WB+ audio codec.

articleTitle: A subtree searching method with pruning for computing minimal m-Bézout number
abstract: It is a basic problem for homotopy continuation to minimize multi-homogeneous Bezout number of polynomial systems with multi-homogeneous structure. For a given polynomial system, different way of partitioning the variables produces different multi-homogeneous Bezout number. All possible variable partitions are regarded as a tree structure. We search in a subtree to find the optimal variable partition whose multi-homogeneous Bezout number is the smallest one. A pruned subtree searching method is proposed for saving the computational cost. Numerical tests with randomly generated examples show that these two methods are efficient.

articleTitle: The effects of advanced information feedback strategies in FI model
abstract: Advanced Traveler Information System provides travelers with real-time transportation information, which can satisfy the dynamic requirements of travelers and increase the ability of transportation infrastructure. Many information feedback strategies are proposed based on the real-time information of roads and vehicles. There are some typical information feedback strategies: Travel Time Feedback Strategy (TTFS), Mean Velocity Feedback Strategy (MVFS), and Congestion Coefficient Feedback Strategy (CCFS). However, all the above information strategies are used in NS model. The effects of the above information feedback strategies in other models have not been studied. The effects of the above information feedback strategies in FI model are validated in this paper. Results show that the above strategies are applicable to FI model.

articleTitle: Analysis of design method shear strength of RC short corbels
abstract: It deals with the factors of influence on shear strength of RC short corbels as well as the mode of failure. The analysis of design and comparison is carried through an example using Code for design of concrete structures (GB50010-2002), Building code requirements for structural concrete (ACI318-05) and simplified softened truss model. It aims to be the base of RC short corbels carrying capacity performance and design calculation.

articleTitle: Adsorption of transition metal ions on metal surfaces with the formation of submonolayer ferromagnetic films
abstract: The influence of the temperature and ferromagnetic ordering on the adsorption of Fe, Co, and Ni transition metal ions on a copper nonmagnetic substrate with the formation of a submonolayer film is described in terms of the spin-density functional theory.

articleTitle: Optimized digital library for digital forenisc based on Decomposed PRNU
abstract: Nowadays, the digital forensic techniques for digital images are developed with the origin identification and integrity verification functions for security reasons. Methods based on photo-response-non-uniform (PRNU) are widely studied and proved to be effective to serve the forensic purposes. However, due to the interpolation noise, caused by the colour filtering and interpolation function the accuracy of the PRNU-based forensic method has been degraded. Meanwhile, the tremendous physical storage requirement and computation consumption limit the applications of PRNU-based method. Therefore, an innovative DPRNU-based forensic method has been proposed in order to solve the above problems. In the method, the artificial component and physical component are separated according to the colour filtering array (CFA) and the PRNU are only extracted from the physical component in order to remove the interference caused by the interpolation noise, which increases the accuracy of the camera identification and integrity verification. Meanwhile, due to the separation, the DPRNU are only 1/3 of the size of the traditional PRNU, which saves considerable physical storage in setting up the digital library and fasters the comparison speed between the fingerprints.

articleTitle: Application of the composite foundation with capped piles in an industry workshop
abstract: Based on practical project and aim at overcoming the defects of the traditional cement mixing pile method on treating deep soft ground, composite foundation with capped piles was first introduced in an industry workshop. The design method of composite foundation with capped piles was present in this paper. Equal settlement surface appears owing to the soil-arching effect in the composite foundation. And load can be passed into the deeper layer by rigid piles. Thus, the total settlement and difference settlement can be controlled.

articleTitle: A minimum spanning tree algorithm based on binary coding
abstract: We can only get a minimum spanning tree from all the spanning trees with the current minimum spanning tree algorithm, So we hope to present a new algorithm to improve it. The new algorithm is mainly use the binary code and the characteristics of the minimum spanning tree to get all the minimum spanning trees. At first, It eliminates some of the non-panning trees according to the number of the graph edges. What is more, It eliminates some of the non-spanning trees according to the judgement of the graph connectivity. In fact, the nature of the algorithm is to look for the best in the global scope. At last, we can find all the minimum spanning trees of the connected graph in view of the algorithm. An example shows that the algorithm has clear steps, convenient program implementation and general good characteristic.

articleTitle: Sonic wave testing technique for surrounding rock loose circle
abstract: This paper introduces the theory and methods of sonic wave testing technique used in measuring the surrounding rock loose circle. And this testing method by acoustic in single hole was used in the Chang Gou-yu coal mine, from the velocity curve with changing depth of hole the thickness of the surrounding rock loose circle was obtained. Based on the loose circle theory, the support parameters of the roadway could be provided by the thickness. Therefore, the sonic wave testing technique is fast and accurate in testing the loose circle, also it has good practicability and extensive application prospect.

articleTitle: A modified HS conjugate gradient method
abstract: In this paper, we propose a modified HS conjugate gradient method which possesses the following properties (l)the sufficient descent property holds without any line searches; (2)this method inherits an important property of Hestenses- Stiefel(HS) method;(3)under some assumable conditions the method is globally convergent.Preliminary numerical results show that this method is very efficient.

articleTitle: Based on the thermal environment dynamic index, study on the livable environment of the high-rise architectural complex in Changsha City
abstract: It is an urgent problem of Chinese city in the process of urbanization how to upgrade the quality of more scientific and feasible urban construction, enrich urban landscape effect, create a good and harmonious city livable environment, and make the most of scarce urban land resources, unleash the largest functional efficiency of urban land, and promote science building of a more healthy and orderly city. In this paper, we study mainly on a high-rise architectural complex in Changsha city and regard it as the urban residential ecological unit.Through testing local environment of high-rise architectural complex from different regions, function and surrounded degree, we collect environmental experiment data to make environmental impact assessment. Then we summarize interrelated contents such as environmental impact of various small regional model and different surrounded degree ,the regional city wind formation. Through correlation analysis on environmental capacity and urban volume fraction of ecological unit,we point out the effect of regional environment in the present stage of building high-rise architectural complex. It can provide support for high-rise architectural complex's planning strategy in future to be beneficial to the integration of urban space in order to create city livable environment in the space of high-rise architectural complex.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis of X-ray fluorescence without standard reference samples
abstract: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) is a non-destructive technique for elemental analysis. But the accuracy of the quantitative analysis of XRF is not as good as other techniques due to the matrix effects. In this paper, we proposed a new method by making the bulk samples into thin films with proper thickness to reduce the matrix effect, and taking into account of bremsstrahlung radiation as part of the incident X-ray intensity.

articleTitle: The characteristic analysis of bridge made in water quenching slag in Shanghai
abstract: Through testing and analysis of a water quenching slag-bridge in shanghai, the characteristics and incentives of bridge- diseases are concluded and revealed in order to provide advices and directions for Daily maintenance and inspection

articleTitle: Model research on energy reduction for lute instrument “flipping” method
abstract: Having adopted experiment analysis means for Lute instrument 'flipping' method, this paper has complied lute acoustic analysis procedures by MATLAB for extracting 26 'flipping' parameters such as duration, energy, spectrum, etc. It gained that: 1) with the reduction on pitch, the duration of sound becomes successively longer and the energy reducing speed is lower; 2) it has also proposed four energy reducing models including sawtooth model, bridge arch model, curve model and linearity model according to chord vibration theory. All these experimental parameter analysis not only provides new research methods for musical instrument acoustics, but also do much help with more objective theory and standard for instrument design and manufacture.

articleTitle: The optimal fusion method study of multi-source information of the track parameters
abstract: This article presents a new optimal syncretic method of the multi-sourced information track-parameters processing. Including the fusion processing method of the double-sourced information and the multi-sourced-information. when multi metrical information exist in the same instant, this algorithm can reject its outliers and eliminate the suspicious errors in the accounting of the track by the multi-source measuring information order with this designed algorithm.Simulation result show this algorithm has good effects in the realtime processing of the track parameters.

articleTitle: A no-reference objective image sharpness metric based on a filter bank of Gaussian derivative wavelets
abstract: The quality of an image depends on various attributes such as sharpness (or blurriness), naturalness, colorfulness, and contrast, etc. To develop a so-called no-reference objective image quality metric by incorporating all attributes of images without referring to the original ones is a difficult task. Hence, the purpose of this paper focuses on the development of a no-reference objective image sharpness metric. A high-frequency component preserving the full information of a given input image is extracted first and then applied to a multi-channel filter bank. The proposed method measures image sharpness based on the output of this filter bank. A snug frame composed of the Gaussian derivative wavelets is applied to construct the filter bank. The output of the filter bank not only contains the complete information of the input but also manifests prominent image features. Experimental results show that the metric predicts well in isotropic and uniform blur case. Validated by the high correlation between the metric values and the subjective test scores, the performance of the proposed metric is comparable to that of human subjects.

articleTitle: Greenways planning and design in the sustainable living environment context
abstract: Firstly, the article systematically summarizes the unprecedented problems and challenges which greenways is facing at home and abroad. Then, taking the greenways planning and design in Yi Country for example, the aims of this article are to integrate and coordinate the ecology, recreation, landscape, culture and heritage of each subsystem, to form greenways with harmonious environment, and to propose planning strategies and design methods of greenways in the sustainable living environment context. Finally it is to offer references to gradually establish and improve the theories and methods of greenways planning and design.

articleTitle: Building the branding and attractive small town based on the CI theory—Take the longmen ancient town for example
abstract: The feasibility of importing the CI theory into the attractive small town was discussed. The ancient Longmen town was selected as the study object to design some specific importing program based on the field work and questionnaires, and extend the new carriers for the application of the CI theory, and support the building of attractive small town with the theory and practice, which made the planning and the construction of the small town more systematic and branding.

articleTitle: HTTP streaming over an improved TCP congestion control algorithm
abstract: HTTP Streaming is a prevalent multimedia streaming service over TCP/HTTP. Its quality is mainly determined by the efficiency of TCP. In this paper, we propose an improved TCP congestion control algorithm named TCP-MW for HTTP Streaming in wireless environments with high packet loss rate. Our experiment results show a significant performance improvement and a good fairness feature for TCP-MW.

articleTitle: The influence of reclamation on the vertical distribution of soil organic carbon content in Calamagrostis angustifolia wetland
abstract: To investigate how reclamation impacts the vertical distribution of SOC (soil organic carbon) content in soil profile of C. angustifolia wetland, 90 soil samples were sampled in 10 cm interval (0–100 cm depth) in C. angustifolia wetland, soybean and paddy field. The soybean and paddy field were reclaimed from C. angustifolia wetland. All these three sites have meadow albic soil. The results showed that wetland reclamation reduced the SOC content at all 10 soil layers within 100 cm depth soil profile. Difference in SOC contents between wetland and farmland was significant at 0–30 cm and 60–100 cm soil layers, but not significant at 30–60 cm soil layers. Compared with soybean field, the SOC content in upper 20 cm soil layers was more homogeneous in paddy field. Though wetland reclamation reduced the SOC content, it hasn't changed the regularity of SOC vertical distribution. The changes of SOC content with soil depth in C. angustifolia wetland, soybean and paddy field all can be described by specific exponential function. Which are useful to estimate and predict the regional SOC pool by models.

articleTitle: Problems in the emergency logistics information system (ELIS) in Guangzhou and the solutions
abstract: The construction of the emergency logistics information system (ELIS) is of great significance to the support capability of the logistics system as a whole, the paper selects ELIS in Guangzhou as the study objective, describes ELIS in Guangzhou, analyzes the problems and reasons existed in the system, and finally proposes to increase funds for construction, accelerate training of professionals and other specific measures.

articleTitle: Adaptive call admissions for multimedia services in DS-CDMA cellular systems
abstract: Link capacity is defined as the number of channels available in a link. In DS-CDMA cellular systems, this is limited by the interference present in the link. The interference is affected by many environmental factors and thus the link capacity of the systems changes with the environment. In addition, since various traffic types mutually interfere with different amount, their different power levels affect the link capacity. Actual capacity of the systems must be evaluated accurately and call admission control (CAC) needs to be adapted to the actual capacity which varies with the environment. Since the capacity of CDMA system is limited by the reverse link, we are concerned with the reverse link and analyze the actual link capacity for multimedia services under varying environments. The analysis results yield a CAC adaptive to dynamically varying environment for multimedia services and thus improve CDMA capacity significantly.

articleTitle: Study on stability of jointed rock slope of open pit
abstract: The existence of fissures can reduce the stability of open pit slope. Meanwhile, the disturbing force that is generated by large equipment and blasting also has significant influence on the stability of the slope. In view of this, to study the deformation law of open pit slope under the action of disturbing force of fractured rock mass, this paper focus on the influence of various fracture angle, trace and joint spacing on the deformation law and safety factor of the open pit slope by means of physical mechanical experiment and discrete element calculation analysis. The research results reveal that different fracture distribution form can result to different deformation and failure character, moreover, the variation of safety coefficient is also greater difference. Furthermore, it can be obtained that the further development tendency and transfixion law of the slope rock mass under the action of external force, which can provide evidence for the further research on the slope stability parameter selection of fractured rock mass in open pit.

articleTitle: Research on the urban population capacity in rapid urbanization area A case study of Dongguan
abstract: Population capacity is a strategic issues regarding ahieving urban sustainable development. Based on Grey System Theory and supply & demand balance model of work force, this paper put forward a calculated capacity of the economic population in each town of Dongguan from 2001 to 2007. An estimated capacity of future economic compacity of each town in Dongguan is also presented based on a compararison with actual population campacity. It shows that: the job number status is the decisive factor of the work force and population migration in Dongguan, as the capacity of economic population is depending on work force demand; In 2001, most towns in Dongguan was expericing economic population capacity suppression compared with actual population, while in 2007, the economic population capacity is 1,610,000 less than actual population capacity; the estimation of economic population capacity of Dongguan has pointed out that it has room to increase in the future.

articleTitle: Research of Characteristic and application on non-linear editing teaching networks in colleges
abstract: Nonlinear editing teaching networks in colleges and universities developed a new type of teaching network of film and television program production in recent years. It comes from television post-production network,but the application object and purpose is different, it is full of twists and circuitous development, its status quo does not meet the needs of specialty media in colleges and universities, and future of diversity. This paper analyzes characteristics of the existing non-linear editing teaching network, problems, Clear the current demand for video editing teaching experiment. Based on the actual situation, and proposed a new type of non-linear editing Teaching Network for teaching.

Author Keywords: nonlinear editing teaching networks (NLETN) instructional design of experiment television editing

articleTitle: Application of mobile multimedia in the communication of public emergency
abstract: The communication means of emergent public crisis, which is based on fixed networks of the first generation formed by broadcast, papers, public display and other mass media, has being transmitted to mobile multimedia networks of the second generation via 3G mobiles, notebook computers and other mobile multimedia. Mobile multimedia plays a special role in the spread of public emergency: relieving the pressure of paroxysmal public crisis communications and timely transmitting accurate information; conducting social mobilization and integration effectively; dissolving the risk according to the process of public emergency, etc. Therefore, it is necessary to construct the decision-making system of mobile multimedia information for emergency control, thus improving the level of crisis management.

articleTitle: City Hinterland and application of urban breaking point
abstract: A Hinterland offer varies supporting resource for the economic activities of focus town. Its size and qualities will work heavily on the development of a city. The city supplies high grade products and servings for its hinterland, and the hinterland acts as agora region and receive cities colligate radiation. Using the theory of space interaction and the method of breaking point and experience analysis and the way of characteristic radii of city, this paper fixed the regional limits of Mianyang City Hinterland. Describes the coherence and otherness between urban attracted and administrate region. Give theoretical basis for the total and especially economic development of Mianyang and its hinterland.

articleTitle: GARCH family model and its application in calculating stock index future VaR in Chinese market
abstract: With heteroskedasticity, HS300 index future goes with GARCH family models thus predicting the VaR. Result shows that the E GARCH and TARCH model can describe its heteroskedasticity and leverage and shows that the model under t-distribution and GED can predict the risk effectively.

articleTitle: Multi-agent modeling of city emergency evacuation
abstract: This paper studies the method and process of multi-agent modeling of city emergency evacuation, and we conduct the simulation experiment based on the multi-agent city emergency evacuation framework. The experiment is based on spatial network distribution, and studies the pattern of how to choose shelter and evacuation path when people are in the disaster area. The prototype system builds the city road network model. And based on Repast S, we establish agent-based model on the refugee, human and disaster source. Furthermore, we make use of this prototype to study the impact on the evacuation result made by the traffic capacity, human's ability of information access and recognizing the disaster area.

articleTitle: Adaptive disparity vector based LSM Color correction for multiview video coding
abstract: Because of the color data from different views may differ greatly between various views in multiview video coding(MVC), Color correction is used to improve the MVC coding efficiency. This paper proposes a foreground based disparity vector estimation algorithm. Using with LSM color correction method, the proposed algorithm can improve the reliability and efficiency of color correction of MVC. Compared with the LSM color correction, the proposed algorithm gets 0.3 0.8dB for luminance PSNR gain and 0.4-1.ldB for chroma for multiview video coding.

articleTitle: Shadowing filter applicated in nonlinear target tracking system
abstract: Strictly speaking, all the systems which are used in the field of target tracking are nonlinear and non-Gaussian. The shadowing filter algorithm and its realization methods which include gradient descent of indeterminism and Iterative gradient descent of indeterminism are discussed in this paper. And compare with EKF at tracking precision, the simulation shows that the performance of shadowing filter is superior to that of EKF.

articleTitle: Study of circuit reaction and servo loop based on the passive atomic frequency standard
abstract: The error signal of physics system is sent to VCXO by the servo loop in the passive atomic frequency standard. The working parameters of electron circuit and the characters of atomic time affect the whole efficiency. The better measurement results based on the setting of the corresponding parameters such as servo time and phase shift of the modulation signal are given.

articleTitle: Stochastic resonance in a linear system induced by multiplicative asymmetric trichotomous noise
abstract: The phenomenon of stochastic resonance (SR) in a linear system with an external periodic signal derived by a multiplicative asymmetric trichotomous noise is investigated. The exact expression of the first moment has been derived by the Shapiro-Loginov formula. The non-monotonic dependence of the output amplitude of the periodic response on the asymmetric trichotomous noise parameter is presented such as the noise strength and the asymmetry degree, and the stochastic resonance phenomena are analyzed. It is found that the multiplicative asymmetric trichotomous noise can induce the SR in a linear system under some conditions in a broad sense.

articleTitle: Simultaneous and non-simultaneous quenching phenomena in heat conduction model
abstract: In this work, we consider the simultaneous and non-simultaneous quenching phenomena in the heat conduction model. We characterize completely the range of parameters for which non-simultaneous and simultaneous quenching occur.

articleTitle: Review of evaluation of the influence of Website
abstract: This paper first describes Common methods in evaluating the influence of the Website, Questionnaire Survey, Indexed search engine, Link analysis, User traffic statistics, Social evaluation, Economic evaluation and so on. Then, two evaluation and the current two commonly used link analysis tools are showed. Finally, the paper indicates defects and improved methods of evaluation of two commonly used evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Soil erosion dynamics of Sanjiang Plain in past 50 years
abstract: During the past 50 years, Sanjiang Plain, which is one of the most important areas for commercial production of China, has experienced soil loss due to improper land use .For this study land use maps for 1954 1976 1986 and 2000 were obtained based on Landsat satellite image and historical topographic map along with expert knowledge. DEM data, soil maps and rainfall data were also obtained. Using GIS and USLE, we selected appropriate methods to calculate each factor in the USLE and evaluated the soil erosion of the Sanjiang plain over the past 50 years .Results showed that light erosion dominated the Sanjiang plain and acute soil erosion was almost nonexistent .The area affected by soil erosion has increased over the past 50 years, with eroded area in 2000 was 1 .4 times of the area in 1954.The intensity of soil erosion has increased especially high-intensity erosion level for which the ratio of soil erosion increased more than that of low-intensity erosion. Muling basin had the largest eroded area and Naolihe basin had the largest increment of erosion area. This study provides a scientific basis for erosion control in the Sanjiang plain and provides reasonable suggestions for management and decision-making in terms of agricultural and development policies.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field simulation of permanent magnet synchronous motor
abstract: Based on the fundamental principle of traditional magnetic circuit design, the simulation model of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) of canned pump is established by the ANSYS software. The load magnetic field of the motor is calculated. The magnetic field distribution of the motor is obtained. The performance of the maximum torque output under different number of magnetic pole pairs, the permanent magnets in different sizes and different rotor core thickness is analyzed in detail. The results of simulation provide theoretical foundation for the optimization design of this kind of motor.

articleTitle: Application of principal component analysis and cluster analysis to evaluation of black soil degradation in Jilin
abstract: The black soil region in Jilin Province is one of the main commodity grain production base in China, but its soil has began to appear degradation and destruction on different degree. With the aim to study the degradation mechanism of black soil for protecting the geo-environment, we conducted the field investigation and chose twenty-nine items, carrying out principal component analysis on twenty samples of different areas and depths in Jilin Province. Principal component analysis is used to reduce the dimension of the evaluation factor. Twenty-nine factors were classified into seven uncorrelated principal components, which reduced the complexity in analysis process. And it adopted cluster analysis method to make sorts of twenty samples into three black soil degradation grades. The result preferably coincided with practical situation of the degradation of black soil in Jilin. Some effective suggestions were proposed according to the result of soil degradation.

articleTitle: Images segmentation of feeding or discharging in jaw crusher based on network edition software ImageJ
abstract: This paper presents an image segmentation method for feeding or discharging in a jaw crusher based on network edition software ImageJ. The images of crushing material to be broken in a jaw crusher are captured by the CCD camera. Analysis and calculation of boundaries and image segmentation of those images are implemented in the ImageJ based on its some image precessing functions. The results show that this method can detect profiles of particles of feeding or discharging materials images.

articleTitle: The VIV detection based on Poincare surface of sections
abstract: By Poincare surface of sections, dynamical features of manifold in two, three or high dimensions can be investigated. Characteristics of Poincare sections for all kinds of manifold can be obtained qualitatively, which is used to study system with high dimensions by reducing dimension. In present work, a method of quick detection on occurrence of vortex-induced vibrations (VIV) of cylindrical structure is developed from measured time history of one variable by using Poincare surface of section. Experimental results have shown that such method is quick and reliable as a new means of engineering detection on VIV of cylindrical structure.

articleTitle: A KNN-based Chinese generating method on static image description
abstract: In this research we present a novel cognition language model ViMac. Through the vision system ViMac can acquire the semantic of the objects shown in 2D images and output its own description for the new images. ViMac uses prototypes as its semantic representation and use KNN method to measure the similarity between these data points in visual subspaces. The BLEU evaluation shows that this method can generate good performance on new image description.

articleTitle: Charge-induced ferromagnetism in two-carbon cluster silicon
abstract: This paper presents the first-principles study of two carbon clusters in silicon matrix with 64-atom supercell. The band structure and net spin density of states indicate that the system with neutral charge is non-magnetic, but ferromagnetic as the system is charging with one electron or one hole. This phenomenon can be applied to design and fabricate Si-base spintronic MOS, non-volatile magnetic memory and other Si base spintronic devices where the field-controllable ferromagnetism is important.

articleTitle: Route choice decision-marking analysis based on congestion charging
abstract: The congestion charging would become the important factor of travelers' route choice when cities carry out the congestion charging. This article concerns the problem of route optimization choice based on congestion charging of the route. According to that, use variable weigh analytic hierarchy process (VWAHP) to analyze the route choice decision-marking. Results show that the approach of analysis could not only benefit using reasonable charging measure, but also guide travelers' travel.

articleTitle: Charactering fiber-based source of heralded single photons
abstract: Based on the photon pairs generated from an optical fiber by a pulsed pump, we study the second-order coherence function, heralding efficiency, and temporal indistinguishability of the heralded single photons as functions of source parameters.

articleTitle: The model of troops deployed for the counter-terrorism based on the density of uncertain conditions
abstract: The strategy of troops deployed for the modern counter-terrorism encounters various problems. Such as the complicate environment, the uncertain information and lots of relative factors. In this paper, the uncertain number and the strategic guidance of troops deployed for the counter-terrorism is studied by the uncertain mathematic method. The condition density and the density type mathematics expectation is defined, the condition density matrix of troops deployed for single target is obtained and optimized. Furthermore the condition density matrix for multi target is calculated by the mathematics expectation of maximum value density type. This model overcomes the limitations of the traditional known method and provides a more practical Theoretical basis for the decision maker.

articleTitle: Research on the application of distributed virtual environment based on Cloud Computing
abstract: This paper offered an idea about the experience of roles in movie and discussed the methods by building models and structures under distributed virtual environment and utilizing the technology of Cloud Computing. It may have some reference value for future development.

Author Keywords: the experience of role in movie

articleTitle: Establishing and verifying on physical graph in the process of bottom tearing scour of Yellow River
abstract: The Yellow River "River Bed Blowing up" phenomenon is a special phenomenon that river sediment stirred up in bulk under the function of hyper concentration floods. It is a complex dynamic process. In this paper, based on the investigation and analysis of the large number of prototype, according to the theoretical analysis and repeated experiments, the author successfully simulated the whole process of the phenomenon in the room, and set up a clear and correct physical graphics of it. All of which laid a solid foundation for people to deeply research into the hydrodynamic conditions and the formation mechanism that caused the phenomenon.

articleTitle: Study on the absolute stress level in 2003 Dayao earthquake source region
abstract: The Ms6.2 Yunnan Dayao earthquake occurred on July 21, 2003, followed by a major Ms6.1 earthquake about 88 days later in the same region. The hypocenters are almost coincidence in the same place. Using the P wave first motion polarities of the two aftershocks sequences recorded by temporary stations and the improved version of grid points test method by Yu et al, we study the stress field in the aftershocks zone and get the two stress field directions in Dayao region. Using the stress value calculation method by Wan, we get the underground stress value in the focal area. The results show that the pre-seismic shear stress is larger than that of the post-seismic, and their difference corresponds to the stress drop approximately. The underground compressive stress is very large, but the differential stress is small. Before the main shock occurred on October 16th, the maximum principal stress is 166.27 MPa, intermediate principal stress is 158.7 IMPa and the minimum principal stress is 150.97 MPa. The normal stress and shear stress projected on fault plane are 157.25 MPa, 7.40 MPa respectively before the main shock occurred on October 16th The normal and shear stress projected on fault plane are 158.81 MPa, 0.15 MPa respectively after the main shock occurred on October 16th.

articleTitle: Study of modern industria product optimization design based on image
abstract: To design the acceptable products that meet consumer emotional demands is very important, and a novel method is proposed combining neural network with genetic algorithm(GA). In this paper, a back propagation neural network(BPNN) is applied to map the relationships between product design elements and customer kansei image evaluation. And then, GA is employed to search for the optimal product form which satisfies customer requirement by using the trained neural network. In the end, the framework of product image form optimization design system using Virtual Reality Modeling Language(VRML) is analyzed. To test the method, an example of kettle design is used to study, the results show that this method is valid and feasible.

articleTitle: Water resources carrying capacity analysis in Strategic Environmental Assessment
abstract: Water resources is the essential and basic natural resources for human living, it is one of the most important factors for restricting natural environment, human survival and development. China is facing serious water pollution and water shortages. In this paper, based on "Environmental Impact Assessment Law of the PRC", evaluation and analysis methods in planning project on Strategic Environmental Assessment of water resources carrying capacity were explored. It had great significance on implementing the Environmental Impact Assessment Law, solving water resources and water environment problems faced by China, and achieving sustainable use of water resources.

articleTitle: Building students' models based on an enhanced concept-effect relationship in intelligent tutoring systems
abstract: The algorithm of an enhanced concept effect relationship is applied into the assessment of chemistry learning (the topic is focus on Redox). The research results indicate that the cognitive level of students' Redox learning can be analyzed effectively and the misconceptions and lacuna in the students' cognitive structure can be measured accurately. Some suggestions of different learning paths are put forward to improve learning effect. Enhanced concept effect relationship is proved to be a good theory to construct students' model in the chemistry intelligent tutor system.

articleTitle: Comparison among three kinds of advanced water purifying processes: Prepositioned, medially positioned and post positioned biological treatment
abstract: On account of subtropical micro-polluted raw water, adopting biological treatment technology in water purification process is suitable. Through engineering projects and experiments comparison, this paper analyzes the characteristics and applicable conditions of three kinds of water advanced purification process: prepositioned, medially positioned and post positioned biological water treatment. Prepositioned biological treatment process purifies raw water directly, the preoxidation result was apparent, the rate of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-N nitrification was high, with the aid of bio-enhanced action in coagulation- sedimentation unit, total organic matter removal rate can reach the level of advanced treatment. But biological treatment unit has to stand adverse impact by high turbidity, sediment impurities, shellfish and algae in raw water, which increases its running maintenance cost. Medially positioned biological treatment unit is located between sedimentation tank and sand-filter, the vast majority of turbidity in raw water is removed through coagulating sedimentation, and with sand-filter behind, technology of high-efficiency biochemistry and absorption can be used to increase the rate of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-N nitrification and organic matter biodegradability. Post positioned biological treatment process is aimed at residual light pollution in effluent of conventional process, the purification efficiency is high, but the problem of tiny creatures leak is evident, so it needs to be connected with ultrafiltration membrane.

articleTitle: Bayesian estimation of two value distribution parameter under a weighted balanced loss function
abstract: In the paper through comparing all sorts of distributed parameter estimation In different papers. This paper considers a new loss function from goodness of fit. This paper mainly discussed the Bayesian estimation of Pareto distribution parameter and Pascal distribution parameter, and had proven that this estimation was admissible with given q(θ).

articleTitle: An environmentally sound new method for groundwater lowering
abstract: Here we propose a novel method for groundwater lowering which can be applied at construction sites, for aquifer remediation measures or in open mining. In contrast to current and traditional techniques dewatering is achieved without water conveyance. Environmental problems above the ground surface with pumped water can be avoided. We introduce the concept and field experiments, before presenting modeling work.

articleTitle: Velocity momentums transformation considering flume slope for 2D LDV measurement
abstract: In the flume experiment, the directions of measured velocity by 2D LDV (Laser Doppler Velocimetery) usually are not the streamwise and vertical direction of the flume respectively. And thus the measured velocity momentums are not along the streamwise and vertical direction of the flow. In this paper, the velocity momentums transfer considering flume slope with 2D LDV measurement is studied. Based on the defintions of velocity momentums, the transformation formulae are deduced. The application of the transformation formulae in uniform flow with rough bed shows that the slope can not be ignored.

articleTitle: Changing photospheric vector magnetic fields associated with a B4.2-class solar flare
abstract: Recent observations have provided evidence that the solar photospheric magnetic fields could have rapid and permanent changes in both longitudinal and transverse components associated with large (X- or M-class) solar flares. However, little work on small ones has been reported on this field. In this paper we find the observational evidence of changing photospheric vector magnetic fields associated with a B4.2-class flare obtained with the Solar Magnetic Field Telescope (SMFT) installed at Huairou Solar Observing Station (HSOS) of Nation Astronomical Observatories of Chinese Academy of Sciences.

articleTitle: The study of Korean new rural residential construction in “Changchun-Jilin-Tumen” district
abstract: as the important content during “the twelfth five-year plan”, the new rural residential construction is the factor of improving the farmers' living conditions. Meanwhile “Changchun-Jilin-Tumen” district is opening pilot area the of the Tumen river. In this district, Korean traditional local-style dwelling building is the largest, in the process of socialistic new rural construction planning, we should be oriented to the history fully understand the value of history and culture of traditional local-style dwelling building with the attitude of being responsible for history and future. We should insist on the principle of combining conservation and utilization, respecting the local traditional architectural styles and living habits, inheriting the distinctive local architectural form and regional culture, and according to the concept of sustainable development and economic carrying capacity in order to improve the new rural residential construction. Besides, we should design creatively based on regional traditional culture and architectural features, thus, achieving sustainable development. Of the new rural construction

Author Keywords: the value of history and culture

articleTitle: Human segmentation based on Bayesian model
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is proposed for human segmentation in the presence of occlusion or shadows. We utilize human body shape model to interpret the foreground in a Bayesian framework. In order to reduce process time, we use head-torso model instead of full-body human shape models in the solution space of Bayesian model. We obtain MAP (Maximum a posteriori) by using MCMC (Markov chain Monte Carlo). The choice of proposal density also can avoid miss-detections caused by mistaking small targets as image noises. In our method, we firstly detect head candidates; then, we construct Bayesian model and calculate MAP of it; finally, we select optimum human models for the candidates and segment human objects precisely. In a number of human segmentation experiments, our method not only achieves good performance in occlusion situations, but also is resistant to background noises.

articleTitle: On the representation dimension of triangular matrix algebras
abstract: We mainly discuss the representation dimension of the 2×2 triangular matrix algebra over an artin algebra. Let Λ be an artin algebra, and let T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(Λ) be the 2×2 triangular matrix algebra over Λ. We will show that the representation dimension of T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(Λ) is upper bounded by the maximum of the representation dimension of Λ plus 1 and the global dimension of Λ plus 2. In particular, we will show that if Λ is a hereditary algebra or a tilted algebra, then the representation dimension of T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(Λ) is at most 4.

articleTitle: Research on the division of Marketing Grid
abstract: Referencing the idea of collaboration and share of Grid, aiming at limitations that customer orientation is rough and marketing has no relevance in traditional marketing model, this paper put forward the concept of Marketing Grid. Based on the analysis of Marketing Grid intension deeply analyze the basis of meshing, summarized four division methods of Marketing Grid, and discussed the measures that enterprise should take to different grid with different division dimensions.

articleTitle: The safety study of bolt and cable support in shallow roadway
abstract: At present, bolt-cable combined support system is still common in shallow roadway, and the design process of bolt cable combined support system include four steps: initial design, implement design, pressure observation and modification of initial design. For modification of initial design, the rationality of support can be obtained from pressure observation that gives the prediction of deformation in roadway. However, as for whether the end of bolt and cable in surrounding rock have separated or damaged and whether the bolt and cable in surrounding rock have lost further effectiveness, it cannot help. So, evaluating the bolt-cable combined support system with new detect method has important value. This paper detects roof strata damage and working resistance of bolt (cable) in 20306 Lane Belt with Rock drilling Camera, Multi Displacement Meter and Bolt (Cable) dynamometer, analyses the development of damage (separation) in roof, and evaluates the safety of bolt or cable support system. The result shows: with the method of Rock drilling Camera, the detection of damage in surrounding rock is intuitive and true; in mining process, the number of separate zones in surrounding rock around peak pressure zones increased obviously, and cause failure of bolt and cable in this area.

articleTitle: The Multilevel Fast Multipole Method and its application
abstract: The MLFMM (Multilevel Fast Multipole Method) is an alternative formulation of the technology behind the MoM (Method of Moment) and is applicable to much larger structures than the MoM, making full-wave current-based solutions of electrically large structures a possibility. This fact implies that it can be applied to most large models that were previously treated with the MoM without having to change the mesh. In this paper we discuss the development and implementation of volumetric integral equations for both dielectric and magnetically permeable materials using curvilinear hexahedral elements. Both piecewise constant and higher order basis functions will be examined in the context of volumetric multilevel fast multipole method implementation. Comparisons with corresponding finite element-boundary integral solutions will also be presented and compared in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: The application of compacted cement-soil pile composite foundation in foundation treatment
abstract: Ground treatment is necessary when the engineering geological features of foundation soil can not meet the demand of the engineering construction. Through analyzing and comparing several different ways of ground treatment, and taking into account of project cost, improved effect, engineering geological condition, engineering process, environmental and the other factors, the authors suggest to adopt the method of compacted cement-soil- pile composite foundation. Having designed ground treatment parameter, examined the quality of compacted cement-soil pile, and performed the loading test of single-pole composite foundation, the authors reach the conclusion that the method of ground treatment can increase the ground bearing capacity and solve the problem of foundation distortion.

articleTitle: Architectural from the perspective of oral history
abstract: Nowadays, The study of Architectural history is a hot topic in both the realm of architecture and history, but these results are based on the traditional data collection methods, which are cold and lifeless. As a new, valued, historical research method, oral history can restore the ‘life’ of architecture from the objective feelings and emotional sustenance out of the audiences. By reference to relevant examples from the relationship between the oral history and the Puppet architecture; the meaning of researching by using; the application strategies of oral history using in the Puppet architecture's researches, etc. to show the further application of academic oral history future value and usefulness.

articleTitle: Dynamic tracking precision evaluating system based on DSP and FPGA
abstract: Dynamic Tracking performance is an important technical index for system appraisal. In view of the reality such as the shooting range target detection system facing small target, long distance, complicated background etc, It designs a dynamic tracking precision evaluating system, which detects tracking accuracy and stability degree by means of calculation the target's relative motion and coordinate transformation. Positions the target's cross center rapidly by using image segmentation, object extraction and other image processing algorithms, calculates the center's offset, obtains the device's tracking error by coordinate transformation, and implements algorithms in DSP (Digital Signal Processing) and FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) to ensure the system's light-weight and small-sized. Experimental results show that the system can detect and evaluate the efficiency and precision of dynamic tracking system in complex environment.

articleTitle: The apply of urban design in the detailed planning of residential areas
abstract: As a part of planning, the place and role of urban design is now paid more and more attention to, and will permeate to much wider field. Residence, as the main one of the four functions of the city, is now concerned more. Presently there are many problems in the construction of residential environmental space in china. The applying of urban design will make the planning of residence more reasonable, make it be merged with the city as an integral whole and create more suitable environment for people.

articleTitle: An experimental simulation of rural house under flood wave pressure in South China
abstract: With a physical model of the rural house in South China, an experiment to simulate flood wave pressure on rural houses was conducted in the flume. A series of wave data was acquired from the sensors placed on the upstream wall. By comparing the measured data with the value calculated from the empirical formula in China's “Technical Code for Constructional Engineering in Flood Detention Basin” (GB 50181-93), the study analyzed the causes and the factors of the deviation between them. Based on this, a correction coefficient verified in this paper was developed for application to common houses in rural areas.

articleTitle: Study on urban planning activities of “Hsingking”
abstract: Urban planning of "Hsinking" has been attached great importance in the history of Changchun. The urban planning and construction activities of "Hsinking" has promoted the modernization of urban development to a certain extent, and it also deepened the colonization degree of Changchun. Firstly the paper analyzes the historical background of the urban planning of "Hsinking" and the plan's formulation process. Secondly it discusses the implementation of the urban planning activities of "Hsinking" from several aspects. Finally it makes the appraisement for the urban planning of "Hsinking".

articleTitle: The design and realization of multimedia courseware for University Photography Foundation
abstract: With the development of computer technology and the popularization of computer, the tradition of the using chalk and blackboard and the way of mainly making comments by the teacher seem too stereotyped. It is inability in the mobilization of students' positivity and activity and no longer fits the development of educational need in the present age. MCAI (Multimedia Computer Assisted Instruction), is a teaching software which uses multimedia computer to combine words, pictures, voices, animations, images and so on. It has broken through the linear constraints of conventional media. Information and knowledge can be vividly shown to the learner in a random, flexible, comprehensive and stereoscopic way. It has high knowledge intensity and great expressive force, can stimulate learners' interests effectively, raise students' learning efficiency, and reduce the repeated work of teachers' and achieve a favorable result. This essay introduces the design scheme of using Authorware to make the multimedia courseware for University Photography Foundation and explains the function of the specific modules.

articleTitle: The application of multimedia animation in physics experiment teaching
abstract: Physics experiment course in science and engineering university is an important basic course, because almost all science and engineering students have to learn this course. In our school (Wuhan University of Technology), nearly 5,000 students learn this course each year. Since physics experiment course involves wider knowledge than university physics course, the instruments are also very strange for students to use, it is difficult to reach the ideal teaching effect with traditional teaching methods. The development of the computer multi-media animation technology provides an effective, advanced and economic means and methods for university physics experiment teaching. This paper discusses how to use Flash animation software and LAB VIEW virtual instrument software, according to the experiment teaching purpose, requirement, to develop and design multimedia animation software that is vivid, friendly interface, suitable for network transmission, easy to understand and operate for students. This paper shows several of screenshots of experiment teaching animation software, and analysis the important role of the multimedia animation software that play in university physics experiment teaching of Wuhan University of Technology.

articleTitle: On lattice H design with block size four
abstract: A group divisible t-design (X, G, B) is called a lattice group divisible t-design, if for any block B ∈ B and any column G′<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>, either |B ∩ G′<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>| < t or B ⊆ G′<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>. When t = 3 and block size is four, we denote a lattice group divisible 3-design of type g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> by LH(n, g, 4, 3). The necessary conditions on the existence of an LH(n, g, 4, 3) are n ≥ 4 and n ≡ 2, 4(mod 6). In this paper, we show that the necessary conditions are also sufficient. An LH(n, g, 4, 3) is said to be resolvable, and denoted by RLH(n, g, 4, 3), if its block set can be partitioned into parts, such that each point of the design occurs in exactly one block in each part. We also show that an RLH(n, g, 4, 3) exists if and only if n ≡ 4, 8(mod 12).

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on mixing performance of Vertical Circulative Impinging Stream Reactor with different blade inclinations
abstract: To further discuss the influence in mixing performance of Vertical Circulative Impinging Stream Reactor (referred to VCISR), numerical simulation was carried out by using CFD software about the structure of VCISR with different blade inclinations under different stirring rates. The results of numerical simulation showed that: average velocity on longitudinal profile with the structure that blade inclination was 15° had maximum, it meant the circulative ability was the best in this structure. The shear rate on characteristic impingement surface with structure that blade inclination was 60° had the highest magnitude, which indicated that the shearing motion among different flow micelles was more vigorous in this structure than others. The results also showed that intensity of shearing motion was inverse proportional to the efficiency of energy consumption, and accelerating the stirring rate was benefit to improve the mixing performance of VCISR, but the effect would be weakened as the increasing of stirring rate.

articleTitle: Constraint of discrete Lax equations with some special types of Lax pairs
abstract: In this paper, firstly we deduce the constraint of discrete Lax equations with some special forms of Lax pairs. Then to illustrate the validity of the method, we construct two discrete Lax equations and successfully obtain their constraints by the method. At the same time, infinitely many conservation laws of these two discrete equations are obtained by the discrete residue formula and the first two conserved quantities are given explicitly. It's interesting that we can obtain continuous AKNS hierarchy and KdV hierarchy through the two discrete Lax pairs. Furthermore, the 0-boundary problem for the first discrete equation is considered.

articleTitle: Design of ecological monitoring platform based on aerospace-aviation-ground from the Lake Qinghai basin, Northeast Tibetan Plateau, China
abstract: In order to improve ecological environment monitoring system for Lake Qinghai basin due to heterogeneous monitoring data, multi-department management and difficultly quantitative remote sensing monitoring. Eco-environment information system integrating platform, which mainly divides into the construction of environmentally sensitive parameters of remote sensing inversion and synthetically environmental remote sensing monitoring ground verification, and GIS integrity platform, is designed. According to integrated system data contents and types, metadata is divided into as follows 5 databases: Satellite data, UAV data, ground data, basic geographic information and applying database, based on aerospace aviation ground remote sensing monitoring. GIS integrity platform is based on metadata, relational database management system and client/server system.

articleTitle: The application of blogs in the higher mathematics teaching
abstract: As a new kind of rising, educational and technological means, the blog has been more and more widely used in Chinese education. With the great increase of university enrollment in China, it is difficult for a Chinese higher mathematics teacher to interact with each individual student in higher mathematics classes. This paper deeply researches into the application of blogs in the higher mathematics teaching as a solution to the problem of low interactivity between teachers and students in large-scale higher mathematics classes.

articleTitle: Oscillation for impulsive delay partial differential equations of neutral type
abstract: Oscillation for a class of nonlinear impulsive delay partial differential equations of neutral type is studied, some new oscillations criterion of the equation for given boundary condition are obtained.

articleTitle: Rapid excavation technology by drilling and blasting and it's application in hard rock roadway
abstract: Aiming at some shortcomings of bad cutting effect, low hole utilization and small circulation footage in hard rock excavation, rapid excavation technology by drilling and blasting is proposed to improve the blasting effect for hard rock roadway from depth of blast hole, cutting form, layout of blast holes and smooth blasting. 1) Medium-deep hole is adopted to increase cycle footage; 2) Wedge-shaped cutting is benefit to overcome the rock clips and raise holes utilization in hard rock; 3) Millisecond blasting can greatly prolong action time of detonation gas and decrease maximum stress in boreholes with a rational broken particle size and even lump size; 4) Large diameter bole for the cutting hole and small diameter hole for the contour hole can save the drilling time and ensure the blasting quality. Application results show that the new rapid drilling and blasting technology can greatly increase circulation footage and hole utilization, improve formation quality of roadway and surrounding rock stability, realize average month drill footage at 120 meters and the maximum at 152 meters.

articleTitle: An improved method of denoising shrink-function by NSCT
abstract: The threshold filtering based on multi-resolution is composed of the soft threshold and hard threshold. For the soft shrink-function, the filtered signal is excessively smooth. For the hard shrink-function, the filtered signal associated with the Gibbs phenomenon in the signal mutation after filtering. The contraction function presented in this paper is between soft and hard. Through its coefficients modification, the filtered signal reaches a reasonable balance between excessively smoothness and edge oscillation. Based on the analysis, this paper shows the PSNR comparison values and the image using different filtering methods. The comparative results show that the improved method eliminates the oscillation phenomena and retain some details effectively while removes noise from image.

articleTitle: Images partitioning method based on M-S model with the parameters of adaptive
abstract: The hierarchical Mumford-Shah model can segment the optic cup and disk of optic nerve head images very well get from Color fundus imaging. But, because of Poor illumination and contrast small, the images have many unwanted noise, so, segmentation of images base on The hierarchical Mumford-Shah model need different length parameters. To solve this problem, this paper presents an adaptive model based on the parameter estimation. Vascular occlusion will also make cup and disk of edge Cave and Part. This paper use a method combination of prior knowledge of the constraint method to extract the effective edge curve, then, get the complete edge of optic cup and disk by using curve fitting. This method can effectively solve the above Problem of segmentation of optic cup and disk of optic nerve head images by the experimental results show.

articleTitle: Analytical solution of Faddeev model
abstract: A nonlinear field model—Faddeev model is discussed. By defining the suitable variables, the vector nonlinear partial differential field equation of Faddeev model is reduced to some simple ones. By utilizing the knowledge of differential geometry to solve the field equation, the analytical solutions of the model are obtained.

articleTitle: Lower confidence limits of reliability for series system with Poisson components
abstract: On the condition of the sample data, the paper discusses lower confidence limits of reliability for series with Poisson components. We can make use of the relationship between the cumulative function of the Poisson distribution and the Gamma function, and then give the expressions of reliability in the series system. Based on the sample data, the precise lower confidence limits of reliability for series system is calculated, and then the approximate lower confidence limit of reliability for series system is given. Finally, numerical simulation is carried out to verify the conclusions.

articleTitle: Joint feature points correspondences and color similarity for robust object tracking
abstract: A new visual object tracking algorithm is proposed by using joint feature points correspondences and color similarity of the moving object to solve the background disturbance. This tracking algorithm is based on particle filtering in which a new method of computing each sample weight is proposed. Each sample weight can be obtained through measuring the similarities of color histogram and feature points between the object model and each sample. Comparisons with the conventional particle filtering and a combination between the mean shift tracking and kalman filtering, the experimental results show that this approach is robust to the moving objects tracking.

articleTitle: Discussion the significance of urban planning on the comprehensive disaster prevention system
abstract: Recently, the urban planning staff is lack of awareness of the city's comprehensive disaster prevention system, which resulted in the shortage of anti-disaster planning. This paper advises to make some improvement on theory, practice and planning content. It is hoped that it will be helpful for the promotion of the lagging disaster prevention system of our country.

Author Keywords: the city's comprehensive disaster prevention system

articleTitle: On local reverse signed edge domination in graphs
abstract: In this paper we introduce the concept of local reverse signed edge domination in graphs. For a graph G, the concepts of local reverse signed edge domination function(LRSEDF) and local reverse signed edge domination number(LRSEDN) are gived. At the sime time we obtain three upper bounds of LRSEDN for general graphs G.

Author Keywords: local reverse signed edge domination function
local reverse signed edge domination number

articleTitle: GIS-based assessment on soil erosion sensitivity of Tianshui region
abstract: Soil erosion is a result of comprehensive effect of geographical environment factors. Based on the theory of Universal Soil Loss Equation and utilizing research results of domestic and foreign on soil erosion, this paper analyzed the influences of precipitation, soil texture, slope length and steepness, and land cover on the sensitivity of soil erosion, and assessed the soil erosion sensitivity in accordance with the standard of sensitivity grading and using the methods of mathematics model and GIS analysis. The results show that the overall sensitivity of soil erosion is higher in Tianshui, among which the area of the extremely sensitive and the highly sensitive reaches up to 6559.34km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, counting for 46.05 percentage of total area, while the area of insensitive is smaller, counting for 3.01 percentage of total area. Based on the comprehensively evaluating the spatial difference of soil erosion sensitivity of Tianshui, this paper advanced some countermeasures for land use planning of different sensitivity grades.

articleTitle: Simulation study on the coordinated development of intra-county economic industries
abstract: On the basis of the study on the overall coordinated development model of intra-county economic system, this paper establishes the model of coordinated development of industry and emulates the relationship between the change of investment level and the coordinated development of intra-county economic industries under certain parameters. The emulation result shows that in the process of investment decision making, to choose proper investment level cautiously can facilitate the coordinated development of all the industries. The result also indicates that emulating its dynamic change by the use of MATLAB/ Simulink can display visually the influence on the systematic evolution behavior caused by changing model parameters, which can provide a reference in fixing parameters of the coordinated intra-county development of overall economy and sub industries.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of digital simulation on outdoor wind environments of a middle school
abstract: A middle school in north china carries on reconstruction planning, uses of the Computational Fluid Dynamics method to simulate outdoor natural ventilation environment before and after its rebuilt, compares of simulation results. According to the result of that comparison, suggestions are advanced about human thermal comfort and energy conservation.

articleTitle: New Media design talent cultivation system—The case of Zhejiang Shuren University interactive new media creative experimental class
abstract: The theory and practice of Media design talent cultivation have made effected and attempted by Zhejiang Shuren University, base on Interaction new media experimental class, for capacity-building objective of innovation-based "seven dimensions", implement open teaching organizational activities and management, explore Multiple Talent Cultivation value orientation of media design Talent Cultivation Mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on working mechanism of cushion in composite foundation with rammed soil-cement piles under flexible foundation
abstract: Based on shear displacement method, together with Mylonakis & Gazetas model for interaction between pile and soil, and the layered foundation model, the calculation formulae of the flexible factors for mutual action between pile and pile, pile and soil, soil and soil were obtained. Then, a new method, which considered the influences of cushion have been proposed to analyze the pile-soil-cushion interaction under the embankment, and the correlated program have also been developed by Matlab software. Meantime, combining with the model test results of the composite foundation with the rammed soil-cement piles under the embankment, the influences of the cushion modulus and thickness on the differential settlement between pile and soil were discussed. All of experimental and theoretical results showed that the appropriate soft cushion is beneficial to take full advantage of the pile, and the load sharing of surrounding soil and differentia settlement between pile and surrounding soil may be reduced, and the working properties of composite foundation were improved.

Author Keywords: composite foundation with rammed soil-cement piles
Mylonakis & Gazetas model and E. Winkler foundation model
