Conclusion: Through investigation on the Siraitia grosvenorii living in the karst landform of northern Guangxi, the results aimed to provide agro-geology theoretical basis and practical guidance for the resource protection, agrogeological regionalization, genuineness study and artificial cultivation of Siraitia grosvenorii.

articleTitle: Experimental design on microstrip line bandpass filters for WCDMA
abstract: Based on the design and improvement of traditional hairpin microstrip bandpass filter, a cross-hairpin bandpass filter is designed in this paper. The filter is used in WCDMA operating between 1920GHz and 1980GHz. This paper analyzes the filters consisting of two hairpin resonators of differential coupling structures and their 3D models are simulated using Momentum based on ADS. Comparison of simulation and test results show that the improved filter has good passband and stopband characteristics.

articleTitle: A gait analysis system using two cameras with orthogonal view
abstract: Tradition gait analysis systems capture the image of a walking subject from either front view or side view. Since the walking direction allowed by the systems is highly restricted, they are inconvenient for long-term evaluation in casual environments (such as home). This study proposes a human gait analysis system with much less restriction on walking direction. In the system, we use the images obtained from multi-viewing angles and performs human gait analysis based on a set of chosen features, including the center of gravity (COG) and pace length, obtained from human silhouette images. The system successfully extracts gait features from various walking directions and integrates the features obtained from two cameras having orthogonal views. The integration principle is discussed in details. The integrated feature is then compared with the ideal gait feature obtained from the camera whose viewing direction is perpendicular to the walking path, resulting in very high correlation. This study shows that a vision-based gait analyzer with two orthogonally arranged cameras has the potential to remove the walking direction restriction.

articleTitle: Machine vision based recognition of emotions using the circumplex model of affect
abstract: In the vision community recognition and analysis of facial expressions is a long investigated area of research with potential applications such as human computer interaction (HCI). Most state of the art techniques focus on recognition of defined facial expression categories, i.e. basic emotions. However, in HCI classical basic emotions are only occurring sparsely, thus they are inadequate to guide the dialog with the user. Here we suggest a mapping to the so called circumplex model of affect, known from psychology. This enables us to determine the current affective state of the user, which can then be used to control the course of the interaction. In particular, the output of the proposed machine vision based recognition method gives insight to the observed person's arousal state and the valence along two axes of the 2-D plane of the underlying circumplex model. In this paper we present the basic principles of our new method and present first results.

articleTitle: Mollification of the Gibbs phenomena using orthogonal wavelets
abstract: In a preceding paper, we study the use of the wavelet expansion in terms of rapidly decaying wavelet, which is Meyer's wavelet, to the problem of mollification in the numerical calculation of the fractional derivative of a function involving noise. In the present paper, we study the problem of depressing the oscillation due to the Gibbs phenomenon, by applying the above method of mollification.

articleTitle: Effect of cement type on the transport properties of crushed sand concrete
abstract: Crushed sand is a by-product of gravel production in limestone quarries. Its use in concrete is hindered by its high level of fines. In this paper an experimental study of the effect of three different types of cements on durability properties of crushed sand concrete containing different amounts of limestone fines (0, 5, 15 and 25%) is investigated. The water to cementitious material ratio of 0.65 was kept constant for all mixtures. Results on compressive strength, gas permeability, chloride-ion penetration, and sorptivity measured at the age of 90 days are presented. Generally, the results show that the use of limestone fines at higher level reduces concrete strength at long-term for all types of cement. From durability point of view, concrete mixtures with limestone fines exhibit lower resistance to chloride-ion penetration and comparable sorptivity values for all cements types. However, the resistance to gas permeability was improved for some concrete mixtures at 15% of limestone fines.

articleTitle: The improvement of classic PF algorithm
abstract: In the TD-HSDPA system, the PF(Proportional Fair) algorithm was invented to solve the fairness and throughput problems in the RR(Round Robin) and MAX C/I algorithms. Although it can obtain a compromise between RR and MAX C/I, a new type of “starving” phenomenon still happens when a new user enters the system. To solve this issue, we propose a modified algorithm of classic PF to shorten the period been occupied by a new entering user so that other users' resources will be scheduled more fairly. The result shows that the improved algorithm can achieve a more reasonable result in the fairness than the classic one.

articleTitle: A Web Services-based security model for digital watermarking
abstract: this paper designs a Web Services-based security model for digital watermarking; the watermark embedding and watermark detection technology components will be the part of the Web Services of the site. The entire system architecture is based on Web Services via SOAP service requester and the exchange of information between service providers, and uses digital certificates, XML encryption and digital signatures and other security technology to ensure information exchange security. The model proposes for digital watermarking and Web services combined with a certain reference value, it also works in the marketing of multimedia network environment effectively protect digital products.

articleTitle: Experimental research on mechanical properties of recycled aggregate concrete
abstract: Through a series of experiments, used construction rubbish as recycled aggregate, the compressive strength and elastic modulus of recycled concrete specifically were studied, which recycled concrete specimens with this recycled aggregate, that contain C20, C30 & C40 these three kinds of compressive strength levels by different recycled coarse aggregate contents (30%, 50% & 100%). The results show that the compressive strength and prismatic compressive strength of the recycled concrete are higher than natural concrete basically. The elastic modulus is lower than natural concrete, and with the increase of recycled coarse aggregate contents, it reduces. In addition, a new equation on the relationship between elastic modulus and compressive strength of the recycled concrete was put forward.

articleTitle: Simulation of snow effects in visual simulation of virtual campus based on OSG
abstract: Simulation of natural phenomena can improve the fidelity of virtual scene, which have been used widely in visual simulation system, city planning, distance education and other fields. The virtual campus can be created by excellent functions of 3D modeling on 3D Studio Max. Particle system is an effective method in simulation of real-time natural phenomena. On the basis of analyzing the realizing principle of particle system, this paper made use of the highly integrated software development environment provided by Microsoft Visual Studio 2005 to build particle model and implement roaming function based on OSG(OpenSceneGraph)2.6. Experiments show that this method can effectively represent the fog, snow, rain and other weather phenomena in 3D scenes with interactive functions.

articleTitle: Uncertain data cluster based on DBSCAN
abstract: Uncertain data mining has recently attracted interests from researchers due to its presence in many applications such as Global Positioning System (GPS) Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), Moving Object Tracking. This paper is researching uncertain data clustering problem, almost all the existed algorithms of uncertain data calculate expectation to express the distance of objects, so they can cluster like certain data. But they neglect the distribution of objects and consume much more running time to calculate expectation. In the paper, we propose CIR-DBSCAN, an algorithm based on a representation model of distance distribution between uncertain objects, which uses the Core Influence Rate (CIR) to extend the traditional DBSCAN algorithm in uncertain data. To evaluate its performance and accuracy, a comparison against the clustering algorithm FDBSCAN is performed using synthetic datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm CIR-DBSCAN outperforms FDBSCAN in some cases.

articleTitle: Design and realization persistence framework of Tourism E-business System based on J2EE
abstract: Based on the construction of Tourism E-business System, the design of data persistence layer of Tourism E-business System was discussed in this paper. However, The realizing scheme of how to use abstract factory pattern, dao pattern, vo pattern, singleton pattern and Hibernate framework to design a data persistence framework, with the development of Tourism E-business System, and part of the implementation codes was given. And the advantages of the framework solution were described.

articleTitle: Engineering demonstration of micro-polluted water pretreatment with high-rate up-flow biological aerated filter
abstract: Problems of seasonal ammonia nitrogen (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N) and organic micro-pollution in drinking-water source have recently become common in cities of China, thus biological pretreatment process is helpful. The water flow of high-rate up-flow biological aerated filter (HUBAF) demonstration project was 735 thousand ton per day, there were 20 filters, sharing a common aeration system and an air-water combined up and down flow backwashing system, and each one with 11 meters long, 9 meters wide and 7.3 meters high. During Jar. to Mar. 2011, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N was 0.443-2.222 mg/L in raw water, and was 0.01-0.43 mg/L in effluent of pretreatment which was all below 0.5 mg/L. COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub> was 1.84-6.06 mg/L in raw water, all below 2.00 mg/L. The highest Fe and Mn concentration in raw water was 1.16 and 0.22 mg/L, while that in waterworks effluent was 0.05 and 0.03 mg/L. Using large particle ceramic filter media, the average removal amount of turbidity was only about 2.5 NTU and the head loss was 39.4-48.1 cm after steady. The project investment was 113.4 Yuan per ton of water, and the operation cost was about 0.04 Yuan per ton of water. Project demonstration shows HUBAF has stronger resistance of impact loading, higher NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N nitration rate and better removal of Fe and Mn than the other biological pretreatment technologies which have entered into production such as elastic packing-contact oxidation technology and suspended ball fluidized technology. HUBAF is a biological enhancement to conventional treatment system, forming a new process, which is in the same level with "O3-BAF" advanced process in water purification.

articleTitle: High-fill embankment settlement estimation based on the theory of unsaturated soils
abstract: This paper gives us a settlement calculation model under the conditions of no lateral deformation and lateral deformation based on the one-dimensional constitutive relations of unsaturated soils, according to the force characteristics of embankment and with consideration of the impact of water environment. In the paper, combined with the three-phase composition relations, we show the estimation methods of embankment settlement or deformation in a variety of conditions (such as external load, gravity effect, groundwater level rise or rainfall infiltration, as well as the combined effects of all the conditions). The method is feasible to be used to estimate embankment settlement, the calculation process of which can reflect the embankment deformation mechanism with clear concept. It can be used not only for settlement and deformation calculation under the effect of load, but also for embankment deformation calculation caused by the change of water content. This method needs to be further examined by practical construction.

articleTitle: Study of urban space based on the visual analysis
abstract: This paper give a scientific visual analysis tool which can wholly include the qualitative analysis, the quantitative analysis and the orientation analysis for the design of urban space. Based on the 3D GIS and its visual analysis function, different urban space have been analysed and evaluated. At last, some results of urban space designing are put forward.

articleTitle: The virtual campus scene based on VRML
abstract: The virtual physical scene which based on the virtual reality technology is one of the important application directions of the virtual reality technology. This design realizes the 3D virtual scene on part of the campus and real-time roaming by VRML. This paper mainly introduces the building of landscape model and the approach of the scene roaming realization. Using the Photoshop for the beautification; and the three-dimensional scene is imported into VRMLPAD, and then inserting the point of view, setting the light; after that program is optimized and so on. Finally, the virtual campus scene is browsed by IE. It presents as three-dimensional model in front of the users and generates an immersive feeling for the browser.

articleTitle: A distributed video coding algorithm based on bilateral motion estimate
abstract: This report firstly analyzes the reasons which lead the compression efficiency of DVC to be low. Next we argue that the inherent reason is not the DVC architecture, but the less side information set used in decoding than the traditional video coding standards. Then a bilateral motion estimate algorithm is proposed to improve the qualities of side information (SI) of DVC by enlarging the side information set, and the enlarging process is based on not only the characteristic of DVC architecture but also the employing of the video structure feature.

articleTitle: The slope stability analysis about 760 section of Jiatanchang reservoir bank in the Three Gorge Reservoir area
abstract: After the impoundment of the Three Gorge Reservoir, the changes of geological environment along the reservoir bank often cause some geological problems, such as slide, bank collapse etc. In this paper, 760 section of Jiatanchang reservoir has been taken for example, Unbalanced Thrust Force Method was selected first to calculate the stability; and then the stability coefficient of the arc slide inside the Quaternary soil was searched by Limit Equilibrium Theory to identify the most dangerous arc sliding surface, then analysis and calculation in three different conditions was conducted by SARMA, JANBU and BISHOP, and the result finally showed that the reservoir was stable.

articleTitle: The design characteristics and inspiration of the Sai Kung West country park in HongKong
abstract: China is experiencing rapid urbanization stage of development, and the environmental problems are increasingly severe. For the healthy development of the city, the planning and construction of country parks is being more and more attention. The Sai Kung West Country Park is a typical and mature case of the country park system in HongKong. Based on field survey, the authors try to interpretation the main content and regional characteristics in its planning and design, and also try to sum up the useful inspiration for the Country Park design and construction in China.

articleTitle: Implementation of map retrieval for technology business incubator management system
abstract: In order to promote the rapid growth of high-tech enterprises, many cities have established a large number of technology business incubators, and publicity through the web site. Users want to retrieve the target incubator quickly and accurately by means of the retrieval function of electronic map,However, the lack of related incubator sites for the map search function. In this paper ,Jscript and ActiveX techniques are used in "Dalian Technology Business Incubator Pilot City Construction Project" to implement the map search function. Users can open Dalian electronic map through the Web page ,then zoom in, zoom out and roaming. With these operations, users can find the target incubators and get their location, and then make relevant information queries.

articleTitle: Research on developmental strategies for regional industry of Changchun-Jilin -Tumenjiang development and open zone
abstract: This paper analyzes the Changchun-Jilin-Tumenjiang region in the industrial development of the present situation and development environment. According to the few characteristics which are the fast growth of the region's economy in recent years, the low level of industrial structure, the internal structure is not satisfied and the low degree of the regional industry association in this region. Make full use of the region of the industrial development district, transportation and resources advantage, to actively respond to the risk of opening up and the regional competition. Seize the opportunity, speed up the adjustment of industrial structure, and optimal distribution of industry, strengthen the industry park construction, improve the industrial development of the basic elements, the carrier of urbanization, market mechanism innovation and the regional division of labor and cooperation of the industrial development of the support system construction.

articleTitle: Almost periodic and asymptotically almost periodic mild solutions for nonlinear abstract functional differential equations with infinite delay
abstract: In this paper we study a class of nonlinear abstract functional differential equations with infinite delay. Some sufficient conditions for the existence and uniqueness of almost periodic and asymptotically almost periodic mild solutions for the equation are obtained by using the contraction fixed point theorem.

articleTitle: Investigation on sound scattering performances of wooden and bamboo diffusers
abstract: Wood and bamboo are both sustainable and healthy materials for use in interior design. In addition, the surface texture and grain of wood and bamboo give them special acoustic characteristics which can play an important role in the interior acoustic design. The sound scattering properties of interior surfaces provide a good and consistent spatial distribution of sound energy. Interior wood diffusers can contribute to the uniform distribution of sound, music and speech, strengthening the dominant sound effect and enhancing the quality of the overall indoor sound environment. Experimental results showed that none of the test materials provide good scattering effects at low frequencies(100–250 Hz), but provide significantly improved scattering effects at mid-to-high frequencies(500–3.15k Hz). Japanese cedar had the best scattering properties, while medium density fiberboards (MDF) was better than plywood and Ramin. Bamboo and bamboo tubes had the poorest scattering properties and provided only a narrow effective bandwidth.

articleTitle: On the value distribution of linear differential polynomials and the solution growth of linear differential equations
abstract: In this paper, we study the value distribution of linear differential polynomials and the solution growth of linear differential equations, and have obtained a fundamental inequality on the zeros and poles of linear differential polynomials. This result not only covers Frank-Weissenborn inequality, and reveals a relation between the value distribution of linear differential polynomials and the solution growth of linear differential equations. As its applications, Hayman-Yang inequality and some known theorems are generalized. The examples are provided to show that the conditions of theorems obtained in the present paper are essential.

articleTitle: Design of self-excited audio amplifiers based on spectrum-shifting
abstract: In order to avoid the generation of amplifiers whistle, the method of spectrum-shifting is used to move the audio signal, in this paper, The design of a spectrum of audio frequency low-noise removal circuit, Circuit by the low-noise preamplifier, low pass filter, analog multiplier, quartz crystal filter and PA power amplifier, After assembly, debugging and testing, the system do not produce self-oscillation and successfully remove the whistle sound. more importantly, there is no distortion of sound signals and the system gain of sound reinforcement reach 6-10dB.

articleTitle: Wavelength selection based on wavelength availability in multi-fiber WDM networks
abstract: This paper proposes a wavelength selection scheme based on wavelength availability in multi-fiber WDM networks. In multi-fiber WDM networks, each link consists of multiple optical fibers. The proposed scheme collects information on wavelength availability on fibers along a route between a source node and a destination node. Then the proposed scheme selects a wavelength based on the collected information in such a way that it makes wavelength usage in links smooth. By doing so, the generation of bottleneck links is suppressed. Through simulation experiments, we show that the proposed scheme efficiently improves blocking probability in multi-fiber WDM networks.

articleTitle: The inverted pendulum error analysis with MATLAB simulation and validation
abstract: This article contains error analysis and stability margin study by using linear and non-linear model analysis. The dynamic differential equation is established to study the state of parameters and to simulate the system; then the error between the linear and non-linear system is performed. The result indicated a 12° deflection angle of the inverted pendulum is an acceptable margin of simulation. Invert pendulum problem is a classical example in the traditional control theory. To simplify the mathematical analysis, a linear approximation is introduced which generates error from the original non-linear mathematical model. The discussion in this article provides specific quantitative error deviation between the linear model and non-linear model. This article is focused to find the relationship between control error and the linearity angle within 12 degrees. By comparing the linear model and the original non-linear model, and using PID control method to verify the presumed maximum angular range, we obtain the comparison of performance between the two mathematical models and draw the results in this article.

articleTitle: On planar flow and its influences in double dike closure by numerical simulation
abstract: Double dikes can be used to reduce the difficulties in river closure under high flow and big drop. It is required that both dikes share water fall during the closing process. But in practice it was often not easy to control the hydraulic conditions to obtain satisfactory situation. A series of 3-D numerical experiments by CFD simulation on two-dike closure in simplified straight boundaries were conducted in this paper. The results demonstrated that two recirculation zones in reverse direction in the flow plane, which were formed due to main stream diversion between the dikes, were necessary to drop sharing of the downstream embankment. The diverting spur wall had been found through computational tests to contribute to this kind of stable flow pattern. The location and size of the wall could influence formation and stability of the pattern. The distance between two dikes had a minimum value for maintaining the recirculation but had less influences on total drop and its allocation on the two embankments in the presence of the two stable return flow.

articleTitle: Image mosaics algorithm based on feature-block matching
abstract: Image mosaics algorithm based on feature-block matching is proposed. Edge detection is used to pickup base feature-block automatically and thus improves the precision of image stitching. In the problem of searching matching block, a hierarchical search strategy is employed, which improves the speed of image stitching. Experiment proves responsibility of algorithm proposed in this paper and good result is gained.

articleTitle: The design of pulsating vacuum sterilizer
abstract: At present, the sterilizers for medical use produced by most enterprises have some shortcomings like low degree of automation, low efficiency of disinfection and poors results of disinfection. This paper introduces pulsating vacuum sterilizer. It has PIC microcontroller as the core, supplemented by the keyboard, LCM display, real time clock circuit, temperature and pressure data acquisition circuit, telephone control circuit, voltage reference circuit, implementation driver circuit, alternating current zero-crossing detection circuit to form the hardware circuit. The software design uses bulk transfer structure and modular design. Test results show that the system is stable, with good disinfection effects and being easy to operate.

articleTitle: Anomaly target detection algorithm based on JPEG images
abstract: This paper describes an anomaly target detection algorithm based on JPEG images. The algorithm deals directly with JPEG image data eliminating JPEG image decoding process. The algorithm extracts the JPEG DC parameters, and then compares two frames of adjacent DC parameters to determine whether the abnormal targets appear. Compared to the YUV image data processing methods, it costs less storage space, access time and computation, which is more suitable for embedded systems with limited resources. Finally, the simulation results of the algorithm are given.

articleTitle: Research on public rental housing demand based on regional difference
abstract: According to the housing situation of different regions and different income groups of urban residents, the scientific measurement of public rental housing demand is the basis for the preparation of housing security planning. Public rental housing needs of different cities should consider the regional urban population distribution, city housing prices and residential housing consumption ability, the immigrant population, the city level and scale, and other factors. We take Zhejiang province as an example, explore the public rental housing demand of different cities, and try to provide a reference for public rental housing construction planning and related policy formulation.

articleTitle: Sampling algorithms for multivariate wavelets
abstract: In this paper, we give algorithms to calculate multivariate wavelet coefficients approximately by sampled values of functions. Then we provide two formulae respectively to calculate the outlines and details of functions. Last, as an example, we draw figures of outline and detail of a function. 2000 AMS Classification: 42A65

articleTitle: Research of potential carbon sequestration for grassland in Qinghai province
abstract: As a big province which owns many grasslands, the potential carbon sequestration of Qinghai province is very great. The strong (A2a) and weak (B2a) scenarios in global climate warming and drying scenarios, the climate in Qinghai Province is opposite to the climate of the global trends, taking on warm trend; The main subject of Qinghai grassland carbon is the alpine tundra categories, accounting for Qinghai Province the total area of potential grassland is 75.69%, the annual carbon potential is 87.22% of the potential carbon potential of grassland of Qinghai province. compared with nearly 50 years (1950–2000) ,the grassland area will show a decrease trend in Qinghai Province, the trend of increasing forest area, grassland area will be reduced respectively by 30.71% and 28.5%; In the future (2001–2050) A2a, B2a scenario in Qinghai Province on carbon sequestration potential of grassland decreased by 25.55% and 20.82%, The warm and humid trend of climate is conducive to increase total vegetation carbon sink, the subject is that the carbon sequestration of alpine tundra categories has a significant reduction, but temperate forests (it is cold temperate coniferous forest class in Qinghai province ) is characterized by increased carbon sink.

Author Keywords: comprehensive and sequential classification (CSCS) NPP potential

articleTitle: CAI teaching design and development for referee scoring of table tennis
abstract: With the use of computers and CAI software, this paper developes the courseware of referee's scoring rules for table tennis, presents the application of Formatfactory, AVI_RM_WMV_Splitter v4.28, Adobe Premiere Pro CS3 in the research process. The paper proposes that we should choose the theme of elite athletes, and record targeted video games, which are more representative and ornamental. To Edit video games in using Windows Movie, we should recognize the characteristics of tennis, emphasizing professional skills, so that students can understand easily. Integrating the use of Microsoft Office PowerPoint 2007 into the courseware, we should notice the rhythm and sequence of the video presentation when editing it, and should notice the consistency of CAI teaching demonstration and the real games, which is one of key technologies. The main conclusions: We can address the difficulty of scoring table tennis referee if we integrate the teaching courseware of scoring table tennis into the network teaching platform of Jiangxi Normal University Tennis Courses, which will innovate and change teaching methods and teaching techniques to promote sports reform. We still need to update the computers and CAI software technology, and develope better P.E. courseware.

articleTitle: New open-web roofs for integrating heat preservation & insulation and structural functions
abstract: The thermal performance of building envelope is a major requirement for generating a comfortable and hygienic interior environment. A roof is a main part of building envelope and provides protection from thermal damage caused by the excessive hot sunshine. In order to improve this thermal roof performance, the use of the air gap in the roof can be considered. This study presents a new type of open-web roofs, which integrates the structural functions and thermal behaviours for building roofs, in particular large span roofs. The conceptual analyses for the proposed open-web roofs on both mechanical properties and thermal performances are carried out. The comparison of material usages and thermal performance between the open-web roof and traditional roof structures is presented for a successfully constructed building. The results from the real case study show the advantages of the new open-web roofs over traditional roofs.

articleTitle: Weakly JP-injective rings
abstract: A ring R is called right weakly JP-injective (or WJP-injective for short), if, for any 0≠a∈J(R), there exists b∈R such that ab=ba≠0 and any right R-homomorphism from abR to R extends to an endomorphism of R. In this paper,several properties of these rings are given, right weakly JP-injective rings satisfying some additional conditions are investigated, some interesting results are obtained.

articleTitle: Neighbor-scattering number in regular graphs
abstract: Network reliability is an important issue in the area of distributed computing. Most of the early work in this area takes a probabilistic approach to the problem. However, sometimes it is important to incorporate subjective reliability estimate s into the measure. To serve this goal, we propose the use of neighbor-scattering number, a measure of graph vulnerability. In this paper, we give a complete characterization of all minimal (1 - k)-neighbor-scattered graph which are k-regular and contain a k-clique.

articleTitle: A separating algorithm for particle image
abstract: In the particle images, objects tend to touch, overlap with each other to form clusters. How to separate these clusters into single objects is a vital problem for the counting, feature extraction and analysis in the following process. Separating them by boundary tracking do not need an acute angle and/or the strong density contrast at the points where the objects touched, so it can get a better separating result. But sometimes when the principal axis direction of the cluster is neither horizontal nor vertical, it does not work. For this, a new separating algorithm is presented in the paper. At first, the algorithm calculates the principal axis direction of the cluster, if it is nearly horizontal or vertical then goes on, otherwise it rotates the cluster to make its principal axis direction be horizontal. And then the algorithm performs separating by boundary tracking. Experiments show that the algorithm has achieved a well separating result.

articleTitle: Study on building publicity and education positions of drug control for youth by using the Internet
abstract: The Internet brings conveniences to people, but it also plays a role in drug abuse and spread in the country. Young Internet users who chase novelties, fashions, avant-garde practices suffer from it enormously. Research findings show that most young drug addicts are Internet users. In view of the Internet being a double-edged sword, it is a matter of utmost urgency to establish effective publicity and education positions of drug control for the youth by using the Internet. It is also necessary to create the public atmosphere of drug control via the Internet, to form publicity and education task forces to implement Internet anti-drug strategies, to reform publicity and education patterns of Internet anti-drug campaigns, and to develop and excavate drug control resources on the Internet. Thus, an important publicity and education role of the Internet need to be played in anti-drug campaigns directed to the youth.

articleTitle: Safe monitoring of foundation pile and optimization of multi-sensors
abstract: To design safety monitoring system in foundation piles, the number and location of multi-sensors should be optimized, so that comprehensive and reliable stress distribution can be observed. Minimal cost principle should be complied for number optimizing of multi-sensors system. Rationality principle of characteristic position and distribution curve of observed values should be complied for location optimizing of multi-sensors system. Based on the optimization criterions, the optimal number and location of stress multi-sensors in foundation pile is studied with genetic algorithm (GA). The system cost of a single pile reduces 30% by optimizing the number of the multi-sensors, and the observed stress distribution curve is more reasonable by optimizing location of sensors.

articleTitle: Some elementary properties of ultrametric analytic functions
abstract: This short note have three intensions. One is to give a unified proof of Hensel's Lemma for ultremetric analytic functions and the classicalWeierstrass Preperation Theorem. The second is to deduce some elementary properties from Hensel's Lemma and norm properties. The third is to extend some of these results to functions of several variables.

articleTitle: Methods of determining the extreme points for trivariate functions
abstract: There have been some researches in recent years, e.g. [2-5], on how to determine the extreme points of a smooth multivariate function, especially in the case where Hesse criterion is ineffective; however, most of the researches focus only on bivariate functions or lower-order stable points. In this essay we adopt Taylor series expansion of the function at the stable points, consider the positive definiteness of the corresponding homogeneous polynomial, raise the image criterion for determining the extreme points of a trivariate function, and finally extend the conclusions to higher-order situations. One fact is that this criterion is effective, and there's no need to consider the influence of the order of the stable points.

articleTitle: Analysis construction method of double-decked electric power tunnel
abstract: With the development of modern technology and space, more and more cities begin exploit underground space, to satisfy the increasingly crowded environment. This article base on double-decked electric power tunnel of 220KV 1 cut change project, use the finite element software MIDAS/GTS analysis and simulation the project construction process of two different method, through all the simulation of construction process, and analysis the engineering the feasibility construction method.lt is the first time use the double-decked tunnel construction methods in Beijing, to discuss and analysis the method of the project have an important significance, in the meanwhile, it can provide some references to similar project construction.

articleTitle: Robust pole assignment via the Schur-Newton algorithms
abstract: In [6], the pole assignment problem was considered for the control system x = Ax + Bu with linear state-feedback u = Fx. An algorithm using the Schur form has been proposed, producing suboptimal solutions which can be refined further using optimization. In this paper, the algorithm is improved, with a weighted sum of the feedback gain and the departure from normality being used as the robustness measure. Newton refinement procedure is implemented, producing optimal solutions. Several illustrative numerical examples are presented.

articleTitle: FEC-based packet loss recovery for AVS-M audio codec
abstract: In this paper, we utilize sender-based Forward Error Correction (FEC) techniques to enhance the robustness of packet loss recovery for AVS Mobile speech and audio (AVS-M) codec. Two FEC schemes are proposed which take the advantage of the codec's structure characteristics and do not introduce extra delay. The objective and subjective listening tests results show that the two methods achieve higher reconstructed quality than the codec's original frame erasure scheme in the case of packet loss.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of earthquake response spectra about viscous and complex damping model
abstract: Towards complex and viscous damping model of the SDOF system, this article researches the differences, similarities of the above two system responses. Through calculating the two kinds of system dynamic equations based on harmonic excitation clearly, the result is that: When the excitation's period is less than the natural period of structures, the displacement response of the complex damping system is stronger than the latter. Oppositely, the speed response, the acceleration response are both weaker than the latter. On the contrary, the result is opposite. Based on those work, the acceleration spectra of some representative earthquake records are provided of the two kinds of systems, and also the velocity and displacement spectra. In comparison with the last two spectra in the condition of harmonic excitation, the results show the similar phenomenon. But the acceleration spectra of the viscous damping model are higher than that of the complex damping model at any time. And with the growing damping ratio, the difference is more remarkable. Under certain earthquake records, the structure displacement response values of certain natural period may differ by 15%.The velocity spectra differ by 14%. The acceleration spectra differ by 8%. In the end, the article gives us a suggestion that how to choose damping model to make the structure more Safe and reliable. And also, it provides some help for the further study of complex damping theory, references for engineering application.

articleTitle: The linear weighting method for solving a class of non-differentiable multiobjective programming problem
abstract: In the paper, we put forward the linear weighting method for solving a type of non-differentiable multiobjective programming problem, and use it to solve an example.

articleTitle: Experimental study and rotational stiffness analysis of bolted timber connection
abstract: Bolted timber connection is one of the main connections in glulam. Bolted timber connection performance, especially rotational stiffness, is very important in the whole structure. The rotational stiffness and bearing capacity of bolted timber connection is studied in this paper. Seven specimens were loaded to failure. Comparison on the flexural bearing capacity and rotational stiffness were developed. Then the failure mechanism of the bolted connections was discussed in detail. The influence of bolt number of single row, bolt diameter and plate thickness on rotational stiffness were introduced.

articleTitle: Analysis of basic characteristics and formation mechanism for the collapse in back of the Panda Garden rearing sheds located in Wolong Town
abstract: 5.12 Wenchuan earthquake triggered a large number of collapses, landslides and other secondary disasters caused serious loss of life and property. At the same time, the earthquake generated a lot of loose debris and serious injured and damaged the mountain so as to form potentially dangerous rock which serious threat to people's safety in the future. On the basis of detailed investigation of the mountain collapse in back of Panda Garden rearing sheds, the collapse failure mechanism and the instability modes of potential dangerous rock are revealed by the analysis of topography, lithology and rock structure. Discrete element software is used to simulate the failure process of collapse in the earthquake. The results showed that the passive protection facilities within a certain range in the slope toe have obvious block and restriction for falling stone. This provides the basis for supporting design, and the evidence for the collapse formation mechanism study under strong earthquake.

articleTitle: Inversion of S-wave velocity profile by microtremor H/V spectrum: Application to four sites in Tianjin
abstract: The method for S-wave velocity profiling by inversion of microtremor horizontal-to-vertical (H/V) spectrum proposed by Arai and Tokimatsu is reviewed and improved, in which, the deep ground structures, usually known from other geophysical methods, are assumed as unknowns. The improvement is then verified by the inversion of S-wave velocity profile of four real sites in Tianjin, and it is shown that the improvement is reasonable and valuable for engineering.

articleTitle: A homotopy regularization method for nonlinear ill-posed problems
abstract: We report on a new method for nonlinear ill-posed operator equation in Hilbert spaces. Based on the principle of the homotopy method, a new functional is introduced to replace the Tikhonov functional. The minimizer of this replacement functional will constitute a continuous curve connecting the initial value with the approximate solution of the original problem. Following the curve by using the numerical continuation method, with local linearization as the basic iteration, we can Anally obtain the approximate solution. As a practical application, we present numerical results for the reconstruction of activity function in Single Photon Emission Tomography.

articleTitle: Flow-aware based dynamic congestion control in Next-Generation Networks
abstract: Congestion control is the key scheme to guarantee Quality of Services (QoS) in Next-Generation-Networks (NGN). A new congestion control algorithm based on flow-awareness for NGN is presented, it can identify different flows congruously in path, and the buffer was adjust dynamically to different flows, the dropping probability was determined by the type and the rate of flows. It can keep streaming flows share bandwidth fairly with elastic flow under light load, and guarantee the priority of real-time applications under heavy load. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has better network performance in fairness, congestion ratio and link utilization.

articleTitle: Study on the wave dissipating performance of air bubbles breakwater with air compressibility
abstract: Assuming the two phase fluid of water and air as a variable density fluid, the numerical model of the air bubbles breakwater is developed. The continuity equation, the Reynolds average equations and the k - ε model are taken as the governing equations, and the VOF method is used to trace the wave surface. The additional source term of the air curtain model is successfully added to the continuity equation by the Macro of UDF. The transmission coefficients are obtained at the different air amounts and the wave periods agree well with the experimental data, the effects of air compressibility on the wave dissipating performance of the air bubbles breakwater are analyzed with different wave characteristics, length scales and air amounts, then some conclusion, which are meaningful to study the wave dissipating performances of the air bubbles breakwater are obtained.

articleTitle: Organizational learning on school and its model design based on information technology
abstract: Organizational Learning theory bring the learning on the strategic aspect, Learning become the key that individual, organize, and even whole country and world survive and develop. This paper drawn experience from the domestic and international enterprise research of organizational learning excavated its impact on educational field. At first, studied the basic problem of the Organizational learning on school and analyzed the important questions. Then discussed the Resources in school conditions, and planed to build a model of organizational learning on school based on information technology, and analyzed the functions of the model, perhaps of realize and problems. Finally, proposed some thinking to organizational learning on school model.

articleTitle: A flexible and transparent ReRAM with CdO/TiO2/CdO structure on PET substrate
abstract: ReRAM is one of the most promising candidates for next generation high-speed non-volatile memory. Until now, no transparent and flexible memory is reported. In this paper, a transparent and flexible ReRAM based on CdO/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/CdO/PET structure is demonstrated, which show typical unipolar resistive switching characteristics.

articleTitle: Analysis of the operation dispatch of the lower reservoir of Langyashan Pumped Storage Power Station
abstract: Langyashan Pumped Storage Power Station in Anhui Province utilizes the constructed Chengxi Reservoir as its lower reservoir. Chengxi Reservoir, which is a comprehensively utilized reservoir, mainly undertakes the duties of water consumption, flood control, irrigation etc. for Chuzhou City. The commissioning of Langyashan Station will influence the operation of Chengxi Reservoir to some extent. In order to properly comprehensively utilize water resource, which means can not only guarantee the normal operation water consumption for the Storage Power Station, but also coordinate the comprehensive utilization requirements such as urban water supply etc., monographic studies for Chengxi Reservoir and Shaheji Reservoir were carried out and the major achievements were shared in this paper.

articleTitle: Inequalities involving the generalized Grötzsch ring function and modular function
abstract: In this paper, we study the monotonicity of the generalized Grötzsch ring function μ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</inf>(r) and the generalized modular function ϕ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sup>(r). Some sharp inequalities of μ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</inf>(r) and ϕ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sup>(r) are obtained.

articleTitle: Comparison of eigenvalues for second order equations on time scales
abstract: In this paper we will employed some results from matrix analysis to obtain the existence and comparison results of eigenvalues of second order linear equations with boundary conditions on time scales.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis on solar-powered ASBR to treat domestic wastewater in Jinan
abstract: Calculated and analyzed the feasibility on Solar-powered ASBR for domestic wastewater treatment in Jinan. Calculated that 2.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>J energy is needed for ASBR to digest 1kgCOD in ambient temperature. And calculated that 43.75 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> Solar panels are needed to provide energy for ASBR to digest 1kgCOD pre day in ambient temperature in Jinan

articleTitle: The mathematical model for solar radiation penetration into double row greenhouse cucumber
abstract: If the photosynthetic rate of inhomogeneous sunbeam greenhouse cucumber canopy were simulated via homogeneous canopy structure photosynthetic model, the error would be very large. In this paper, by taking illumination distribution in the sunbeam greenhouse cucumber canopy and the inhomogeneity of blade photosynthetic characteristic into account, the photosynthetic rate model of sunbeam greenhouse cucumber inhomogeneous canopy is described which includes model of direct radiation, scattered radiation and supplementary radiation of solar radiation in inhomogeneous canopy.

articleTitle: One Newton-type method for the regularization of nonlinear ill-posed problems
abstract: In this paper we consider a combination of Newton's method with simplified Newton iteration for regularizing a nonlinear ill-posed operator equation. We show that under certain smoothness conditions on the nonlinear operator the method converge locally. For perturbed data we propose an a priori stopping rule which guarantees convergence of the iteration to a solution as the noise level goes to zero. Under appropriate closeness and smoothness assumptions on the starting value and the solution, we obtain convergence rates.

articleTitle: The existence and nonexistence of global solutions for a nonlinear hyperbolic equation
abstract: This paper gives the sufficient conditions of the blow-up of the solution for a class of nonlinear hyperbolic equation with initial boundary conditions in finite time and proves the existence and uniqueness of the local solution of the problem.

articleTitle: A constitutive model and numerical simulation for zonal disintegration of surrounding rock in deep roadway
abstract: In comparison to shallow roadway, disintegrative zone and un-disintegrative zone appear several times alternately in the surrounding rock of deep roadway, which is called Zonal Disintegration. Now, no agreement is established about the mechanism of zonal disintegration in deep roadway. First, based on traditional Nishihara model, the second power strong rheological model is constructed, which can describe full stage creep process of rock, and accelerated creep equation of rock mass is obtained. Second, according to evolution process on zonal disintegration of deep rock, maximum tensile stress criterion, shear failure criterion and the fourth strength criterion are determined as failure judgment criteria of deep rock mass with the priority level decreased. Against the background of mining and geological conditions of 4417 transport roadway, zonal disintegration simulation of surrounding rock is carried out in this roadway with FLAC-3D numerical simulation software, judgment criteria and constitutive equation got in this paper as accelerated creep equation of rock mass, and simulation results are the same as those of field tests.

articleTitle: Binomial parameter estimation with nonignorable missing data
abstract: When an observation of a binomial distribution suffers missing data from a nonignorable nonresponse mechanism, the binomial distribution parameters becomes to be unidentifiable without any other auxiliary information or assumption. To address the problems of non-identifiability, existing methods mostly based on the log-linear regression model. In this article, we consider to use the auxiliary data to improve identifiability, further we derive the maximum likelihood estimator(MLE) for the binommial proportion and its associated variance, the simulation study shows that the proposed method gives promising results.

articleTitle: Increasing the proportion of garbage situ treatment in rural areas, assuring orderly conduct of desakota garbage disposal—Take Luan County in Hebei province for example
abstract: It has drawn the attention of state and society that the current rural sanitation work is facing many problems. In order to effectively solve the difficulty of domestic garbage disposal, the country decided to bring the work of garbage disposal in rural areas into the one of urban-rural integration. This paper analyzed the present situation and the existing problems of domestic garbage disposal in rural areas and proposed some suggestions on increasing the proportion of domestic garbage situ treatment in rural areas. Hopefully, may the paper provide ideas and set examples for the other districts.

articleTitle: Optimal classification for blow-up phenomena in ignition model
abstract: This paper considers blow-up phenomena in ignition model. The behavior of solutions depends on the interactions among the local and localized sources as well as the diffusions with the null boundary conditions in the model. The aim of the paper is to distinguish simultaneous and non-simultaneous blow-up for the non-global solutions.

articleTitle: Technical principle of development and study trends of building materials made by mine tailings—Taking mine tailings of copper in Tongling region for an example
abstract: Study on building materials made by mine tailings could contribute to solving problems of environmental protection from exploiting minerals, as well as those of excessive consumption of land resources from producing building materials. In view of ingredients and technologic property of mine tailings in Tongling region, mine tailings in the region apply to exploiting such products as bricks by steaming and pressing, cement, glass, building ceramics, etc. Studying on building materials made by mine tailings, most of organizations carry out experimental study for exploitation aiming at specific mine, and few of basic research are conducted. In addition, inter-disciplinary researchers and research funds were both of shortage. In the light of study trends, study on building materials should focus on physical and chemical properties of interrelated silicates, technologic property and technical principle. Furthermore, greater effort must be exerted in support of policy and funds.

articleTitle: The research of multimedia instruction environment based on campus network
abstract: According to the current situation of multimedia instruction and application of campus network in new local colleges, this paper analyses problems and technical limitations in the process of implementing multimedia teaching; At the same time, combined with new requirements of multimedia instruction using network, it proposes the view that local colleges campus network should possess the ability of supporting multimedia instruction and the technical program of constructing multimedia teaching platform based on campus network.

articleTitle: No-reference quality assessment for video streams based on China Mobile Multimedia Broadcast
abstract: This paper investigates the perceptual quality of multimedia affected by compression and implements a system of quality assessment for compressed video over CMMB (China Mobile Multimedia Broadcasting standards). It can evaluate the video quality of CMMB video streams and get a good corresponding with the subjective assessments results. We examine the impact of several factors on the perceptual quality, and extract various feature parameters directly from the streams, then select representative feature parameters as the inputs of our model. Finally we propose a no-reference metric that measures the overall quality degradation due to lossy compression. The experimental results show that our model can achieve a good performance for the streaming video quality prediction over CMMB. In addition, since our model does not require the source picture, or fully decoding process and has a low complexity, it is also suitable for many other real-time video applications.

articleTitle: The development strategy and planning design on industrial park in globalization
abstract: At present the fourth industry transfer contributed by the trend of globalization brings both opportunities and challenges for Chinese cities' development. In order to spare more space and resources to take the international high-end industry, many low-end industries in the eastern coastal areas are being transferred to Midwest cities in the mainland. In order to seize this opportunity and develop the cities, Midwest cities begin the construction of industry park to provide enough space for industry development. Xiangyang Jiahai Industry Park(XJIP) in is the fruit of this movement. Contrary to the traditional study that only focuses on the rationality of the planning and design structure, this study considers the macro context of urban development as its first priority under which background it advocates that the industry park's position should be based on its function. This paper proposes new creative design concepts in terms of land using, ecological environment, park development, etc. and this study will provide useful reference on industry park's comprehensive study and construction.

articleTitle: Studies on centroid jamming model using stochastic differential equation
abstract: According to the scattering quality of target, the stochastic differential equations are given for the tracking capability of monopulse anti-ship missile terminal guidance radar. The probability density function of azimuth is represented, which enables identification of their stochastic volatilities with certain free functions. At last the simulation experiments were made by MatLab and the effectiveness of the model was tested and verified.

articleTitle: Fast adaptive motion estimation for H.264
abstract: H.264 motion estimation achieves better compression efficiency of video coding than previous video standards (e.g. MPEG-2, H.263, and JPEG). But it leads to higher computational cost and complexity in coding. In this study we propose an efficient early termination searching method to reduce the computational complexity and achieve better compression ratio. Adaptive search strategy is applied to reduce the search point in a search range. Furthermore this study presents an analysis of the performance of the proposed algorithm in terms of motion estimation time, total encoding time, and video quality (PSNR). Simulation result shows that compared to Full Search (FS), this algorithm achieves up to 60% reduction in motion estimation time without degrading the video quality.

articleTitle: A network sensor system for e-science applications around Qinghai Lake
abstract: In 2005, thousands of wild birds around the Qinghai Lake died of avian influenza virus. Following the incident, Computer Network Information Center (CNIC) of China Academy of Sciences and several other research institutions as well as the local natural reserve administration took actions to study it from different aspects and at different levels. With the launching of CNGI project around the Qinghai Lake in 2010, the network sensors have begun to be widely applied in this area so that both the hardware and software environment there have been greatly improved, thus providing large quantities of original data for further scientific research, which will definitely promote the further development in the regional study.

articleTitle: Analysis the establish of Vertical Search Engines' simple ontology
abstract: Analysis the establish of Vertical Search Engines' simple ontology, take a research on Vertical Search Engines on the method and key technology.

articleTitle: Seismic performance under environment corrosion for curved beam bridges with high piers
abstract: Dynamic response under rare earthquakes of the small radius curved beam bridges with high piers under environment corrosion are studied and compared with the cases without corrosion in this paper by time history analysis method based on an actual project. The influence of pier-height and the environment corrosion on the seismic performance of bridges during the service life are studied, and the cumulative damage of piers is discussed.

articleTitle: One review of McShane-type inequalities
abstract: In this paper Diaz-Metcalf inequality is refined upon the conversion of McShane-type inequality. Extension of generalized Hadamard inequality on functions of two variable is reviewed. The inverse of Hölder's inequality is proven using the property of two-variable function. One estimation of Jensen's functional is rewritten.

articleTitle: Solitons for a supersymmetric seventh-order KdV equation by superbilinear approach
abstract: In this paper, a N = 1 supersymmetric seventh-order KdV equation is proposed. We bilinearize this equation with Hirota's bilinear method to obtain its one- and two-supersoliton solutions. It's shown that the N-supersoliton solution only exists for a particular choice of parameters.

articleTitle: Study on promote the construction and development of the “digital Hubei”;
abstract: This research-driven “digital Hubei” construction and development, to ensure the authority of Hubei public digital data and the current trend. It is also aim to improve the level of informatization services and government scientific decision-making; to break down departmental barriers of information and to achieve the information sharing and interoperability, reduce administrative costs; to enhance the city's comprehensive competitiveness, to upgrade the city image. This essay first introduces the domestic and international macroeconomic policy framework and specific implementation aspects of related research; then analyzed the advantge and disadvantg of digital Hubei's development strengths and its future opportunities or future challenges, to study their needs, to establish the distribution of future investment projects in digital industry of Hubei Province; at the last, to provide the strategies and recommendations for speed up the development of “digital Hubei”, which including digital technology is a prerequisite; do the top-level design of e-government well; government, business and academia to participate.

articleTitle: Robust piecewise planar stereo with modified segmentation cues in urban scenes
abstract: This paper proposes a robust piecewise planar multi-view stereo (MVS) approach specifically designed for urban scenes. These architectural scenes are problematic for traditional computer vision methods. In our work, we focus on exploiting some useful constraints of artificial structures such as piecewise coplanarity and boundaries of superpixels. Firstly, we reconstruct quasi-dense 3D point clouds of urban scenes using patches-based MVS (PMVS) method. Secondly, a set of 3D candidate planes are generated by the obtained point clouds without any assumption on the normals of planes, unlike famous Manhattan-world assumption. Then, we segment multi-view images with watershed algorithm and modify the contours of superpixels by the classical Douglas-Peucker approximation algorithm to fit the contours to the boundaries of objects in urban scenes as much as possible. Finally, we use the candidate planes as labels and superpixels as nodes to formulate our Markov Random Field (MRF) optimization problem, then a piecewise planar depth map for each view is recovered by solving the optimization problem using graph-cuts. Experiments show that our method outperforms previous approaches in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Effects of effluent C/N ratio on pollutant removal performance in sequencing batch membrane bioreactor
abstract: By taking a sequencing-batch membrane bioreactor (SBMBR) which operated in anaerobic aerobic (AO) as the research object, the effects of influent C/N ratio on pollutant removal performance in this system have been investigated. when the influent C/N ratio was 17.3 ∼ 18.5, the average removal rate of COD, ammonia nitrogen (NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N, total nitrogen(TN) and total phosphorus (TP) were 90.7%, 92.8%, 81.9% and 79.8%, respectively. When the influent C/N decreased to 8.6 ∼ 10.3, the average removal rate of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N dropped to about 84% and was promoted to 93.5% by improving the aeration rate. At the same time, the average removal efficiency of COD, TN and TP were 90.7%, 81.9% and 79.8%, respectively. A problem worthy to be pointed out was that the average removal rate of TN could be increased to 83.9% by improving influent organic loading based on the influent C/N ratio of 8.6 ∼ 10.3, while the removal efficiency of COD, NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N and TP were not impacted. The average removal rate of them were 92.5%, 93.5% and 76.9%, respectively. Results obtained from this study indicate that the C/N ratio of had no obvious effect on the removal of COD and TP in this system. And this system also have shown a better removal ability of nitrogen.

articleTitle: Application of chaos and fractal theory in structures under wind load
abstract: The emergence of chaos and fractal theory provides a brand-new concept and research method to solve structure problems in order and disorder. Based on the nonlinear dynamic characteristic analysis of the observation data of structures under wind load, this paper first introduces chaos and fractal theory in structures under wind load through theoretical analysis, formulas and the practical example analysis. It is a brand-new attempt in this aspect and has an important significance in promoting the further development of the structural analysis.

articleTitle: An implement strategy of context-based adaptive binary arithmetic coding in H.264
abstract: The paper studied mainly the context-based adaptive binary arithmetic coding (CABAC) and its concerned implement strategies in the h.264. The improved CABAC adopted Finite-State-Machine and Lookup-Table to implement its arithmetic coding engine. Compared with the normal CABAC, the improved one is conceptual simple and outputs lower bit-rate with better efficiency. Finally, its test model is evaluated and verified.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of ALM-over-IPM multicast model based on IPv4-IPv6 hybrid network
abstract: Multicast technology is widely used in the field of video transmission. Firstly, the working mechanism of the traditional IP multicast and the application-layer multicast is described in the paper, and their advantages and disadvantages are analyzed and compared. And then a new ALM-over-IPM multicast model is proposed, and the working mechanism and key technology of it are analyzed. Finally, Simulation environment is constructed, and a test is carried out to validate the feasibility of the new model.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of smart pipe based on QoE of voice and internet service
abstract: Abstract-With the development smart pipe, in recent years, the PCC architecture attracts more and more attention. In this paper, firstly, it analyzes the existing standardized architecture based on the PCC, and the research of QoE at home and abroad, and then points out of the existing shortcomings in the PCC architecture; Secondly, it introduces QoE to the PCC architecture QoE innovatively, and proposes the PCC architecture design based on QoE, and insights into the changes in the structure of each module and works; To verify the practical value of the architecture, it designs and implements PCC prototype system based on QoE of the typical business, and the system for each functional module and application scenarios are given in detail; Finally, intelligent user experience that the application of pipeline the prospects and challenges of smart pipe based QoE are introduced. (Abstract).

articleTitle: Optimal sensing time allocation for minimum aggregate interference to primary system
abstract: In practical cognitive radio, perfect detection of idle channels can not be guaranteed, unavoidably leading to interference to primary system. In this letter, the problem of allocation of sensing time over multiple channels to minimize the aggregate interference to primary system subject to the constraints that interferences in each channel are kept below some constants is considered. By exploiting the hidden convexity of this problem, the optimal solution is obtained by reliable and efficient algorithms. Simulations the optimal solution can considerably mitigate the aggregate interference to primary system.

articleTitle: The construction of iterative methods with higher convergence
abstract: In this paper, we prove that iterative methods with higher convergence to solve nonlinear equations can be obtained either by using the higher derivatives or by using more iterative steps. Based on these theories we developed some new iterative methods which converge fast. The numerical tests also corroborate our results.

articleTitle: An inexpensive embedded electronic Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) based on neural networks
abstract: The high nonlinearity and the high cost of the Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) system need to realize a low cost embedded system based on an inexpensive microcontroller using the full neural networks. The two parts, training and validation are used to adapt the network parameters in real time as proposed in this paper. The realized card simulates the CSTR model. The well-known backpropagation algorithm is implemented to train a neural network model. Both the training and the validation parts are shown through an alphanumeric liquid crystal display. A comparison was made between the realized embedded system and the computer results.

articleTitle: Approximate stability of the parametric inverted pendulum
abstract: In this paper, we study the stability border of the damped parametric inverted pendulum by variational method. The stability relation of the parametric inverted pendulum between parameters is obtained in the case of the large pendulum length, but the forcing amplitude is not confined, especially, the forcing amplitude can be bigger than 1, which makes up for the small amplitude case. The comparison between the stability and instability domains is given by the numerical simulation for the nonlinear system. The numerical results show that the border is reliable.

articleTitle: Analysis on the localized paths of Lingnan modern architecture based on individual perspective
abstract: In the context of the development of Lingnan modern architectural education, analysis and comparison on the localized practice of Modern Architecture of three famous Lingnan architects, Lin Keming, Xia Changshi and Mo Bozhi will contribute to the in-depth understanding on the localization process of Modern Architecture in Lingnan region from individual perspective.

articleTitle: Mixture mathematics model of two-phase turbulence flows and its application
abstract: In this paper, turbulent form of the mixture model is deduced by Renoldys averaging, and Heat buoyant force is added to the Averaged Momentum Equation. An office, including two man bodies, two computer and six lights, is simulated numerically, It is shown that the computational results is well agreed with the experimental results and the modified two-phase flow model is perfect for the indoor environment with heat source.

articleTitle: Influences of sea level rise to the once-in-many-year water level of inshore area of China
abstract: The sea level rise has great effects on the security of coastal projects. The definition of check water level has always played an important role in coastal constructions. Under the circumstance of sea level arising, as time passes, the security of high check water level will descend eventually. This paper demonstrates that the sea level of inshore area of China has a tendency of ascending in general drawn from monthly average sea level data of 25 stations, with an average rate of ascending of 1.24mm/a. In the condition of sea level arising, the change of return period corresponding to high check water level with time is also studied using the method of the Gumbel distribution law. For the 21 stations in which the sea level arises, the once-in-50-year water level will decay to once-in-15.4-year one after 50 years while the once-in-100-year water level will decay to once-in-30.5-year one on average.

articleTitle: Design on Google Earth-based Platform for the public participate in urban planning
abstract: In China, the construction of the urban is rapidly developing, however the seriousness of it has been suspected by the public, which are manifested in two aspects, one is the urban planning is appeared to be freely modified in short time; the other is the houses of the public are forced to remove. The main reason is due to the lack of public participation and supervision in urban planning. This paper using Google Earth Platform to create a convenient platform for public participates in urban planning. The platform is easier to use than traditional ones, and easier to be accepted by the public who are lack of knowledge on urban planning. It is helpful for them to participate and supervise the urban planning.

articleTitle: The study and application of multiple life model based on the same monotonous
abstract: When research multiple life insurance problem in life insurance actuarial practice, often assuming that all the random variables of rest life are independent, so we can get the life function and the net single premium of multiple life. But in fact, because the each life in the multiple life model is always under some common factors, and between life there must be exist some kind of dependency, by reference[1] know with drab is one of the strongest dependency. This paper assumes that the multiple life under a common factor and the rest life is under the same monotonous, give the net single premium of the year regular life annuity of multiple life model.

articleTitle: The application of multiple linear regress equation on analysing the effect factors of student scores
abstract: To some extent, the academic scores of students reflect the teaching level of a school. Taking the students taught by me in 2010 as study objects, from the teaching perspective the paper studies the factors affecting the exam scores in advanced mathematics by using the method of multiple liner regression. The study result shows: although there are some differences in mathematics foundation among students, yet they can still make a great progress in mathematics study and they will have no difference in exam scores , as long as they are willing to spend time, willing to study hard. Meanwhile, the class atmosphere and the learning atmosphere can also play an important role in improving student exam scores.

articleTitle: Study on energy efficiency design of public building base on overall consideration of energy consumption factors
abstract: Based on the correlation between outer protective structure, natural ventilation, natural lighting and illumination, as well as HVAC system, gets the thermal load and cold load of the designed building by using DeST, which is a dynamic energy consumption simulation software, and with a comparison with the standard building, explores the energy efficiency design in a form of full consideration of factors with coupling relationship and choosing design parameters reasonably, finally meets the requirement by optimizing HVAC system.

articleTitle: Regulations and management measures for estrogen in livestock farming system of China and Japan
abstract: Researches and measures for endocrine disruptor management in livestock farming system in Japan have been fully investigated. Special attention has been paid to the international communication and cooperation in the control and management of endocrine disruptor in Japan. Based on the researches on veterinary drug residues in animal food and chemical list in China, regulations and management measures of endocrine disruptor, especially estrogen, in livestock farming system in China has also been discussed. Much more work are still needed for China to catch up or outstrip Japan in the pollution control of endocrine disruptor in livestock farming systems in near future.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis on supersonic ellipsoidal dome
abstract: Studied the transient thermal transfer analysis method due to a kind of supersonic ellipsoidal dome, which is a conformal dome. Illuminated the principle of transient thermal transfer analysis. Accomplished the transient thermal analysis based on the model of ellipsoidal dome, and studied the influence about the different material and the different velocity. Considered three materials consist of MgF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and ZnS, and meanwhile, the velocity was Mach2.5, and the time consists of 10s, 20s and 60s. The temperature initial loads were from FLUENT thermal simulation. The thermal conduction analysis and the thermal convection analysis were finished in software ANSYS, in which the entire transient thermal analysis consists of modeling, meshing element, calculating and getting the results. The different temperature distributions based on varied time were gotten about the different materials. The results from analysis showed the temperature distribution of the structure of ellipsoidal dome, which could help the following coupled thermal-structure analysis.

articleTitle: Research on integrated control technology of the seamless pipe shape
