abstract: A novel two-scale decomposition-based harmonious cloning algorithm over images is presented in this paper. Different from previous methods, we first decompose the lightness channel of the image into two scales: the base layer and the detail layer. Then, we process each scale using different fashions. Finally, we use mean value interpolation to solve image cloning problem. Our cloned result matches well with the target image on the detail and is seamlessly. Our approach can obtain visually pleasing cloned result between different appearance images, which is problematic in previous image cloning methods. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our harmonious cloning algorithm.

articleTitle: The new algorithm for grounding grid fault diagnosis
abstract: Grounding grid is commonly installed in the substation. When it's damaged, not only restoring and improving work affects the production, but also it is difficult to carry this work out. In this paper, a new method to solve the problem of grounding grid fault diagnosis is given. Due to the characteristics of grounding grid fault diagnosis, PSO is used. As the particle produced by evolution rules of the PSO often does not meet the constraints, to improve the feasibility of particles, we translate the renewal of particle into nonlinear least squares with the simple bound constrained optimization, and then convert this problem into a constrained quadratic programming by using Gauss-Newton method in the evolutionary process. But for grounding grid fault diagnosis problem, the Hesse matrix of constrained quadratic programming may be non-full rank, so we adopt regular splitting in order to achieve rapid solution. To prevent premature happen, when some particles are near enough to the optimal particle, we renew it by the way the initial particle is generated to increase the diversity of the swarm. The algorithm proposed here could solve the multi-solution problem when accessible nodes are not enough, so we can find out corrosion state of the grounding grid.

articleTitle: Innovation ability training of college students through multimedia network teaching
abstract: It has always been a key task for higher education to train students with innovation ability and practicing ability. Nowadays, network teaching is widely used in universities. Here are some of our views on how to train innovation ability of college students.

articleTitle: Discuss promoting central China rise countermeasures
abstract: Along with the CPC central committee on “wings fly together, rising in central China”, the strategy of rise of central China strategy has increasingly drawn the attention of Henan provincial government, then what measures should be taken to promote the rising of central China, has become our first solve the problem. This article will put forward eight aspects corresponding countermeasure: strengthening culture far-surpassing, stimulating the rise of Central China; renaissance Central Chinese culture and forming Central China's exclusive brands, supporting culture in the central plain discussed amid local civilization again positioning. keep abreast with the requirements, improve the competitiveness of the domestic culture, Zhongyuan culture industry need to build long-term planning, Zhongyuan culture industry to develop improved industrial system, The rising of central China needs scientific development, the cultural industry should be paid more people-oriented; promoting zhongyuan rise, the need to create a good atmosphere of cultural industry development. Hoping strategies taken by Henan province can provide reference for the rise of central China.

articleTitle: A bayesian test for LOMAX distribution with composite LINEX loss function
abstract: We describe a bayesian test for LOMAX distribution with composite LINEX loss function. Bayes test for a parameter θ of lomax distribution is in the Complex symmetric loss function. We select the gamma distribution as prior distribution of parameter θ, then the bayes estimate contains two hyperparameters α and λ. The multi-bayes estimation of parameters θ is discussed, and the permissibility is proved. In the end, simulation made by Gibbs sampling MCMC methods was given to check effectiveness of the theory.

articleTitle: Multiple attribute group decision making with incomplete information based on interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy sets theory
abstract: This paper deals with multiple attribute group decision making with incomplete information based on interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy sets theory. At first, score function, accuracy function, consistency index function are introduced. Next, optimization models based on consistency function are established to obtain attribute weights. Then, the weights are utilized to select the most desirable alternatives. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate application of the method. The numerical results show that the proposed methods are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The infrared remote system design based on FPGA
abstract: One design method of infrared remote control is introduced which is based on field programmable gate arrays FPGA devices. The paper gives a construction method for infrared remote system. The system uses PT2248 as a transmitter, MIM-R1AA38kHz integrated infrared receiver demodulator as a receiver. Then it explains how to use EDA technology top-down design approach to achieve infrared remote control decoder chip, decipher, key in, number reveal and alarm function of briefing on etc. The paper also details in features and performance of ALTERA DEII platform, at the same time use the Cyclone II ?of EP2C35F672C6N to realize the whole system on DE2 board with the EDA tools.

articleTitle: Analysis of failure mechanisms of Guang Yang highway slopes in jointed rock masses
abstract: This paper demonstrates the ability of Shear Strength Reduction (SSR) analysis based on the Finite Element Method (FEM) to model the excavations sizes effects of discontinuity networks on the stability and failure mechanisms of slopes in blocky rock masses. Through GuangYang highway slope in k3+980∼k4+240, it shows how these mechanisms depend on joint network geometry and change with increasing slope height.

articleTitle: An efficient and secure one-round authenticated key agreement protocol without pairings
abstract: Two-Party Authenticated key agreement protocol is essential for setting up the common session key for parties to establish secure channel for network communication in the open environment. Most of proposed schemes require expensive bilinear pairing operation and only provide limited security attributes. So such protocols are unsuitable for real-world applications that require stronger sense of secrecy. In this paper, we first analysis two schemes recently proposed by Cao etc., and then present a one-round ID-based authenticated key agreement protocol with more desired security attributes, which need no pairing operations while still achieve nice computational efficiency. These security attributes include known-key secrecy, perfect forward secrecy, PKG forward secrecy, key-compromise impersonation resilience, unknown key-share resilience and no key control. Moreover, it captures the enhanced security attributes known session-specific temporary key information secrecy, which means that even the ephemeral secret key were compromised, the adversary can hardly acquire the agreed session key.

Author Keywords: Known session-specific temporary key information secrecy

articleTitle: Detection of traffic signs based on visual saliency model
abstract: In this paper, a visual saliency model is used to detect the traffic signs in the natural images. A number of features consist of intensity, color opponency and orientations are extracted from the image by the model. Without the need for image segmentation, the saliency map indicating the area where the traffic signs are can be computed. From the experiments on the real scene images with the domestic traffic signs, the detection rate of 89% is achieved.

articleTitle: Snow disaster damage to urban building and prevention strategies in Chill Region
abstract: This paper analyzes snow disaster damage to city building to outline that the safety and habitability should be fully considered during architectural creation in the chill region circumstance. Then the suitable prevention strategies for snow disaster damage in designing the safe and livable buildings in cold region is proposed, followed by detailed description in the aspects of site selection and layout, rational building construction and nodes setting, energy saving and heat preservation measures, windproof and skidproof outdoor environment. It is pointed that the problem of snow disaster damage to urban building in chill region is concerned with various aspects of architectural creation. All these aspects need general consideration and thorough thinking with systemic method in analyzing and problems solving, so that building can be created which adapts to the snow and ice climate in frigid regions.

articleTitle: A early mode decision algorithm based on statistics and machine learning for enhancement layers in H.264 Scalable Video Coding
abstract: In this paper, a early mode decision algorithm is proposed to reduce the complexity of the mode selection process for enhancement layers in H.264 Scalable Video Coding. Generally, the proposed algorithm consists of the following three main steps, which are applied to the enhancement layer. Firstly, we divide all the macroblocks into 4 classes according to the mode of collocated macroblocks in the base layer. Then, according to the mode of neighboring macroblocks, the macroblocks are subdivided with trained BP (Back Propagation) network. At last, for different cases we choose different mode selection algorithms. Compared to JSVM 9.18, experiment results show that, with this algorithm, 30% encoding time can be saved with a negligible loss in BDSNR, and BDBR can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Fundamental mechanical properties of Lytag concrete
abstract: On the basis of measurement of Lytag properties, concrete mixtures of eight different proportions with design strength of 30 MPa to 60 MPa were prepared. According to the testing results, the regression equations of the axial tensile strength and the axial compressive strength of concrete as a function of cubic compressive strength were obtained, and then were compared with the regression equations in respective specifications. The axial tensile strength and the axial compressive strength of fly ash ceramics concrete are all matched the respective specifications, so the standard value and design value of the mechanical properties could use the respective specifications.

articleTitle: Research on feature selection in automated writing assessment system
abstract: Automated writing assessment system which uses artificial intelligence to evaluate essays and generate feedback. We designed and developed an automated writing assessment system. Not only words and phrases but also dependency triples are used to evaluate the content of the essays from long distance. Users can learn English from the feedbacks given by our system because it gives a detailed explanation of errors. Currently College English Test (CET) has been accepted by society and used as one of the assessment in employment. We did a lot of feature selection experiments on the official CET data and found 26 feature types were contributed to essays assessing. Experimental results provided our method was prominent.

articleTitle: Convergence of coefficient regularized fully online algorithm
abstract: This paper gives the convergence of coefficient regularized fully online nonsmooth classification algorithm. With the strongly convex loss function based on the Euclidean Space and the parameter λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> changes with learning step give a better convergence rate than the usual convex loss functions.

articleTitle: Gust effect factor of large-span domed roof structures under wind excitation
abstract: The primary purpose of this study is to provide simple formulas for estimating the design wind loads denoted as gust effect factor for large-span domed roofs considering their dynamic response under wind excitation. In this paper, systematic parameter analysis for the gust effect factor of Kiewitt6-6 type domed roof structures have been performed with random simulation method in time domain, including geometric parameters, structural parameters and aerodynamic parameters. Moreover, an empirical formula for the gust effect factor is provided as a function of these parameters based on a statistical analysis, which can be conveniently used in wind-resistant design of these structures. The results indicate that the geometric parameters are the most important factor influencing the wind induced response of domed roof structures, and the gust effect factor is well-proportioned, which is 3.0-3.2 as a reference for the wind-resistant design.

articleTitle: Design and realization of stainless steel hot strip mill coiler control system based on siemens TDC
abstract: Fujian Desheng Special Iron and Steel Corporation 1150mm hot strip line is a set of fully automatic hot strip line designed and manufactured by our Chinese engineers.The coiler automatic control system of the strip line is based on SIEMENS TDC, the system functions were programmed in Siemens STEP7 and friendly HMI was designed with Siemens WinCC. All of this can realize the coiler fully automatic control of stainless iron hot strip line. The system has many merits such as high precision, low control period and so on. And Good results are obtained in this factory.

articleTitle: The application of automatic controlling and measuring system based on LabVIEW in thermal conductivity of poor conductor experiment
abstract: Based on the improved traditional steady-state method which combined with LabVIEW virtual system in measuring of the thermal conductivity of poor conductor, the minutely monitoring of temperature on the two surfaces of a sample is realized. By using the digital output of the acquisition card and external circuits, the sample is made to reach thermal conduction steady state in a short time and keeping stable. During the data processing, the cooling curve of the plate and some other parameters are recorded and the slope of cooling is calculated by LabVIEW. The design realizes the automatic monitoring, automatic controlling and measuring.

articleTitle: Research on treatment of oil-containing wastewater by fly ash
abstract: In order to solve the environmental pollution caused by oil-containing wastewater, research on treatment of oil-containing wastewater by fly ash as sorbent, added after modification and combined with other process was summarized. The results show that treatment of oil-containing wastewater treatment by fly ash has the characteristic of simple in process, good effect and lower operation cost. And this process has expansive application foreground. The problems remained were pointed out. Further research on the mechanism of wastewater treatment with fly ash, separation and final utilization of the saturated fly ash are needed to do in the near future.

articleTitle: The stability of a class of epidemic model
abstract: This paper establishes the model which describes hepatitis by ODE. It can calculate the equilibrium points of no disease and diseasedness and discuss the stability on the basis of classifying people into three groups: the susceptible, infectors, and people who are hepatitis-free. Eventually, we give numerical simulation in terms of the actual data of hepatitis and verify its practicability.

articleTitle: A RPM-based multimedia communication model
abstract: Multicast is one of the key technologies for supporting the multimedia networks services. Based on the concept of the distributed algorithm theory, this paper discusses a multimedia communication model and its corresponding data structure, and also simulates RPM algorithm by using forwarding table, the time line and data packet cache to discuss the algorithm QoS solution.

articleTitle: Chinese traditional architectural landscape and ecological consciousness
abstract: Chinese traditional architectural landscape is an important factor of Chinese traditional culture and also an indispensable part of Chinese traditional architecture. It was built with ecological consciousness of following and respecting nature during thousands of years so that the combination of architecture and nature forms ecological representation of images. In this study,It analyzes the ecological consciousness of Chinese traditional architectural landscape and ecological characterization of imagery with the methods of cultural ecology. It purpose to research into the strain and influence of culture and nature in traditional architectural landscape.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of PLC multimedia software
abstract: To solve PLC(Programmable Logic Controller) hardware devices shortage problem in teaching and research, the PLC multimedia software was designed and implemented. It was achieved to simulate the PLC programming, running and simulating, and to monitor the behavior of the system, based on Borland C++ Builder, object-oriented technology and multithread technology under Windows situation. The thesis focused on multithread technology application in monitoring module and realization of saving and opening programs. A kind of coding rule was proposed to express controls, to save programs with notepad format. It has friendly user interface, easy operation, which facilitates PLC teaching and off-line debugging, also has reference value for designing other similar systems.

articleTitle: Influences of structural parameters variation on static behavior of suspension footbridge
abstract: Based on the finite element theory, taking a suspension footbridge for example, it is used the finite element analysis software called MIDAS/Civil builded bridge element model to carry out the static analysis, to research the influences of different sag-to-span ratio and the constrained way between the cable and the tower on static behavior of suspension. The results showed that, the cable stress increase gradually with the decreasing of the sag-to-span ratio. Under the mid-span concentrated load, as the decreasing of the sag-to-span ratio, the deflection value of the mid-span point is reduced gradually. It has a very small influence on the cable stress and stiffening girder deflection when changing the constrained conditions. It shows that the results in this paper can be used in structural analysis for long-span suspension bridges of the same kind.

articleTitle: Effects of random field modeling methods on slope stability
abstract: Soil properties exhibit an inherent spatial variability, its parameter changes from point to point and can not be neglected in probabilistic slope stability analysis. The commonly used methods to model soil random field in probabilistic slope stability analyses are variance reduction method, midpoint method and local average subdivision method. However, the effects of different random field modeling methods on slope stability has not been studied yet. In the paper, for a simple slope the three random field modeling methods together with first order reliability method are employed to conduct probabilistic slope stability analysis, and the results are compared with each other. The reliability analysis results from different random modeling methods are comparable with each other from practical point of view. The reliability results also show that the stability of slope is influenced by the spatial variability of soil properties, and the influence depends on the relative dimension of the scale of fluctuation and the length of critical slip surface.

articleTitle: Content based image retrieval using Gaussian Lie group spatiogram similarity
abstract: In this paper, we apply the spatiogram features to the image retrieval problem using a recent proposed Lie group based similarity measure. The spatiogram features are extracted at HSV space. For each channel of the HSV space, we extract the corresponding spatiogram features separately. Such kind of feature extraction method produce much lower dimension features than extracting features directly on the 3 D HSV space. Then, we compare the images using a recently proposed spatiogram distance measure, which is based on the Lie group theory. We test our algorithm on the corel image retrieval benchmark dataset. Experiments show better performance than the previous proposed spatiogram similarity measure.

articleTitle: Health risk assessment of mercury exposure for the sensitive populations living along the Di'Er Songhua River region
abstract: The Di'er Songhua River is an important tributary of the Songhua River, which originates from Tianchi Lake in the Changbai Mountains and flows through central Jilin Province in northeast China. In the early sixties of last century, this river became one of the typical water bodies with mercury polluted river, due to its discharge of wastewater containing mercury. In order to investigate whether there were still human health risk from mercury exposure for the sensitive subpopulations living in the Di'er Songhua River region, a number of 155 hair samples were collected from the children aged of 0 to 15 and the women of childbearing age aged from 16 to 45, and the hair total mercury concentrations were detected by the methods of CVAAS. The average hair total mercury concentrations of child was 0.99 mg/kg with the range of 0.16–14.97 mg/kg. The mean hair mercury value of the women of childbearing age was 2.43 mg/kg with the range of 0.07–92.13 mg/kg. There were 7.69% of women of childbearing age with their high hair mercury concentrations exceeded 2.8 mg/kg, whose frequency of paraesthesia was 50%. There were 7.69% of women of childbearing age with their high hair mercury concentrations exceeded 3.8 mg/kg, whose frequency of comprehensive nervous system influence was 5%. There were 1.91% of children with their high hair mercury concentrations exceeded 2.8 mg/kg, whose frequency of paraesthesia was 50%. There were 0.02% of children with their high hair mercury concentrations exceeded 3.8 mg/kg, whose frequency of comprehensive nervous system influence was 5%.

articleTitle: Optimization of parameters for 3-D reconstruction with uncalibrated monoplane angiograms
abstract: A method about optimization of parameters for 3-D reconstruction with uncalibrated monoplane angiograms is presented in this paper. Based on the model of monoplane angiographic system, variables concerning about the precision of reconstruction are discussed. Distance between initial image and projection of reconstructed 3-D model is employed to formulate objective function. Adaptive simulated annealing algorithm is utilized to solve the problem of optimization. Experiments on angiograms are presented. The results show that the method greatly improves the accuracy of 3-D reconstruction.

articleTitle: Internet-based visualization of newsvendor problem using Java applet
abstract: Newsvendor problem is a famous and basic problem in stochastic programming, and has been profitably applied in many fields, such as economic management, optimization control, supply chain. Newsvendor problem modeling is studied in this paper, and Internet-based experiment is developed using Java applet. User can study the principle and algorithm of newsvendor problem, and understand essential character of the classical stochastic programming through the experiment system. Two types of the random demands with continuous and discrete probability distribution are respectively selected by user to demonstrate the mechanism of newsvendor problem modeling. The developed system can display optimal results with text as well as graphics, and provides a visual platform with interaction for users.

articleTitle: Nitrogen transformation character from the Tiaoxi river to the estuary of the Qingshan Lake
abstract: Through the fixed-point sampling of the Qingshan lake and the estuary of Tiaoxi river, the temporal and spatial variation regularity of DCK COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub>, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N and TN in the waterbody were analysed emphatically, and the preliminary analysis of its sources was carried out. The results showed that DO content decreased gradually from the Tiaoxi river to the estuary of the Qingshan Lake, but COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub> and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N increased, and there was a significant relationship between DO and COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub> and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N. The waterbody from the Tiaoxi river to the estuary of the Qingshan Lake has reached a certain degree of nitrogen pollution, and TN content was 2.64±0.38 mg L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, which is slight eutrophication, but the Qingshan Lake reached moderate eutrophication.

articleTitle: Packet scheduling scheme for MPEG video transportation
abstract: Packet loss control is an essential issue for video transportation over Internet. Buffer management is a traditional network technique to protecting video data against packet loss. To meet the need of quality of service in MPEG video transportation, a new innovative use of packet scheduling to meet the loss constraints of video communication is proposed. Followed by programming tests concerning establishment of systematic video communications, the packet-scheduling scheme that intra and inter-stream loss requests for video transportation are met was simulated and evaluated using real video data. The simulation experimental results show that the quality of service mechanism can effectively improve the quality of service of MPEG video transportation.

articleTitle: Urban expansion of Kunshan based on RS and GIS
abstract: Abstract-This paper aims studying the dynamic spatial expansion process of Kunshan based on Remote Sensing (RS) and Geographic Information System (GIS). For the purpose of comprehensive analysis and programming on urban sprawl, we discussed the vital driving forces from the perspective of spatial development. The conlusions indicates that: (1) From 2001 to 2010, Kunshan was expanding at fast pace and strong intensity. The gap between central city and towns dimmed, while the connection between them became stronger. (2) The compactness of urban built-up area reduced gradually and the epitaxial type dominates urban expansion, which also aroused environmental problems. (3) Factors such as total export and GDP had a major impact on the urbanization process. Great attentions have to be paid to these factors in the future urban constructions.

articleTitle: Fast historic document retrieval by extracting document image summary
abstract: Historic documents such as Chinese calligraphy and old newspapers usually were handwritten or printed in poor quality so that an automatic optical character recognition procedure for scanned document images is difficult to apply. Thus efficient pattern matching techniques are required in order to do content-based information retrieval based on user's queries. In this paper, a fast pattern clustering and image matching procedure is proposed to do image/pattern search in a historic document image based on user's query images. The image summary extracted from the document image is constructed so that a set of distinct image clusters are formed. A couple of distance measures that calculate distance between image patterns are also proposed to evaluate their cluster similarities. By precise pattern matching and hierarchical image clustering, our experimental results show that an online query image can produce accurate and faster results than traditional approaches for a broad range of historic document images.

articleTitle: Positive solutions of the multiple point boundary value problems for nonlinear fractional differential equations
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the existence of positive solutions for a class of multiple point boundary value problems of fractional differential equations. By means of the fixed point theorem, we obtain some sufficient conditions of the existence of at least one positive solutions or three positive solutions.

articleTitle: Researches on structural characteristics of the concrete crushing-type side wall and its influence on the stress-strain of Shuibuya CFRD
abstract: Advanced grid discreteness technique and the method to solve large scales of equations were used for the researches on structural characteristics of the concrete crushing-type side wall and its influence on the stress-strain of Shuibuya CFRD. Computational results indicate that the concrete crushing-type side wall can not only replaces the procedure of bedding material extra-filling, scaling, dressing, roller compacting and slope face protection to quicken the schedule and enhance and guarantee the construction, but also improve the stress and deformation situation of the face. In most of the time the concrete crushing-type side wall works in a low stress level, the material properties close to plain concrete.

articleTitle: Bayes shrinkage estimation in exponential distribution under progressively Type-II censoring
abstract: In this paper,the Bayes estimator and Bayes shrinkage estimatior of the parameter of exponential distribution are obtained based on progressively Type-II censored sample.The loss functions used are squared error loss function and weighted square loss function.The properties of the minimax estimators are also discussed.Finally,an example to illustrate the application for our result.

articleTitle: Hägerstrand time-geography revisited from current perspective
abstract: With the data-rich environment and the advancement of information and communication technology, the origin of Hägerstrand's time geography become inadequate on meeting the need of representing and analyzing characteristics of human activity nowadays. In this regard, this paper revisits the space-time path and space-time constraints as two main parts of the theory from the current perspective and envisions how these two parts relevant in analyzing social networks by reviewing the recent work in this area. In conclusion, by extending the theory in these two parts, Hägerstrand's time geography can not only fit well in human activity in physical space but also in the virtual space.

articleTitle: A method for detecting document orientation by using SVM classifier
abstract: An approach for document orientation detection and classification by using support vector machine (SVM) theorem is proposed in this paper. First, all the characters in a document image will be isolated and some valid ones are selected.Using the valid characters,the document image will be vectorized to a 32 dimensional vector by the feature extracting. By training lots of samples, an SVM classifier can be obtained, and then the orientation of unknown document images can be classified. Experimental results show the accuracy of the proposed method is considerably higher than Bray Curtis distance, even for some bad samples.

articleTitle: Study on nonlinear calculation model of load transfer in super-long piles
abstract: Based on load transfer mechanics and deformation properties of super-long piles and on the soil mechanics theory which is in disturbed state, a calculation model of pile resistance is put forward when the soil around piles is under elastoplastic state and slipping plastic state. With the reference of Duncan-Chang model in nonlinear elastic theory and Mohr-Coulomb strength theory, calculation formulas of every parameter in the model are deduced. On the basis of foundation engineering theory, tip resistance of piles is computed. Then, through nonlinear iterative calculation of super-long piles load-settlement relationship, load and settlement relationship curve is obtained and compared to the results from engineering static load test which can verify the correctness of this model.

articleTitle: Weighted Stechkin-Marchaud-type Inequalities for Baskakov-Durmeyer operators
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the weighted K-functional and Stechkin-Marchaud-type inequalities of weighted approximation for Baskakov-Durmeyer operators is obtained.

articleTitle: A matrix computation method of the equivalent parameters of the conductor systems and the linear networks
abstract: An equation about the equivalent capacitance and the potential coefficients of a conductor system is given. On the basis of the equation, a matrix computation method of the equivalent capacitance of a conductor system is brought forward. The procedure of the method is as follow: write out a matrix about the conductor system according to some rules, firstly, and secondly, do some calculations. The method is simple and convenient, compared with other methods. Further more, the method is popularized to compute the equivalent parameters of the linear networks, based on the principle of duality.

articleTitle: Experimental research on soil-water characteristic curve for a landslide considering density effect
abstract: With the advanced Pressure Plate Extractor which made of Soil moisture Equipment Corporation. The experiments of soil-water characteristics curves are made under different density for sliding zone soils of Qian Jiangping landside, The varied consistent functions have been established from the experiment data of soil-water characteristics curves. The physical meanings of parameters in the consistent functions have been deduced and the effect resulted by variation of soil density have been analyzed. The studies show that the variation of soil density has close relationship with soil-water characteristic curve. Finally, a comprehensive function expression which can reflect the relation among soil density, suction and water content, is established. The test and calculated data verify the reliability of the formula.

articleTitle: The research of long-range dependent linear process under the supersmooth case
abstract: This paper give some certain assumptions at first,then present the important conclusions of long-range dependent linear process, and carry through a detailed argument finally under the supersmooth case and considering non-parametric regression model for dependent data.

articleTitle: Experimental measurements on air jets issuing into a coaxial rough pipe
abstract: In this experimental study a number of measurements are presented, analyzed and discussed, concerning incompressible air jets (issuing from circular opening d=25 mm) into coaxial rough pipes (equipped with ring rectangular strips roughness elements on the pipe boundaries, κ×κ with κ=2.5 mm, at distances λ=25−50−100 mm) of internal diameters D=49−138−287 mm, in various combinations among them. The flow is fully turbulent, since the Reynolds numbers at the openings vary between 30,590 and 109,340, while the exit velocities V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</inf> vary between 18.21 m/sec and 69.30 m/sec. A large number of axial velocities u and boundary shear stresses τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</inf> are measured, and the flow field structures are qualitatively presented and compared. The authors believe that the results and conclusions of this investigation may be useful to environmental, chemical and fluid mechanics pipe engineers.

articleTitle: Improveing depth estimation through fusion of stereo and TOF
abstract: In this paper, a novel method for depth estimation through fusion of stereo and TOF is proposed. Both the depth data and intensity gray images from TOF are taken into the calibration processing for getting the more accurate camera exterior parameters. Using the exterior parameters, the depth image captured by TOF is warped to the scope of the CCD camera pairs to form an initial depth image. Due to the problems of depth errors in the edges and the occlusion, the stereo rig is used to obtain the accurate depth of the edges of the objects, and eliminates the effect of occlusion simultaneously. Finally, by fusion method that takes advantage of the stereo vision, the depth data and the color image, the depth is optimized to obtain high resolution depth image. The experiment results show that higher spatial resolution and correct depth at edges' position is obtained, compared with only using the TOF camera, and also the higher quality dense depth image.

articleTitle: Minimum repeater model in both flat and mountainous area based on goal programming
abstract: The systematic programming of the telecommunication network is a prerequisite for reliable quality of telecommunication. How to place the repeater on different areas is particularly an essential procedure for optimizing the planning of the network. Based on the cellular system, this article proposes a model contributing to the minimum number of repeaters both on mountainous and flat circular areas, respectively with employing the mathematical programming methods. On the flat area, the goal programming model is established on the basis of service coverage quality, coverage intensity, signal interference and regional area into consideration, which can as well deal with the situation where the population increases practically with the cell splitting (CS) technique to ensure the optimum number of repeater. On the mountainous area, the concept of Fresnel zone is employed by the model to confine the diffraction loss, the model also illuminates the optimum effort to place the repeaters with the GIS technique. We concluded that the models on flat and mountainous area are feasible to the actual conditions, conducive to the planning of the repeater network.

articleTitle: A study method of ecological risk evaluation for reclaimed water
abstract: According to characteristics which generate from reclaimed water for ecology environment , we utilize event tree analysis (ETA) method to analyze the risk transmission way of reclaimed water, on the base of it , the evaluation index system which reclaimed water for ecology environment effect is preliminary established, and indicator weight is determined by entropy value method. Finally, we set up comprehensive evaluation model using entropy value and gray connection method, combine with the risk matrix to qualitative describe the risk level of comprehensive evaluation result.

articleTitle: Software development for the coal layer's gas permeability coefficient calculation based on the VB
abstract: The coal layer's gas permeability coefficient is an important index to judge wether it is easy for the gas drainage. The radial flow method is the most common testing way for the coal layer's gas permeability coefficient calculation the current. However, its calculation process is tedious. And sometime could not find the right calculation formula during the calculation. At times, it turns out two results during the calculation. According to the coal bed gas flow theory, combined with the outlier's processing method, using the VB language to develop a software for the coal layer's gas permeability coefficient. Using this software, it can realize the accurate and rapid calculation for the coal layer's gas permeability coefficient.

articleTitle: The library information management in University
abstract: Level of library information management is a key to success for the information management in University. The information resource of library is the most necessary and important for professors and students. American University library information system has many adventures, comparing with Chinese University library, including resource setting, information share, workshop and services etc. It will be benefited to Chinese University library by researching the advanced university library information management.

articleTitle: Spacewire codec module analysis
abstract: Spacewire is a full-duplex, point-to-point, high-speed data link standard that is intended to meet the needs of future, high capability, remote sensing instruments in space missions. In SpaceWire bus codec module occupies an extremely important position. In this paper, codec module in Xlinx FPGA in reality, through actual application, do some performance analysis, and puts forward some Suggestions

articleTitle: The stability analysis of reinforced embankments
abstract: The stability analysis of reinforced embankments is investigated by means of a multiphase model developed in the framework of the yield design approach. According to this model, called multiphase model, the reinforced material is described not as a single homogenized continuum as in the classical homogenization approach, but as the superposition of two mutually interacting continuous media. It is shown in particular how such a model allows to capture both scale and boundary effects.

articleTitle: Lax pair and soliton solutions for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation in inhomogeneous optical fiber media
abstract: In the paper, a Lax pair is presented for a generalized variable-coefficients nonliear Schrödinger equation in inhomogeneous optical fiber media with the loss/gain and the frequency chirping. Two types of soliton solutions are constructed by solving its linear non-isospectrum problem. With computer simulation, the main features of bright and dark solitons are shown by some figures. These results will be useful in optical pulse propagation in inhomogeneous optical fiber media.

articleTitle: Analysis on the concentration and decentralization of population in Lanzhou-Xining Cities Region based on the regional density functions
abstract: The exploratory spatial data analysis is used to examine the population distribution characteristics of thirty-five countries in Lanzhou-Xining Cities Region, and three high population density centers are found. To make sure which regional density function is more appropriate for Lanzhou-Xining Cities Region, the gravity-based model is used to delineate the radiation scope of these three high population density centers and then the square-root negative exponential density function shows the precedence over the others. Since the monocentric regional density function has limits in multicentric regions, such as Lanzhou-Xining Cities Region, the function based on the square-root negative exponential is used to examine the characteristic and the development trends of concentration and decentralization of population. Compared with the result of monocentric and polycentric functions, it shows the polycentric function is more appropriate in detecting the trend of population movement. And there are two different types of concentration and decentralization of population, where the different levels of population density center display different characteristics, namely, the concentration type, and the dispersion type through weaken center.

articleTitle: Localization of a single-point magnetic target in the special geomagnetic field
abstract: This paper presents a set of linear equations for the localization of a single magnetic target in the special background of smooth geomagnetic field and geomagnetic anomalies, which serves as a solution to the problem of the localization of a single magnetic object for small area. Meanwhile computer simulation and error analysis are also provided. The results indicate that this mathematical model is relatively satisfying for medium/short-range localization in special geomagnetic background and has some reference value in practical application to some extent.

articleTitle: Estimate of the precipitation based on X-band marine radar
abstract: X-band marine radar was tested out the estimate of precipitation on the basis of rain gauge data and weather radar. This higher frequency radar is capable of measuring precipitation. The high resolution rainfall measurements will be used for run-off simulations and urban drainage applications.

articleTitle: Assessing urban green space by landscape structure indices and gis for a Chinese City, Taipei
abstract: Green space for environmental quality has been emphasized in urbanized area as the global trend of Eco-city. However, green space in developed urban areas is always fragmentary because dense land uses and transportation constructions indeed cause numerous landscape and environmental problems. This study aimed at assessing the spatial structure of green space in Taipei City, a typical developed urban area of the Chinese society, by using of the landscape structure indices. Based on the assessment results, the problems and strategies of greenway network development for Taipei were recommended. The assessment process and developed strategies could contribute to the other Chinese urbanized areas and provide essential basis for future greenway network development.

articleTitle: Maintenance model for series system with multiple vacation and CCF
abstract: In order to achieve the long-run expected rewards and the average downtime of the system with repairman vacations and CCF, a series repairable system consisting of K identical components is studied. By the theories of renewal process and geometric process, the expressions of the long-run expected rewards and the average downtime of the system are studied. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate some theoretical results in this paper. The simulation demonstrates that the optimal policy M = (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>,……N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf>) is existed. It is useful for improving the rewards of company and the safety critical system to make rational use of resources and equipments.

articleTitle: A new adaptive denoising method based on empirical mode decomposition in ultrasonic elastography
abstract: Important soft tissue parameters such as elasticity can be obtained by ultrasonic elastic imaging. Nonetheless, the radio frequency (RF) data received by ultrasonic transducer are always mixed up with noises. In this paper, we develop a new adaptive signal processing method for ultrasonic elastography. The key part of the method is the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) which a method associated with the Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT). EMD method is well suited to analyzing non-stationary and non-linear signal such as biomedical signal. The raw RF data is firstly decomposed into several intrinsic mode functions (IMF) using EMD. Then we analyze its energy distribution and set a to control the signal reconstruction. In the experimental study, the data gathered both from tissue mimicking phantom and volunteer are tested. The results obtained with the new method are in good agreement with those obtained with the conventional one, the interferences are removed effectively especially in the low frequency domain.

articleTitle: Experiment study of buckling-restrained brace and PFD-BRB system
abstract: A new-typed PFD-BRB frictional damping brace system is put forward, whose Pall's frictional damping (PFD) braces are buckling restrained braces (BRB) instead of conventional braces. Static cyclic tests were conducted on steel buckling-restrained braces (BRB) and PFD-BRB system. The results demonstrate a desirable hysteretic behavior and energy absorption capacity. The PFD-BRB system can undergo fully-reversed axial yield cycles, the hysteretic loop of damper is full, and the BRB is also confirmed to have nearly the same yielding stress and ultimate strength under tension and compression. The results calculated by using the ANSYS are similar to those from the tests, which demonstrate the validity of the model and parameters of the brace.

articleTitle: A feasible set swelling homotopy method for general nonlinear programming
abstract: This paper provides a non-interior homotopy method for nonlinear programming with general equality and inequality constraints. Under a weak assumption for a swelled feasible set as well as several basic conditions for nonlinear programming, existence and convergence of a smooth homotopy path are proven. In addition, the starting point is not needed to be a feasible interior point of the original feasible set, and can be chosen freely in a bounded ball region, hence this homotopy method can be implemented conveniently.

articleTitle: The experimental research of transverse gravel pile preventing roadbed freezing
abstract: Lots of methods about the roadbed freezing have been used including drainage method, replacement of roadbed fillings etc. In order to study the result of gravel pile preventing roadbed freezing, the water migration properties of roadbed is tested under the condition of gravel pile. This experiment simulated roadbed freezing, and experiment condition based on the actual situation of Jin-Cheng expressway. In experiment, the horizontal gravel piles were inserted the model to block the rise of capillary water. The experiment results indicate that laying gravel piles transversely with a certain interval in the roadbed soil can effectively block the rise of underwater, thus can control the extent of soil freezing significantly, and can improve the bearing capacity of roadbed. In the existing freezing prevention treatment of roadbed, this is a viable measure of project.

articleTitle: A new feature description based on feature relationships for Gait recognition
abstract: In order to carry on the gait recognition fast and efficiently, a new representation scheme for feature description is proposed in this paper which utilizes nostationarity in the distribution of feature relationships. Firstly, edge pixels of silhouette are considered as low level features, then relationships among those features are characterized by two attributes, which are label of relative direction of two adjacent edge pixels in 8-Neighborhoods region and distance from edge pixel to shape centroid point. Shape of the joint probability function of the two attributes vividly embodies the inter-feature relations and changes following specifically motion pattern. Secondly, we represent each relational distribution as a point in a space of probability functions(SOPF), which can be setup using the well-defined theory of principal component analysis(PCA). Finally, nearest-neighbor classifier is adopted for classification by normalized Euclidean distance(NED). The proposed approach is tested on NLPR gait database. The experiment result demonstrates that the proposed method has achieved a good recognition performance with relatively lower computational cost.

articleTitle: Query schedule algorithm based on deadline and value over data stream system
abstract: Dynamic stream rate of continuous queries, real-time deadline and important value in high critical data stream application is considered in this paper. Firstly, current time stamp, deadline and value are all taken into account in defining a new priority of query operator here. Based on this priority, a value and relative deadline jointly based query scheduling algorithm in different stream rate is proposes. The experimental results indicate that the algorithm raises the hit value radio (HVR) and the success ratio continuous query scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on digital watermark of combination of wavelet and balanced multiwavelet transform
abstract: Based on wavelet and balanced multiwavelet transformation, a watermarking algorithm for gray image is proposed in this paper. First the low frequency area is obtained by decomposing the original image by wavelet, which is further decomposed by balanced multiwavelet. Then the high-frequency coefficients with highest scale are chosen as watermark embedded carrier. The normalization of gray watermarked image has greatly reduced the amount of data. The algorithm adopts additive principle to embed watermark. This algorithm has the advantages of wavelet which can concentrate energy easily in the low frequency area and characters of balanced multiwavelet transform which can distribute energy averagely. This algorithm is generally applicable of the gray watermark system. Experimental results show that this algorithm has a good performance of watermark both in the robustness and the invisibility.

articleTitle: Matlab were used to achieve “fast electronic verification of the theory of relativity” experimental data processing
abstract: A program was designed based on MATLAB. It can have data processing of "theory of relativity of swift electron experiment", it was realized graphical interfaces with guide, and it not only provide convenience to student on data processing but also fit teacher checkout date. This program has characteristic of velocity, preciseness and intuition on data processing. It can run without MATLAB be parceled.

articleTitle: Study of energy conservation between natural and mechanical ventilation in subtropical classroom
abstract: Energy consumption in subtropical classroom is different between natural ventilation and mechanical ventilation. Energy conservation is related with occupants' thermal comfort in these two ventilation systems. This study proposed an electronic questionnaire and instruments to facilitate the continuous monitoring of the state of thermal comfort to investigate the satisfaction level of thermal comfort in the classroom.

articleTitle: Contour segmentation using an improved GAC model
abstract: An improved geodesic active contour model for the detection of object boundaries is presented. A geodesic active contour model is based on an active contour evolving in time. The geodesic active contour model has a serious weakness, that is, it stops at a local minimum where there is a deep concave boundary in an image. The generalized geodesic active contour model makes an active contour convergent to long, thin boundary indentations by introducing a shrinkage force. In this paper, we present an improved geodesic active contour model based on the generalized geodesic active contour with an error term. Experimental results show that the proposed model works successfully for concave objects, it can not only detect object boundaries, but also improve double rings. The convergence rate is faster, the robust is better than the generalized geodesic active contour model.

articleTitle: The seismic damage index of elastomeric pad bearing for bridge
abstract: The seismic damage of bridges always closely related to the state of bearing damage. This paper firstly summarizes the earthquake damage of plate type elastomeric pad bearing for bridges. On this basis, two kinds of restoring force model of bearing taking account of failure are proposed. By earthquake response analysis of a simply-supported section of Baihua Bridge which was damaged during the Wenchuan Earthquake, the reliability of these restoring force models is tested. At last, by the numerical simulation of earthquake response and a number of research results in earthquake resistant codes, a set of preliminary proposals about the seismic damage index of elastomeric pad bearing for bridge is put forward.

articleTitle: The study of an one-dimensional problem of heat conduction with inhomogeneous boundary conditions
abstract: We found an one dimensional problem of heat conduction with inhomogeneous boundary conditions when deducing the Casimir force. In this paper, we gave out its solutions in two cases and discussed its influence on the calculation of Casimir force.

articleTitle: Investigation of metacognitive strategies in writing of English as a second language based on multimedia technology
abstract: The paper investigates and analyzes the relationship between metacognitive strategies and their English capabilities of 90 sophomores of English majors in the writing of English as a second language based on multimedia technology. Quantitative researches are involved in the investigation and the result shows that the frequencies of the subjects' metacognitive strategies in fundamental English writing are at the level of somewhat and often. T-test proves that significant statistical differences exist between successful and less successful learners in their application of metacognitive strategies. Multi-regression analysis shows self-monitoring is the dominant factor affecting the writing of English as a second language. It is apparent that multimedia technology plays an essential role in conducting the research. The study concludes that instructors should actively implement metacognitive strategies in the process of the writing of English as a second language.

articleTitle: Sustainable development of Tujia people's “Diaojiaolou” house in southwest of Chongqing
abstract: "Diaojiaolou" (the Tujia people's traditional houses) are reelusiving in the area of Chongqing's southeast. The paper investigate their basic types (such as I, L, U shape, quadrangle and the other varietal types) and characteristics. The paper also analyses the causes and the wisdoms of "Diaojiaolou" that are the antiquated inhabitancy wisdom because of it was "Chinese beautiful former residence" from the viewpoints of historical origin, the contemporary suitability wisdom from the viewpoints of landform, climate, technique,economy and life style, and the aesthetic wisdom from the viewpoints of the holistic "Fengshui" surroundings and landscape, the image of architecture and the detail decorations. Finaly, the paper conclude that "Diaojiaolou" are worth to be inherited and sustainable developed.

articleTitle: Research on passive evaporation cooling of wet porous material veneered wall structures in hot-humid climatic wind tunnel
abstract: Conducts experiments about different porous material veneered wall structures in hot-humid climatic wind tunnel in typical climate condition of Guangzhou .Based on the double-hest flow meter method, calculates equivalent thermal resistances of wet porous material veneered wall structures in the testing period and obtains heat insulation abilities as well as water absorbing/desorbing capacities .Which provides basic data and evaluation of passive evaporation cooling technique for actual engineering.

articleTitle: Exponential stability for impulsive stochastic functional differential equations
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the pth moment exponential stability of mild solutions to impulsive stochastic functional differential equations. Based on a fixed point approach, sufficient conditions are derived for achieving the required results.

articleTitle: Traffic accidents inference based on Bayesian networks
abstract: Bayesian network is a graphics mode which is used to show joint probability distribution. It reflects the potential dependence relationship among variables. The Bayesian network has already been the powerful tool to solve various uncertain questions. This thesis collects some information about traffic accidents in a city of Anhui Province. According to the information, it gets the Markov network firstly. Secondly, it gives directions to all edges of the Markov network according to the mutual degree of dependence. Finally, it reaches the Bayesian network which shows the relationship of uncertain factors in traffic accidents.

articleTitle: Precompression and dynamic compaction processing technique for the soft soil of Jingangwan B Port cargo area
abstract: Lianyungang Jingangwan international logistics park is constructed in the coastal soft soil, the freight traffic loads is large, high demands is must to the Port cargo area, For consultation in the soft soil in the economy of Port cargo area works, "precompression and dynamic compaction" are used to processing the soft soil of the B Port cargo area, combined with the researches, Proved this method is reasonable and effective,We not only guaranteed the quantity of the reconstruction project, and the cost is lower that the budget, In this article we will share our experiences and techniques.

Author Keywords: soft soil of Port cargo area

articleTitle: Educational reform for higher universities of traditional Chinese medicine in China
abstract: At present, higher universities of traditional Chinese medicine in China are undergoing a period of reform. Chinese higher educational institutions are expected to play an important role in this process, and these situations in medical related universities are more serious, because of more non-medical specialties have been constructed this century. Though the dilemmas which plagued China's past education reformers remain unresolved, there are new developments in the field of educational reform in higher universities of traditional Chinese medicine that are based on four interrelated sections. The first is the speciality setup and discipline development, the second is the teaching method and the ideology of running universities, the third is the teaching staff and condition, and the last one is students overall development and internationalization. This study could provide a strategy to educational and teaching reform in higher universities of traditional Chinese medicine in China.

Author Keywords: higher universities of traditional Chinese medicine

articleTitle: Comparison research on the regular flooding route protocol and directional flooding route protocol in the DTN
abstract: DTN network is a new type of wireless mobile ad hoc networks. In recent years it has been a hotly debated. To enable transfer the packets between nodes efficiently,proposing a directional flooding algorithm: Based on ∝ angle mechanism in DREAM, rectangular mechanism and distance mechanism in LAR for determining to find the domain;General flooding protocol and improved directional flooding protocol are stimulated and compared by NS2 network stimulation tool. Stimulation result show that the directional flooding routing reduce the network overhead, and save network resources,and reduce the delay between the nodes,and improve the network transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Highway dynamic landscape design The path landscape design for the city section path of Chengdu Chengwenqiong highway
abstract: According to the status of highway development in China and the highway landscape design problems, and through the elaboration of the concept of landscape and culture, this article emphasize that highway landscape design should pay attention to local culture, to reflecting the regional, historical, social, national, and other features. By analyzing the landscape design based on the practical case of Chengdu city as part of the road Chengwenqiong, the entire road landscape design is divided into four basic segments and five street nodes, gradually changing from the regular road landscape to natural. Design focus is reflected in two aspects: the harmonious and unified relationship of culture and environment.

articleTitle: An efficient Ray Casting method for terrain visualization
abstract: This paper proposes a novel algorithm for terrain visualization. The algorithm is based on QTA algorithm (Quad tree Atlas Ray Casting). It simplifies the iteration process of the QTA by removing the branch structure of the original algorithm and replacing the rasterization part of it with a simpler and more efficient one. These operations make the algorithm break through the limitation of only fitting for planar terrain. The simplified algorithm also fits for spherical terrain. The experiments show that our algorithm has the highest rendering rate and precision among the newest few algorithms.

articleTitle: Precise delay measurement based on NetMagic
abstract: NetMagic is an open hardware platform facing the internet research and the teaching of network, which is widely applied to the new network technique. The dissertation took the study of technology of precise delay measurement based on NetMagic, then put foreword the idea of carrying timestamp by means of SMAC and brought it into force, moreover, we fulfill its corresponding measurement.

articleTitle: Hole filling method of triangle mesh
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm of hole filling in triangle mesh. There are four steps in this algorithm. First, the hole's boundary information is obtained by the relations of vertex, edge and angle in the triangle mesh. Secondly, the hole is directly filled by triangles according to the order of the angles in the hole. Thirdly, the new triangles with high curvature are divided. Finally, adjust the filled mesh according to the surrounding mesh. Experimental results show the proposed algorithm is efficient and stable, and holes with complicated shape can be filled smoothly.

articleTitle: Performance of TiO2 /AC prepared by sol-get method on Photocatalytic oxidation of the Gaseous Formaldehyde
abstract: The performance on Photocatalytic oxidation of Gaseous Formaldehyde had been explored based on the sol-get preparation of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/AC catalyst. We found the optimum proportion of Tetra-n-butyl.titauate: Solium carbonate anhydrous (V/V) is 1∶4.The best degradation rate of formaldehyde has approached when load quantity of Ti is 19.36 % and 450 °C roasting temperature. The cause maybe is that the mixed form of Rutile and anatase would help for the degradation of formaldehyde by XRD.

articleTitle: RP and SP data-based two-stage railway mode choosing model—Take Suzhou railway i as an example
abstract: The paper analyzed a two-stage choice pattern of transport mode under the circumstance that a new urban railway is going to be introduced to local transportation system. The supporting RP and SP data were obtained from a questionnaire of Suzhou railway. The paper accounted for bias nature of SP data and put forward a false data eliminating method. Then, from data digging in the survey, three interactive functional modules are built to estimate the share rate of transport modes not only in a macro scale but could it forecast the transferring rate. Finally, data aggregating technology is introduced which is proved to do macro-scale forecasting.

articleTitle: Steganographic embedding in JPEG images with visual criterion
abstract: In this paper, we present a new information hiding scheme in JPEG images to achieve a good embedding efficiency considering visual criterion. We construct an embedding impact model based on human visual system, and then assign each cover element a flipping cost which would be the key parameter during the embedding procedure. In this way, the proposed method can minimize the total embedding impact via Viterbi algorithm, meanwhile improve the visual quality of the stego medium. The experimental results later show that the proposed information hiding system can perform well in different types of images.

articleTitle: The performance analysis and research of sorting algorithm based on OpenMP
abstract: On the basis of OpenMP relevant technology, under the condition of combination of OpenMp with the Bubble Sort algorithm, OpenMp scheduling and load balancing issues are discussed. The parallel programming of Bubble Sort algorithm was implemented using the oMPi compiler in the Linux Ubuntu environment.Taking advantage of the program level instrument method to monitor the total time consuming and each thread time overhead under four kinds of scheduling strategy in a parallel program segment. The big difference in these four kinds of scheduling strategy is shown. From the result of the experiment we can see, load balance spending has greater impact on performance than scheduling overhead in the decreasing cycle with small loop body and many iterations. Dynamic scheduling with smaller block should be taken to release load imbalance and the execution efficiency and performance of the algorithm will be enhanced greatly.

articleTitle: The study of the inclining-load method of the landslide model based on numerical calculation
abstract: In landslide model test, it is more commonly used the inclining-load method to realize imitating the destruction state of the slope. This paper will analysis the fracture morphology of the inclining-load method and the strength reduction method based on numerical calculation. Then it can be seen that the destruction state of the inclining-load method and the strength reduction method is coincident. Because of the constraints caused by the similar material, traditional model test is hard to make the stress level of the model be coincident with the prototype. This paper propose the relative stress field to study the similarity of the stress field of the inclining-load method and the centrifuge model test. The results show that the relative stress state of the model is similar with the centrifuge model test when the tilt angle is less than 9°.

articleTitle: Dynamic vehicle routing model and algorithm design
abstract: On Based on the static vehicle routing problems and actual practices, this paper transforms the constants from the static model into dynamic, and deduces the model of dynamic vehicle routing problem, moreover, designs a model algorithm. According to the analysis, the model can be in line with actual needs and easy to solve in practical problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of collage in the post-modern landscape design
abstract: Collage, the core of post-modern art practices, a concept that has been extremely expanded in many areas, has gradually become a popular topic in the field of urban planning and landscape architecture. The popularity of the collage art, is a symbol of our society in which deconstruction and structure coexist, and restrict each other. Many of the landscape design process introduce the concept of “collage”, and show unique ways of thinking and design techniques of collage. This paper has made a thorough overview of the concept of collage, and other concepts and design techniques to achieve the concepts of organic renewal such as collage metaphysical against the city to copy, reconquest of time and n-times cutting and restructuring. The paper takes New Orleans Italy plaza as an example, analyzes post-modern collage design techniques in landscape design in specific applications, especially characteristic elements of collage and conversion of the concept of isomorphism. Consequently,the paper sums up the significance of the design collage, hoping through research and analysis to provide new reference for landscape design.

articleTitle: Shadow detection in ADS40 images using near-infrared information
abstract: Accurate shadow detection is very important for many remote sensing applications. In this paper, we applied an algorithm which takes advantages of combined information from RGB and near infrared images (NIR) to ADS40 data in Swiss national inventory ( NFI). Preliminary experimental results shows that shadows can be successfully detected by this simple methods.

articleTitle: A new parallel difference scheme for solving parabolic equations
abstract: Parallel algorithm for solving partial differential equations, mainly by re-construct a finite difference scheme. So the required solution of the difference can be split into several smaller independent parallel solutions of equations. In this paper, I get a new parallel finite difference scheme by using the format of Saul'yel asymmetric. The method stays as both parallel and absolute stability, so can improve the calculation accuracy. And it is suitable for applications in the MIMD type computer.

articleTitle: New digital teaching platform for physics
abstract: Due to the development of information technology, physics 3D animation multimedia has been introduced to physics teaching process. In order to match the modernization of physics teaching, new digital teaching platform for physics has been developed up by our group. The digital platform contains two individual parts. One is development system platform which can be used to generate physics 3D animation, and the other is presentation system platform which has been designed to present physics 3D animation. The new digital teaching platform is an open and efficient system and it can communicate with 3DMAX and Matlab program. The digital platform enriched college physics teaching resource and it has been employed to 18 university of China since 2009. Statistics showed that it can stir up students' interesting and it is convenient for physics teachers to explain physics concept. Furthermore, digital platform is easy to use and convenient to control teaching process physics teachers.

articleTitle: Throughput analysis of IEEE 802.11 DCF in presence of hidden nodes
abstract: The paper proposes an analytical model, which deals with the throughput of 802.11 DCF in presence of hidden nodes under saturation condition. Different scenarios are used in simulation to validate it, and the results show that the model is fairly accurate.

articleTitle: Research of steep coal seam mining methods based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: This paper adopt fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to evaluate the mining methods for complex difficult steep coal seam. Using FAHP to calculate weight vectors of each assessment factors, in order to get more real reaction of sorting relationship between various factors. Then calculate evaluation scores for various mining methods by establishing the mining methods fuzzy comprehensive appraisal model. Finally, set up the mining methods appraisal model based on the conditions of Carboniferous coal seam on +570 level in Qian juntai mine of Mu Chengjian coal mine. The result shows that flexible shield mining method and bow pseudo-inclined cantilever support mining method apply to the two conditions of steep and inclined of the inverted “S” type seam. In engineering practice, the two mining method achieved the desired objective and get good economic benefits. This research will provides a reference for similar coal seam mining in the future.

articleTitle: Study on the human settlements of Chinese mining city
abstract: The concept and the particularity of the human settlements in Chinese mining city are described. The analysis of present situation and existing problems of these cities are also introduced. Referenced to the success of foreign mining city, the emphasis of article is to discuss the development strategy on the three subsystem of society, economy and ecology. Meanwhile, it also tries to find out the right way of sustainable development of Chinese mining city on human settlements.

articleTitle: Existence and successive iteration of positive solutions for some second-order four-point boundary value problem with p-Laplacian on time scales
abstract: In this paper, existence of positive solutions for some second-order four-point boundary value problems with p-Laplacian are investigated by applying a monotone iteration method. At the end of paper, we give an example of main result.

articleTitle: Weighted approximation of functions by Bernstein operators on the semi axis
abstract: This paper gives estimates for weighted approximation of functions/on the semi axis (0,+ ∞), where f can be singular at the origin, by means of Bernstein-type sequences. Results in present paper extends the result of Mastroianni and Occorsio[1].

articleTitle: The impact of low carbon technology innovation policy on China's macro economy
abstract: Basing on CGE modeling theory and technology, this article studies the impact of the low-carbon technology innovation policy on the macro economy. Simulation result shows that low-carbon technology innovation policy significantly reduces the intensity of carbon emissions and optimizes the industrial structure. In the short term, the products price rising is part of the industrial output decrease and exports decline, while in the long term, the incentive policies are helpful for the long-term GDP increase.

articleTitle: Predicting wet gluten content of winter wheat through remote sensing method based on HJ-1A/1B images
abstract: The purpose of this study is to further improve the accuracy of predicting winter wheat quality with remote sensing, and to enhance the prediction mechanism. In order to predict wet gluten content (WGC) in winter wheat using HJ-1A/1B images, The experiment was carried out in Jiangsu regions during 2010 winter wheat growth season. Based on HJ-1A/1B image, synchronous or quasi-simultaneous ground observations of SPAD value, biomass, leaf area index(LAI), leaf nitrogen content(LNC) and grain quality parameters of winter wheat at jointing and booting stage. Firstly, this study analyzed the relationships between WGC and remote sensing variables, and between growth parameters and satellite remote sensing variables. Secondly, the quantitative models were established and evaluated to predict WGC. Finally, the indirect model of predicting WGC based on remote sensing variable and biomass was compared to the direct model based on only remote sensing variable. The results showed that: The relationship between WGC and remote sensing variables was more significant at booting stage than at jointing stage. At booting stage, WGC presented a more significant correlation with normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) than other remote sensing variables. At last, a direct model for predicting WGC was established with only NDVI. At the same time, biomass in this period also showed a higher correlation with WGC. Based on NDVI and biomass, an indirect model of predicting WGC also was established. The indirect and direct models were evaluated with 25 independent samples by the determination coefficient (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) with 0.766 and 0.674, the root mean square error(RMSE) with 1.81% and 2.59%, respectively. The indirect model based on NDVI and biomass performed better to predict winter wheat WGC than the direct model based on only NDVI, and obtained the higher accuracy by 30% than the direct model. It is concluded that the research can provide an effective way to improve the accuracy of predicting wheat quality based on aerospace remote sensing, and contribute to large-scale application and promotion of the research results.

articleTitle: Research on speed limit of highway in Vissim
abstract: There are frequent accidents at the Liuxia section of the highway around Hangzhou City, that is from the 68th kilometer to the 75th kilometer.
