We consider creating a model of the road in Vissim, a program of traffic simulation, collecting the parameters of vehicles and analyzing the data in Matlab. Taking the standard deviation of vehicle speed as main referred index, the speed of vehicles at the section is limited, where the standard deviation is high.

articleTitle: Intelligent SpaceWire bus controller driver design and implementation based on VxWorks
abstract: This paper describes driver design principles under the real-time multitasking operating system VxWorks, and presents the implementation process and work steps in detail. It takes Intelligent SpaceWire bus controller as an example to introduce the hardware structure of the controller SpaceWire, and present key steps to realize the driver.

articleTitle: Study of flare ribbon separation and magnetic flux density
abstract: We have studied the correlation between the flare ribbon separation speed and the magnetic flux density in a two ribbon flare. The peak separation speed is up to about 260 km s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in a weak magnetic field region, while it is about 30 km s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in a strong magnetic field region. The separation speed is negatively correlated with the longitudinal magnetic field, and the negative correlation is the strongest at the early stage of the flare, and the weakest at position of the HXR source.

articleTitle: Experimental research on reutilization of malysite resource in sludge
abstract: The extensive application of malysite flocculants inevitably brings about the massive production of malysite-containing sludge. The recycle of malysite flocculants can not only make the sludge reduced in volume and reused as resource, but also solve the problems of environment protection. The research object of our study is malysite-containing sludge. The technology of recycling malysite under the synergistic effect of acidification and ultrasonic is also discussed in our study. Experimental results show that the recovery rate of malysite raises accordingly with the concentration of [H]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> increasing. Under the influence of ultrasound, the average particle diameter of the sludge is decreased, the reaction rate is increased, the recovery rate of malysite and the reduction of total solid are enhanced. The malysite recovery rate and the total solid reduction is in a linear relationship under the effect of acidification, the effect of ultrasonic, the synergistic effect of acidification and ultrasonic.

articleTitle: Producing text and graphics of big screen in a indoor stadium based on AUTHERWARE
abstract: The big screen of a indoor stadium is mainly used to show score in sports game. This paper introduces the specific methods of using AUTHERWARE multimedia application software to realize the application software of big screen which has interactive function, including the construction of the whole framework and the division and the function of every branch framework, and introduces the key technologies systematically, and then gives specific procedures of using AUTHERWARE multimedia production software to realize the big screen display in detail. it have certain practical value When we make text and images of indoor and outdoor big screen.

articleTitle: The testing methods on fracture toughness of the reservoir ice layer in different temperature and loading rate
abstract: Referenced the fracture mechanics theories, based on the consideration of the destruction characteristics, the cementation force of ice in the ice and fictitious crack, the wing crack fracture model of base layer of reservoir Ice Layer. the fracture toughness, is the fracture mechanics performance of ice material, which must be measured by experiment It is the experimental method of fracture mechanics used in this paper. These ice specimens on the different thickness were tested with fracture mechanics method at low-temperature testing machine, to obtain the fracture flexibility change rate of ice body which contains pre-crack and the values of under different conditions of T and Ṗ, which could determine fracture toughness G̃<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</inf> of ice body during the ice pressure generated, It is a meaningful attempt to research the anti-frost ice layer of reservoir in seasonal permafrost regions, and provides a reference for stability design.

articleTitle: Comparison study of seismic design methods for subway structures
abstract: A variety of seismic design methods for subway structures, which are present popular in China, are introduced, including the response displacement method (RDM), modified cross section racking deformation method (MCSRDM), the response acceleration method (RAM) and the pushover analysis method (PAM). A comparison calculation was then made for the same typical subway structural cross-section under the same typical geological conditions in Beijing by use of all above methods and dynamic time history analysis method. It was shown that the calculated results gained from the RDM, whose coefficient of dynamic subgrade reaction was based on Japanese railway earthquake-resistance designing code or static finite element, the MCSRDM, the RAM and the PAM were close to that from the dynamic analysis method. It provided some reference for practical seismic design of subway structures in the future.

articleTitle: An approximate solution for single pendulum cycle based on evolutionary algorithm
abstract: Through an approximate treatment for Sine function based on the "the local constant law", a simple pendulum cycle model was constructed. By using evolution algorithm to solve the parameter of the model, it obtained a new high-precision pendulum cycle formula that has explicit physical significance and has concise form, its absolute error achieves 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> order of magnitude.

articleTitle: On spatial definition of metropolitan area in Ningbo
abstract: Metropolis area is a new type of human settlement, established when the urbanization develops unto a certain stage. It can be described as the highest form of urbanization development by far. Under the new trend of urbanization in the world, and in the context of the acceleration of Yangtze River Delta integration, to construct Ningbo metropolitan area bears new practical significance. This paper firstly describes the background of the construction of Ningbo metropolitan area. And then the author conducts quantitative calculation and qualitative analysis on the spatial range of Ningbo Metropolitan through probing into three indicators, namely economic distance, gravity and the gravitational field strength. Next, the author also illustrates the multi-center spatial structure of Ningbo metropolitan area based on analyzing the intercity interaction within the area.

articleTitle: Research and application of the valuation method for coal and rock digital modeling
abstract: Based on deterministic data of drills and other geophysical information, common interpolation methods were studied based on given geological information to speculate unknown spatial information. And summarized the conditions of proper application and advantages and disadvantages of trend surface, weighted least-square fitting, spline function, linear interpolation of triangulation, multi-faceted function, inverse distance square and mobile fitting. It is proposed that the effective optimized methods of parameter selection combined different existing conditions of coal-bed and rock and distribution characteristics of given data. During applying either multi-faceted function or mobile fitting, the article analyzed main factors of causing pathological equation groups and made use of mathematical methods to improve the distortion phenomenon of elevation value. Taking 1# coal of Dalianhe surface coal mine it as an example, we apply the above interpolation methods to analyze and compare their limitations and superiority, and use the cross validation test for verifying. The above research results show that triangulation linear interpolation has strong stability, especially suitable to contain orebody of fault.The root mean square is relatively the least.

articleTitle: Research on interactive CAPTCHA mechanism based on RIA
abstract: In order to better ensure the Web security, we designed a CAPTCHA mechanism. It took the RIA areas flexibility combined with interaction design field and used to CAPTCHA design field. This kind of mechanism improves the safety of the CAPTCHA from four aspects. First, we used interactions of man - machines; Second, by comparing the server-side SessionID, random ID and flag variable, it prevents malicious person from bypassing the authentication procedures; Third, it adopt RemoteObject communication mode; Fourth, client's program implemented by Flex. The mechanism well guarant that human can easily through the CAPTCHA test, but computer cannot pass the test.

articleTitle: Discussion on the rail site area planning based on the new lifestyle
abstract: With changes of the society, the lifestyles of the people are in constant evolution. Nowadays, The people expect the life to be comfortable, convenient, fashion and elegant, healthy and environmental protection, enjoy the life. Inevitably, the new lifestyles characteristics will stimulate new demands. Based on the new lifestyles, the article mainly discusses the rail site area planning aimed at the angle of the function orientation and region characteristic, landscape, traffic organization, from the living, working, transportation, consumption, and leisure modes.

articleTitle: Exploration into reflective teaching of middle school English teachers in the ethnic and remote regions of Guangxi in China
abstract: Professional development of foreign languages teachers rely heavily on cultivating and improving the awareness of reflecting on their own teaching. This paper investigates reflective teaching of secondary school English teachers in the ethnic and remote regions of Guangxi in China. The result shows that few teachers there have much knowledge about reflective teaching and none of them have practiced reflective teaching on purpose. For bettering the poor situation, the author provides three suggestions.

articleTitle: Thinking of indoor environmental problems
abstract: This article describes the source and harm of indoor environment pollution, put forwards specific methods and measures to solve the problems of indoor environment, strongly initiates the philosophy of green design and green dwellings so as to reduce the indoor pollution and avoid the damage.

articleTitle: The method of processing the uncertainty knowledge on incomplete domain
abstract: There are many reasons to cause the uncertainty of knowledge. The method of rough sets can be used to process the uncertainty knowledge caused by rough approximation's boundary on the given domain. For some tremendous domains such as n-dimensional space, people may not fully understand and master of all information but only know some of information about it. It is difficult to get the knowledge of incomplete domain with using the limited information. With the concepts of rough membership function and rough inclusion, a method was proposed to process the uncertainty knowledge that it can be get some part knowledge of unknown sets with knowledge of known sets on the incomplete domain.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of softphone based on softswitch framework
abstract: Acted as the communication terminal equipment, softphone can realize communications between PC to PC and PC to PSTN. Meanwhile, with the development of the next generation network (NGN), softswitch has been widely deployed in network. Based on the facts above, this paper discusses the design and implementation of a softphone based on softswitch framework. Firstly, this paper presents the concept of a softphone and SIP. Secondly, it analyses the function of a softphone and designs the architecture of it. Finally, it introduces an implementation of each module of a softphone, including: main control module, SIP signaling process module and media process module.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of performance optimization of cluster resource database
abstract: In large scale cluster system, cluster resource management system is an important part. The data of cluster resource management system related to cluster are stored in resource database. To improve the efficiency of the entire cluster system the operation of the cluster can be optimized by adjusting the performance of the cluster resource database. In this paper, to develop performance tuning tool for cluster resources database is proposed. The design ideas and design processes of performance tuning tool for cluster resources database are illustrated in detail by MySQL database under Linux environment. Finally, the cluster resource database performance tuning is achieved through three interface functions: performance analysis, access to parameters and parameter adjustments.

articleTitle: Research on the people-oriented bicycle customerization system
abstract: In this paper, the method of building the bicycle customization system is introduced as an example according to the relationship between the characteristic parameters of the human body and the bicycle frame structure.So that the customization system really be people-oriented and serviced to every customer, to meet customer requirements about individuation customization and mass customization.

articleTitle: Calculation of electronic structure and photoelectric properties of rutile VO2
abstract: The electronic structure and photoelectric properties of VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, such as dielectric constant, absorption constant, refractive index, and conductance were calculated by using the method of SCC-DV-X-ECM. A broad band on top of which located the fermi energy level was formed by the combination of the 2p energy band of O and 3d energy band of V. The energy levels under the Fermi Energy Level were occupied by electrons, most of which made contribution to the ability of conduction. Therefore, the VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> showed metal features. There were two peaks in the figure of the imaginary part of dielectric constant versus the frequency of incident light: The peak around 0.8 eV was mainly stimulated by electronic intraband transition, while the peak between 4-7 eV was mainly stimulated by electronic band-to-band transition. The calculated results of refractive index and extinction coefficient consist with the experiment results.

articleTitle: Calculation of structure coefficient in design of penstocks as subentry coefficient
abstract: Using Probability-based Limit States Design Method, according to subentry coefficient design expression, to carrying capacity limit state, designing expression of five subentry coefficient will be adopted. In the condition that the distribution of water weight in a pipe is log-normal distribution, and the maximum distribution is extreme □ distribution, Structure Coefficient in design expression was ascertained by the engineering experience calibration method and by the reliability analysis method.

articleTitle: An epidemic model on evolving networks
abstract: The evolving networks are extensive in many real world networks, which are characterized by rearrangements of the links between nodes. In this paper we develop an SEIRS epidemic models on evolving networks using a general ordinary differential equation (ODE) model, and further the basic re production number is obtained. The basic reproduction number in epidemic systems is the critical condition which determines the spread of the disease. The analysis of the evolving SEIRS networks show that different rewiring process can get different thresholds of system.

articleTitle: Simulation research on collector plate structure of solar air collector
abstract: This paper adopts the method of Fluent software simulation and simulates research the thermal performance of a solar air collector's with porous and fold lined. Changes in the structure of the collector plates whether the openings, folded plate and the plate hole collector aspects to impact performance are discussed. In order to have comparable, to simulate in the intensity of solar radiation, wind speed and imported air supply means, collector plates and glass cover settings such as radiation carried out under identical conditions. By simulating the temperature distribution, flow distribution of the collector and the internal air, it can be obtain the conclusions: in the collector plates to keep the same shape, hole board than non-hole plate uneven temperature distribution significantly, and local overheating, non-hole lead was the heat collector plate collector thermal efficiency with the collector plate lower than the hole; the hole in the collector plate to keep the same rate, opening flat and folded plate openings due to air within the collector differences in flow pattern on the plate led to overheating, increasing the external environment, heat loss, solar collector performance decreases.

articleTitle: Application of FMODM in the bench blasting parameter optimization
abstract: Fuzzy Multi-objective Decision-Making (FMODM) was applied to select blasting parameters and establish fuzzy matrix for the objective functions; minimum weighting relative deviation distance method was adopted to optimize the design scheme which not only agrees with the engineering requirements, but also can cut the cost as much as possible. The optimized scheme was compared with an actual engineering data and it is indicated that the optimal parameters obtained by this scheme are basically in accordance with the engineering practice.

articleTitle: Test study on domestic wastewater treatment by Coagulate-MBR
abstract: To enhance the membrane bioreactor treatment effect, improve the sludge characteristics, parallel compared experiments of the submerged membrane bioreactor of adding coagulant (PAFC) and the normal membrane dealing with domestic wastewater was carried out. The results showed that coagulation membrane bioreactor was significantly higher treatment effect than normal membrane bioreactor, the removal efficiency of coagulation-MBR on COD, NH3-N was 92.04%, 96.55%, the normal membrane bioreactor was 90.26% 91.74% As can be seen from the operating pressure, sludge microscope photographs, after adding PAFC, membrane fouling was prevented effectively.

articleTitle: Convergence analysis of the modified P1 - nonconforming finite element for a class of nonlinear parabolic equation
abstract: In this paper, convergence analysis of the modified P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> - nonconforming finite element for a class of nonlinear parabolic equation is discussed. By use of the special properties of the element, the optimal error estimates are obtained without Ritz projection.

articleTitle: The exploration of key technology about Interactive multimedia courseware design
abstract: The design of interactive multimedia courseware will enable multimedia teaching to combine with the traditional teaching, and enhance the flexibility and interactivity of multimedia teaching. The design process of interactive multimedia courseware has been presented, structure design of the courseware has been analysed, the interactive design of the courseware has been discussed, and the policy and realization of the interactive design has been presented. Two-way interaction must be thought much of in the teaching process, so as to make modern teaching methods to play the greatest benefit, to obtain the best teaching results.

articleTitle: A point feature-based cylindrical image mosaic method
abstract: A cylindrical image mosaic method based on Harris corner feature is proposed in the paper. Firstly, the sequence of photographs taken around 360 degree is projected to cylinder coordinate system, and then the Harris corners are detected by an improved Harris corner detecting algorithm. After the NCC (Normalized Cross Correlation) corner matching algorithm performed a rough match, an improved RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) algorithm is applied twice to remove the mismatched points as far as possible to improve the correct matching ratio. Finally, the image mosaic and fusion are accomplished according to the registration result. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has achieved a well result.

articleTitle: Chinese university students' English learning satisfaction evaluation
abstract: With the Chinese higher education becoming more popular, English teaching in Chinese higher institutions is facing a series of new problems and challenges. It has to be reformed in all aspects to accommodate the economic social development and international communication. Chinese university students' English learning satisfaction is the important measure of the quality of college English. This essay evaluates Chinese university students' English learning satisfaction by using the sample study of certain Chinese universities so that targeted advice and suggestions could be provided for resources allocation, method adjustment and quality improvement of English teaching and learning in Chinese universities.

articleTitle: A modified color image segmentation method based on FCM and region merging
abstract: A new color image segmentation algorithm based on histogram, FCM clustering, and region merging is proposed in this paper. First, the RGB space is transformed to HSV space, and the image is divided into non-singular points and singular points in accordance with the saturation. Second, characteristics of the image pixel are mapped to the one-dimensional histogram, we can determine the number of the cluster and the initial cluster center thought peaks selection algorithm, non-singular points and singular points are separately clustering by FCM,. Finally, we merger regions by image spatial information to eliminate the scattered small area after clustering, which overcomes the over-segmentation problem in FCM, and increases the ability of anti-noise. Experimental results show that this method not only can make the partition consistent with the human visual psychology, but also overcome the singularity of HSV space, and significantly reduce computational complexity and greatly improve the speed of the algorithm, realize automatically dividing images without manual intervention.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation reach of effect of external wind on flue gas movement pattern in high-rise building vertical shaft
abstract: Using theoretical analysis and numerical simulation for different wind direction and speed conditions, this paper studied the flue gas flow pattern within and outside continuous side opening shaft. It was found that when the building opened in windward side, external wind could produce dynamic pressure difference on the continuous opening ,which made opposite effect with static pressure difference that caused by temperature difference on flue gas flow pattern . There exists the critical wind speed and time that make the flue gas flow pattern changed from previous state to opposite. Negative pressure outside the Leeward openings enhanced stack effect, and favored smoke exhaust under fire conditions. External wind played a close role in the shaft when the openings were in sideward side, and not conducive to effective discharge of smoke. But it has little effect on flue gas movement when the openings in leeward and sideward of the building.

articleTitle: Multi-channel Wireless Sensor Network MAC protocol based on dynamic route
abstract: MAC protocol is an important topic in Wireless Sensor Network, which plays a decisive role in network performance. The current MAC protocol has many problems such as highly dependent on time synchronization, low throughputs or data delay. With multi-channel allocation strategy, the paper put forward a dynamic route allocation algorithm, which reduced data delay and increased the throughputs. The simulation experiment show that the algorithm improves the throughputs, reduces the collision and data delay.

articleTitle: The approach of detecting LDoS attack based on correlative parameters
abstract: Low-rate Denial of Service (LDoS) attacks and TCP flows are be modeled in the time and frequency domain for the purpose of analyzing the signatures and extracting LDoS attack's period T and length L. A simulated LDoS attack signal is constructed based on the extracted parameters of T and L. The correlation between the signal of simulated LDoS attack and the hybrid signal (TCP flow plus LDoS attack) is calculated. To compare the correlation value with a detect threshold, which is determined through experiments. If the correlation value is exceeds the threshold, the LDoS attack is determined. The proposed method has been tested totally 1500 times in NS-2 environment and 200 times in real network environment with different parameters of T and L. Experimental results show that the false negative alarm rate PFN is less than 1.1%, the false positive alarm rate Pτρ are less than 0.8%, and the detect rate PD is more than 98%.

articleTitle: A study on the correlation coefficient matching algorithm of general digital stereo under the approximate epipolar line constraints
abstract: By analyzing the features of general digital image and calculating the deviation of epipolar line, a correlation coefficient matching algorithm is proposed. In this paper, we make a summery of the particularity of general digital stereo, analysis the deviation of the corresponding epipolar line, and provide a matching method under the epipolar line constraint. It is proved by experiments that this algorithm can conquer image deformation well and has a higher matching accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Research of main memory database data organization
abstract: Main Memory Database(MMDB) for its fast data access capability, it is more suitable for fast response and high transaction throughput applications than Disk-Resident Database(DRDB). Especially, as the price of random access memory dropping and a large number of real-time applications disappeared, MMDB becomes hot research topic in the database. It analyzed the difference between MMDB and DRDB in terms of system characteristics, the algorithm targets and index structure, etc; Then it introduces some of the data organization which used in MMDB, highlight several typical types of index structures; At last, it analyzed the algorithm's time efficiency and space efficiency and given the prospects of future research directions.

articleTitle: Grey correlation analysis of bearing capacity of rock-socketed pile in soft soil area
abstract: The bearing capacity of rock-socketed pile in soft soil area is affected by many kinds of uncertainty factors, which is a complex grey analysis program. The influencing factors of bearing capacity of rock-socketed in soft soil area are analyzed in some different kinds of grey correlation by grey system theory such as pile diameter, pile length, socket length, the length to diameter ratio, the socket length to diameter ratio, rock strength and rock coefficient of weathering. The grey correlation analysis is combined with the statistical data of 76 rock-socketed piles which have different kinds of features in soft soil area of Zhejiang province. The paper has get the corresponding ranking results of various factors and found out the corresponding influence advantage factors of bearing capacity of rock-socketed pile in soft soil area, which have reflected the bearing performance of rock-socketed pile in soft soil area in some degree. The results can provide important reference for the future theoretical research and design application of rock-socketed pile in soft soil area, and show that the grey correlation method is effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Designing a restful question bank service in cloud
abstract: Online question bank systems play a critical role in evaluating learners' achievement. For easy sharing and reusing, there is a standard for encoding question banks' pedagogical contents and presentational format. However, access interfaces to most online question banks are proprietary, such that the offered contents are available to limited users only and difficult to utilize and circulate. SOAP-based Web service to some extent solves the openness issue by conforming to existing standards. To enrich contents of question banks and facilitate sharing them among educators, it is of great importance to build easy-accessible as well as open question banks. This article proposes a method for designing a question bank in cloud according to the representational state transfer architectural style. Accordingly, the question bank can allows instructors and students using various devices to access online assessment resources under various learning circumstances.

articleTitle: Solving initial value problem of ordinary differential equations by Monte Carlo method
abstract: Monte Carlo method was a new numerical method different from traditional method. It was based on probability and statistics theory, so it was also called as random sampling or statistical test method. In this paper, on the basis of Monte Carlo method, a new way to solve initial value problem of ordinary differential equations was presented. The authors have given the calculating process in detail. Some calculation samples, such as one-order ordinary differential equations, implicit second order differential equation and Vander Pol equation, showed the exactitude and efficiency of the method. And all the relative errors were less than 1%.

articleTitle: A new scheme for side information generation in DVC by using optical flow algorithm
abstract: A new side information (SI) generation scheme based on optical flow algorithm is proposed. The optical flow algorithm improves the SI quality by obtaining a higher accurate motion vector. Simulation results show that the SI accuracy, as well as the RD performance of DVC, has been improved significantly compared with SMV scheme in the case of low motion sequences.

articleTitle: An efficient routing protocol for heterogeneous wireless ad hoc networks
abstract: There are lots of devices with different power in the network. This phenomenon may be nothing in the wired network, but in the wireless network that would be a serious problem. Most of the traditional routing protocols assume that the link is symmetric. We found that heterogeneity network performance will be severely affected. We give new routing protocol that employs adaptive technique to the MANET routing protocols. In this routing protocol, nodes can sense the power to determine whether to forward packets or not. By avoiding dependence on periodic beaconing, this method requires low overhead and delay. Performance results show that technique improve performance in heterogeneous environments.

articleTitle: Teaching software development of Electrical Machinery & Towage based on MATLAB GUI
abstract: According to the course teaching features and its' fundamentality in electric specialized subject of Electrical Machinery & Towage, a visual teaching software is developed based on MATLAB GUI. This paper provides a detailed introduction of the software's function and illustrates the theory and scheme of the design. The graphical interfaces design of static and dynamic characteristics for DC motor is illustrated as an example, and the visual effect is helpful to the course teaching.

articleTitle: Sustainable hydropower development: International perspective and challenges for China
abstract: The Hydropower Sustainability Assessment Protocol proposed by the International Hydropower Association is aim to represent the latest understanding and view of hydropower sustainability on behalf of the hydropower sectors around the world. Main principle and general contents of the Protocol are introduced in this paper at first. Then the references of the IHA Protocol to China are analyzed by combing the principles of the Protocol and main problems exist in the development of hydropower in China. The hydropower sectors in China should learn the concept of sustainable hydropower development, emphasize the environment protection measures and establish benefit sharing mechanism in the hydropower utilization. Main challenges of the sustainable hydropower for China are to meet the demand of national energy strategy for hydropower, protect the aquatic ecosystem in exploitation and solve social problems represented by resettlement. The IHA Protocol is helpful to identify the problems and find solutions for the challenges.

articleTitle: Adaptive concepts for mobile cartography
abstract: This paper introduces an adaptive and dynamic generation of visualisations for mobile users on the basis of SVG. We present the concept adaptive visualisation, i.e. the personalisation of the presentation mode to the current user as well as the situation, the device. We will put emphasis on the adaptation of the presentation form and demonstrate how to use SVG for delivering adapted content to mobile users. We will briefly address the dynamic generation of SVG files from database content, depending on user, context, and constraints. SVG seems well suited for the goal of presenting dynamic and adapted geoinformation content to mobile users, since it offers a lot of useful features for this task.

articleTitle: Detection of OSAHS using only time-domain property of snoring signal
abstract: Polysomnography (PSG) is the standard method for obstructive sleep apnea hypopnea syndrome (OSAHS) diagnosis in medical, but the shortcomings in it have pushed many researchers to find a more convenient and effective way to detect OSAHS. With this purpose, a new technique for OSAHS assessment is proposed in this paper. It combined the properties of respiratory events with an ingenious dynamic threshold endpoint detection method to realize the automatic detection of respiratory events, and then obtained the apnea hypopnea index (AHI) to determine the patient's condition. The method was evaluated on the whole night snoring signal of 34 patients. Compared the results with those monitored by PSG, it has shown that the accuracy of this method can reach above 90%, at the same time, it has the advantages in low cost, high speed, easy to operate and so on.

articleTitle: Design of sound card electrocardiosignal acquisition system based on LabVIEW
abstract: Sound card as DAQ card has low-price, high performance and flexible-system such virtues. However, because the sound card is only for the collection of sound signals (20Hz~20kHz), it's unsatisfactory for electrocardiosignals that contain low frequency components. So, this paper applied LabVIEW programming environment to realize a design proposal of electrocardiosignal acquisition measurement system that match the frequency of the PC sound card based on the standard amplitude modulation (AM) theory in common computer with sound card. Practical application shows that the signal acquisition technology based on sound card, especially combining with virtual instruments and modulation has broad prospects.

articleTitle: Multi-scale bilateral grid for image tone mapping
abstract: Edge-preserving smooth filter has been widely used in tone mapping for HDR images. In this paper, we propose a new optimistic tone mapping method which combines bilateral grid filtering and multi-scale base-detail decomposition. We compare our method with four other filtering methods by computing the PSNR, MSE and timing to demonstrate the advantage of ours. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in the context of LDR and HDR tone mapping.

articleTitle: The application review of GARCH model
abstract: There are some volatility clustering in the time series, especially in the financial time series, from the proposition of ARCH model to the later development and reproduction, it has resolved many such problems in a lot of fields extensive involves: funds, stock prices, futures, crude oil prices, GDP, foreign exchange administration in bank, inflation rate, foreign exchange rate, etc. This paper mainly introduces the huge development system of GARCH family and reviews their applications.

articleTitle: Fuzzy prime filters in lattice effect algebra
abstract: We introduce the definition of fuzzy prime filter of lattice ordered effect algebra and investigate their properties.

articleTitle: Solid texture synthesis based on 2D exemplar and procedural noise
abstract: Compared with 2D texture method, solid texturing can achieve better realistic results. A novel solid texture synthesis method based on 2D exemplar and procedural noise is presented. First, the movement path for exemplar in 3D space is designed using procedural noise. Next, all the pixels of exemplar are used to color the 3D space through their trajectory so that the solid texture is synthesized. Experimental results show that our method is able to efficiently synthesize 3D texture to simulate the natural properties of the given 2D exemplar. The method is simple and stable, and takes on a few seconds on an ordinary PC.

articleTitle: Soil-water characteristics of unsaturated undisturbed loess under isotropic compression condition
abstract: Using triaxial apparatus for unsaturated soils, the isotropic compression tests at constant water content are conducted on unsaturated undisturbed loess in Xi'an under different water contents. The maximum of net confining pressure is 400 kPa. Matric suction is measured by an elevated all round air pressure and with measured pore-water pressure under zero-applied stress and applied stress. Influences of net confining pressure on matric suction characteristics of unsaturated undisturbed loess are determined and illustrated during isotropic compression at constant water content. The formula of soil-water characteristics of unsaturated undisturbed loess is obtained to determine the matric suction under zero-applied stress. Experimental results show that the influence of net confining pressure on matrix suction is related to water content. When water content is smaller than shrinkage limit, the relationship between matrix suction and net confining pressures is different from that larger than Shrinkage limit. The influence of net confining pressure is large when water content is between shrinkage limit and plastic limit, and it is slight when water content is smaller than shrinkage limit or larger than plastic limit. The relation between matric suction and degree of saturated related to net confining pressure with water content smaller than shrinkage limit is different from that related to water content. The influence of degree of saturated related to net confining pressure on matric suction is much smaller than that related to water content. Net confining pressure has relatively large influence on the relation between degree of saturated and matric suction. When net confining pressure is smaller than 400kPa, its influence on he relation between water content and matric suction is negligible, and the soil-water characteristics of undisturbed loess is illustrated by the logarithm function relation between water content and matric suction under zero-applied stress.

Author Keywords: isotropic compression test at constant water content

articleTitle: Improved error concealment method with weighted boundary matching algorithm
abstract: It is challenging to achieve graceful quality degradation in an error-prone environment,since channel errors can drastically deteriorate the quality of the video, classical error concealment schemes commonly utilize surrounding correctly reconstructed frame or motion information for concealment. In this paper, An efficient spatio-tempral boundary matching algorithm (STBMA) is proposed to recover the lost MV in the lost frames. We apply a weighted motion estimation scheme by minimizing a distortion function which exploits both spatial and temporal smoothness properties of the video signals. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can recover better quality images compared with classic boundary matching algorithim (BMA).

articleTitle: Adaptive identification of circle targets in image measurement system
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive algorithm for circle target identification is proposed in the light of the real-time demand in practical image measurement systems. Firstly, the image is segmented using an adaptive dynamic threshold method. Then, least square method is applied to sub-pixel circle detection. The proposed scheme is simple and powerful. It can meet the real-time demand of on-site test and can precisely locate circle targets, which provides reliable assurance for measurement of moving objects. Finally, some experiments are done to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive fast motion estimation based on probabilistic prediction and Object Grouping
abstract: Conventional fast search motion estimation algorithms use a heuristically based approach to determine their search window. By making use of temporal correlation between the current frame and the past frame and spatial correlation between the neighborhood blocks, the proposed algorithm defines a search window on the basis of probabilistic prediction. Usage of Object Grouping results in an improved performance, when combined with probabilistic prediction.

articleTitle: Research on meteorological data display based on G/S model
abstract: Meteorological data display involves real-time gathering and processing for various kinds of spacial and non-spacial data that is complex and massive, which makes high demand for the data handling ability and mechanism of the client. The existing client access mechanism, C/S mode is lack of uniform exchange standard, B/S mode is not available for handling spacial data, and consequently, it is difficult to realize an intuitionistic and real-time display for the massive and complicated meteorological data. According to the concept of 'information-gathering, service-polymerization' while combining the ArcGIS geographic processing technology, this article proposes a kind of meteorological data display mechanism on the basis of G/S mode, which is based on HGML uniform exchange standard. This research will provide technical assistance for meteorological data display and it has great significance for the popularization application of meteorological service.

articleTitle: Fitting relations on sets and applications
abstract: In this paper, the concept of fitting relations on sets is introduced and generalized. The intrinsic characterizations of them are obtained. In addition, we give an algebraic characterization of posets for which the relation ≰ is fitting.

articleTitle: Design and development of multimedia classroom automation management system
abstract: As for the present problems of multimedia classroom management, multimedia classroom automation management system has been developed. First, the system structure and principle are discussed in this paper. After that, the function and design method of each software and hardware modules are introduced in detailed. Finally, the advantages of this system are summarized.

articleTitle: Self-organization of highly ordered mosaic structure of porous silicon at long anodic etching of p-type silicon in the electrolyte with internal current source
abstract: Self-organization of highly ordered mosaic structure of porous Si at long anodic etching of p-Si (100) in electrolyte with internal source of the current is observed. Sizes of the nanocrystallites islets of porous Si, the period of their location and self-organization of the mosaic structure of porous silicon are defined by the effect of forces of elastically-deformation, defect-deformation and capillary-fluctuation that exist at the interface of electrolyte/porous Si/c-Si/ in process of pores formation. Process of spontaneous formation of mosaic structure por-Si has place in results from relaxation of the elastically-strained layer of porous surface and effect of capillary-fluctuation forces. Conditions of development of these forces depend on the self-coordinated parameters of etching of interface heterophase of electrochemical system the electrolyte/porous Si/c-Si/ and parameters of electrodes and electrochemical cell.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional vertical SPH method for dambreak flow simulation
abstract: A meshfree particle-based Lagrangian method-Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) has been applied to simulate instantaneous dam-break flows. The dam-breaks generated highly unsteady and rapidly varied flows moving over the beds and obstacles, so it was very complicated by fixed grid numerical simulations. The SPH method performed well when the flood wave moved over a flat bed, the strong hydraulic jumps can be reproduced, the numerical results agreed well with the Experimental data.

articleTitle: An equation involving the Fibonacci numbers and Smarandache primitive function
abstract: for any positive integer n, let S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>(n) denotes the Smarandache primitive function, F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> denotes the Fibonacci numbers. The main purpose of this paper is using the elementary methods to study the number of the solutions of the equation S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>(F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>)+S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>(F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>)+ߪ+S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>(F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>)=S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>(F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n+2</inf>ࢤ1), and give all positive integer solutions for this equation.

articleTitle: Design and realization of four-channel image data acquisition for framing gated camera
abstract: Firstly, the paper introduces the principle and basic architectural scheme of the high-speed framing gated camera. Then, elaborates the hardware design and realization for the four-channel synchronous image data acquisition. After that, the functions and the development of the control software are discussed in detail. Some critical problems and the solutions, such as the multi-channel data synchronous acquisition controlling, the multi-image synchronous displaying, the selection and saving for the useful image data, and the correction for lightness difference between odd and even image fields, are emphasized. At last, the integrated camera is tested, and the performance of data acquisition system for it is analyzed.

articleTitle: Reflection and recommendation for the teaching of english as a second language under multimedia networking environment
abstract: This paper reflects the rapid development of multimedia networking in the teaching of English as a foreign language (EFL) and teaching of English as a second language (ESL) in Chinese universities in recent years. Compared with the rapid development of multimedia networking in the teaching of EFL, the teaching of ESL has lagged behind in terms of the teaching methodology. The paper recommends that teachers teaching ESL should endeavor to make full of multimedia networking in their teaching in order to achieve a better teaching effect. In addition, the paper provides some concrete methods on how to advance the implementation of multimedia networking in the teaching of ESL.

articleTitle: The application of Multimedia And Networking in sino English teaching: Retrospective analysis
abstract: This paper reviews the application of multi-media and networking in English teaching of China over the past ten years based on the studies published. In contrast with the traditional way of teaching, the features and effectiveness of Multimedia and Networking are summarized. Challenges along with their future prospects are raised as well.

articleTitle: Research of wavelet base's choice in wavelet transformation based on image compression
abstract: In wavelet transformation used for image compression using different wavelet base has a great influence on the effect of image compression. In this article through analysis of wavelet base's some characteristics such as orthogonality, regularity, energy concentric and so on, the influence of using different wavelet base to image compression coding is researched.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of an online collaborative editing systems on CSCW
abstract: This article attempted to build a network based classroom for users to communicate with each other and edit collaboratively based on the CSCW concept. It proposed a web based "Online Collaborative Editor System" which based on CSCW to establish a visualized collaborative learning group to prompt the discussion, communication and experience sharing between teachers and students, students and students. The article also discussed the application value of the system model.

articleTitle: DFT algorithm of the trispectrum reconstruction
abstract: As the bispectrum of the symmetric distribution random signals is equal to zero, whereas its trispectrum is not equal to zero, signal or system needs reconstructing from samples of the trispectrum of observation data. DFT algorithm for amplitude and phase reconstruction from trispectrum is proposed based on the bispectrum DFT algorithm. The magnitude and phase of the Fourier transform of a signal as well as those of the trispectrum are expanded into a series using a set of appropriate basis functions. Reconstruction is achieved by equating coefficients of like terms of these two expansions. Its advantage is that it only use the diagonal elements of amplitude and phase of the trispectrum, thus the computation is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on daily runoff forecasting model of lake
abstract: Once there were many predicting methods, such as ANN, etc. But these methods are not very precisely. This paper uses wavelet analysis to decompose daily runoff series, then it uses ANFIS to modeling the decomposed series, in the end it combined these series. The result shows that, the prediction accuracy rises a lot, and it is fit to used in daily runoff predict.

articleTitle: Riemann-Hilbert's mixed boundary value problem for bianalytic functions
abstract: A formulation of two class of Riemann-Hilbert's mixed boundary value problem for bianalytic functions are proposed, and their solvability are discussed.

articleTitle: Data embedding with multi-ary tree coding
abstract: This paper proposes a novel steganographic method based on tree structure. This method tries to reduce the amplitude of modifying the cover object to minimize the distortion. In data hiding process, each secret digit is represented by a (2n+1)-ary notational system. We employ complete tree structure to carry the difference between cover pixels and secret digits, and secret digits are embedded into the cover pixels by using tree structure. An optimum node distribution with least distortion is found by performing adjusting procedure, in which the amplitude of modifying is dispersed in all cover pixels evenly. The embedding algorithm obtains the stego object by performing addition between cover object and adjusted tree object. We can prove that our method can produce a stego object with least distortion. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that our method is very efficient for hiding the secret message due to its simplicity and has higher embedding efficiency than other algorithms when the embedding rate is same.

articleTitle: Finite symmetry transformation groups and some exact solutions of the Wu-Zhang equation
abstract: In this paper, the finite symmetry transformation groups of the Wu-Zhang equation are presented by the new symmetry group method and symbolic computation. The Lie symmetry groups obtained via traditional Lie approaches can be recovered in case of restricting some arbitrary constants. Some exact solutions of the Wu-Zhang equation which contain double solitary-like wave solutions and some complexiton solutions are derived by the multiple Riccati equations rational expansion method. At the same time, the corresponding new solutions can also be constructed through the finite symmetry transformation groups obtained.

articleTitle: Security issues and solutions of WPA encrypted public wireless Local Area Network
abstract: For most wireless LAN(Local Area Network), WPA(Wi-Fi Protected Access) is still the most common encryption mechanism. However, there is potential danger in the public wireless LAN using public PSK(pre-shared key), which could not be ignored. In such public wireless LAN, it is easy for members within the network to obtain other users' encryption keys and steal their information. This paper analyzes the generation of an encryption key, the security issues and the solutions.

articleTitle: Comprehensive assessment of water quality in Lanjiang River watershed based on fuzzy mathematics
abstract: A comprehensive water quality assessment model was developed based on fuzzy mathematics technique. The model adopted function of subjection to describe the boundary of water quality, was under the jurisdiction of subjection degree selecting nearly principles, reflect the mistiness, make the result closer the objective reality. The water quality data covering 6 parameters from 6 monitoring stations were collected from January 2005 to December 2010, and the model was used to assess the water quality of Lanjiang River watershed. The water quality of Lanjiang River from 2005 to 2010 is maintain Class III, and can basically satisfy its designated use. The major pollutants were ammonia nitrogen and total phosphorus. The water quality assessment model based on fuzzy mathematics is suitable for Lanjiang River watershed.

articleTitle: A simplified method of analyzing the transverse vibration of railway bridges
abstract: Transverse vibrations of bridges stirred by train affect the bridge's safety and comfort of the train. For simply supported beam, the paper deduces the response of the beam under a fixed harmonic load, uniform constant load or uniform moving harmonic load. The conclusion is that the response of the beam under uniform moving harmonic load is only about half of the response under a fixed harmonic load, which makes it reasonable that the train translates into a fixed harmonic load. Then a simplified analysis method of the bridge's vibration is obtained. The Example shows the feasibility of this simplified analysis.

articleTitle: Research of direction-based search algorithm in distributed P2P network
abstract: Based on the concept of the flooding algorithm and its improved algorithm the search algorithm in P2P networks is proposed based on the direction. This algorithm dynamically generates a search tree taken the source point to be its root which makes the search processing along the search tree. By this algorithm the production of redundant search packets can be effectively avoided in the search process, the network bandwidth can be saved and the efficiency and network performance can be improved. The analysis on experimental results of two dimensional digital data and image data fully reflects the effectiveness and feasibility of this algorithm in the search process, document.

articleTitle: Intelligent ship-bridge collision avoidance algorithm research based on a modified Gaussian Mixture Model
abstract: Faced with ever more serious security situation in bridge area, A Moving ship target detection and tracking method based on the complex background of the bridge area is presented. The background model based on a modified Gaussian Mixture Model. The algorithm upgrades the background model in real time, Foreground area is extracted by adaptive threshold method by marking each moving region in the binary image, the geometrical features parameters such as width, height, centroid position and speed can be extracted, which lay the foundation for the analysis and track of moving. Ship motion situation calculation module based on visual geometry model, and calculates the movement state information of target ship's position in space coordinate, Ship's size, speed, heading etc. Collision risk prediction and collision avoidance maneuvering decision-making module combined ship real-time motion state information, and Bridge area ship's motion, introducing the collision risk to rank term, and early warning and collision avoidance maneuvering decision-making. Through calculation of ship maneuvering and collision avoidance related distance parameter of bridge area, Introducing collision risk to rank terminology, Forming rationalization collision avoidance decisions, Thus reach the ship-bridge collision avoidance warning and precontrolling effect. Experimental results show that the proposed method is robust, real-time and accurate.

articleTitle: Why was it so damaging?
abstract: This paper analyses the unpredictable and devastating effects of the earthquake that Lorca (Spain) suffered on the 11<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> of May. It was much more harmful than expected, according to the Spanish seismic-resistant structural code in force, NCSE 02. The conclusions were presented in the symposium on the matter that took place in Lorca, during days 2, 7, 15 and 22 June, 2011.

articleTitle: A watermarking scheme based on digital images' signatures
abstract: In this paper, an effective scheme to resist copy attack based on digital images' signatures is proposed. In the DCT domain, the digital images' signature is obtained by use of ICA. Then imbed both the digital signature and a watermark into the image. The embedded digital signature can test whether the digital signature is copied illegally or not. The experiment results show that the digital signatures algorithm have the universality of resisting copy attack.

articleTitle: An improved schema matching algorithm of opaque database schemas
abstract: Schema matching is a crucial problem in Data Integration and Data Translation. In this paper, a pretreatment algorithm is proposed, which is an optimized and improved algorithm for the previous schema matching algorithm on opaque column and data value. Thus, the calculation of previous algorithm is decreased greatly, the time of the execution, the efficiency and precision of schema matching is enhanced.

articleTitle: Modern radio monitoring applications for radio frequency spectrum occupancy measurement
abstract: Here we propose an alternative approach to limitation of allowable estimation errors of radio frequency spectrum occupancy. In this report we have included some reasons why the use of absolute error estimation would be more practical. Also, we have proposed a set of steps to evaluate spectrum occupancy in accordance with the new recommended allowable estimation errors.

articleTitle: The construction of public computer teaching experiment platform based on the campus network
abstract: The computer teaching experiment platform of campus, revolves the computer class teaching experiment. This paper presents a solution of this platform, which is about the way to accomplish resources sharing through making other courses teaching experiment can also set up in this field, and the way to construct a experimental teaching platform based on campus network, which unites teaching and practice, steps across subjects, and has many functions.

articleTitle: QoS based handover in heterogeneous networks
abstract: Today, the user is interested in comparing one service with another in terms of universal, user-oriented performance parameters which apply to any end-to-end service. The QoS concept encapsulates the idea that different data streams could be treated differently by the network depending upon the service being carried. QoS features shall provide the required performance of latency, jitter and packet loss needed to support the service. In this paper we have analyzed QoS in case of Wi-Fi/WiMAX and WiMAX/Wi-Fi handover.

articleTitle: Calculating coefficients of new asymptotic series for the Gamma function
abstract: This paper calculates the polynomial's coefficients of novel convergent asymptotic series for the Gamma function using the Stirling numbers of the first kind, and proves that polynomial's coefficients are always positive except the constant terms.

Author Keywords: Stirling numbers of the first kind

articleTitle: Special convergence analysis of Quasi-Wilson element
abstract: The new convergence analysis of Quasi-Wilson element for the second-order problems is presented in this paper. It is shown that the consistency error of Quasi-Wilson element can reach to O(h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) order on rectangular meshes, two order higher than that of the famous Wilson element and one order higher than that of the known result on arbitrary quadrilateral meshes, which further improves the results of previous literature.

articleTitle: Determination of polycyhe aromatic hydrocarbon (PAHs) in wastewater sewage sludge and its pyrolysis oil and gas
abstract: PAHs in sewage sludge and its pyrolysis products are ignorable components as a result of their pollution on environment and deteriorate the quality of sewage sludge pyrolysis products. In this study, on the basis of the standard methods of detecting PAHs contained in materials with different phase, such as air, water, and coal, the specific analysis methods for PAHs in municipal wastewater sewage sludge, its pyrolysis oil and gas were built. The studied methods include three main processes, "purification of original samples", "concentration, extraction, and depuration of PAHs" and "separation and qualitative and quantitative detection of PAHs by GC-MS". It was found that sewage sludge and its pyrolysis oil and gas contains to different extents PAHs contents using the built analysis methods. Adding the certain amount of standard PAHs solution was employed to check the recovery efficiencies of the analysis methods. It was proved the recovery efficiencies all of PAHs were above 80% except for naphthalene due to its strong volatility.

articleTitle: A watermark identification method for video copyright
abstract: Aiming at identifying extracted watermark for video copyright, this paper proposes a novel method based on synergetic pattern recognition. A meaningful binary image is serially processed into watermarking signal and then embedded into the AC coefficients in DCT domain of video frames. The algorithm of synergetic pattern recognition is discussed in detail and used in the extracted video watermark identification. With lots of experiments, the results show that the proposed method is effective, fast and robust.

articleTitle: Research into computer-aided music teaching
abstract: It is discussed the application of CAI in music teaching from the use of CAI courseware and the use of computer music software in this paper. It can help to improve student's aesthetic experience and it can help to train and improve student's innovation ability, independent learning ability, cross learning capabilities etc. if we use CAI in music teaching.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence of excavation of foundation pits on existing metro tunnels
abstract: Development and utilization of urban underground space is conducive to improving the urban functions, giving full play to the city's social, environmental and economic benefits, but also inevitably encounters many new and more complex geotechnical engineering problems. In this paper, we took a foundation project above the metro subway tunnel in Guangzhou as an example, for which a numerical model was established to calculate and analyze the influence of excavation on the existing tunnel from aspects of deformation, additional stress of tunnel segments and anti-floating stability. The results show that the excavation inevitably leads to soil deformation at the bottom of the foundation pit, which causes displacement of the tunnel and change of the stress state of the tunnel segment. The results provide valuable reference to the project design and construction. It is helpful to other similar projects.

articleTitle: A modified Quad-Theremin for interactive computer music control
abstract: A novel designed system that uses modified Theremins for non-haptic interactive music control is presented. Without wearing any electronic glove or device, player with free hands and fingers movement is able to control the music content in a dynamic way, which can be applied to interactive music performance or gaming design. Four sets of antenna are used in this apparatus named Quad-Theremin to control four channels of MIDI (MAX) messages or digital audios (MSP). We use the Arduino micro-controller to interface the Quad-Theremin to the MAX/MSP running on a PC. Arduino is programmed by Processing Language, a language similar to Java and is compatible to MAX/MSP. The system is tested and demonstrated with some pre-defined scenarios. The result shows that our design is superior to other designs for it is easy and cheap to construct and is versatile for various interactive scenarios planning on MAX/MSP.

articleTitle: An aground-underground seamlessly integrated modeling method
abstract: The seamlessly integrated modeling of aground, terrain and underground objects is the direction of up-to-date 3DGIS, traditional GIS mostly emphasize on independent modeling, lack of considering the interactive association of aground and underground entities. Based on spatial data model CSG+CD-TIN+GTP—TTS, an aground and underground seamlessly integrated modeling method together with key algorithms were introduced. Finally, an example verified the feasibility and availability of this method.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent network disk storage system
abstract: Faced with mass storage demand in the area of high performance computing, video monitoring, IPTV and multimedia, storage technology have no choice but to be developed rapidly on the basis of current conditions. Network cluster storage technology founded on cluster storage system is most popular storage method to solve mass storage problem at present. Intelligent network disk (IND) is a novel idea of storage system architecture. IND cluster is a new way for mass storage. In order to realize IND storage function and reflect its characteristics such as mass, speed, security, scalability and low-price, some of key techniques, i.e. self-bootload, linux kernel portability and start, file management, disk mounting, intelligent control routine, fault tolerance and recovery and IND combination pattern are described in the paper.

articleTitle: A framework for electronic pasture based on WSN
abstract: With the development of wireless communication and micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS), the wireless sensor network (WSN) has aroused enthusiasm in the world, the research of application of WSN is a hotspot. This paper use the WSN to construct a framework of electronic pasture, solved the problems of artificially grazing and pasture management in recent years, then discussed the hardware and software design system. It realized the wireless monitor sensor network used in the pasture. Practice shows that the electronic pasture simple, feasible; save manpower, money, realization management modernization.

articleTitle: The view of the disobeyed housing phenomenon on the contemporary housing in Taiwan
abstract: The existing residences constructed with additions have long been considered synonymous with disobeyed buildings, and those with iron roof additions are often associated with slums. Yet in Taiwan, it is a secondary construction activity, a long-existing way of residence addition constructing aimed to meet people's need for residency. This phenomenon of constructing residence additions highlights the fact that the space purchased from the housing market fails to fulfill citizen's need for residential space, the government's power to control and forbid unlicensed constructions appears weak, and that unlicensed construction activity has become common in modern residential construction. In order to interpret the spatial construction of modern residential buildings in Taiwan and its social value, this paper reviews the literature related to the history of unlicensed construction in Taiwan in order to set up its correspondent system which is later analyzed by means of the research into the construction of unlicensed residence additions. Then, the Field Study is applied to the photography and recording of the types of unlicensed residence additions, and the effect of the residence addition types is developed through the Induction Method. The results of this study indicated: 1) There is a long history of residence additions. 2) Building cost speculations behind unlicensed buildings. 3) The complete paragenesis mechanism of residence addition building. 4) The two-stage construction process is one of the residence modes in Taiwan.

articleTitle: The study of improving dust driving velocity on high velocity transverse plate electrostatic precipitator
abstract: This paper was simulated high speed horizontal plate ESP dust remove test by changing the applied voltage U, electrode distance d, flow gas speed v, and dust concentration θ single factor, etc. the experiment substituted the results into Deutsch formula to calculate drift velocity, by drawing the curve to analysis various factors on the impact of driving velocity, looking for the range of parameters to improve the drift velocity. The results showed that the applied voltage was at the 17-21kV, pole spacing was at 40mm, gas flow speed was at the 4m/s or so, a higher dust collecting was inside the device, dust particles was more easily charged and captured by collecting plate, dust collecting effect is well and now dust driving velocity was at the 150 cm/s or so.

articleTitle: Application of Struts framework based on MVC in Online Countryside Teachers' Training System in China
abstract: With the development of the computer science and the information technology, the network has become a kind of basic infrastructures in our daily life. Kinds of distant learning systems based on Web application appeared , and the Online Teachers' Training System is one of them. The core of MVC pattern is a kind of layers-designing, which separates the whole structure into several layers: Model, View and Controller. After the separation, each layer exists separately, and the interface among them is clear, thus making the coupling lowest. So these characteristics satisfy the need of the Online Teachers' Training System for Vocational Education. Especially noticed is that this system is based on the J2EE platform, which can provide kinds of component s and containers used by the program developers to conduct the roles in MVC, and can make the development much easier and further improve the efficiency. The same is noticed is that Struts is a kind of framework based on the J2EE platform and realizes the MVC pattern, provides a large tag lib as well as improves the support for View.

articleTitle: The effect of land use categories resolution on geography cellular automata model
abstract: Cellular automata model is a useful tool to understand the urbanization process. But nontrivial questions have to be answered about the choice of model parameters such as cell state resolution. The objective of this study is to evaluate the sensitivity of cellular automata to cell state resolution when using CA in a geographic context. The study chooses CA-Markov model to simulate urban expansion in the Huadu district (Guangzhou city, china). Two cell state resolutions are designed (urban/non-urban land use categories, multiple land use categories). Then the sensitivity of cell state resolution is undertaken by evaluating the resulting simulation accuracy of the model and the morphology of urban area. Results show that cell state resolution have a significant impact on simulation result in terms of both urban area and spatial pattern. The model outputs using two different cell state resolutions have great difference in term of both the resulting simulation accuracy of the model and the morphology of urban area. The urban area and patch numbers of model output produced by multiple land use dataset are higher than the model output with urban/non-urban land use dataset. While the urban growth rate and mean annual increment urban area are lower than the latter. Therefore, we shouldn't ignore the effect of modifying land use categories resolution on model output when using CA model to simulate urban expansion.

articleTitle: The application research based on high-precision's measurement method of time interval
abstract: The traditional time-interval measurements have the flaws of Low precision and long time measuring, accordingly the method of Phase time-interval measurement is used in the paper. It can solve the contradiction between measuring precision and measuring time well and overcome the measuring principle error of the traditional time-interval measurements.

articleTitle: Research on the undisturbed area of convergent air curtain
abstract: In the industrial production and everyday life, there are some problems which was hard to resolve in flow of pollution-control. If the traditional sealed enclosures or partial enclosures is used to control pollutants, the collection rate of it is very low, and it costs more energy consumption. Convergent Air Curtain(CAC) is a “invisible, transparent, enclosed heat shield” between the pollutants and operator. It can be used to controll pollution sources outside because it is a sealed cover which can prevent contamination-spreading out, and cut off the heat-passing out. By changing the angle of the initial installation of air curtain, the wind speed and thickness and other factors, access to the undisturbed area of convergent air curtain parameters and to establish a convergent air curtain jet experiments and theoretical models. Based on the results of experimental and theoretical analysis, the CAC is very useful for environmental protection, labor protection and health protection in production and everyday life.

articleTitle: Research and design of autonomic computing system model in cloud computing environment
abstract: The aim of autonomic computing is to realize self - management of complex IT systems, which makes systems own the ability of self-configuration, self-recovering, self-optimizing and self-protecting. The aim of cloud computing is to realize the use of resources on demand in distributed environment. But the problem of how to build an autonomic computing model for cloud computing environment has not been solved. This paper proposed a method to design autonomic computing model for cloud computing, which united the application of two computing patterns, so as to solve the problems of high availability and resource management in cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Speed estimation with single loop detector using typical effective vehicle length
abstract: The importance of real-time speed estimation is undoubtedly significant for traveler information and traffic management systems. Unfortunately, the most common form of traffic detector, the single loop detector, is incapable of providing speed measurements. Analyzing the weakness of mean effective vehicle length (MEVL), typical effective vehicle length (TEVL) was introduced instead of MEVL using in speed estimation. The TEVL is more robust than MEVL and has less difference in different detector stations. So the same value of TEVL can be set for all detector stations. Then a new method was proposed to reduce the error of speed estimation. This method used the 15th percentile vehicle passage time over the detector which was the typical vehicle passage time corresponding to TEVL. The algorithm of the proposed method is implemented and evaluated using the field data from urban expressways in Beijing. The results show that the proposed method has more excellent estimation accuracy than conventional method.

articleTitle: Application of genetic algorithm on optimization of engraving paths
abstract: This paper is mainly on the basis of processing regional blocks, by using genetic algorithm optimization model, and designing coding rules and genetic operators to achieve tool path optimized processes. The experimental results show that algorithm has a strong practical.

articleTitle: The construction and application of virtual digital campus platform
abstract: Virtual Campus is an important part of the construction of digital campus. The paper discussed the main steps and processes of domestic virtual simulation platform vr platform in virtual campus construction, and some special problems to be noticed in the production and management. Through the construction of virtual campus, all kinds of digital campus resources will be integrated into a virtual digital space, which merges the school's teaching, laboratory, management, services and other activities in one. The target is to service the teaching, research and management planning.

articleTitle: Dynamic response analysis of pavement and subgrade of highmay
abstract: The dynamic response of pavement and subgrade of highmay were analyzed by the developed two-dimension finite element numerical analysis procedure. The influencing of pavement base course stiffness, driving speed and vehicle weight on dynamic response of pavement and subgrade were discussed. The research shows that the vertical maximum vibration acceleration of pavement surface decreases with the base course stiffness increasing; except for base course, the maximum dynamic stress of other parts decreases; with the driving speed increasing, the vertical maximum vibration acceleration of pavement surface and subgrade increases, and the increasing amplitude reduces gradually along the depth direction; the maximum dynamic stress of surface and base course decreases with the driving speed increasing, but that of other parts under base course increases; the increasing of the vertical maximum vibration acceleration and maximum dynamic stress of the pavement surface and subgrade is very remarkable with the vehicle weight increasing.

articleTitle: Research on the conservation and development of historical towns and villages in China
