abstract: In analyzing the dilemma of preservation in Chinese historical towns and villages, this paper proposes a participatory community planning approach, which can work well to avoid the normal problems of other approaches, such as over-emphasizing on short-term interests and physical heritage conservation, lacking of residents' participation and support. The dynamic mechanism and regulatory mechanism in conservation of historical towns and villages also has been discussed in details.

articleTitle: Mechanical behaviour of recycled concrete filled steel tube conlumns strengthened by CFRP
abstract: This paper presented an experimental research on the behavior of circular, concrete-filled solid and hollow steel stub columns with recycled aggregate concrete (RAC) and normal aggregate concrete (NAC) concentrically loaded in compression to failure. Ten specimens were tested to investigate the effects of deformability, stiffness, failure modes and the ultimate carrying capacities of the RAC and NAC columns reinforced by carbon fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP). The ratio of the external tube dimension to the wall thickness of the tube sections varied from 50 to 57 covering compact sections. The main experimental parameters included the reinforcement ratio of CFRP, the cross section of columns strengthened, the portion of the RAC used and the length of the steel tube columns. The results show that CFRP contribution the significant increase in ultimate strength and ductility of the columns strengthened. The test results also indicated that the strength of columns strengthened increased greatly by the more layers of CFRP, and the stiffness of the strengthened columns was improved more significantly than the columns strengthened by full wrapping arrangement of CFRP.

articleTitle: Reversible logic synthesis based on a modified tabulation method
abstract: An important property of reversible circuits is that they can reduce the energy consumption which is now a big problem for the advanced circuit design. If a circuit is reversible, it can reduce the energy consumption caused by information loss. The tabulation method is more efficient than other simplification methods for combination logic circuits. But the classical tabulation method is not directly applicable to reversible circuits because the basic logic gates, except the NOT gate, are not reversible gates. In this paper, we propose a method to solve the problem so that the tabulation method can be applied to the reversible circuit synthesis. Our algorithm provides a systematic method to simplify the reversible circuit. This can produce the resulting expression in exclusive-sum form and transform it into a final reversible circuit with lower quantum cost. Moreover, we can realize permutations to be reversible circuits with lower quantum cost and without unnecessary garbage bits. We can also convert irreversible circuits by adding qubits to make the circuits reversible. The experimental results show that the average saving in quantum cost is 15.82% compared with previous approaches.

articleTitle: Grid-based three-dimensional geological models of the update method
abstract: Launched a three-dimensional geological modeling study, based on contours, borehole data and profile data to establish a three-dimensional geological data and, based on contour features and drilling data were presented to the grid modeling method, further establishing the grid layers stitched into a grid formation of three-dimensional geological model. In the establishment of geological model, the relevant data associated with the geologic bodies and classification, making the data in a particular area changes, to quickly determine the regional impact of the change, and change the region to re-model and replaced data changes to resolve the problem of re-modeling; Finally take Xiangjiaba hydropower station for example, establish the corresponding three-dimensional geological model of the grid to verify the significance of theoretical study and the value of practical application .

articleTitle: Based on RSAODV the solution to routing table overflow problem
abstract: AODV is the most common and the most important routing protocol. But AODV protocol has some severe security bugs, and routing table overflow is one of them. In this paper, RSAODV protocol model is first imported and introduced, and then it is applied to solve routing table overflow problem in AODV protocol. Finally, the validity of this solution is analyzed and proved from two aspects—routing found processing and network load. Moreover, its disadvantages are pointed out.

articleTitle: Compare of navigation constellations' GDOP with different construction
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> BeiDou and GPS, three kinds of constellations constituted by MEO, GEO+IGSO+MEO and GEO+IGSO+LEO+MEO were simulated in this paper. Space geometry intensity of these constellations was compared during autonomous orbit determination and ground positioning. The results show that GDOP of MEO satellite has been improved in autonomous orbit determination after adding GEO, IGSO or LEO satellite where the total number of satellites remains the same. However, the geometry intensity of GEO and IGSO is relatively poor in the mean time. During the ground positioning, because GEO and IGSO are over China and surrounding, the positioning accuracy is improved in these areas and geometry intensity is weakened in other areas.

articleTitle: Weak solution for backward stochastic differential equations driven by fractional brownian motion
abstract: We introduce the concept of weak solution for Backward Stochastic Differential Equation driven by Fractional Brownian motion. By Girsanov theorem for fractional Brownian motion, we establish the equivalence of existence of weak solutions for two Backward Stochastic Differential Equation driven by Fractional Brownian Motion with different drift coefficients. We also give a sufficient condition to the existence of the weak solution.

articleTitle: Bifurcations of travelling wave solutions for the ZK-MEW equation
abstract: By using the bifurcation theory of dynamical systems to the Zakharov-Kuznetsov-Modified Equal-Width (ZK-MEW) equation, we analysis all bifurcations and phase portraits in the parametric space, the existence of solitary wave solutions and uncountably infinite many smooth periodic wave solutions are obtained. Under different parametric conditions, various sufficient conditions to guarantee the existence of the above solutions are given. Some explicit exact solution formulas are acquired for some special cases.

articleTitle: A objective planning model Of education and its optimization
abstract: This paper, based on the input-output of education system, discussed a construct method of education planning and its model. Also discussed its application and optimization.

articleTitle: Improvement of remote sensing classification method by multiway support tensor machine
abstract: In remote sensing image classification, it is usually to introduce a spectral feature vector by transferring the digital number of a pixel from each band into an array. However, this kind of vector represents only one pixel of a remote sensing image, considers the spectral information but ignores the spatial relationship of neighboring pixels. In this paper, we propose a multiway support tensor machine for remote sensing image classification. The training samples are represented as 3-order tensors with local neighbor information, then, the mathematical model and solution of multiway support tensor machine are discussed in detail. Experiments on the classification of HYDICE hyperspectral data set suggest that this scheme can deliver a high classification rate with a small number of training samples.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of voice controlled Tetris game based on Microsoft SDK
abstract: "Tetris" is a very popular puzzle game. It's very popular for the audiences of all ages because of its simple easy to use and other benefits. The framework of speaker independent voice controlled Tetris game based on speech recognition is introduced in this paper. Then the implementation of voice controlled Tetris game based on Microsoft Speech recognition is described in detail. Finally the system is tested and analyzed. Experiments show that, although the voice controlled system lacks flexibility, it still has some practical value for its high recognition rate and its robustness.

articleTitle: Accumulation of the polyaromatic hydrocarbons in a snow cover of altai settlements
abstract: The paper presents results of evaluation of snow cover contamination levels of the settlements from point and non point sources. The empirical dependences of Polyaromatic hydrocarbons total concentrations on the distance from main sources of pollution are established. It is shown that the effects from initially unaccounted sources can be revealed by measuring PAHs concentrations in different directions from accounted sources. Bar charts of snow cover contamination in public places and maps of areal distributions can be used for assessment of potential risk for population health.

articleTitle: The canny operator based on the study of the method of image text location
abstract: For now the image text algorithm is widespread positioning accuracy text is not high,this paper proposes the use of positioning text area variance projection algorithm, the original image using Canny operator based on the maximum gradient algorithm to detect text edges; re-use of text-rich edge information, using the variance projection locating the text area. Tests show that the algorithm has a high positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: FPGA realization of multi-port SDRAM controller in real time image acquisition system
abstract: Multi-port controller means the share of the memory source, which is mostly applied on occasions for need real time process. This paper firstly introduces the principle of the SDRAM, then a multi-port SDRAM controller based on FPGA is presented, which is apt to the real time image acquisition system. The details from overall concept to sub-modules are focused. This controller has wide scope of application because of FPGA's features of fast, flexible and strong characteristics of transplantation.

articleTitle: An integrated rate control method joint with error resilience for H.264 over packet loss channel
abstract: To the applications of H.264 /AVC standard in packet loss channel, an integrated rate control method joint with error resilient techniques is proposed. Based on the end to end distortion model deduced in this paper, the basic unit level rate control is achieved by combining error concealment with intra-update strategy which based on rate-distortion optimal decision. Simulation results show that the end to end distortion model can fit for the actual distortion characteristics well, by using our proposed scheme in packet-loss channel, the better integrated performance of rate control and image quality can be gotten.

articleTitle: The data processing based on factor analysis
abstract: This paper starting from the teacher assessment data, analyze whether the evaluation indicators are suitable for factor analysis, then find the two factors which played a decisive role in evaluation indicators these indicators were interactive and related, so as to achieve the purpose of simplifying calculation. Final get the teachers' rankings by factor analysis.

articleTitle: Sustainable land use under the influence of mega-events
abstract: From the perspective of sustainable development, the paper analyzes the influence of mega-events on urban land use and sustainable development, including abnormal land appreciation and "edge effect" of the core land, and puts forward strategies for sustainable development, including: the relevance of land development and reasonable mechanism of land use. The paper selects the city of Guangzhou as a case for in-depth analysis. Studies are focusing on the city's land use before and after the mega-events, such as 6th national game, 9th National Game, and Canton Fairs, including analysis of several aspects: land-use structure, urban land price, and land-use change. It aims to reveal the gradual influence of mega-events on urban land use, and to reflect on the relationship between them.

articleTitle: Improved method based on NMF for face recognition
abstract: A method of dealing with NMF (non-negative matrix factorization) basis to enhance face recognition rate is introduced in this paper. Firstly, we use discrete wavelet transformation to produce a representation in the low frequency domain, and get basic matrix according to the NMF method. Secondly, parts of face features which possess outstanding performance are extracted by threshold value judgments, and they are used to form optimized facial subspace feature. The training and testing images are projected to the optimized subspace feature. Finally, support vector machine is used for classification. Experiments show that the improved method is workable, especially under the circumstance of partial occlusion, it achieves remarkable effects.

articleTitle: High speed fingerprint recognition method
abstract: In this paper we intend to propose a high-speed method for fingerprint recognition based on minutiae matching, which, unlike conventional minutiae matching algorithms, also takes into account region and line structures that exist between minutiae pairs, allowing getting more structural information of the fingerprint and resulting in stronger and more accurate matching of minutiae.

articleTitle: Research and development of JSP based online testing system for bilingual teaching of fundamentals of manufacturing technology
abstract: Online testing system is an important means to evaluate the teaching effect; it plays a significant role in online course of bilingual teaching of fundamentals of manufacturing technology. On the basis of system analysis, this paper discussed the developing process of the online testing system. The system used B/S(Browse/Server) mode, supported by dynamic web page technique JSP, Web server Tomcat, database MySQL, achieved the functions of online testing, auto-selecting questions, composing test papers, auto-marking papers, score inquiry, paper analysis and so forth. The effect and quality of bilingual teaching were improved after using the system in undergraduate education.

articleTitle: A novel non-convex regularization method for image segmentation
abstract: This paper proposes a new variational method with a non-convex regularization term which is introduced to restore high quality image. Non-convex regularization has advantages over convex regularization such as total variation (TV) for image segmentation. In practical, the used of the non-convex regularization is limited by the difficulty of the minimization. Through the variation splitting technology, we develop a new fast minimization algorithm to solve the non-convex problem for image segmentation. The new algorithm has higher efficiency and more robust to the choice of parameters. Experimental results illustrate the performance improvements by using our method.

articleTitle: A robust audio digital watermarking algorithm in DCT domain for air channel transmission
abstract: A robust audio digital watermarking algorithm in DCT domain for air channel transmission was proposed. The algorithm is in DCT domain, and using code of Barker technique as synchronization code sequence. By modifying the coefficients of low frequency, the watermarking and synchronization code was embedded with large capacity and good hidden effect. Experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm is able to resist common attacks and interference with air channel, and against cropping MP3 compression attacks and the attack of 30% resample, and achieve the blind watermarking extraction. To summarize, the proposed algorithm will give a new prospect to the research filed of audio digital watermarking for air transmission.

articleTitle: Probability density estimation by linear combinations of Gaussian kernels- generalizations and algorithmic evaluation
abstract: This paper examines parametric density estimation using a variable weighted sum of Gaussian kernels, where the weights may take positive and negative values. Various statistical properties of the estimator are studied as well as its extensions to multidimensional probability density estimation. Identification of the estimator parameters are computed by a modified EM algorithm and the number of kernels are estimated by information theoretic approach, using the Akiake Information Criterion (AIC). This paper provides empirical evaluation of the estimator with respect to window-based estimators and the classical linear combinations of Gaussian estimator that uses only positive weights, showing its robustness (in terms of accuracy and speed) for various applications in image and signal analysis and machine learning.

Author Keywords: modified EM algorithm and AIC criterion

articleTitle: Debris flow hazard assessment based on Monte Carlo simulation
abstract: This Screening several factors in debris flow hazard assessment is carried out based on the infinite irrelevance method, it eliminates some factors of overlap information too much. The ratios of importance between indices as given by experts are always an dot of ratios for construction of judgment matrix in analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Due to the drawback of AHP, a debris flow hazard assessment method based on Monte Carlo simulation as a stochastic one is therefore presented. The dot assignment can be extended to the interval assignment. Then, using the statistical method gives the results of debris flow hazard assessment, this method has more accuracy and generalization. Finally, the method is proved to be feasible and reliable by an actual example. And it provides a new method for weight determining on debris flow hazard assessment.

articleTitle: Backtracking and best-first based channel assignment strategy for multicast in multi-radio wireless mesh networks
abstract: In multi-radio multi-channel wireless mesh networks (WMNs), we are interested in how to allocate interference-free and partially overlapping channels to a multicast tree to support multiple high-quality video/audio stream transmissions. The goal is to maximize the number of serviced clients so that the maximum profits can be obtained. A new channel assignment approach named BBF algorithm based on backtracking and best-first search strategies are developed. The experimental results show that our BBF method outperforms the conventional methods based on BFS and DFS principles in terms of the number of serviced clients, throughput and packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Study of the application of AHP in blasting scheme optimization
abstract: Analytic Hierarchy Process Method was applied to comprehensively evaluate and analyze the hierarchical structure relations of the overall blasting cost, each line-item cost as well as proposed blasting scheme; furthermore, the optimal scheme was chosen by this method.

articleTitle: A framework for parallel simulation application performance evaluation and optimization
abstract: Massively parallel simulation application software running on high performance computers is composed by a number of distributed sub-systems which have close interaction and logic processing relationship. How to analyze application performance problems during programming and execution, and how to effectively improve the performance of parallel simulation application are important and challenging problems. To meet the requirements of parallel simulation application software on system quality, system load balancing, system performance and other evaluation and optimization, the paper presents a framework for PSoA-Tool (Parallel Simulation-oriented Analyze Tool) on high-performance computer environments. It is divided into five layers: model and code input layer, data collection layer, data management layer, data analysis layer, and decision optimization layer. It can achieve performance optimization for massively parallel simulation application software in the code, node, and task levels by PSoA-Tool.

articleTitle: Research on application of temporal GIS technology in monitoring landslide hazard
abstract: The key point of early warning and prevention of geological disasters focuses on the regional geological disasters in long-term real-time monitoring. For the always happened, most damaging geological disaster-landslides, unattended monitoring stations with embedded, wireless sensor networks were designed to real-time acquire regional geological environment data related to landslide in monitoring area, then stored the data in the data warehouse that based on temporal GIS technology. On the system platform designed by ArcGIS Server, using geological disaster warning model systems that built on space analysis technology to process and analyses the GIS data that contained the time properties comprehensively, to predict the probability of landslide occurrence in the future point, and use WebGIS to publish, form a complete warning system platform.

articleTitle: A preliminary investigation of the reason of large damage caused by the YingJiang Ms 5.8 earthquake
abstract: At 12:58 on 10 March 2011, a destructive Ms 5.8 earthquake hit Yingjiang county, Yunnan Province. 25 people were killed and three thousand houses collapsed. Seismological researchers are thinking why a medium earthquake like this could cause such serious damage. We study and compare the geological backgrounds and building structures of several worldwide earthquakes recently, and try to find the cause of the serious damage by the Yingjiang earthquake, and finally we hope to propose the corresponding solution about earthquake disaster prevention and reduction.

articleTitle: Application of the multi-level set method in image segmentation
abstract: In this study, the multi-level set method based on Chan-Vese model was applied to image segmentation. The proposed method is a generalization of the active contour model without edges, which developed by T. Chan and L. Vese. This method can automatically avoid the problems of vacuum and overlap and represent boundaries with complex topologies. The model and the details of the numerical algorithms are given. Numerical example for image segmentation is provided to show the feasible to the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of video-on-demand system for elementary and secondary schools
abstract: The courseware, which is merely made up of texts, pictures, links, etc, can not meet the requirements of learners. The teaching video is becoming more and more popular. Video-on-demand system for elementary and secondary schools contains much teaching videos, it allow learners to choose what to learn freely, control learning process. From the paper, you can learn what the video-on-demand system for elementary and secondary school is and how it is designed in its general structure, users, functions and database. Besides, you can also learn how the system is implemented from the homepage, registration /login, retrieving video, video on demand and management.

articleTitle: Experimental approach to the thermal reduction of plant beside windows
abstract: This paper presents a experiment of 3 different kinds of shading performance and thermal reduction of plant-covered windows. Two types of experimental rooms are chosen, all the conditions are the same, and one placed plants (Sedum lineare) beside (inside and outside) the window, the other one is the contractive room The experimental data shows that the plants can reduce 3~8°C at most, the effect of thermal reduction is very significant. However, if the plants are put inside the room, the air humidity will raise up, so we should consider ventilation to reduce the air humidity to get the most comfortable indoor air environment.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method for the location selection of affordable housing based on entropy weight
abstract: At present, when the Government in China selects the location of affordable housing, there are so much subjectivity and randomness that it is difficult for affordable housing to make the best of their own advantages. For the purpose of solving the problem, a new method was brought up. Use entropy theory to determine the weight of the various impact indicators, on this basis, use fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to get the score of each site of affordable housing, and the area with the highest score will be the final location of affordable housing. The project example shows that: It is more reasonable and feasible to evaluate the location selection of affordable housing with the method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation based on entropy weight.

articleTitle: Motion estimation using a compressive sensing architecture for H.264/AVC
abstract: Compressive sensing provided the probability of reconstructing signals using significantly fewer samples than the Shannon sampling theorem would normally permit. This encouraged people to try to collect less information other than to compress them during signal processing and reconstruction. The main focus in compressive sensing lies in the reconstruction of basis set and nonlinear optimization. This paper used a compressive sensing architecture to reduce the computation complexity in motion estimation of H.264/AVC, through constructing a measurement matrix to connect the reference macroblock and current macroblock. Then we achieve an analytical resolution and reduced computation cost without matching accuracy lose.

articleTitle: The impact of rib beam on additional stress in solidified Foundation
abstract: This article take finite element analysis of hard shell layer of solidified in the course of Foundation treatment. Research based on strip load, the effect on curing two-layer Foundation additional stress when rib beam added into the hard shell layer flange. Draw the conclusions that the rib beam can significantly reduce the interface additional stress. And discuss the effects of the additional stress when changes of various physical parameter of the rib beam.

articleTitle: Millimeter waves as a tool for determination of the composition of biodiesel fuel
abstract: Dielectric properties of biodiesel fuel, as well as its blends with conventional mineral diesel fuel are investigated experimentally. It is shown that millimeter waves allow one to carry out real-time nondestructive control of the composition of biodiesel blends with conventional mineral fuel. The highest sensitivity to the composition of blends is exhibited by the measurement of absorption of waves in the short millimeter wave band.

articleTitle: A note on harmonic measures and the incompleteness of exponential system in the weighted Banach space
abstract: We study the incompleteness of exponential system in C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub> from a harmonic measure point of view, where C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sub> is the weighted Banach space consists of complex continuous functions f defined on the real axis ℝ with vanishing at infinity, in the uniform norm.

articleTitle: Several problems in proper application of multimedia technology in advanced mathematics teaching
abstract: The application of multimedia technology in advanced mathematics teaching has become a tendency, and it meets with some dispute during the process of application. In this article, we will analyze the position and superiority of multimedia technology in advanced mathematics teaching, And traditional teaching and traditional teaching. Besides, we will also study the problems about how to make the proper application of multimedia technology in advanced mathematics teaching.

articleTitle: Web-based software development for cluster analysis experiment
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the principle of cluster analysis and develop the Web-based software based on Java applet. The system is accomplished based on object-oriented technique. The system can be embedded into Web page and display via browsers. The applet can perform two basic operations from the button of demo and the button of cluster analysis on interface. One operation from demo can completely demonstrate cluster procedure, and the other operation from cluster analysis can obtain the classifications of samples according to the data inputted by user. Three cluster methods including single linkage, complete and faster cluster are used to demo and cluster analysis, and the hierarchical cluster graph can plot and display at the same time. For the sake of convenience, the applet provides the pop windows that allow users to input and edit data.

articleTitle: Solvable time-dependent generalized harmonic oscillator
abstract: A case of the generalized harmonic oscillator with time-dependent coefficients is considered. The time-independent so(2, 1)-generators are constructed explicitly. The relation between the invariant previously proposed and the so(2, 1) generators is explicitly given. Some consequences of the assumption made in this paper is discussed.

articleTitle: Meso-damage test of deformation degradation process of marble and quantitative research of crack parameter
abstract: With the help of SEM(scanning electron microscope) , we research the initiation and development of wing crack of prefabricated crack marble specimens under uniaxial compression and then do the quantitative analysis. The size of the marble specimens is: 20mm*10mm*2mm, and there is a crack (length is 4mm, width is 0.5mm) in the middle with loading direction of 45 degrees. We take photos when the system is loading, then get a set of SEM images about meso-damage. We deal these images with quantization process and do some mathematical statistics analysis to get the law of the development of the wing crack. These researches law the foundation of establishing the mesoscopic damage mechanics model of rock.

articleTitle: In situ high temperature X-ray diffraction research for Kunlun green jade
abstract: The jasper from Kunlun Mountain in Qinghai is analyzed with the method of situ high temperature X-ray diffraction (HT-XRD) analysis, which gives the result that the chemical formula of its main composition is Ca2Mg5[Si4O11]2(OH)2 at room temperature, proving to be Tremolite, still mixed with a spot of Dolomite and Talc. By analyzing the diffraction data, it is found that at 1150°C for the jasper's main composition phase transition occurs. This phase transition is that the Ca-Mg pyroxene forms because of the Tremolite being affected by products of the thermal decomposition of Dolomite and Talc.

Author Keywords: In situ high temperature X-ray diffraction

articleTitle: Object tracking integrating template matching and mean shift algorithm
abstract: Mean shift algorithm assumes the object motion is smooth with no abrupt changes, leading to failing to track the target when the target's speed is fast. Fast template-based tracking could tackle this problem but faces the difficulties like the loss of the optimal matching result and fixed-size template. We present a new object tracking approach integrating these two methods. Firstly, the template-based tracking method, which is speeded up by the coarse-to-fine strategy and dominant feature set, is employed to find roughly the candidates in the entire image. Then, a local mean-shift process is initialized in each candidate and these processes find the nearest local maximum in their respective neighbors. Among these local maxima, the position with the maximum one is regarded as the final estimate of object location. Finally, the target's current size is estimated and the template is updated accordingly. Experiments demonstrate the good performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of remote video acquisition system based on 3G
abstract: The thesis designs and implements a remote video acquisition system based on 3G wireless network. It mainly describes the implementation framework of system, the structure of hardware and software in acquisition side, and the functions of software in client. With the use of MPEG4 codec technology, 3G wireless data transmission technology, P2P technology and DirectShow display technology, the system, which is based on embedded technology, achieves the data transmission, completes controlling camera and acquiring video data remotely. The test results show that the system achieves the desired goals, meets the requirement of video's resolution, and has the advantages of broader coverage, high quality of video, etc.

articleTitle: An optimal replacement policy for a series repairable system with two dissimilar components based on downtime
abstract: In this paper, a geometric process repair model for a two-dissimilar-identical component series repairable system with a repairman is proposed. Assume that the component after repair is not “as good as new”, and a repair can be delayed with a probability of 1−p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>,(i=1,2), by using geometric process and renewal theory, we consider a replacement policy (M,N) based respectively on the number of failures of component 1, component 2. The expression of the long run average cost and the expected downtime per unit time are derived. Meanwhile, the replacement policy model is presented with minimizing the expected downtime rate subject to an appropriate cost rate. Finally, an appropriate numerical example is given to approve the rationality of the new model.

articleTitle: Explore the lakefront landscape design of Wuhan East Lake with cubism
abstract: With the comimg of cubism, the painting world had a rash. It is encouraged for me to have multi-view logical methods and forms. This paper took the influence of cubism to landscape design as a basic one. Suggested new logical design and design method, in order to covering the shortage of landscape of Wuhan East Lake. Look for the breakthrough points for the lakefront landscape innovation. Then form the high-quality East Lake lakefront landscape and advance the promotion of East Lake landscape.

articleTitle: Frequent oscillatory criteria for a neutral partial difference equation
abstract: In this paper, frequent oscillatory criteria of a neutral partial difference equation is studied. By making use of frequency measures, some oscillatory criteria are established and an example is given to illustrate our main result.

articleTitle: Study on inhomogeneous foundation multiple bearing capacity
abstract: In this paper, making use of ANSYS to do research on inhomogeneous foundation multiple bearing capacity, analyzing the inner stress, deformation, failure patterns, ultimate bearing capacity, finally concluding the foundation's failure mechanics. Meanwhile, compare the simulating results with experiment data.

articleTitle: Cultural survey of network vocabulary
abstract: The emergence and development of network vocabulary is the results of network in close contact with the social. The network vocabulary is not only one communication tool, it also can reflect the speaker's inner world, and it even becomes one's cultural symbol. In this paper, the author tries to analyze the network vocabulary and the reasons of its emergence with cultural knowledge from the cultural point of view.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the initial phase of atmospheric discharges
abstract: Results of experiments on breakdown of long gaps in air are presented at atmospheric pressure on ERG installation (LPI). Generation of X-ray radiation in the form of single and multiple pulses of a nanosecond scale with quanta energy of 5÷150 keV during the various moments of a time interval from the beginning of a potential difference raise and before development of the main discharge is registered. Presence a current prepulses, connected with X-ray pulses is shown. Increase of generation of a near ultraviolet λ=240÷400 nm occurs for 20 nanoseconds, and the moment of occurrence of first X-ray pulse is necessary on UV maximum. Frame shooting of an initial stage of the discharge in a visible range has shown streamer growth on formed spherical area of the leader head.

articleTitle: Regional environmental risk assessment and zoning based on matrix method
abstract: Aiming at the features of environmental risk such as multi-source, multi-channel and multi-sensitive target, a regional environmental risk assessment method based on matrix method was raised in this paper. This method converts risk effects from multi risk source into risk loss probability, and evaluates regional environmental risk according to the method of joint probability, and geographic information system (GIS) was applied to zoning on the basis of assessment results. Min hang District, Shanghai was selected as the analysis example, and maps of environmental risk zoning were made by the analysis results. It can be used by government for setting regional development plan, environmental risk preventive measures and emergency plan, supporting regional industrial layout optimizing and enhancing regional environmental risk management on the theoretical and scientific basis. It has certain theoretical and practical meanings.

articleTitle: Frequent oscillatory solutions of a neutral partial difference equation with variable delay
abstract: This paper is concerned with a class of neutral partial difference equations with variable delay. By making use of frequency measures, some new oscillatory criteria are established. And an example is considered to illustrate our main results.

articleTitle: The development and application of multimedia courseware simulating physical chemistry experiments
abstract: The development process of software simulating physical chemistry experiment "The determination of heat of combustion" as an example was shown based on Flash 8 software as developing platform and Photoshop as auxiliary software. The developing purpose and properties of the courseware as well as development concepts were discussed. Multimedia courseware architecture was given and the realization of simulation process included six steps of which main scenes were discussed. The good evaluation was obtained from the appilication effect and statistics of the student evaluations.

articleTitle: The current status and development of treatment technique in organic acid wastewater
abstract: In this paper, the sources and characteristics of organic acid wastewater were introduced firstly. Meanwhile, the current status and development of the common processing techniques are summarized. Based on the principle and applicability of treatment techniques, the advantages and disadvantages of various processes were analyzed and discussed in detail. The comparison demonstrates that using the biological treatment in treating high strength organic acid wastewater is advantageous due to minimal space requirements, low capital cost and excellent removal efficiencies, and especially using an anaerobic aerobic integrated bioreactor is the development trends in future .

articleTitle: FEM analysis of CHS X-joints on the effect of out-of - plane bending performance
abstract: The out-of-plane bending performance of unstiffened X-joints with similar brace and chord diameters are studied, and the influence of brace inclination angles, axial stress and diameter-thickness ratio of chord on failure mode, ultimate bearing capacity and flexural rigidity of tubular joints are discussed in this paper. The results indicate that failure mode for X-joints with high brace-to-chord diameter ratios, which yielding area first be found around the chord wall between the two saddle points and then expand to intersecting lines, is different from joints with low diameter ratios. It is obvious that tubular joints show characteristics of semi-rigid connection, its plastic zone develop relatively full under lager bending and thus reflect plastic hinge feature. It can be found that a larger brace inclination angles could increase the ultimate capacity of X-joints, but decrease its flexural rigidity. What's more, axial pressure and tension in chords could weaken the rigidity and bearing capacity of X-joints, and an over larger pressure can lower the ductility of X-joints. At last, by comparing non dimensionalized moments, the paper points out that it is not reasonable to use geometrical factor just considering chord radius-thickness ratio.

articleTitle: Solvability of a periodic boundary value problem for a second ordinary differential equation
abstract: In this paper, we consider a certain nonlinear periodic boundary value problem, by making use of the fixed point theorem, we prove the existence of positive solutions for the problem.

articleTitle: Optimal design of interconnected bioreactors under split-flow and recirculation circumstances
abstract: The term “optimal” here should be understand as the minimum of the total volume of the reactors. The optimal design is given with split-flow of different input concentrates distributed between the tanks at steady state, and the stability of the designed process is analyzed.

articleTitle: The reliability assessment of in-service bridge based on probabilistic and non-probabilistic hybrid reliability model
abstract: Due to the complexity of the existing bridges as well as the impact of the survey methods and funds, interval variables are the main parameters, there are few random variables and they are mostly of normal or lognormal distribution and are difficult to be solved with the conventional probabilistic and non-probabilistic hybrid model. Therefore, this paper presents a new probabilistic and non-probabilistic hybrid model. First, take a realized value for the interval variables, get the reliability indexes with the first-order second-moment center-point method, establish a second-order functional equation only containing the interval variables based on the provisions of the existing regulations on highway reliability and finally solve the non-probabilistic reliability indexes so as to evaluate the hybrid reliability of the existing bridges. Via example evaluation, the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Hierarchical correlation for content-based image retrieval
abstract: This report proposes a hierarchical correlation calculation approach to content-based mammogram retrieval. In this approach, images are represented as a Gaussian pyramid with several reduced-resolution levels. A global search is first conducted to identify the optimal matching position, where the correlation between the query image and the target images in the database is maximal. Local search is performed in the region comprising the four child pixels at a higher resolution level in order to locate the position with maximal correlation at greater resolution. Finally, this position with the maximal correlation found at the finest resolution level is used as the image similarity measure for retrieving images. Experimental results have shown that this approach achieves 59% in precision and 54% in recall when the threshold of correlation is ≥0.5.

articleTitle: An improved method of colorized line drawing
abstract: In this paper we present an improved non photorealistic rendering method that automatically generates colorized line drawing from an input image. Based on flow based difference-of-Gaussians filtering which uses the edge tangent flow to strengthen the edge direction, the gray line drawing is generated while the obvious features are preserved well. As an improvement, we integrate color information into the gray line drawing which keeps another important component of images to visual cognition beside edges information, and aperture filling technique is also used to strength the coherent line effects, which is inspired by the labyrinth algorithm, making the final outcome more vivid and fantastic. The experiments validate our method's effectiveness.

articleTitle: The Design and Construction of High-end Simulation Training System to Emergency Rescue of Public Emergencies on the Prefecture-level City Based on Virtual Reality Technique
abstract: The analysis was conducted using the virtual emulation technology linked with the SimMan 3G which is a high-end simulation system, in order to establish the virtual rescue Mechanism for Public Emergencies. The virtual simulation to help the safety of rescuer determined rescue strategy and help to enhance the training efficiency in complex locomotive field environment. The implement of the staff-training model provides more scientific reinforcement learning to enhance significantly rescue skills and psychological adjustment of rescue worker in various public emergencies rescue.

articleTitle: Automatic evaluation method for Chinese handwritten ability
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an automatic evaluation method for Chinese handwritten ability, research on information card design, algorithms of image processing and the index computation of automatic evaluation. Image processing includes distortions detecting, stretching detecting, image de-skewing and image enhancement, the index computation of automatic evaluation based on features of global character, distance distributions and grid blocks distributions. Results of this method applied show that the efficiency of evaluation is high, ensure the consistency of the large-scale test standard, score of evaluations show that the computation index accord with subjective feelings.

articleTitle: The integrated design process for ground leveling and layout of rainwater pipe
abstract: The optimal design of ground leveling is to find the elevation and slope for ground with minimal volume of filling-digging rock-soil. At the same time, we should consider the balance between filling and digging With the given slope in ground leveling design, the aim of rainwater pipe layout is to calculate the optimal pipe diameter, pipe slope and buried depth to make the investment of layout pipe system minimal. Typically, the design process is stepwise implemented with individual cost minimal. In this paper, we investigate the relationship between ground leveling and layout of rainwater pipe system and propose an integrated design for ground leveling and layout of rainwater pipe network. With the united model, we get a global optimal design scheme with minimal total cost. The illustrated example in last part verifies the efficiency of our design process.

articleTitle: Pitch extraction for musical signals with modified AMDF
abstract: Pitch period is an important parameter of speech recognition and speech synthesis. Pitch period detection has been focused on the field of audio processing research. An algorithm is presented for pitch detection of musical signals. It is based on the AMDF method with a number of modifications that combine to prevent errors. The algorithm proposed here has been proved simple and implemented efficiently. There is no upper limit on the frequency search range, so the algorithm is suited for high-pitched music. A comparative study between this algorithm and the AMDF is also given.

articleTitle: Exploring the innovative design method of ecological building combined with plants
abstract: The integration of plants and building is one of the most effective method to realize the fusion of building and its environments and plants have been used in the architectural design practices more and more. It is significant to analyze the highlighted effect of plants in the architectural design. Several design cases have been studied to reveal how to realize the combination of building and plants and some countermeasures have been put forward for the design of modern ecological building.

articleTitle: Piecewise constant time discontinuous Galerkin method and error estimate
abstract: This paper proposes a piecewise constant time discontinuous Galerkin method to solve the initial-boundary value problem for the heat equation. The finite element is formulated in terms of continuous approximation functions in space directions and piecewise constant approximation functions in time direction. The error analysis for this method in L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> norm is established, and some numerical examples are included to validate the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Shear Wall linked with the ground's arrangement in the shear wall structure of large space at low part
abstract: In this paper, five models are established by changing the location of the Shear Wall linked with the Ground, then analysis the Impact on the period and lateral displacement between floors when the Shear Wall linked with the Ground is Symmetrical layout and Asymmetrical layout. The results can serve a reference for the engineering.

Author Keywords: Shear Wall linked with the Ground
the shear wall structure of large space at low part‥

articleTitle: Flood risk assessment in Pakistan at 1km grid scale
abstract: The flood disaster has become one of the natural disasters, which brings serious damage to human now. In 2010 July, it is happened in more than a hundred years that the flood occurred in the northwestern of Pakistan. This paper uses this example to identify that the country's flood caused great casualties and economic loss. With the comprehensive consideration of precipitation, rivers, terrain, land use, vegetation and social economy, a total of six kinds of related factors, this paper which uses Pakistan as the research object and uses the 1km grid data as the basis makes the rasterizing and normalization. Using AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) gives every factor of different weights, and the various layers are overlaid to assessment hazard and vulnerability of flood. Finally, the flood risk comprehensive evaluation map of Pakistan is finished, and on this basis, the results are corresponding analyzed.

articleTitle: Influence on removal iron and manganese from groundwater with micro pollutants
abstract: Groundwater in the runoff process dissolved iron and manganese from strata. The groundwater, polluted slightly by surface contaminants through strata penetration, is multi-polluted groundwater. All these impurities in the water are reductive condition, thus causes oxidation competition and steady-state complexation among them. And effect of the water treatment is reduced. The groundwater was treated with the process as aeration and contact oxidation filtration for pollutants to influence removal iron and manganese from groundwater. The test was done with three different water samples respectively in the meantime. The first water sample contains iron and manganese; the second iron, manganese and ammonium; and the third iron, manganese, ammonium and organics. The third sample is as the multi-polluted groundwater. The test results indicated that coexisting with iron and manganese in water, organic material and ammonia nitrogen impeded greatly oxidation of iron and manganese because removal rate of iron and manganese from the multi-polluted sample was lower greatly than from the samples containing only iron and manganese. And that the removal rate of organic material and ammonia nitrogen from water polluted was low. Coexisting with iron and manganese in water, ammonia nitrogen affected lightly to removal iron, but removal manganese greatly. In conclusion multi-polluted groundwater is difficult to be treated for drinking.

articleTitle: Freeze-hole construction technology applied to in-situ mining for oil shale
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the application of the freezing technology in the field of oil shale mining and the principle of the freezing technology. It also describes different characteristics of application for in situ mining for oil shale from other of underground works for the freeze-hole technology as well as the risks inherent in this technology. The operational parameters for the freezing technology also need to be studied in depth. As for the broad applicability of the freeze-hole technology, the freezing technology would be applied to the exploitation in other fields of new energy.

articleTitle: Treatment and settlement analysis for soft rock dam foundation
abstract: The Xixiayuan project is a regulating reservoir in china. The concrete dam section is constructed on soft rock foundation. In this paper, we present the case study on the treatment for the soft rock foundation. The treatment includes the construction of concrete cut-off wall, reinforcement by dynamic compaction method, and installation of the stone columns. The treatment was justified by the field instruments installed in the foundation. The measured data show that the treatment can reduce significantly the settlement at the foundation. Moreover, layered settlement was employed in the analysis. The results demonstrate that very small total and differential settlement occurred in the foundation. The analysis illustrate the success of the treatment for the soft rock dam foundation, and useful for gaining experience for future designs and analysis.

articleTitle: Generalized fuzzy ideals in semigroups
abstract: Abstract: In this paper, the concepts of (λ,μ)-fuzzy bi-ideal and (λ,μ)-fuzzy quasi-ideal were introduced which can be regarded as a generalization of conmen correspondence concepts, and some properties of (λ,β)-fuzzy bi-ideal and (λ,μ)-fuzzy quasi-ideal were discussed. At last, the regular semigroup was characterised by (λ,β)-fuzzy bi-ideal and (λ,μ)-fuzzy quasi-ideal.

articleTitle: The necessary of undertaking the social responsibility based on the system dynamic theory
abstract: The most of national enterprises perform the corporate social responsibility at passive stage. This stage brings a lot of bad problems. Therefore, this paper analyzed internal and external influence factors on the social responsibility, including the enterprise value, financial performance, market competition, government regulation, consumer and equity structure. The paper concluded that the development of the enterprises must undertake the social responsibility passively.

articleTitle: Acoustic design for the music hall of Huainan Normal University
abstract: There are three acoustic defects for the Music Hall of Huainan Normal University: sound focusing, flutter echo and low capacity-seat ratio. Aiming at the Hall's acoustic defects, two acoustic devices had been developed in the acoustic quality design. The testing result shows that the applied acoustic devices in the design produce a good sound effect.

articleTitle: A college English teaching model based on web-platform
abstract: The impact of the network has penetrated into all areas of human social life, especially in language teaching. From the perspective of constructivist theory, this article analyzes the characteristics of multimedia and network technology and the specific application in college English teaching, points out that the college English teaching model based on web-platform provides teachers and students a new means to achieve independent, selective, and interactive teaching and so as to improve the quality of college English teaching, and enhance the students' interest of learning English.

articleTitle: Image de-noising based on learned dictionary
abstract: The sparse decomposition of image based on over complete dictionary is a new theory of image representation. Using the redundancy of over-complete dictionary, we can effectively capture various structural features of the image capture in order to effectively express the image. For sparse representation, theory research mainly focuses on sparse decomposition algorithm and dictionary structure algorithm. In this paper, an improved KSVD dictionary training method is proposed. By the method, an updated dictionary is acquired by smooth I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> norm as the sparse coding method, and application in the sparse decomposition of image. Estimating the image by maximum a posteriori criterion was used to image de-noising, the experimental results confirm the proposed method is effectiveness.

articleTitle: Exploring a research framework for the understanding of ageing and urban space in West China
abstract: This paper focuses on the differences of the elders aged 60 years and older between East and West in China. Because studies have always focused on East China, a research framework in West China should be explored essentially. A mixed method approach was used for exploring the framework. The framework emphasizes the comfort, health, and adaptation of urban space for elders. The promotion-process between urban space and elders' communication, physical activities, and healthy care are also the key points of this framework. Meanwhile, the specificity of place should be considered. The study suggests that urban space needs to take local politics, finance, culture, custom, human existence, and local spatial pattern in consideration.

articleTitle: On the historical mission of landscape values
abstract: By discussing the conduction of consciousness acting upon behavior, this article has elaborated the different historical missions at different ages as well as the significance of modern values of landscape on instructing landscape design. It's purposed to arouse the social attention about the values of landscape and to help the landscape designer set up a appropriate concept about landscape value.

articleTitle: On college English teaching of writing in the network environment
abstract: For a long time, English writing has been the weak point for many Chinese college students. The rapid development of information technology has provided us with a good opportunity of improving the English teaching of writing. This paper analyzes the present situations and problems in Chinese college English teaching of writing, expounds the new teaching process in the network environment and sums up the advantages of using information technology in the English teaching of writing.

articleTitle: Application of wavelet threshold denoising method in gravity data processing
abstract: In this paper, we first introduce the basic theory of wavelet transform and the process of wavelet threshold denoising. Then we establish double sphere model to demonstrate the denoising effect on 2D gravity data processing and discuss the choice of parameters for the wavelet filter, more specifically, the threshold, the wavelet basis and the scale. Finally, the wavelet threshold denoising method is applied to practical gravity data to obtain good effect. Both synthetic and field examples show that the proposed method is an efficient method for gravity data processing.

articleTitle: Deposition of transparent conducting CdO on flexible PET substrate
abstract: Highly transparent and conductive Cadmium Oxide (CdO) thin films were deposited on poly ethylene terephthalate (PET) substrates by RF Magnetron Sputtering. The structure, optical property and electrical conductivity of the thin films were studied. The results of XRD shows that as the sputtering power increases, the intensity of (002) diffraction peak increases at the beginning, but as the sputtering power is greater than 85w, the intensity of the (002) diffraction peak decreases. Results of square resistance test shows that the resistance of the CdO thin film decreases as the sputtering power increases, but the rate became slow when the power is greater than 85w. The result of transmittance test shows that the transmittance of the CdO thin film decreases as the sputtering power increases. Finally, a thin cap layer of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thin film was deposited on CdO to improve the transmittance of the CdO thin film.

articleTitle: The design and research of landscape architecture based on low-carbon
abstract: After the world climate change conference convened in Copenhagen, the idea of low-carbon has been widely accepted in the world and the low-carbon landscape is becoming the main trend of landscape design. The concept, principle and method of design of low-carbon landscape have been discussed from the idea of low-carbon in this paper, and a basis for future low-carbon landscape design has been provided.

articleTitle: The group schemes for the hyperbolic equation
abstract: This paper is concerned with a class of hyperbolic equation. We consider some group schemes to approximate it. Here the group schemes are explicit and can be computed easily. The numerical experiments show the schemes are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: On cognitive application of generalized computer Logic
abstract: The generalized computer Logic whose main body is narrowly computer Logic and artificial intelligence, not only belongs to Logic, but also belongs to computer science and cognitive science. Narrow computer Logic, artificial intelligence Logic, fuzzy Logic is not only among each other to promote, but also belong to cognitive science. Thus, in essence, the computer Logic is generalized cognitive science. Fuzzy Logic belongs to the Logic of computer science too. Fuzzy Logic is playing an increasingly important role in the engineering controls or in the Management-science-engineering .etc..

articleTitle: Research on low temperature and high pressure of water infiltration of carbonate rock
abstract: The paper uses the way of sampling and simulating the condition of low temperature and high pressure, based on the result of the research in the karst corrode of research area, pays attention to water infiltration of carbonate rock, and gets the result of average velocity of infiltration. With the help of geologic conformation and karst research, forecasting the high infiltration area of research area, the paper divides the research area into 4 parts in the uprightness direction and 3 parts in the level direction. On that basis, the paper divides the 9 high infiltration area into 3 kinds.

articleTitle: Dynamic texture recognition based on fluid motion vector calculation
abstract: Dynamic texture is a part of the natural scene. Dynamic texture segmentation issue is research hotspot in the field of computer vision and even robot research area. This paper studies the method of dynamic texture recognition. We study the strategy based on fluid vector calculation. There three steps in the strategy. Firstly, we calculate the motion vector of fluid flow. Then remove noise using multi-resolution sampling method. At last we obtain the dynamic texture recognition results. Much more experimental results show that it is very efficient and can effectively achieve the dynamic texture recognition.

articleTitle: A digital photographic method to measure ambient black carbon concentration
abstract: In this paper, a digital photographic method was developed to measure the concentration of ambient black carbon. Encouraging results showed when comparing the transmittance of BC particle layer measured by digital photographic method to transmittance measured by a laser transmissometer. We also discussed the detection limits and uncertainty of this method in this paper.

articleTitle: Estimation in linear mixed-effects model with errors in covariate
abstract: In this paper, we consider the estimation methods of parameters and the variance component in the linear mixed-effects model with measurement error. The likelihood-based methods are commonly used in random effects models, but it needs some assumption on the error distribution and the computation of likelihood-based methods is difficult. In this paper, two corrected methods based on least square are proposed to estimate regression parameters and variance components. The estimations are free from the distribution of the model error and random effect, which is different from likelihood-based methods. Simulation studies are carried out to compare the efficiency of the two methods, and the results suggest the proposed estimation is practicable for finite samples. From the simulation we can see, if the effects of measurement error to the estimation are ignored, then the estimators may be biased.

articleTitle: Speech visualization of Chinese Mandarin single-finals
abstract: A novel speech visualization method for Chinese Mandarin single-finals is proposed for speech training of the hearing impaired. In this method, the first three formant frequencies of the input speech are mapped to RGB primary colors, and each final are characterized by different colors. The results of the subjective test show that a high recognition rate is achieved with the method.

articleTitle: Research on the significance and strategy of seismic design to architectural design
abstract: A good seismic design of buildings is not only a part of the structural designs. It should also start from the architectural design and attach full attention to the importance of seismic design in architectural design. This paper analyzes the damage mechanism of earthquake to buildings and expounds several issues, to which attention should be paid in architecture design stage, from the perspectives of architectural graphic design, elevation and modeling design, vertical layout design, and setup of Seismic Joint, in order to improve buildings' seismic performance.

articleTitle: Thermopower in nanowires: A generic model and formula
abstract: In present paper, by using the nonequilibrium-Green function approach, we investigated the thermopower through a quantum dot connected to Luttinger liquid. The generally analytic thermopower formula for the thermopower is firstly derived to take into account intralead electron interaction. The thermopower S varies linearly with the temperature T at low temperature and is enhanced by intralead electron interaction. These features qualitatively agree with the experimental and theoretical results.

articleTitle: Video image mosaic based on coarse matching
abstract: Video panorama mosaic is investigated in the paper. Firstly, we give out a scheme for video panorama mosaic. In the scheme, a coarse matching is applied which is based on the multi-scale corner feature. It avoids the process of choosing region of interested in Panoramic image mosaic. Then, the local image features are used to match. Based on these, planar projection model is used to realize image matching, and thus fused with fading out model. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can get good effects in large field video view panorama and the application of acquiring high-resolution image.

articleTitle: Tail dependence coefficients of multivariate elliptical distributions
abstract: In this article, the tail dependence coefficient of the multivariate elliptical distribution and its properties are obtained. Furthermore, some specific tail dependence coefficients (TDC) and regularly varying elliptical distribution are given. From these results, it is easy to see that the TDC is only determined by its tail index and the correlation coefficient of the multivariate elliptical distribution. Finally, for comparing with the results in [4], some simulations are presented.

articleTitle: Passenger Traffic split considing congestion model
abstract: The purpose of this thesis is to analyze the influence of congestion on passengers' Effectiveness Function which is based on the travelers' characteristics when they choose the mode of transportation. Namely, each passenger's utility value which will be influenced by other passengers'choice is not independent. According to the principle of utility maximization, the transportation split model will be established and the solution will also be proposed. Eventually, the equilibrium distribution ratio will be reached under the condition of the travelers'congestion after the game of the transportation mode.

articleTitle: Valence-band offset in ultra-thin HfO2 film on GaAs
abstract: This paper presents the first-principles study of an ultra-thin (monoclinic-) cubic-HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> layer on GaAs substrate. The heavy stress in hafnia layer significantly causes the structure deformation and results in a charge transfer and superstoichiometric HfOy. The valence-band offset of the structure c-HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/GaAs is increased, while that of m-HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/GaAs is decreased after structure relaxation. These characteristics should significantly affect the properties of CMOS devices made from an ultra-thin HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> dielectric film stacked on GaAs channel.

articleTitle: Research on application of multimedia technology in equipment IETM
abstract: Multimedia is a importance information object in IETM. Its application can enormously enhance the efficiency of IETM. So it had been a hot issue in the field of IETM research. The paper expounded the application of multimedia technology in equipment IETM from these aspects of types, request, storing and retrieval of multimedia. The research of the paper has some application values for advancing development of IETM.

articleTitle: Research on protection and utilization of ancient village heritage
abstract: Ancient village has lots of valuable cultural heritage, which is the root of Chinese traditional culture. During the reconstruction of the new countryside, the protection and utilization of ancient village heritage is a new issue without precedent. This paper puts forward the advices on the protection of ancient village heritage, based on all areas of research on the current situation of ancient villages.

articleTitle: Viscosity approximating fixed points of nonexpansive mappings by Ishikawa iteration
abstract: It is shown that under some certain appropriate conditions, a strong convergence theorem of a new Ishikawa modified viscosity iteration for nonexpansive mappings is obtained in Banach spaces and the method in this paper is new ones. The results presented here improve and extend the corresponding results of other authors, such as S.S.Chang, H.W.Joseph Lee and C.K.Chan [On Reichs strong convergence theorem for asymptotically nonexpansive mappings in Banach spaces, J.Math.Anal.Appl.66:2364-2374,2007].

articleTitle: Probability density distribution of bedload 3-D velocity
abstract: The probability density distribution of bedload particles' three dimensional velocity components was studied by experiments. Ten runs of tests with different particle diameter, specific gravity and flow slope were performed, and the 3-D velocity components were measured by a Three Dimensional Particle Tracking Velocimetry (3D PTV) system. The analysis results of experimental data showed that the probability density distribution of bedload particles' velocities approximately took on the normal distribution, and the particle diameter and specific gravity did not exhibit considerable effects on the average characteristics of probability density distribution. The deflection coefficient of longitudinal velocity component increased with the increase in flow slope.

articleTitle: Study on noise filtering
abstract: In the process of collecting spectrum using near-infrared instrument, the final spectrum signal detected by detector contains not only sample related information but also the noise signal because of influence from various aspects of interference factors. In order to eliminate interference resulted by drift and shift of baseline, random noise and stray light of instrument, and to improve signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of spectrum, various baseline correction methods and spectral smoothing methods were used to process rice spectrums. And then eight models were established. The model which used first derivative and Savizky-Golay convolution had the best performance with comparison of various performance indicators including correlation coefficient(R), root mean square error of calibration(RMSEC), root mean square error of cross validation(RMSECV).

articleTitle: The existence of nonoscillatory solution for neutral difference equations
abstract: The existence of nonoscillatory solution for neutral difference equations are studied, and some sufficient conditions are obtained.

articleTitle: The R&D for hydraulic press simulation teaching system
abstract: Hydraulic press simulation teaching system of the world's mainstream design software 3DS MAX Three-dimensional modeling, rendering, after the model has been refined and realistic three-dimensional view, given the model given the real action animation. Will ultimately improve the model of three-dimensional animation into flash production platform, production and development of the model in ActionScript to embed flash script and make it educational for the whole simulation of the operation of the interactive system.

articleTitle: A study on establishing the sustainable building environment assessment tool for communities in Taiwan
abstract: Based on SBTOOL (2008 version) promoted by the World Sustainable Building Conference (WSB), this study first discovered assessment items related to “symbiosis” and “disaster resistance” through literature review, selected the assessment factors using an “expert evaluation method,” and calculated the weighted value of each indicator through an “analytic hierarchy process (AHP).” The weighted values of the assessment aspects according to the expert groups are: “disaster prevention and community safety” with 0.191, “environmental loading” with 0.152, “energy and resource consumption” with 0.127, “symbiotic community environment and life” with 0.126, “indoor environment quality” with 0.1, “site selection, project planning and development” with 0.084, “social and economic aspects” with 0.081, “service quality ” with 0.073, and “cultural and perceptional aspects” with 0.067. Expert identification analysis on the descriptive statistics indicated that general experts most strongly identify with “B. energy and resource consumption,” followed by “H. symbiotic community environment and life” Meanwhile, experts from industry, government, and academia fields strongly identify with “I. disaster prevention and community safety” and “C. environmental loading.” These results suggest that in addition to focusing on “energy and resource consumption” and “environmental loading” regarding sustainable building developments, Taiwanese experts highly regard the issues of “symbiotic community environment and life” and “disaster prevention and community safety” under extreme climates.

articleTitle: Automatic recognation and real-time alarming of eerthquake induced vibration of a tied arch bridge
abstract: China is heavily suffered from various types of natural disasters, such as earthquakes and typhoons. This paper presents the monitoring and recognizing of seismic responses of a tied arch bridge, which has been installed with a long-term structural health monitoring system since November 2007 in Hangzhou, China. Wenchuan earthquake (Magnitude 8.0) occurred at 14∶28 (China standard time) on May 12, 2008, in Sichuan province of China. The earthquake was felt in the city of Hangzhou—about 1,600 kilometres away—where bridges and office buildings swayed with the tremor. The bridge health monitoring system successfully monitored the structural responses due to the earthquake. About two-minute abrupt changes in displacement amplitude were observed in the measured signals starting at 14∶37, about 9 minutes later than the earthquake's occurring. In order to achieve the real-time alarming of extreme events, such as earthquakes, typhoons, and collisions, this paper proposes a Euclidean distance based recognition method to compare the variation rate of seismic response data with preset thresholds calculated from the normal response data. Using the proposed method, the displacement responses under excitation of Wenchuan earthquake are successfully recognized and the realtime alarming is thus realized.

articleTitle: A note on regularity criterion for the Navier-Stokes equations in terms of the pressure
abstract: In this note, a logarithmically improved regularity criterion for the Navier-Stokes equations is established in terms of the pressure in the nonhomogeneous Besov space.

articleTitle: Bayesian shrinkage estimation of shape parameter of Lomax distribution based on record values
abstract: The Bayesian and Bayesian shrinkage estimators of the parameter of Lomax distribution are obtained based on record values. The loss functions used are squared error loss and LINEX loss function. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the application for our result.

articleTitle: High resolution seismic imaging of subsurface objects using horizontal shear waves
abstract: Shallow subsurface objects with strong contrasts are capable of generating strong reflected and diffracted waves. High-resolution seismic reflection profiling in horizontal shear wave mode can easily image reflectors that are less than 10 meters below the ground surface. This research demonstrates that it is possible to image boulders down to 1 meter in diameter with the Hilbert envelope attribute. In low velocity sediments, SH wave seismic reflections can have sub-meter resolution.

articleTitle: A measurement method of wool fiber diameter based on Euclidean Distance
abstract: Fiber diameter is one of the most important indicators for wool test and classification. This paper designed and actualized a wool fiber diameter measurement method based on image processing, in which the sample images were taken by the CCD camera of OFDA instrument. Median filter was used as algorithm to filter the noise. Then OTSU threshold segmentation was employed in order to segment and collect the segmentation parameters for image binaryzation. Based on Euclidean Distance and Weighted Algorithm, the fiber diameter was calculated. According to the actual measuring need and image features, the whole image was segmented into pieces and only some of them were selected so as to reduce the calculation work load and enhance the calculation speed. The result shows that precision of the measured wool fiber diameter by using this algorithm may reach ±0.3μm, which means it can accurately and speedily measure the fiber diameter, well meeting the need of measurement.

articleTitle: Interaction and association
abstract: With the function transformation in the culture architecture, It was the fact that the culture architecture conformation had become one of the part in the whole city environment, both of them had have a very closed relationship. The article has raised interaction and association between the space form of culture architectures and city space and listed the design methods which can make a comfortably harmony environment between the culture architecture and city space.

articleTitle: Remove impulse noise using randomized harmonic propagation
