abstract: An image restoration algorithm named Randomized Harmonic Propagation (RHP) is proposed to remove extensive salt-and-pepper noise. The values of uncorrupted pixels are propagated to the corrupted ones iteratively under the constraint of locally self-similarity of the natural image. Compared with traditional methods, the information of all the uncorrupted pixels can be used to estimate the value of each corrupted counterpart. Extensive simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is effective and comparable with many existing, well-accepted methods in impulse noise restoration.

articleTitle: The research of media combination in English instruction
abstract: By cycling test, we made researches on how media combination effects English lessons with the method of circular experiments. Subjects are eighth-grade students, the combinations of media are video & text, audio & text .It shows that there is no significant difference between video & text media composition and audio & text media composition through maintaining tests. However,it shows that video & text media presentation is significantly better than audio & text media composition through transfering tests. In addition, video & text media composition will inspire the students' learning interests better.

articleTitle: Lattices generated by orbits of subspaces under the general linear group according to joints
abstract: Let <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(n)</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</inf> F be the n-dimensional vector space over the finite field q F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</inf>, Let M(m,n) be any orbit of subspaces under GL<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>(F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</inf>), denote L(m,n) as the set of subspaces which are joins of subspaces in M(m,n). This paper discusses the relation under the general linear group, with the condition that a subspace is an element of set generated by the given orbit, and when sets generated by orbits form geometric lattices.

articleTitle: Research on the formation mechanism of the risk of insufficiency knowledge sharing among partners in knowledge alliance
abstract: In this paper we apply Bertrand model to analysis the process, strategies and outcomes of knowledge sharing between competitive enterprises in the same industry. We argue that when no risk controlling measures were taken by the members of alliance, there exists opportunism actions between the alliance partners, both sides want to increase outcomes by reducing knowledge quantity and even providing false information and this leads to the risk of insufficiency of knowledge sharing in alliance.

articleTitle: The research of protection and reuse of Manchuria architecture and interior space on Xinmin Street in Changchun city
abstract: The building interior environment has a strong relationship with the building and it would have bad influence on the building itself if they are inconvertible with each other. The restructure and reformation of the historical building have both substantial reality and a historical significance due to the fact that these buildings witness the development of the city and be part of the history. This paper investigated and concluded the reformation and preservation of the Manchuria architecture in the historical famous Xinmin street of Changchun in order to instruct the further research of the Manchuria architecture.

Author Keywords: preservation and reuse of historical building
Manchuria architecture in Xinmin street of Changchun

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation for m-consecutive-k-out-of-n: F system with Burr XII components
abstract: Based on Type-II doubly censored samples, we study the reliability evaluation of m-consecutive -k-out-of-n: F system with Burr XII components. Classical statistical method and Bayes approach have been used to derive the MLE, Bayesian estimator and E-Bayesian estimator for unknown parameter and system reliability. The statistical performances are compared through the accuracy of MSE based on Monte-Carlo simulation. According to these comparisons, it is concluded that the E- Bayesian estimations are preferable.

articleTitle: Determination and remediation of contaminants in the soil from diesel leakage accident near the Weihe River
abstract: This research focuses on treatment model of diesel leakage accident near the Weihe River at the beginning of 2010. A technical option is proposed for determination of diesel content in soil by the method of ultrasonic-ultraviolet spectrophotometry, so as to evaluate the soil pollution and reasonably select the remediation scheme according to the pollution degree and the migration and transformation regularity of diesel contaminants in the loess soil. Results show the diesel-soil separation effect comes to the maximal degree during the deposition process using petroleum ether as extraction solvent, and ultrasonic irradiation at 200W for 10min, and then using ultraviolet spectrophotometry to determine the diesel content in soil. The diesel content in soil at each sampling point exceeds the maximum allowable concentration (3g/kg). If physical remediation is applied at the occurrence of the accident and bioremediation is selected later, the migration and transformation efficiency of diesel contaminants can be improved and the diesel content in soil can be reduced. The objective of this paper is to establish a model of the determination and remediation of diesel contaminants in soil, which can be used for reference in the treatment of petroleum leakage accident.

articleTitle: Stable distribution and option pricing
abstract: This paper shows that FFT algorithm will be used to calculate the option prices according to characteristic functions of the stock log-prices. The statistical models of stock returns, the historical date of options, parameter estimation methods will be concerned. We will use the stable distribution to fit the Chinese stock market returns statistical distribution, and then compare with Black-Scholes formula.

articleTitle: Slice router: For fine-granularity fault-tolerant Networks-on-Chip
abstract: Almost all existing Networks-on-Chip (NoC) fault-tolerant schemes are based on fault-tolerant routing algorithms. In these fault-tolerant schemes, faulty links or routers will be discarded all together. However, only a few part of the discarded link or router is faulty in most cases. It is wasteful to discard the whole link or router. In this paper, we present a slice router architecture which can be used in fine-granularity fault-tolerant NoC. The major motivation of presenting slice router is to refine faulty links and routers. The major idea is that a router is split into several sub-link routers, noted slices. Different from several physically independent routers, slices are coupled together in input/output ports. The coupling of slices makes the network to be able to fine-granularity fault-tolerant. In order to evaluate the fault-tolerant capability of slice routers, we design a loosely-coupled 4-slices router with a backup sub-link in each link. Each slice is a single-cycle output buffered switch. Simulation results prove its fault-tolerant capability in the present of high faulty rates. The critical latency is only increased 0.04ns, because the configuration of slice interfaces is parallel with the output arbiter of slices. Under 65nm technology synthesized results show that, the increased area overhead of a slice router is only a few logic gates compared with the non-coupled slice router.

articleTitle: Experimental study on effect of unsteady flow on mooring conditions in Shuifu port
abstract: With the major basins of the hydropower station built one after another, usually as flood control and power generation, and other important role. The power station regulating the downstream from the dam will cause the water level changes, the navigation of the ship berth and will cause a certain impact. In the paper, the Xiangjiaba hydropower station hydraulic model will test the conditioning power station, downstream of the dam-water port the ship's mooring stable condition, the water level of the moment, the flow rate variability and other factors, as the ship's navigational control and election of certain guiding significance.

articleTitle: The relation between survivor probability and activeness of species in a well-mixed rock-paper-scissors game
abstract: In an ecosystem, coexistence of competing species is always transient due to unavoidable fluctuations of their population and interactions. In this letter, we use stochastic simulation method to investigate the variation of each species' population and the relation between the lifetime and its reaction rate of the specie. The simulation shows that the predator of the weakest specie always goes extinct firstly. Our finding provides a new evidence for the law of the “weakest” specy survival.

articleTitle: The application and development of EEG in Standard Chinese study
abstract: Language is a product of the cerebrum thinking, based on the development of EEG technology and its use of interdisciplinary fields, the study of language becomes more and more in depth. This paper briefly introduces the linguistics, summaries the current research of Standard Chinese in three aspects (research about sound, glyph and meaning; research about part of speech; research about sentence), meanwhile prospects that there will be more meaningful study results in the futrue of EEG technique on Standard Chinese.

articleTitle: Seismic performance analysis and countermeasures of Hefei important infrastructure constructions
abstract: Through the questionnaire survey and field survey method, Hefei important infrastructure constructions were surveyed to the seismic performance. With earthquake damage prediction method, the seismic performance was analyzed to the infrastructure constructions. On the basis of analysis, the seismic recommendations and countermeasures were gaved, which is very important to government decision-making and earth-quake disaster prevention.

articleTitle: A study on emotional feature extraction and analysis in speech
abstract: Analyses the features of the time, amplitude, fundamental frequency and formant constructions involving 5 emotions as happiness, anger, surprise, sorrow and neutrality. Through speech parameters extracted from emotional database of German, this paper sums up the distribution laws of emotional features of different emotional speech signal and presents practically theoretical data for processing and recognition of emotional speech.

articleTitle: Title A/O process viscous sludge reduction of inflation condition
abstract: This thesis focuses on a lot of problem generated sludge in the process of activated sludge wastewater treatment. Examine sludge reduction effect under sludge viscous inflation state in the A/O process. The sludge SVI value in this experiment is 150-290(ml/g), between maintain stable operation with the reaction, the value has a trend to decrease slowly. Water in the system and the stable operation of the state standards and zero to do blank dosage comparison earthworm flutter, flutter by adding different earthworm weight (unit weight of sludge (MLSS) in the flutter earthworm wet weight, that is, g wet weight than the flutter earthworm / MLSS), that have a certain effect of sludge reduction.

articleTitle: Case study on the development orientations of suburban industry new city
abstract: Industrial development and urban construction of new city support each other, whose orientations guide the new city into the healthy development and the smooth progress of post-operational level. Taking special steel new city in Jiaxing as a case, this paper explores the industrial guidance and construction carrier of new city. To ensure the healthy development of industry new city ,the orientations are established and the strategies are put forward from the angle of facing the city.

articleTitle: Research on algorithm for physical topology discovery in heterogeneous multi-subnet
abstract: Knowledge of the physical topology of an IP network is crucial to a number of network management tasks, including reactive and proactive resource management, root-cause analysis, and event correlation. Given the dynamic nature of IP networks, keeping track of network topology information manually is a daunting task. So, effective algorithms for automatically discovering physical topology of an IP network are necessary. Earlier topology discovery has mainly concentrated on discovering logical (i.e., layer-3) network topology, which implies that the connectivity of all layer-2 elements in networks is ignored. In this paper, we present a novel algorithm for discovering physical (i.e., layer-2) topology in heterogeneous (i.e., multi-vendor) multi-subnet. The algorithm presented in this paper relies on standard SNMP MIB information that is supported by IP network elements and require no modification to the operating system software. The algorithm has been implemented and has been tested on our own research network. The experimental results can clearly validate our approach, demonstrating that our tool can consistently discover the accurate physical topology in time.

articleTitle: Affect of mechanical properties changes of injecting cement paste on ground settlement with shield driven method
abstract: When using shield driven method to construct tunnels, mechanical properties of injecting cement paste will change at curing age. And then ground settlement will also change because of changes of mechanical properties of injecting cement paste. Based on the first line of Ningbo rail transit, this paper will discuss the effect of ground settlement caused by changes of elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio of injecting cement paste using finite element simulation (FEM) software. The results show that ground settlement will increase if considering changes of elastic modulus, while ground settlement will decrease if considering changes of Poisson's ratio. If changes of elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio are both considered, we will accurately predict ground settlement .The results also show that elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio at early stage of curing age play an important part in ground settlement prediction.

articleTitle: Subject and unit of public participation in city plan
abstract: The article interprets the concept of public participation comprehensively and explores the inadaptability reasons of Chinese-style public participation through analyzing its subject and unit. Finally the article comes to a conclusion that community organization, trade association and intermediary organization are the basic units of public participation in city plan.

articleTitle: Robust upper body detection in unconstrained posture
abstract: This paper presents an efficient approach to detecting upper body in unconstrained posture based on Shape Context and Histograms of Orient Gradients. The method contains two steps. Shape context matching is used to get the candidates of upper bodies in the images at first, and then validation of each candidate is performed by using the Histograms of Orient Gradients. The method has two advantages, comparing with existing body detection methods. One is that it can detect upper bodies in all kinds of postures other than upright standing posture, and the other is that it significantly speeds up the computation.

articleTitle: Slope aspect and position affect soil arthropod assemblages in a temperate secondary forest of hilly region (northweast China)
abstract: Spatial heterogeneity is a key factor to understand structure and dynamics of populations, communities and ecosystems. In this study we investigated the densities of soil arthropod communities across different slope positions in a hilly region, such as the river bed, foot slope, upside slope and crest slope of shady and sunny slopes in a typical temperate secondary forest of northeast China. Redundancy analysis was performed to determine the patterns of spatial distribution of soil arthropods in relation to slope aspect and slope position. Slope aspect and slope position had significant impacts on spatial distribution of soil arthropods, but overall effects varied considerably across soil arthropods because of significant differences in taxonomic identity and biological traits among them. The study shows that slope aspect and position significantly influence the spatial distribution of soil arthropod assemblage by their effects on the integrative features of soil and vegetation factors on the microhabitat scale.

articleTitle: Dynamic stabilization of Rayleigh-Taylor instability driven by 4 impulses in Newtonian fluids
abstract: Dynamic stabilization of Rayleigh-Taylor instability in newtonian fluids is studied in terms of an approximate analytical model that take into account the vertical vibration of the interface between the fluids. The force driving the vibration is modeled by parametric excitation consists of 4 impulses in each period. The dispersion relations are obtained firstly and the numerical solutions are compared with the results obtained by Piriz et al., who considered the driving force with 2 impulses in each period.

articleTitle: A discussion on problems and planning countermeasure of the aged persons, public cultural facilities in ZHENGZHOU City
abstract: Based on the research of Environment-Behavior Study and the analysis of marks of age, combinated relevant literature and investigation, choose the aged persons of central area as the study object, the requiring construction of public cultural facilities for the aged was studied, further more, Planning Measures were proposed, to faced with ever more serious the demand of aging.

articleTitle: A blind watermarking algorithm using low density parity check coding for Mpeg-4 videos
abstract: A new digital watermarking algorithm for MPEG-4 video based on LDPC coding is proposed. Which embeds into and retrieves the digital watermark information out of the MPEG-4 video using LDPC coding technology and human visual characteristics. The watermark is encoded by LDPC at first and then embedded into the intermediate frequency coefficient of the luminance of the video's I-VOP. Furthermore, it is retrieved from the watermarked video by the LDPC iterative methods. Making full use of LDPC codes' error correction features can reduce the bit error rate in transmission process of the watermarking, and improve the anti-attack capability of the watermarking. Experimental results show that this algorithm greatly decrease the bit error rate of the retrieved watermark and is robust to the video attacking such as frame deleting ,frame switching ,frame average, recompression,et al. The watermark can be extracted blindly. As compared without LDPC watermarking, the performance of the algorithm is improved.

articleTitle: Construction inclinometer monitoring analysis for a deep foundation pit in soft soil area
abstract: Using the combination of deep foundation pit construction in soft soil and on-site monitoring of horizontal displacement as example, according to the monitored data, the paper illustrates the excavations surrounding wall deformation changes, and analyses the various reasons for the deformation conditions, and makes targeted measures based on that. The follow-up monitoring data shows that the effectiveness of the relevant measures, as to help guide the construction of similar projects with certain significance.

articleTitle: Complete the design of highway track lane type
abstract: Exist for highway congestion, traffic accidents, big risks, such as road maintenance cycles, this paper start from the definition of highway proposed standard highway design concepts and methods, illustrated by the legend. Type described in this article completely lane highway most of the features is to ensure that a variety of lane closure and specificity, and highway entrances and exits of the design is simple, economic, and reflect the nature of the highway.

articleTitle: Existence of positive solutions of three-point boundary value problem for a third-order dynamic equation on time scales
abstract: In this paper we investigate the existence of positive solutions for the third-order three-point boundary value problem on time scales. The methods involve applications of Green,s function and the nature of concave -convex functional on cone.

articleTitle: A Raster-based forest fire regime model
abstract: Considered both the natural (e.g. climate) and anthropogenic factors which contribute to regional fire dynamics, a new fire regime model is proposed. It consists of four components: fuel module, fire occurrence module, and fire behavior module, and fire effect module. We derive the fuel load data from ecosystem model's carbon and nitrogen pools and fix the fuel properties (e.g. depth, size and compactness) based on other related studies. The fire occurrence is related to the fire danger index, ignition sources (e.g. lightning and human-caused ignition), and fuel load. The fire danger index is an aggregative indicator which can be calculated based on regional temperature and precipitation data. As for the ignition sources, we hypothesize that human-caused ignitions vary with human population density, while the lightning ignitions are distributed evenly. With the spatially explicit fuel load, wind speed data, population density data, and climate data, the model has been tested in forest ecosystem of China.

articleTitle: Theoretical calculation of pentachlorophenol spectrum
abstract: Use the density functional optimization (DFT) B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) to calculate the structure and infrared spectrum of pentachlorophenol. Besides, us the time-dependent density functional (TDDFT) B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) to calculate uv-visible absorption spectrum of pentachlorophenol. In comparison with the calculated results of uv-visible absorption spectrum of the pentachlorophenol and the uv-visible absorption spectrum of phenol, the calculation method is feasible in this paper.

articleTitle: The influence of groundwater quality on irrigation: A case study in Dezhou, Shandong Province
abstract: Groundwater, which is the key factor of the regional agriculture irrigation water, plays a significant role of water supply in the north of China. In the past 50 years, grain yields enhanced unceasingly as effective irrigation area rised. As China's important major grain-producing areas, the agricultural population is big and the agricultural economy takes a large proportion in Dezhou. The agriculture irrigation mainly depends on Yellow River, not only by the pollution of local rivers, and even a threat to groundwater. It was found that diversion water can refresh local groundwater, whereas irrigation by polluted river waters resulted in contamination of local shallow groundwater and over-exploitation of groundwater declined regional water table. In order to optimize high groundwater management of agricultural production areas, water resources construction should receive more attention.

articleTitle: Some conditions on stabilization of generalized dynamical systems
abstract: Based on studying the distribution of generalized eigenvalues of some special matrix pairs, this paper propose some conditions for stabilization of generalized dynamical systems. An example is presented to demonstrate the results obtained in this paper.

articleTitle: The design of infrared refractive-diffractive optical system with high diffraction efficiency
abstract: In this paper, a double-layer diffractive element in far-infrared wavebands is investigated and the design process and simulation are described. This method can give a better design result than that with the conventional design method, in that the diffraction efficiency is large than 90% at each wavelength. A infrared optical system with this double-layer diffractive element is described, which can work in the infrared wavebands with high image contrast and imaging quality.

articleTitle: Temperature control three-dimensional simulation sensitivity analysis of RCC dam during construction time in cool spell region
abstract: The temperature field and stress field of RCC dam during construction time were calculated in complete simulation by using the calculation means of "negative heat of hydration" and "volumetric force method" and so on as well as adapting the e-variable temperature stress calculation finite-element method which considered concrete creep influence in connection with the construction temperature control requirement of RCC dam in cold spell region. Yunnan lead factory hydropower station RCC dam was used for the instance, fluctuating main temperature control parameters to proceed simulation calculation and sensitivity analysis about the outcome, which drew the influence that main temperature control parameters had on dam crack, meanwhile, sensitivity curves were fitted via adapting Lagrangian method, cutoff value and surplus cutoff value of temperature control parameters were worked out while the best program results were found out. It has been applied to the actual projects and has reference value for similar programs of other projects to choose.

articleTitle: Research on the seismic responses of frame construction on sand-gravel cushion
abstract: The main purpose of this paper was to study what impact the sand-gravel cushion may make on seismic responses of frame construction on it. This paper uses a reinforced concrete frame construction on the sand-gravel cushion as the analytical model, and two calculating models were made in finite element method for it, one is the reinforced concrete frame construction with sand-gravel cushion under it, the other is the same superstructure but with rigid foundation. The seismic responses of the 2 calculating models were calculated in time history method. By comparing the seismic responses of the reinforced concrete frame structure on sand-gravel cushion and the seismic responses with rigid foundation, it was found that with sand-gravel cushion under the constructions, the displacement of the construction at the bottom of the structure increased a little while the displacements of the other floors all decreased, and the acceleration responses of the constructions on sand-gravel cushion all decreased comparing to the construction without sand-gravel cushion. As the results show, the sand-gravel cushion served as a vibrating isolation in a certain extent, that the seismic displacement and acceleration responses of the constructions on it all decreased.

articleTitle: On the connectivity in one-dimensional ad hoc wireless networks with an access point
abstract: This paper investigates the connectivity in one-dimensional ad hoc wireless networks with an access point. We derive the probability that a random ad hoc wireless network has exactly m clusters by means of the methods of combinatorics and probability. The probability of connectivity, i.e. m = 1, can be obtained as a special case. Further, we explain how the transmission range of node affects the connectivity of the wireless network.

articleTitle: Unit testing optimized functions in H.264
abstract: Unit testing is a very useful but also very time consuming process to verify the correctness of individual functions or procedures. Although unit testing may have already been widely used by video codec engineers, to the best of our knowledge, designing efficient unit test suites for optimized video codec functions has not been systematically studied. Therefore, the authors propose to attack this problem by firstly summarizing various SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) related bugs based on past experiences. Then, random testing and manually designed test suites design are exploited to detect those bugs. Random test cases would be sampling uniformly from the admissible values and are shown to be effective detecting those bugs. The manually created test suites are specially designed for some type of errors and can guarantee the bug detection as well as locate those bugs.

articleTitle: Research on slab-cable structure
abstract: Slab-cable structure, which is a new form of deployable structure, is proposed due to the disadvantages in practical application of current deployable structures; for instance, the excessive joints and units, and as a result, cumbersome unfolding procedures and unwillingness to provide space with large spans, complicated manufacturing processes which to some extent limit the wide application of deployable structures. Slab-cable structure is developed based on the three-hinge arch system, which is one of the most reasonable type of structure when bearing uniform loads, and further decrease the degree of freedom of the structure in order to enhance structural rigidity and thus makes structure with high bearing capacity as well as stability. Slab-cable structure system, does not only give consideration to the advantages of conventional deployable structures such as availability of reusing, convenience of storage and transportation, but also make up the shortages: slab-cable structure has low requirements for the manufacturing accuracy of each units and technology during assembling because of its fewer units and simple joints; and it can be used to provide large inner space thanks to the arch-like format. Slab-cable structure is analyzed theoretically and experimentally in various aspects, in order to confirm this structure is reasonable and efficient so that wide application can be prospected.

articleTitle: Argument on the construction and optimization of the head teacher's harmonious environment
abstract: It needs the environment to provide the essential physical conditions, the spiritual condition and the activity spots for a head teacher's work development. If there are not the conditions and the places to make the guarantee, a head teacher is unable to do the work normally. The construction and optimization of environment itself is one kind of education, a head teacher's working progress itself is the construction and optimization of harmonious working conditions. The construction and optimization of harmonious working conditions should keep to the following principles: the integrity, the excitability, people-oriented, the creativity, fairness and tolerance. We can discuss the basic way to optimize the head teacher's harmonious working conditions according to the following three aspects : Setting up the harmonious ideas and integrating educational resources optimizes macroscopic environment in which the head teacher works; establishing incentive mechanism and improving related systems makes medium environment which the head teacher works; Persisting the Theory of “People Oriented”, promoting working abilities and building the microscopic environment.

articleTitle: Study on optimum fusion algorithms of IKONOS high spatial resolution remote sensing image
abstract: IKONOS image provides the 1m high spatial panchromatic and the 4 m multi-spectral data, which can be fused to improve the class accuracy of visual or computer interpretation. The fusion techniques have been developed an important remote sensing research topic. In this paper, with the IKONOS image of CHONGQING acquired on May 23, 2010 as the experimental data, several image fusion algorithms as commonly used in the image fusion experiment were applied; analysis for the experimental results were made on the basis of two remote sensing image processing softwares: ENVT 4.7 and ERDAS 9.3. It is shown that Gram-schmidt fusion algorithm of ENVI 4.7 is the optimum method for IKONOS high spatial resolution remote sensing image.

Author Keywords: High spatial resolution remote sensing image

articleTitle: Current situation and development prospects of college sports education under the context of information technology
abstract: The emergence of new technology has provided new insights into the traditional sports education in China's colleges. Analyzing the problems and their causes existing in our current tertiary sports education, following the pedagogical principle of "Health First" and "Knowledge and Creativity", we point out the informationalized sports education will be the main trend in the future. We further build up a corresponding teaching network in order to strengthen and promote the development and application of new information technology in the reform and improvement of tertiary sports education.

articleTitle: Study on goal-oriented urban design
abstract: This thesis starts from the angle of rational construction of the urban design process, proposes goal-oriented urban design on basis of problem identification, and carries out relevant explanation from the practical level combining with specific case, aiming at providing theoretical foundation as a reference for urban designers to propose effective and creative urban design plans.

articleTitle: Effect of electromagnetic stirring on the formation of primary phase of Al-Si alloys
abstract: Research ZL102Al-Si alloy under the effect of electromagnetic stirring changes of microstructure and study the Al Si alloy under electromagnetic stirring solidification. Test showed Electromagnetic Stirring could chang the behavior of solidification in gear to Al-Si alloys. Atomic group of Al-Si alloy melt segregation is merged in the electromagnetic force and electromagnetic stirring. Al-Si alloy melt in the formation of local micro-area transient voltage by electromagnetic stirring and reduced critical radius required for nucleation.

articleTitle: User friendly Synthesizer Software
abstract: The Synthesizer Software [SyS] teaches the users to play the keyboard. It acts as a substitute for human teachers. It accepts the audio file which the user wants to learn and then highlights keys on the GUI. The highlighted keys will show the user the keys to be pressed in accordance with the songs/melody and will wait for user input. Based on these inputs, the system generates a Report that will analyze his performance. In this paper, we discuss the functionalities of the Synthesizer Software system.

articleTitle: Surcharse precompression processing technique of the C Port cargo area for the low infiltration & deep thick silty
abstract: Lianyungang Jingangwan international logistics park is constructed in the coastal soft soil, the freight traffic loads is large, high demands is must to the Port cargo area. For consultation in the soft soil in the economy of Port cargo area works, "Plastic drainage board and preloading" are used to processing the soft soil of the C Port cargo area, combined with the researches, Proved this method is reasonable and effective. We not only guaranteed the quantity of the reconstruction project, and the cost is lower that the budget. In this article we will share our experiences and techniques.

Author Keywords: soft soil of Port cargo area

articleTitle: A novel method concerning about image transition region extraction and segmentation
abstract: According to the feature that the gray distribution of the transition region (locating between the objects and the background) is more scattered than that of the regions of targets or background in an image, this paper proposes a novel method concerning about transition region extraction and segmentation, which is based on local variance of different areas of an image. The experiments indicate that the proposed approach can achieve better segmentation results than the local complexity method (one of the previous methods for extracting transition region).What's more, the novel approach outperforms the local complexity method about more complete and more accurate transition regions, less interference from backgrounds, more detail information of segmented targets, clearer and better segmented targets, easier calculation, and higher processing speed.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis based on fuzzy neural network
abstract: A method for fault diagnosis of Aircraft Subsystem based on the fuzzy neural network (FNN) is put forward. To automatically acquire the fuzzy rule-base and the initial parameters of the fuzzy model, the improved method based on fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is used in structure identification. Then a initial FNN is constructed to match with the fuzzy model. The FNN is trained by its learning algorithm to obtain a precise fuzzy model and realize parameter identification. The model of aircraft subsystem fault diagnosis is set up by using the measured data at the fixed-check state on the ground as learning samples. Finally as testing and analysising the fault diagnosis model, the results show that this method has the advantages of anti-noise, anti-sensitive and higher diagnosing precision.

articleTitle: Optimization of urban morphology for comprehensive disaster prevention supported by GIS
abstract: In the rapid urbanization process, there are many irrational existences of urban morphology, thus a large amount of potential disasters lurk. The paper aims to throw a light upon the present urban morphology and some conflicts about urban disaster prevention. This research was given from the viewpoint of urban disaster prevention through several cases of different types of urban disaster. Then the relations between the optimization of urban morphology and urban disaster prevention were analyzed, e.g. location of the city, urban size and environmental capacity, direction for urban development, space urban structure, etc. Furthermore, an application was probed, which was used by some space information technology, such as GIS, in the disaster-oriented urban form optimization.

articleTitle: The influence of interaction between man and nature on urban spatial morphology
abstract: The different interactions between man and nature in different historical periods lead to different urban spatial morphology. The urban space of the ancient Yichang city was mainly influenced by the idea of “the harmony between man and nature”, and the urban spatial morphology was a passive choice conforming to the natural environment. In modern times, the urban space is influenced by the idea of “respecting nature” and “transforming nature”. In 1840, limited by territory of Yangtze River, the Yichang city was belt in form and in modern times, with the rapid expansion, it developed into spatial structure of community, limited by Yangtze Rive and the highlands. In new periods, under the guidance of sustainable development, Yichang develops into a spatial structure of “decentralized concentration” and create specific characteristics of landscape garden by making full use of the natural environment.

articleTitle: Retracted: Impact of magnetization field/torsion field on the formation of hexagonal water crystal
abstract: In this paper, the morphology growth of hexagonal water crystal under effect of magnetization field and “torsion field” was investigated. In order to conduct the experiment, we use permanent magnets having their own “torsion field” according to the study of A. I. Veineik [1] to consider how the proportion and the shape of hexagonal water crystal appear with different strength of magnetic field divided into three ranges: under 1500 gausses, from 1500 gausses to 3000 gausses, and over 3000 gausses. The experimental results revealed a remarkable difference between treatment water and no treatment one. The higher proportion of hexagonal water crystal happened in water samples treated with “torsion field”, from 1 to 4 successful samples in 30 samples. Otherwise, This difference also occurs in the three-range of magnetic field strength which was under 1500 gausses, from 1500 to 3000 gausses and over 3000 gausses, respectively. Moreover, in the range of over 3000 gausses, we conducted the experiments with different treatment time with “torsion field” to investigate the appearance rate of hexagonal water crystal according to the change of time in 12 hours, 24 hours and 48 hours, respectively. Under observation, when the strength of magnetic field was under 1500 gausses, the hexagonal water crystal was not perfect. Conversely, these hexagonal water crystals in the range of from 1500 to 3000 gausses were more perfect and complicated than those in the smaller range. For the rest part of the range, the proportion of hexagonal water crystal decreased or seldom appeared with different time of “torsion field” treatment. These empirical results proved that the “torsion field” of permanent magnets effect to the hexagonal water crystal formation.

articleTitle: Optimal design of the muffler based on numerical calculation
abstract: Based on the physical modeling of the improved muffler in this paper, Methods for internal acoustic computation of the muffler with SYSNOISE software based on Indirect Boundary Element Method are introduced and the rationality of the improved modal validated by the computation results in this paper, which may be a credible guidance of the muffler improving design.

articleTitle: Research on Markov-Switching model
abstract: On analyzing the basic thought of the parameter estimates of Markov switching model, and researching on the derivation of likelihood function, This paper deduces the smooth probability and the expected duration of the state variable of Markov-Switching model, so as to provide a reference for other researchers.

articleTitle: How to select information management models for the small and medium-sized enterprises
abstract: The further development of small and medium-sized enterprises need information management. This paper puts forward three models for small and medium-sized enterprises to select with business characteristics; Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) provides a qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis of information integration pattern for the small and medium-sized enterprises to choose their information management model.

articleTitle: Experimental research on coagulation floating combination process used in oily wastewater
abstract: The flotation process were tested by the method of coagulating sedimentation in oily wastewater. The influence of PAC, PAFC, complex coagulation agent (PAFC + PAM) and the solution pH value on the oil removing effect after coagulation were studied. The coagulation tests showed that: the complex coagulation agent has the best effect, with the best dosage of PAFC 400 mg /L, PAM 1 mg /L and the best pH value range of 6 to 10, when the removal rate of oil was 95%. The flotation process experiments show that : in the optimization condition, with the PAFC dosage of 250 mg /L, PAM dosage of 1 mg/L, the removal rate of oil can reach 98%. Results show that: the flotation process has better effect than the coagulating sedimentation process on the treatment of oily wastewater.

articleTitle: The similar design method of unloading rock mass in model test and its application
abstract: The unloading injury and constitutive equation of unloading rock mass isn't linear. Therefore, the similar design method of unloading rock mass can't be designed according to the linear elastic constitutive model. So the dimensional analysis is adopted. The result shows that there are only two basic similar scales if the complete geometric similarity is used. All other similar scales can be deduced according to these two basal similar scales. The test method is easy to use. In the end, the design method and experimental program on conglomerate is briefly introduced.

articleTitle: The research and analysis on the situation of college students' on-line games
abstract: Using questionnaire to inquire 3,402 college students nationwide, we analyze the situation of college students' on-line games through three aspects: the time, the types and the purpose of playing on-line game. The results come as follows: the time college students playing on-line games is skewed distribution; role-playing game, puzzle games and shooting games are the three most favourite games among college students; the two main purposes of playing on-line games are “killing time” and “releasing pressure”; the situation of playing on-line games presents difference on gender, grade, major and so on.

articleTitle: High-precision magnetic measurement data in Huailai prospecting application areas
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the use of 1:10000 magnetic measurement data for geological structure Huailai area and its interpretation. Through the region to deal with the geomagnetic data, the method further summarized the conditions and sign the application. In the data processing, the use of Surfer8.0 software grid for data preprocessing. Use of conventional gravity and magnetic data processing software, upward extension, vertical second derivative(0°, 45°, 90°and 135°), Horizontal direction derivative and other data-processing. All maps and intermediated processing results maps and intermediate processing results maps are using mapping software Surfer8.0. Based on the analysis and comparison of the results of middle-handling chart, to draw the characteristics of magnetic anomaly map (fracture or structural boundaries). Re-use of geomagnetic data and geological data analysis and comparison of the study area conducted a preliminary geological interpretation, to infer the structure of the region partition maps and fracture distribution. Underground geology in the region have further understanding of the situation with a view to the future in the study area can be helpful to mineral exploration.

articleTitle: A lightweight embedded Web server for non-PC device
abstract: With the development of World Wide Web, more and more non-PC devices are required to networking. So embedded web servers are needed and they have been used in multitude of embedded applications. With them the remote maintenance and diagnosis of components and systems by Web browsers via the Internet or a local Intranet has a very weight for many development projects. In this paper the architecture of a EWS is presented and its implementation is also introduced in detail. Finally, a real application example shows the performance of this EWS.

articleTitle: The changes in soil physical and chemical characteristics at different desertified lands in alpine meadow region
abstract: The paper investigated the soil organic C (SOC), total N (TN), pH value (pH) and soil bulk density (SBD) in the bottom and the middle of slope during different desertification stages at Maqu alpine meadow. The results showed that the content of SOC, TN and C/N declined with the development of desertification, SOC declined distinctly than TN; SBD and pH increased with the development of desertification.

articleTitle: Using Genetic neural networks in image segmentation researching
abstract: Due to the complexity of image segmentation, using genetic algorithm optimizes the weights and thresholds of BP neural network to get the neural network with minimum error, then proceeds the iterative calculations of image pixel. Experiments show that the algorithm correctly segments image and improves efficiency and the robustness and accuracy of image segmentation significantly. Meanwhile the different size and signal to noise ratio of the target image can be split with better results.

articleTitle: A study of a new type 2-dominating fuzzy matrix
abstract: In this paper the fuzzy matrices of the 2-dominating type were discussed in detail. It was shown that the 2-dominating type is a more general class than those have been discussed before,and the results established for matrices of 2-dominating type is as good as the results obtained for controllable matrices. Therefore most commonly used types of fuzzy matrices can be examined under the framework of 2-domating matrices, and the convergence index or oscillating index can be estimated based on the results.

articleTitle: The construction of Public Video Service Platform base on IPV6
abstract: On the basis of the current situation of streaming media application, this article analyses the limitations of traditional streaming video service platform. Seeing that present defect oft application of traditional streaming media. On the one hand, it introduces IPV6 network into Public Video Service Platform, which guarantees the reliable transmission of streaming media. On the other hand, this paper sets out from the construction status of public video service platform, aiming to create a logical clearness and complete functions public video service platform with leisure, entertainment and study in one body on the Internet, which will provide video on demand services for online users free of charge.

articleTitle: Analysis on intelligent construction of stadium based on virtual operation mode
abstract: Large stadium is designed and constructed to address the short and huge numbers of people, logistics, and information flow which brought by large-scale sports events; therefore, the post-match benefit of stadium is the difficult problem which troubles sports management departments and operation organizations of various countries. Virtual operation mode can take full advantages of modern computer and network technology, and at the same time keeps the stadium property unchanged. This paper mainly discusses how to introduce the intelligent agent technology and realize the virtual operation mode in stadium, in order to use the advantages of stadium facility resources to solve the stadium idle problem through modern information technology combined with sports transcations of demand and supply, then effectively promote stadiums economic benefits and social benefits.

articleTitle: A graph cuts based human shadow extraction using entropy-expressed texture and color features
abstract: Human shadow is one of the most important aspects which can be used for gait recognition. However, human shadow extraction is a hard task due to the umbra-penumbra phenomenon and backlight effects. In this paper, a new Graph Cuts based human shadow extraction method using entropy-expressed texture and color features is proposed. In this method, the local area attributes are estimated totally both by the entropy-expressed texture and color features to build the data term, and the whole-optimized shadow region are extracted by using of the Graph Cuts theory. Some experimental results show that our method is stable and efficient under different conditions.

articleTitle: Research and design of data acquisition system in TD-LTE Wireless Integrated Testing Platform
abstract: Based on TD-LTE (TD-SCDMA Long Term Evolution) Integrated Testing Platform, data acquisition need to be completed between DSP and FPGA, a realizing scheme of downlink link processing in system is proposed, with which complete the design and verification of the McBSP (Multichannel Buffered Serial Port) interface in the FPGA chip of series Virtex-5. The scheme has been used in TD-LTE wireless integrated testing instruments to complete large-capacity uplink data acquisition, meet the requirements of TD-LTE test in terms of processing speed and data accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on the site selection of logistics park based on the AHP method: Take Jiaozuo city for an example
abstract: In order to provide the planning basis and explore the best layout program for logistics park layout, this paper takes Jiaozuo city as an example and selects several factors, such as position, facilities, function and development potential to design a comprehensive evaluation indicator system in site selection of logistics park with the GIS platform, and then At last, the paper points out the location of five logistics parks in Zhongzhan district, Macun district, High-tech Zone, Qinyang city and Xiuwu county and obtains the best layout program of logistics parks in the method of AHP comprehensive evaluation. Field-proven results verify the design feasible and effective objectively.

articleTitle: Asymptotic stability of nonlinear singular discrete systems
abstract: In this paper, the stability of nonlinear singular discrete systems is discussed by the method of Lyapunov function. Some asymptotic stability criterions are given according to the equivalent system and the equivalent transformation, and the regularity is considered.

articleTitle: Establishment of estimation method for manure-borne steroid estrogens
abstract: Because of the wide existence and serious endocrine disturbing for humans and animals, the steroid estrogen hormones have been focused more and more in recent years. Steroidal estrogen hormones such as 17β-estradiol and estrone are particular concerns because there is evidence that low nanogram per liter concentrations of them in water can adversely affect the reproductive biology of fish and other aquatic vertebrate species. The animal manure is one of the main sources of steroid estrogens to the environment. Based on the literatures review, the study established the basical models to estimate the excretion of 17β-estradiol and estrone from five types of animals including pig, dairy cattle, beef cattle, layer and broiler. We tried to assess the yearly excretion of steroid estrogens from farm animals in China and compare the difference of excretion rates between five types of animal feces and urine. On the basis of current studies on the estrogens, the tendency for the future research in this field was discussed and suggested.

articleTitle: Youth online game analysis and countermeasures
abstract: Online games entertainment has become an important network life entertainment for vast of students. Through a lot of literature researches, this paper defined the concepts of network entertainment, introduced the current development of online games and addressed young students the reason why online games like, positive and negative effects from the two discussed the impact of the game for young students, and finally discussed countermeasures.

articleTitle: Generalized convexity with idempotent operations and its application in production theory
abstract: The aim of the paper is to introduce some of the concepts of generalized convexity using idempotent operations, to elaborate applications in the theory of production functions, and to apply the approach to studying a model of a triad 'resources institutions - production'.

articleTitle: The consolidated drained tests and numerical analysis on sewage sludge by using sand well
abstract: Abstract-The dewatered municipal sewage sludge is very difficult to re-dewatered, and becomes an important issue in wastewater treatment progress. As an effective soft foundation treatment technology, sand well foundation treatment technology could accelerate the rate of consolidation. It is extremely worth exploring whether making use of the sand wells to shorten the distance of drainage can increase the properties of dewatering. In this paper, the test device was first designed and a indoor sludge dewatering of the experiment was completed by using sand well, study the effects and laws of dehydration, enhance the efficiency of dehydration by the numerical analysis and optimization. The results showed that: the role of sand wells can improve the efficiency of sludge dewatering, sand well spacing, load size, load time, and such factors as the initial thickness of the sludge affect the deep dewatering. Through numerical analysis and optimization, this paper argues that the sand well spacing should be 5cm, load may be 800kPa about the size, duration of load could be 2~5h so as to the water content getting down to 60%.

articleTitle: Inflation adjustment on error covariance matrix of ensemble Kalman filter
abstract: In ensemble Kalman filter assimilation, the estimated forecast error covariance matrix and prior observational error covariance matrix could be far from the truth. This is likely to significantly affect the assimilation results. To compensate, this paper introduce two inflation factors to adjust forecast and observational error covariance respectively and estimate them simultaneously in one assimilation circle. The proposed schemes are tested using Lorenz-96 model, with a class of nonlinear observational operators. It illustrates that the improved assimilation schemes perform better than the original scheme.

articleTitle: Research on the framework of reverse engineering based on Logic Layer of Procedure Blueprint
abstract: Traditional reverse engineering is based on object code, which makes software understanding and reuse limited in a particular field. Combining the advantage of Model Driven Architecture in modeling with Natural language in understanding of program, this article puts forward a reverse engineering framework based on Procedure Blueprint which not only makes up for the lack of UML modeling in the program description of behavioral modeling, also reveals the procedure of behavior in Limited Natural Language. Establish the model from program source code to Implementation Layer of Procedure Blueprint by the XML technology, and by establishing the mapping rules according to the limited natural language grammar based on Logic Layer of Procedure Blueprint, the conversion from program expression of Implementation Layer to limited natural language semantics of Logic layer can be realized.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in the analysis of shearing capacity of deep beam
abstract: In order to set up analytical mode of shearing capacity of deep beam and seek for more significant influencing factors, the factors have been analyzed by fuzzy comprehensive judgment, combine with the theory of fuzzy set, compare and select the Method of Determination to the Index Weight, and determine the weights of each factors. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation has been proved to be simple and convenient by the evaluation analysis of examples, and the evaluation results are approximately identical to the actual test, which has comparable value in engineering application.

articleTitle: Convergence of randomly weighted sums for arrays under a condition of integrability
abstract: Let {X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ni</inf>, u<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> ≤ i ≤ ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>, n ≥ 1} and {A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ni</inf>, u<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> ≤ i ≤ ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>, n ≥ 1} be two arrays of random variables. A new notion of integrability for an array of random variables {X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ni</inf>} with respect to an array of random variables {A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ni</inf>} is introduced, weak laws of large numbers for the randomly weighted sums equation are obtained. Our results extend and sharpen the known results in the literature.

articleTitle: Software design of rail transit train braking system fault diagnosis based on MATLAB/VB
abstract: With the requirements of safety and reliability in brake system increasingly enhanced in urban transit train. For brake system the performance of prediction system and fault diagnosis must be increased at the same time. MATLAB is a high performance mathematics software integrated data analysis, numeric processing and graphic display, combined with the high powered software in VB graphical user interface, the convenience of developing fault diagnosis system not only has shorter time but also has good performance characteristics. This paper focus on the software design of brake system fault diagnosis in urban rail transit train, attempt to do some theoretical research for timely and effectively avoid for brake system in operation of the train traffic accident caused by failure.

articleTitle: The study of detection system based on TFDS is compatible with TVDS
abstract: Due to the requires for railway bus TVDS system and railway truck TFDS system to shoot using different cameras, this paper presents to design the compatible system between TFDS and TVDS by the target body design, studying the pattern of the target body and the installation location, achieving the compatibility of the two systems; the paper also studied to achieve the function by using the means of GPS the train coordinates and CDMA wireless data transfer notice, which is the detection system can detect through the inspection train, it improves the efficiency of the dynamic testing greatly and ensures the traffic safety.

articleTitle: Sensitivity simulation and analysis of CO2 injection for enhanced coalbed methane recovery
abstract: Injecting CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> into a coal seam with the purpose of enhancing desorption of coalbed methane can be applied to the long-term storage of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, which accompanies with complex coal gas interactions. In this study, a fully coupled coal deformation, gas flow, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> counter-diffusion and gas absorption/desorption finite element (FE) model was developed to investigate sensitivity of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> injection related parameters. Modeling results indicate that (1) CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> injectivity is positively sensitive to injecting pressure, so trying to increase the injecting pressure within the safe pressure threshold of coal seam, is an efficient solution to improve the methane recovery efficiency; (2) Initial coal permeability has positive impact on the performance of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> replacing methane. Larger initial permeability accompanies with larger CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> injectivity; (3) Increase to coal elastic modulus results in lower coal permeability and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> injectivity, showing that lower coal mechanical properties could be more suitable to binary gas diffusion.

articleTitle: The landscape design of cities both with mountains and waters
abstract: By taking Dandong which is the largest boundary city as an example, relevant problems about landscape design of cities with both mountain and water scenery are discussed. Based on analysis of function and orientation of along-mountain area, downwn area and waterfront area, the designs of landscape and grassland are investigated. Furthermore, the city's natural attributes, particularly the relationship between the physiognomy and the urban landscape design, are discussed, thus a new concept of advocating planning and designing the landscape with obeying the natural process is proposed.

articleTitle: Image processing based burglarproof system using silhouette image
abstract: Image processing based burglarproof systems used today mainly depend on the features extracted from a front face. But several problems cannot be solved currently, e.g., fake face, covered face, etc. Here we propose a method to solve the problem of the traditional Automatic Teller Machine burglarproof system.

articleTitle: Design of combination logic circuits based on variant-length cellular automata
abstract: During the past decade, using genetic algorithm (GA) to design circuit, which called as evolvable hardware (EHW) technology, had attracted many experts' attention. In this paper, EHW based on variant-length cellular automata (CA) to designed combination logic circuit is described. The state of cell in CA is no longer as ‘0’ or ‘1’ but a bits string that indicates an embryonic circuit. The length of cell's encodes is dynamically grow while a correct circuit is not been found. Each cell in CA can exchange information with their neighbor in parallel. The experiments have indicated that parallel evolutionary strategy combining with dynamic developed encoding method can automatically design and optimize the object circuit efficiently.

articleTitle: Application of numerical analysis method in estimating kinetic model parameters of complex chemical reactions
abstract: Chemical kinetic parameter estimation, such as the estimations of the rate constants and the kinetic exponents, is very important. According to these parameters, we can speculate the reaction mechanisms. There are four main types of chemical reactions: simple n-order reaction, consecutive reaction, parallel reaction and reversible reaction. In this paper, a parameter estimate method of using numerical analysis for these chemical reactions is proposed. By example of the ethyl acetate hydrolytic reaction, we verified the good accuracy of the method, as well as its reliability.

articleTitle: Collaboratively modeling buildings from large-scale street-side and remote sensing images
abstract: This paper proposed an approach to rapidly generate 3D models for street-side buildings from street-side images, remote sensing images, and GPS information. Traditional modeling methods usually require a single user to fulfill all processes of 3D modeling, and lack efficient management on massive data. Thus, they are unsuitable for large-scale modeling. In order to overcome those drawbacks, we employ the pipeline idea. The modeling processes are divided into several steps, which are further assembled to form a pipeline elaborately. We allocate computing resources into each step according to their requirements; on the other side, human resources are deployed into the pipeline to achieve team-work modeling. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, we developed a distributed prototype system for rapid large-scale urban 3D modeling. This system was tested to build an urban scene with more than 500, 000 street-side images. The results show great improvement on modeling efficiency compared with traditional methods, and it reveals a great prospect in applications.

articleTitle: The Application of impedance-weighted network distance in Urban land grading
abstract: This paper analyses limitations exist in the calculation of the land grading score though the simple network distance between the land cell and the land effection factors, and make three improvements: 1) establish a unified road network including the current roads and the planning ones; 2) define impedance Coefficient for different space-media(including roads) to correct the distance. As the shortest cost while routing; 3) think the desired distance is a fuzzy measure between the straight-line distance and the minimum cost network distance. By designing the algorithm the Empirical studies have done and shown that: After the above improvements, the land grading scores calculated from impedance-weighted network distance is more reasonable, more in line with the actual situation and expectations.

articleTitle: Demand research of construction of China's regional international logistics information comprehensive service platform
abstract: In recent years, the construction of logistics information entered into rapid development period. Regional international logistics information platform plays a tremendous role in promoting enterprises logistics information processing ability, speeding up market response speed, extending service, improving logistics operation efficiency and reducing logistics cost. Therefore, China's regional international logistics comprehensive service platform should be built up as soon as possible in order to respond enterprises` need. This article mainly introduces Trans-regional international trade logistics booking collaboration and reports this service corresponding product demand survey.

articleTitle: Planning and construction of characteristic ecological village
abstract: It takes “small cost, great benefits, low emissions, and sustainability” as its aim to construct a rural area into an energy-saving, environment-friendly, healthy, secure, and comfortable eco-civilized village. The planning and construction of ecological villages requires to deal well with the influences from factors such as geography, climate, living creature, human culture to the construction of villages and the relationship between ecological construction and the comprehensive control of hills, farms, rivers, roads, ditches, reservoirs, and villages. The construction of ecological villages is a process of integrated design of rural agricultural activities, rural life and ecological environment. Reasonable planning can lead to good economic system of ecological agriculture. Village's ecological environment can be changed by using environment-friendly energy. The harmony between man and nature as well as environment and economy can be realized by developing ecological economy, ecological landscape and energy saving.

articleTitle: Research on phosphorus removal by non-metallic mineral in wastewater treatment
abstract: In order to solve the environmental pollution caused by phosphorus wastewater, research on treatment of phosphorus wastewater by non-metallic mineral such as zeolite, bentonite, attapulgite, sepiolite and vermiculite was summarized. The results show that treatment of phosphorus wastewater by non-metallic mineral has the characteristic of simple in process, good effect and lower operation cost. And this process has expansive application foreground. The problems remained were pointed out. Further research on the mechanism of wastewater treatment with non-metallic mineral, separation and final utilization of the saturated non-metallic mineral are needed to do in the near future.

articleTitle: Research and design of the audio coding scheme
abstract: Audio Coding is widely used in telecommunications, computers, and electronic products and so on. Different audio Coding scheme has different compression efficiency and different vendors have different compression standards. This paper introduces MPEG-1, MPEG-2 AAC audio coding standards and principles. They, the mainstream of today's audio coding standards, is based on the psychoacoustic theory. They makes full use of the auditory characteristics and only transmit the information that human ear can feel in order to compress the encoding and decoding. According to the MPEG-2 AAC encoding and decoding compression Algorithm, an audio coding system is designed with the system flow chart.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis and determining methods for modification coefficients between floor-area rate and urban land price
abstract: Floor-area Ratio as the main index on the control of land use is one of the key factors having an effect on the land value. Referring to the actual situation of the land grade and land value estimation in Beihai city, this paper firstly analyses the principals between floor-area rate and land value from many Theoretical views; then put foreword the concrete methods of how to determining the Modification coefficient between the floor-area ratio and the sample land prices. A case study was done in Beihai City of China.

articleTitle: Survivability evaluation indexes of command information system under complex electromagnetic environment
abstract: For survivability evaluation of command information system, it is important to build efficient survivability evaluation indexes. To solve the problems of unclear index classification, weak index operability and incomplete index content, a three-level structure of survivability evaluation indexes is proposed for command information system under complex electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: The discussion of landscape planning and ecology restoration of Hydropower Project base on temporal and spatial perspective
abstract: With the development of science technology, human being have a increased demand for energy. Building Hydropower Project vigorously has been a important way to energy exploitation. It's no doubt that Hydropower Project created a high economy efficiency, while it made seriously damage to environment. There are series of problems have appeared, such as ecological imbalance, environmental vulnerability, landslides etc. Those cases not only influenced landscape effect of hydropower districts, but also restricted their sustainable development. In this article, according to the temporal and spatial dynamic analysis of landscape fragmentation about hydropower construction districts, we summarized the influencing factors of landscape fragmentation used the theory and technology of landscape ecological restoration. We put forward measures of landscape ecological restoration of Hydropower construction districts.

articleTitle: Symmetry groups and new exact solutions of (2+1)-dimemsional Broer-Kaup-Kupershmidt(BKK) system
abstract: Using the modified CK's direct method, we derive a symmetry group theorem of (2+1)-dimemsional Broer-Kaup-Kupershmidt (BKK) system. Some exact solutions of the model are given by the simple method.

articleTitle: An edge detection technique based on geometrical features
abstract: This paper proposed an edge detection technique based on extracting geometrical features from images . With helping of geometrical features,such as line and point features , fault connections are removed , edges of targets are refined.And we implement this algorithom on random arrangement capsule edge detection,and rely on refined edges defective capsules are detected and counted successfully.

articleTitle: The effect of urban flood control on evolution of the urban morphology: Case study of Changde, Hunan
abstract: Waters are the source of urban existence for waterfront cities, nevertheless also the limitation to urban growth, and so urban flood control comes crucial to the evolution of urban space. The waterfront city of Changde at the lower reach of Yuanshui in the Dongtinghu plain is taken as a case to examine the impact and role of the emergence and shift of urban flood control system on urban morphological evolution. It is also pointed out that urban flood control is the major factor limiting the urban morphology evolution of waterfront cities, and will gain more impacts on the size and direction of urban growth.

articleTitle: Shape reconstruction of the object immersed in the incompressible fluid flow
abstract: In this paper, we present a formulation and numerical results of the shape reconstruction of the object immersed in the incompressible fluid flow. The cost functional should be minimized satisfying the Naiver-Stokes equations. The Shape sensitivity analysis of the cost functional was derived based on the adjoint method. The level set method is successfully utilized as the minimization algorithm, which is implemented in an Eulerian framework, therefore the computational cost is moderate. For the numerical study, the optimal shape of the body which has a rectangle shape as an initial state can be finally obtained as the circular target shape.

articleTitle: Image detection method based on fuzzy set theory
abstract: Image is an objective reflection of natural scenery. The light information of objects' projection or reflection forms an impression or understanding in the brain after received by the human visual system. Image processing is to process and dispose by some mathematical operation on the image information in order to meet the human visual and physical needs. This paper analyzes and compares the existing Image enhancement algorithm based on fuzzy set theory and proposes a new image detection algorithm. This algorithm utilizing the generalized fuzzy enhancement ideas and considering the region characteristics of the image's object area, background area and the edge area, proposes a faster and better enhancement operator of the edge detection which is especially for detecting low-contrast images, images with finer part, and texture-rich images.

articleTitle: Experimental study on water conduction of sliding surface in an expansive soil slope
abstract: Strength of the expansive soil is sensitive to water content, and the strength declines as the water content increasing. The property change of sliding surface is important to the stability of the expansive soil slope. Therefore, the water conduction characteristic of the sliding surface is important to the stability of the slope. We set three observation pits that are 3 m interval along the toe of an expansive soil slope. The water level in the three pits is pronounced different, and an outflow zone of water appears along the toe of the slide slope a period after a rainfall. The experiment indicates a part of rainwater can flow into the slope soil through cracks on the expansive soil slope during and after the rainfall. This part of rainwater flows along the sliding surface in expansive soil slope under the hydraulic gradient, and the water conduction ability along the sliding surface is serious, which may decreases the stability of the expansive soil slope.

articleTitle: A numerical solution technique for a Timoshenko beam-column with generalized end conditions
abstract: In this paper, the numerical simulation for a weakened Timoshenko beam under constant axial load is considered. We present a lineared three-level difference scheme on uniform meshes by the method of reduction of order for a Timoshenko beam. A numerical example is presented to verify the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the unified authentication in heterogeneous wireless convergence networks
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the different authentication information and authentication methods in heterogeneous wireless network, based on the idea of the separation of identity, position, addressing etc information, the paper puts forward the unified client identity, and builds a complete client identity hiding and substitution mechanism, which effectively solve the moving terminals unified access in heterogeneous wireless integration network. The result of Theory analyzing and experiment shows that the unified authentication mechanism appeases heterogeneous network real-time corresponding essence demands. The project provides a testing flat for the unified authentication of the heterogeneous wireless integration network, and offers technology support for further solving the general dependable access and seamless roaming problem.

articleTitle: Adomian method solution for flow of a viscoelastic fluid through a porous channel with expanding or contracting walls
abstract: Flow of a viscoelastic fluid in porous channels with expanding or contracting walls is investigated.
