Using similar transformation, the governing equations are reduced to a nonlinear fifthorder differential equation. The Adomian method is employed to obtain the expression for velocity fields. The analytical solutions are influenced by the permeation Reynolds number Re, the wall expansion ratio α and viscoelastic parameter ω. The effects of some values of parameters on velocity are discussed in details.

articleTitle: First principles study on electronic structure and optical properties of pure and Au or Ag doped zinc blende ZnS
abstract: The electronic structure and optical properties of pure and Au or Ag doped zinc blende ZnS were calculated by first principles ultrasoft pseudo-potential approach of the plane wave based on the density functional theory. The calculated results show that the density of states near Fermi energy level is derived from Au 5d and Ag 4d states. Besides, the optical dielectric function graph shows an obvious red shift and a new peak of optical absorption appeared at the lower energy side after doping with Au and Ag.

articleTitle: A novel feature weighting method for FIT Based saliency area detection
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is proposed to weight the contribution of different feature maps for Feature Integration Theory (FIT) based saliency area detection in static images, aiming to imitate the bottom-up attention mechanism of Human Visual System. Firstly, the same topographic representation feature maps are generated through extracting color, orientation features of an original image. Then the corresponding weight is computed for each feature map based on its shape parameter of Generalized Gaussian Distribution (GGD) and variance of position distribution so as to generate the saliency map through combination of feature maps with their computed weights. Through comparison with experimental eye tracking data, the results on natural images demonstrate that our proposed method is more efficient than other existing methods on jointly consideration of predicting accuracy and time consuming. Moreover, this method is also fairly universal and can be applied to the other existing FIT based saliency computational models.

articleTitle: On the mathematics teaching strategies in the network environment
abstract: With the popularity and development of computers and the Internet, the network technology has found more and more applications in education. We should make good use of it to conduct mathematics teaching. This paper emphasizes the selection, design and application of the mathematics teaching strategies in the network environment.

articleTitle: The review of antibiotics in the global water environment
abstract: This review uses dozens of domestic and foreign literatures which were published in the last 10 years, and outlines the antibiotic problems in two different aspects below: the development of the antibiotics' analytical technology and the current situation of antibiotic pollutions in the water environment. The conclusion shows that it is still arduous and urgent to solve the problem about eliminating antibiotic pollutions.

articleTitle: Similarity transformation and exact solutions to the generalized (3+1)-Dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation with distributed coefficients
abstract: In this paper, a similarity transformation is presented to reduce the generalized (3+1)-dimensional (D) nonlinear Schrodinger equation (NLSE) with distributed coefficients to the related constant-coefficients (3+1)D NLSE. Some Jacobi elliptic function solutions are given by a generalized subequation method for the constant-coefficients equation. Thus some general solutions for the generalized (3+1)D NLSE are constructed by the similarity transformation and the Jacobi elliptic function solutions. Some figures are given to illustrate the main evolution properties of these general solutions by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Rate-Distortion Optimization in HTTP Streaming
abstract: HTTP Streaming plays an important role in today's multimedia distribution over internet. Besides the data rate of network, the quality of user experience of HTTP Streaming is also related to multimedia's distortion that server could limit under a certain bit-rate. Given a specific bandwidth, how to provide the HTTP Streaming client the multimedia content with the least distortion in HTTP Streaming system is what this paper want to discuss, which we call Rate-Distortion Optimization problem in HTTP Streaming.

articleTitle: Studying on identification of the historic building in the building legacy protected
abstract: It is a very urgently realistic question that how to protect and make good use of buildings legacy better with city developing in the present reconstructions of city. For protecting the historic buildings better, the research content of this paper is the identification of historic buildings as starting point with the protecting method.

articleTitle: Applications of computer simulation in statistical optimization problems
abstract: Optimization problems exist in many areas of statistics, and such problems are very difficult to get the exact solution by mathematical or statistical theory. In such situations, computer simulation is a feasible way. In this paper, some examples are presented to show how to use computer simulation in optimization problems in areas of parameter estimation and hypothesis testing.

articleTitle: K-stable subsets of extended derivations on Banach algebras
abstract: In this paper we discuss the generalized Hyers-Ulam Rassias $K$-stable subsets of extended derivations on Banach algebras associated to a generalized Jensen equation.

articleTitle: Layout recognition of multi-page document based on Naive Bayes
abstract: A layout recognition method for multi-page document image is proposed in this paper.Because there exists of spacings in vertical and horizontal direction in this kind of document, vertical and horizontal projection are used to extract the layout feature and Naive Bayes classifier is generated to realize the layout recognition of multi-page document. Experimental results show that the method of this paper has higher accuracy and efficiency,and has practicality and value to some extent.

articleTitle: The alternative choice of National Land Restoration-translation of land and space and local participation
abstract: This paper focuses on Pingtung's 'Raise Water, Grow Electricity' plan. Through this case study to better understand how the local government, business and local people can work together to propose a solution to turn a highly populated disaster area into a land conservation space without hindering the developmental needs. Local participation is a vital step for the success of the plan. By introducing the new 'technical actant' to create translation of land and space and raise new alternative income source. This plan not just fulfilled the ethics of the government being a government, but also carried out the legitimacy of policies. The translated space will have more influence, bring in more actors and energy, and ultimately undertake better and greater actor network.

articleTitle: A high sensitive longitudinally driven giant magnetoimpedance of FeCo-based ribbon in weak magnetic field
abstract: In this article, a high sensitive longitudinally driven giant magneto-impedance (LDGMI) effect in Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">36</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">36</sub>Nb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4.8</sub>B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19.2</sub> (FeCo-based) ribbon under weak magnetic field (WMF) was presented. The FeCo-based amorphous ribbon was prepared by single roller quench and annealed with joule-heat in flowing nitrogen atmosphere. The LDGMI effect profiles of FeCo-based ribbon have been measured with HP4294A impedance analyzer. The result shows that the LDGMI effect of FeCo-based ribbon responds to the WMF sensitively (as high as 1380 %/A·m-1). The super high sensitivity can be obtained in a moderate narrow range of annealing current density (27~34 A/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and closely depends on the driven current frequency. The highest sensitivity (1380 %/A·m-1) was observed when the FeCo-based amorphous ribbon annealed at 32 A/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for 10 minutes and then driven with AC at the frequency of 300 kHz. The high sensitive LDGMI effect in WMF may results from the multiple magnetic anisotropy structure which induced by the temperature grads in the ribbon. This high sensitive LDGMI effect in WMF is promising for the development of weak magnetic-field sensors.

articleTitle: Study on corn land suitablity assessment in Liaocheng district
abstract: Based on demands of corn habitat and using cultivated land as an assessment object at 25m × 25m grid resolution, a suitability evaluation index system of corn in Liaocheng city was established.The quantity, quality and spatial distribution of suitable land resources for corn were assessed by means of GIS technique,Some sustainable utilization countermeasures aiming at the corn situation and existing problems of land resources utilization for corn are proposed.

articleTitle: Anti-periodic boundary value problem for first order dynamic equations on time scales
abstract: In this paper we are concerned with the following first order anti-periodic boundary value problem on time scale T {x<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Δ</sup>(t) + λx(σ(t)) = f(t, x(σ(t))), t ϵ [0, T], x(0) = -x(σ(T)), where λ >; 0 is a parameter and f : [0, T]×R → R is continuous. Some existence criteria are established by using a Leray-Schauder nonlinear alternative.

articleTitle: Optical limiting characteristics of zinc phthalocyanine
abstract: In this paper, it is the first time to experimentally demonstrate the dependence of optical limiting performance of zinc phthalocyanine (ZnPc) dimethylformamide (DMF) solution on concentration and optical length. The optical limiting characteristics are measured at various concentrations and optical lengths. By employing a reverse saturable absorption (RSA) equation, the physical mechanism of such optical limiting is interpreted, leading to excellent agreement with the experimental results. The obtained results imply that the optical limiting effects are quite sensitive to both concentration and optical length, giving parameter guidance for designing optical limiter in practice.

articleTitle: Study on rate-quantization models based on main DCT coefficient distribution models
abstract: Rate-distortion (R-D) model that includes rate quantization (R-Q) and distortion-quantization (D-Q) models is very important in rate control and mode decision for video coding algorithm optimization. R-D model can be derived by rigorous mathematic analysis based on DCT coefficient distribution. Thus, the statistical distribution of DCT coefficients is very important for R-D modeling. Laplacian, Cauchy, and Generalized Gaussian Distribution (GGD) are three main distribution models. Some R-D models based on these three models were proposed in the literature. However, there is no systematic and rigorous comparison on their accuracy currently. In this paper, we had examined three coefficient distribution models for accuracy comparison. Also, we had examined main R Q models based on these three models. This work is meaningful for more accurate R-Q modeling in the future for efficient video coding algorithm optimization.

articleTitle: Study on influential factors of phosphate accumulating organisms
abstract: Phosphate accumulating organisms (PAO) is the most common sludge in sewage treatment, This paper examines the effect of carbon source, temperature, PH on PAO, providing references and basis for training.

articleTitle: A defect-correction method based on equal-order finite elements for the incompressible flows (II)
abstract: Based on stabilized defect-correction method and the stability and convergence of velocities, the property of pressures is emphatically discussed, and the stability and convergence of the method are accordingly proved for the each step. The error estimation results show that the constant in the estimation is independent of the viscosity coefficient but on a reduced viscosity coefficient λ + h , and one step of defect-correction method improves spatial accuracy in the previous step by one power of h. In a general way, combining with the proper timing k, the accuracy is proved to be o(h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>) in m - 1 step.

articleTitle: The survey and prevention of highway flood hazard in the eastern mountainous areas of Jilin Province
abstract: The catastrophic floods in Jilin province on July 28th 2010 led to the serious highway flood hazard in multiple places in eastern mountainous area, and brought about the huge economic losses. On the basis of the survey of highway flood hazard along the road, we analyse the reason of it. After that we put forward the measures of the prevention and cure, which including the measures of the design, construction, management, maintenance etc. Only making the prevention coming first, paying various attention of highway flood hazard, its occurrence can get effective control.

articleTitle: The monotone coherent of series-parallel system and parallel-series system
abstract: This paper has proved that the series-parallel system and the parallel-series system are the coherent systems. Furthermore, we give the coherent structure function of series-parallel connection system φ (x) = <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>Π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j=1</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>?<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i=1</sub> x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ij</sub> and the coherent structure function of parallel-series system φ (x) = <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>Π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j=1</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>?<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i=1</sub> x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ij</sub> and we also give the dual coherent structure function.

Author Keywords: the monotone coherent of structure function

articleTitle: Decision-making on economic maintenance of earthquake-resistant reinforced concrete structures
abstract: It is necessary to repair or reinforce earthquake resistant reinforced concrete structures during their service time since their safety performance may gradually deteriorate due to environmental factors such as concrete carbonation, steel erosion, natural aging, or earthquake damage. This paper adopts a benefit-cost analysis and puts forward an economic decision making method on preventive maintenance, pre-earthquake reinforcement, and post-earthquake repair and dismantling of structures, with consideration to earthquake damage accumulation, natural aging, and durability damage. It is of crucial theoretical significance and application value to the decision-making on the maintenance of structures.

articleTitle: The generation of digital terrain models from LiDAR data using seeding and filtering and its application to flood modelling
abstract: Digital terrain models are foundation of many applications. Several algorithms have been developed for laser point segmentation and usually each has its advantages and drawbacks. In this study, we present a novel unsupervised algorithm for digital terrain model generation, which combines the advantages of the seed-based filtering and the slope-based filtering to classify objects and ground points. We also apply the results of digital terrain models to flood modeling. The experimental results have shown that the proposed algorithm is able to handle large buildings and steep slopes for the generation of digital terrain models.

articleTitle: Experimental study on structure damage detection based on Electro-mechanical impedance technique
abstract: Based on the electro-mechanical impedance technology, experiments were carried out to study the damage identification. A precise impedance analyzer HP4294A was used to extract electricity admittance from free piezoelectric (PZT) patches to analyze the characteristics. And extract and analyze electricity admittance from PZT patch on the steel beam with original undamaged and different depth of cracks. In order to characterize the damaged severity of structure quantitatively, a damage index RMSD was employ in analyzing. The experiment results showed that Electro-mechanical impedance method can feasibly be used to detect small damages, the electricity admittance curves shift toward the left and the resonant frequencies corresponding to peak values reduce with increasing the depth of cracks in the steel beam. Index RMSD could quantify the damage degree precisely and effectively. Further study showed the effect of temperature, the length of the wire and the excitation voltage will be considered in the electricity admittance signal. These experiments lay basis for Electro mechanical impedance technique applied in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Application of OpenGL-based virtual collision avoiding technology in robot path planning simulation
abstract: In order to improve the sense of reality in virtual environments, based on the software platforms of VC++ and OpenGL, by taking advantage of complex modeling techniques and fast rendering algorithm, a three-dimensional simulation scenario system for the robot path planning is established. Its collision detection function in the virtual environment has been realized. And the simulation results show that the effect and fidelity of the simulation process in robot path planning can be remarkably improved by utilizing this collision avoiding technology in the virtual environment.

articleTitle: Spatialization approach to 1km grid GDP based on remote sensing
abstract: The applications of remote sensing data are maturing and the study of resources and environmental sciences greatly requires the spatialized data sets of socio-economic data which are always obtained from administrative regions at county or province level. Based on the summary and analysis of previous gross domestic product (GDP) spatialization approaches, with the regional differences of China's economic development, the authors integratedly analyze and establish a close spatial relationship between land use database derived from Landsat Multi-spectral TM image and primary industry, secondary industry, tertiary industry according to China's provincial-level administrative boundaries, eventually, create 1km gridded GDP map of China. GDP density map could be reflect complete details and characteristics of the national GDP distribution, which is extending the field of remote sensing research and application in the resources and environmental sciences. Thereby, the results are significant to policies of sustainable economic development and basically explore the interaction between socio-economic and regional ecological environment.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-speed JPEG image encoding system based on FPGA
abstract: This paper presents a design scheme of high-speed JPEG image encoding system based on FPGA. The encoder of this system can achieve the parallel processing of the input image sequences and work in pipeline mode. According to simulation test and FPGA verification, the whole system, which meets the JPEG standard for the requirements of image compression quality and compression ratio, can support the processing speed of 400fps for 1024x768 gray images, when the encoder core number is 4 and the working frequency is 100MHz. The high performance of the system can fully satisfy the demands of high speed and real time encoding applications.

articleTitle: Design of VoIP encryption algorithm based on H.323 protocol
abstract: As a result of some protocols of high security like SRTP protocol which is applied effectively in some occasions of quite high security requirements, here, propose an encryption algorithm based on one of the two major VoIP encryption algorithms which named H.323. As a fact, the security of those existing communication solutions need high investment, give a substantial decline in system performance, as well as increase in the problem of voice traffic delaying, this algorithm can be used with fewer invest, smaller sacrifice performance for commercial purposes. First introduce the basic architecture of VoIP briefly, then give an analysis of the main-stream protocols, select the H.323 protocol and study the family of this protocol about VoIP application, and finally add encryption algorithm to the corresponding application. The algorithm is designed on the variability of algorithms instead of the complexity of the encryption algorithm Thus, it can guarantee security on the basis of implementing simply and easily, consuming as small as possible and costing as low as possible.

articleTitle: A VBCM-RBF based meshless method for large deflection of thin plates
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of large deflection of thin plates depicted by the Berger equation and presents a meshless method based on the virtual boundary collocation method (VBCM) and radial basis functions (RBF). Firstly, we convert Berger equation to a linear fourth-order iterative equation, then the approximation solution can be obtained by VBCM and RBF, hence the problem is solved by the iterated collocation method. Finally, some numerical examples are given. Numerical results have proven that our method is more efficient and performs better than the local boundary integral equation (LBIE) method.

articleTitle: The opportunities and challenges of Internet medicine transaction services providers
abstract: China's pharmaceutical e-commerce is in the early stage of development. B2C and B2B although the formation of patterns such as e-commerce transactions, but with the continuous development of medical e-commerce, China will establish and apply large-scale third-party service platform for pharmaceutical e-commerce transactions to further promote the improvement and development of the pharmaceutical industry. Internet medicine transaction services providers have a tremendous opportunity for development in the national policy support, medical e-commerce booming and many other changes in consumer shopping habits, while also facing online information disclosure, system integration, security of online transactions and a series of challenges. Internet medicine transaction services providers need to properly deal with the situation, then they could get more achievements in the expansion of the wave of pharmaceutical e-commerce.

articleTitle: A super penalty C0 discontinuous Galerkin method for Kirchhoff plates
abstract: A super penalty C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> discontinuous Galerkin (SPCDG) method is developed for solving the Kirchhoff plate bending problem. For this method, optimal order error estimates in certain broken energy norm and H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>-norm are established with k≥5 where k is the order of the finite element polynomial. Moreover, we analyze the error estimates of the SPCDG method with 1≤ k <5.

articleTitle: A no-reference blockiness metric for videoconference
abstract: A no-reference blockiness metric which is used to measure blocking artifacts of H.264/AVC coding videoconference, is presented in this paper. The encode information extracted from bit stream in the decoding process and the human face information are used to construct a region-of-interest (ROI) map. Based on the ROI map, the Sobel operator is adpoted to make the fast estimation of blocking artifacts for H.264 videos. Experimental results show that the proposed method can measure blocking artifacts consistent with the real quality and show high sensitivity to the bit rate.

articleTitle: Vulnerability analysis of structures under loads based on the form
abstract: The robustness shows the ability of a structure to resist damage. For a structure small damage can lead to disproportionate consequences if it is not sufficiently robust. In this paper, the theory of structural vulnerability developed at the University of Bristol is applied to the analysis of vulnerable failure scenarios of the structure. The displacement response under unit force is used as a new measurement of the well-formedness to combine the theory with a standard response analysis and to identify the failure position of the structure under practical loads. Numerical analysis is carried out for vulnerable failure scenarios of a pin-jointed truss and a 24-member space frame. A comparison was made between the failure scenario of the structure due to the vulnerability analysis and the practical external loads. It is shown that this approach is efficient in the determination of the weakness and the failure position of structures under load actions.

articleTitle: IMS learning design and its application
abstract: IMS Learning Design (IMS LD 2003) is an open specification that can be used to specify a wide range of pedagogical strategies as formal models. Such formal models then can be interpreted and executed by IMS LD compatible players to support online learning. This chapter introduces the basic knowledge required to effectively use IMS LD. First of all, we present fundamental principles behind IMS LD. Then, we briefly introduce IMS LD implementation and application process. Finally, how to model learning designs using IMS LD is explained through demonstrating the whole procedure to model a use case.

articleTitle: Enhanced mean shift tracking algorithm based on evolutive asymmetric kernel
abstract: Aimed at the defect of the traditional mean shift tracking algorithm which using symmetric kernel function who contains amounts of background pixels, this paper presents an enhanced mean shift tracking algorithm based on evolutive asymmetric kernel to improve the tracking accuracy and stability. The paper firstly described the calculation method of Template Center which is the key issue in introducing asymmetric kernel function into mean shift algorithm framework. Then, to combine the expression and evolution of asymmetric kernel function, level set contour evolution algorithm using regional similarity is presented. Finally, the asymmetric kernel function update strategy is introduced. The above three points constitute the mean shift tracking algorithm based on active asymmetric kernel function overall context. Experimental results show that compared to existing methods, the mean shift tracking algorithm based on evolutive asymmetric kernel presented in this paper has higher accuracy and reliability, as well as meets the real-time requirements of general tracking tasks.

articleTitle: The assessment of water stress in Minqin County in China with the Water Poverty Index
abstract: Water has become an increasingly important issue in the world during the last few years. The paper describes the evaluation of water scarcity in Minqin County in Northwest China. The imbalance of water availability and water demand happened there, and the problems caused by over-using water resources have received increased attention. The Water Poverty Index is applied as a holistic tool to assess water stress at the yearly time scale in the study site. The study presents details of the methodology used, and the results show that water stress in the county has fallen over the past decade and that both Resources and Environment are the critical factors constraining the local water situations.

articleTitle: Construction of sustainable spatial structure of resource-exhausted cities
abstract: Sustainable development is an urgent task that resource-exhausted cities are facing. The role and potential of urban spatial structure (USS) in achieving environmental, economic and social sustainability of resource-exhausted cities is vital. The first part of this paper discusses the basic connotation of sustainable USS and set up a framework for it which includes the urban spatial form (USF) and the urban functional organization (UFO) in three interdependent dimensions: economic sustainability, social sustainability and environmental sustainability. In the second part, the characteristics and problems of the USS of Liaoyuan city are analyzed. In the end, merging theoretical framework and empirical analysis, the ways of USS optimization for Liaoyuan city in urban and regional scale are put forward.

articleTitle: Project based learning based on simulation and network of engineering hydrology
abstract: With the support of 3D digital basin and Hydrology Learning Content Management System (Hydro-LCMS), simulation and project based teaching of the engineering hydrology courses have been carried out, the results of course evaluation indicate that network-based simulation and project based teaching mode has more advantages over traditional teaching mode in teaching effect, such as connivance of communication and interactions, development of learning skills. This evaluation system can evaluate individual learning situation through statistical analysis of learning enthusiasm and personalized on-line tests, etc.

articleTitle: A hue-saturation histogram difference method to vehicle detection
abstract: To prevent moving shadows being false detected as moving vehicles, this paper presents a Hue-Saturation Histogram Difference (HSHD) method for vehicles detection. In the method, H-S histogram of each frame in the detection area is counted firstly. Then, comparing the differences between histograms of two adjacent frames, the peak of differences may stand for a car. Experiments on videos shot in daytime and nighttime show HSHD algorithm is feasible and robust, and the detection accuracy rates are over 97% in daytime, and over 90% even in nighttime.

articleTitle: Preparation of a novel chitosan derivative and use in water treatment
abstract: Chitosan-betaine derivative was prepared by chitosan and betaine hydrochloride through dry process in the presence of dicyandiamide. The product exhibited solubility, practical flocculating property and antibacterial efficacy.

articleTitle: The analysis of land subsidence in Tianjin basing on interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) technique
abstract: Tianjin is one of the cities in the north of China where the land subsidence has most seriously developed. The land subsidence has been lasting for 50 years. In the paper, we use permanent scatterers interferometric synthetic aperture radar (PS-InSAR) technique to detect and measure ground movement in this area. The time serial measured results demonstrate that land subsidence in the study area, is controlled by geological tectonics, especially in south deformation areas. The detail information of deformation shows that the tendency and spatial extent of subsidence is controlled by geologic structures. Comparing the subsidence extracted by PS-InSAR technique to the leveling survey, both of them are mostly consistent. Meanwhile, it is revealled that different aquifers make different contributions to land subsidence. At last, we should take measures including set limit to groundwater exploitation, save water, and replenish groundwater artificially, also some new techniques (eg, InSAR) in measuring ground deformation are used to prevent and slow the land subsidence.

articleTitle: Study on the derived food safety management information system based on AJAX and Portal
abstract: Aim at meeting the very need of sharing information, complex access authorization for kinds of user and system interface customization for individual user in the current food safety management information system, it firstly analyzed the Ajax and Portal techniques in this paper, then brought forward the forestry, of the system, data flow of function, and the realization of system role for controlling system users, all these were supported by the Portal, Ajax and access authorization by role controlling. The system enhanced the access to information integration of system's resources, security access control greatly, reduced management overhead and management complexity, and achieve rapid integration the use of system resources. The farm can check the information of food products; the producer also can discover the problem of producing quality food products at once; consumer can check particular information of every single packing of food products through the Internet.

articleTitle: Research on correlation of modal frequency of long-span bridge structures and environmental temperature
abstract: The space analysis model of the Runyang Cable-stayed Bridge and Suspension Bridge are established to perform modal analysis at different simplified environment temperature and to compare with the analysis result of the collected data from the safety monitoring of the Runyang Bridge when identification of the modal frequency are greatly affected by change of environment temperature. The results of the study show as follows: The relationship between temperature and modal frequency of both Runyang Cable-stayed Bridge and Suspension Bridge is negative correlation. Frequency of vertical bending model decreases gradually as the temperature grows. Frequency of high order model of the mid-span vertical bending of the Runyang Suspension Bridge have more notable influence than that of low order model while the Runyang Cable-stayed Bridge decreases. The related conclusion is beneficial to eliminate the effect of temperature on identification of the modal frequency.

articleTitle: The research on the application of game in online education
abstract: Game contains both positive learning factors and a lot of contents unrelated to the learning, so the integration of game and education is a gradual process. This paper analyzes the positive elements and learning factors of the game, and proposes the application form of game in education. The game provides an environment with fun, competition and cooperation under control, which makes the game an educational supplementary means. The game's intrinsic motivation such as challenge, curiosity, control, competition, cooperation is full exploited to stimulate students' interest in learning, so they can take the initiative to learn and maintain the learning time longer.

articleTitle: Surface acoustic wave, electric boundary conditions, velocity control, sensors
abstract: A possibility of a phase velocity of a surface acoustic wave control by a metal screen near a substrate surface is described in this paper. Dependences of a phase velocity on a distance between a screen and a substrate are calculated for some substrates. Approximating expressions for these dependences are determined. An application of this phenomenon for force sensors is shown.

articleTitle: Impact of chopped continuous basalt fiber on flexural toughness of self-compacted concrete
abstract: An experiment was done to study the impact which SCC reinforced by different volume fraction has on CBF in the relative increase of splitting-tensile strength, splitting toughness and flexural toughness. The findings were that the more the fiber volume, the more increase of the splitting toughness. When the volume was 1.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub>, the splitting tensile strength of 28d and 60d reached its maximum; SCC tension increased with the increase of the volume of CBF; when the CBF was added, the flexural load-displacement curves of SCC became not so sharp, thus having an apparent impact on the toughness of SCC.

articleTitle: The motion detection method apply to video-surveillance embedded system
abstract: In embedded video surveillance system, many moving target detection methods are used. But for some complex environmental, they have some problems in detection accuracy and speed of moving target detection. In this paper, a target detection method based on improved adaptive threshold hybrid difference is proposed, then for wiping off the noise, the method of morphological filtering is adopted to gain exact moving objects. Finally, according to the requirement, the area method is used to choose the final images to avoid false alarms. Experimental results show that the proposed method not only gets moving objects completely, but also adapts to the complex environmental change, at the same time, the method is rapid, efficient, and is applied to embedded system well.

articleTitle: Snow cover extent and duration in MODIS time series: A comparison with in-situ measurements (Provincia Verbano Cusio Ossola, NW Italy)
abstract: An automated approach is presented, with the purpose of computing snow cover duration from satellite imagery and to, validate them with in-situ measured data. In the present study the employed MODIS dataset has a spatial domain covering the entire study area, while its temporal domain covers the last ten years, i.e. 2000 - 2010. Snow depth records from sensors integrated in automated nivo-meteorological stations were used to provide field measurements for comparison with the MODIS data. The meteorological network records snow and climate variables such as snow depth, air temperature, wind speed, and soil temperature. Snow depth is measured from above with an ultrasonic snow depth sensor (mounted on a mast 6 m above ground). The two independent automated procedures to derive snow patterns and particularly to define the end of snowmelt have shown a fairly good agreement. Moreover, the study has shown that a strong influence on the relationship between MODIS and snow-sensor derived snow melts may be due to the elevation, with higher sites showing longer lasting snowpacks under the snow sensor than over the 500 m-side grid.

articleTitle: Variable bandwidth M-estimators of the partial linear regression models
abstract: In the paper the variable bandwidth M-estimators of the partial linear models are discussed The variable bandwidth M-estimation of the unknown function and local variable bandwidth M-estimators of the unknown parameter is proposed by local linear method. Under the assumptions, the consistence and the asymptotic normality of the estimators of the unknown function and the unknown parameter are proofed. The proposed method inherits the advantages of local polynomial regression and overcomes lack of robustness of least squares techniques.

articleTitle: Design and development of multimedia web photography courseware based on the theory of self-directed learning
abstract: The course of photography is one of fundamental courses for college students who are majored in educational technology. The key to gain the wonderful works for students is to master the theories of photography expertly and do practice regularly. However, there are not adequate equipments for students to do exercises, so , the college students learn the skills of photography slowly, and performance of instruction is dissatisfied. We know the courseware of photography is defect in our nation. We summarize the design rules based on the theory of self-directed learning and other theories related it. We developed the courseware of photography based on the design rules. The design rules were tested by the process of development of the courseware. The results prove that the design rules are feasible and exercisable. Now, our college students develop into principal part in instructional context of self-directed learning. We satisfied the courseware of photography by its instructional effects. The design rules works very well. It proves that they are reasonable. We can harvest good productions and realize the self-directed learning if we put the design rules into practice properly.

articleTitle: The bootstrap approach for DEA model with undesirable outputs
abstract: In this paper, the DEA models with undesirable outputs are considered and an effective bootstrap approach is developed for statistical inference. The most attractive point for our method is that it not only can allow statistical noise and inherent dependency to be investigated simultaneously, but also can further enhance the statistical foundation of DEA analysis with the case of undesirable outputs. Finally, an empirical example is used to illustrate our methodology proposed above.

articleTitle: Field litter decomposition rate estimation: Does incubation starting time matter?
abstract: Litter decomposition rate is one of the most important variables regulating ecosystem carbon and nutrient cycling. However, the current estimation - method fitting an exponential decay curve to data describing litter mass remaining - may produce incorrect results if the litter decomposition rate varies depending on the time of year the field incubation trial is started. Using a computer simulation method, we demonstrated that the trajectory of litter mass remaining varied with different starting times. Although the final litter mass remaining after two years was similar for each starting time, the estimated litter decomposition rate varied significantly in the simulations. Our analyses raised cautions in the estimation and interpretation of field measured litter decomposition rate.

articleTitle: A Channel Estimation Technique in OFDM systems using no pilots
abstract: This paper proposes a channel estimation technique in OFDM systems that needs no pilots transmission and needs no knowledge about the channel statistics. This technique is mainly based on that a modulation type with a constant phase constellation can resist phase errors and that with a constant envelope constellation can resist envelope errors. Combining both types of modulation can resist both phase and envelope errors.

articleTitle: Multi-objects tracking and online identification based on SIFT
abstract: This paper presents a method of point feature tracking and online identification using SIFT(Scale Invariant Feature Transform). The proposed approach uses the probabilistic voting method with appearance model to estimate the object's optimal center and apply hierarchical vocabulary tree to recognize the object. Since SIFT feature is invariant to changes caused by rotation, scaling and illumination, we can obtain higher tracking performance than the conventional approach and the probabilistic voting approach enables the track to search object efficiently. Online identification is also a challenge in video surveillance system, we use bag of words method based on hierarchical vocabulary tree to represent and match tracked objects by sampling SIFT feature online. Experimental results illustrate that the proposed approach works robustly for multi-persons tracking and identification.

articleTitle: Simulation of fire in the space under bridge
abstract: Numerical simulation for the fire in the space under bridge was presented in this paper. Two combustion models were examined in this fire simulation. Turbulent models coupled with different combustion models, while radiation model is coupled with the computation of the turbulent combustion processes. The results were compared and evaluated for their performance and predicting the fire. These numerical simulations can be adopted as a very useful tool in investigating and customizing optimal set of design parameters at fire control in the space under bridge against potential fire.

articleTitle: The self-adapt spectrum management formula base on cluster model
abstract: With the shortage of wireless spectrum, variable spectrum management is payed close attention to for it can enhance spectrum utilization. Variable spectrum management carry out the limited spectrum resource based on spectrum sensing. This paper put forward one variable spectrum management formula based spectrum cluster. The paper brings up dynamical spectrum formula focus on spectrum cluster base on the model of central spectrum management. This model's key idea is to set spectrum band into different spectrum cluster according to signals different characters, then spectrum cluster can be divided into a number of small bands, last every band also can be divided into a number of channels. Every CR user access into several bands of someone spectrum cluster's small band by adopting (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) OFDM modulation way which has better spectrum use ratio and anti-interference performance. The paper analyses the principle of this model in detail, then get its advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: The virtual campus system based on VR-Platform
abstract: Taking the campus of Guilin University of Electronic Technology as prototype, combing with the software of 3Ds max and other virtual stimulate technology, a virtual campus has been developed. In this paper, a real-time roaming system of Virtual campus is fulfilled by using a VR-Platorm and data base connection. In addition, 3D-virtual campus implement some function including self-excursive trip, path auto-generation of roaming, positioning in bird's eye view, and the buildings querying for database. Through improved optimize technique of the scene, the system efficiency is greatly increase, and running process stably and fluently. The experimental result indicates that the technical route and design proposal are reasonable, and the system developed can entirely meet the need of real-time scene roaming in the ordinary PC.

articleTitle: The coordinated research of transportation and economic development in China
abstract: This paper measured the coordinated degree of transportation and economic development, and made a comparative analysis with the data of 31 provinces in China by the DEA method. The results showed: the coordinated degree of transportation and economic development in China was low, the average support degree of traffic system for economic development was 0.632, and the average degree of economic development for transportation was 0.753. From the three regions of east, center and west, the coordinated degree of transportation and economic development in eastern region was higher than that in the midwest.

articleTitle: A method of inserting and mending for the GPS precipitable water vapor
abstract: The construction of the water vapor monitoring by ground-based GPS network in our country is still at the starting stage at present and some technology is still unripe. If there are some data in which GPS original data or the surface meteorological elements are lacked, it is unable to calculate out precipitable water vapor by GPS. It not only affects the continuous monitoring of the water variation, but also the accumulation of GPS precipitable water vapor data and the application of climatology in the future. This paper utilizes the surface meteorological data to be the relevant factors by using some methods, and the least square method to fit the experience formula of the precipitable water vapor. It can perform a substitution or a reserve scheme of the precipitable water vapor if they are lacked. This method raises the usefulness of this new observation data, keeping the continuity of GPS water vapor array, and expanding their application area, which have a very importance practical value.

articleTitle: Based on rough set and wavelet neural network information fusion in the furnace Control
abstract: Integrated multi-sensor information fusion theory and technology, starting from the furnace application is given a structure of multi-sensor information fusion to discuss rough set and wavelet neural network in multi-sensor information fusion, fusion control proposed clustering thinking and control structures.

articleTitle: Research on scalable coding technology application in video compression based on H.264 standard
abstract: Currently, multimedia technology is widely used. Using the video encoding compression technology can save storage space, and also can improve the transmission efficiency of network communications. The goal of the research is to use motion estimation and compensation technology for scalable video compression coding. A detailed discussion of H.264/AVC motion estimation technology is presented, including the principles of motion estimation, macro-block division, module decision-making, rate-distortion optimization, the best matching algorithms, and the standards of evaluation of the quality of coding. The direction of research and development of H.264/AVC is discussed as well.

articleTitle: Using multivariate grey model and principal component analysis to modeling the blast furnace
abstract: Blast furnace ironmaking process (BFIP) can be considered as a grey system due to the complexity. In this paper, a new approach is proposed to predict the silicon content in blast furnace (BF) hot metal based on the multivariate grey model in grey theory. Principal component analysis (PCA) method is also used to deal with the high correlation relationship between different variables of BFIP. With the new variables extracted using PCA technology, multivariate grey models show better performance. Numerical simulations show that the prediction accuracy of BF silicon content with multivariate grey models combined with PCA is remarkably improved compared with typical multivariate grey models.

articleTitle: The seismic damage mode of bridge in Wenchuan Earthquake
abstract: This paper reports some typical damage samples of the bridges in Wenchuan Earthquake, based on an inspection visit to the earthquake site. The causes and regular patterns of the earthquake damage are analyzed. The typical damage of girder bridge can be divided into the damage of main load-carrying member and the damage of link member. The typical damage of arch bridge included: span collapsed, abutment and arch springing cracked, spandrel arch damaged, damage in the joint member between deck and main arch, damage out of arch plane. At last, a set of seismic damage indices of bridge which comes from typical damage mode of the bridges in Wenchuan Earthquake is proposed.

articleTitle: Trigonometric extension of quartic Bézier curves
abstract: A class of quasi-quartic trigonometric polynomial Bezier curves with two shape parameters is presented The trigonometric polynomial curves have the same characteristic with traditional quartic Bezier curves, and it can represent exactly some quadratic curves such as the arc of circle, arc of ellipse, arc of parabola without using rational form. Its shape can be adjusted locally or totally through changing the value of the two parameters, and approach to the given control polygon from both sides. The G<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> continuity condition of two pieces of curves is discussed. Examples are given to illustrate that the new curve has high applied value in model design.

articleTitle: The expanded utilizations of urban waterfront green spaces- three cases in Hangzhou
abstract: Taking the expanded utilizations of waterfront green spaces in Hangzhou as typical examples, this paper analyzes the development of waterfront green spaces, such as creating the leisure and fitness spaces and planning the fitness trail system. The purpose of the expanded utilizations of waterfront green spaces is to be convenient to nearby residents, to improve green space utilization rate, to upgrade the urban living environment quality, and to promote green ecological city construction.

articleTitle: Life cycle costing management of construction projects based on value engineering
abstract: Owing to the characteristics of construction projects such as one- time establishment, large-scale investment, complexity and high-energy consumption in operation, the cost management of construction projects is more difficult and time-limited than that of usual products. Thus, effective entire-life-circle cost management and control is key to the survival of building enterprises. With the application of principles of value engineering and based on target cost management, this paper proposed a dynamic entire-life-cycle cost management model in combination with supply-chain management and cost management methods such as Kaizen cost system. As is shown, this model provides a new method to achieve reliably a better efficacy and more comprehensive benefits of construction projects with minimum entire-life- cycle cost.

articleTitle: Triple-play switchboard IP phone business achievement based on sip call
abstract: It describes the implementation process of SIP voip call in the triple-play switch and discusses the transplantation and application of the osip stack in the Linux system, meanwhile, it proposes an embedded SIP switch application in the PSTN call processing and gives the realization diagram and solutions, which has some significance in SIP development.

articleTitle: Turbo product code method for real-time video radio transmission
abstract: In order to achieve the reliable decoding when the real time video compression bit streams are transmitted in radio channel, the effective channel codec method is given. It is based on the Turbo product codes with AHA4501. The performance of its delay time and error correction is evaluated. The selection of block size, the iteration number and frame sync header and is described. And the method has been used to the system of video transmission. Its reliability and validity can be proved.

articleTitle: Compressive sampling based image coding using wavelet domain signal characteristics and human visual property
abstract: The contribution of this paper to compressive sampling (CS) based image coding is two-fold. Firstly, we propose more accurate CS performance metrics: 1. Adopt bit-rate to replace common but inaccurate measurement rate in R-D performance. 2. Algorithm complexity is measured by the elapsed execution time and their ratios. Secondly, we improve the R-D performance by exploiting wavelet domain signal characteristics and human visual property. Experimental results show that the proposed schemes can improve PSNR by 3.5 dB (0.75bpp) to 6 dB (1.5bpp) at cost of increased codec complexity of 106.3% and 109.2% respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental study on aerobic biodegradation of phthalic acid esters in urban sewage
abstract: In order to evaluate phthalic acid esters environmental hormone's detention in the environment, predict its biodegradability and properly solve the treatment of urban sludge, we make a study on the aerobic biodegradation law of dibutyl phthalate (DBP), which has the highest concentration and pollution risk in the urban sludge. The result shows that the process of PAEs aerobic biodegradation can be best described by First-order kinetic model, and the rate of dibutyl phthalate degradation in aerobic granular sludge increases as dibutyl phthalate load increases. At various temperatures, there is some difference for the aerobic sludge in the degradation of phthalic acid esters. The high temperature would be more propitious for degradation.

articleTitle: The sufficient condition for the existence of periodic solution about iced cable with two degrees of freedom
abstract: In this paper, with symbolic computation software of Maple, Melnikov function and sufficient condition for the existence of periodic solutions about iced cable with two degrees of freedom are investigated. The conclusion not only enriches the behavior of nonlinear dynamics about iced cable, but also provides the reference to the study of controlling the icing disaster, which is caused by large amplitude low frequency vibration of iced cable.

articleTitle: Automatic partition focusing based perpendicularity adjustment technology for camera optical axis
abstract: A perpendicularity adjustment method for camera optical axis based on automatic partition focusing was proposed to improve the spatial positioning accuracy of monocular micro-vision for plate microstructure. The method combines high-precision focusing technology and focusing distance accurate measurement technology. Based on the focusing distance deviation of corresponding region and the center distance of corresponding partition, the method can accurately calculate the deflection angle of the axis. Experimental results show that the method is simple, easy and practical, and has been successfully applied to the adjustment of the visual positioning system of micro structures.

articleTitle: Accelerated Belief Propagation for hardware implementation
abstract: Disparity map plays an important role in 3DTV and FTV systems. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art algorithms fail to generate a precise disparity map rapidly enough for VLSI real time processing. Belief Propagation (BP) is a popular global optimization algorithm and has several advantages for hardware implementation. However, it requires high bandwidth, memory and computational costs. Tile-based BP is an efficient improved BP for hardware implementation. Boundary messages loaded from different directions have been performed with different iterations. As a result, energy cost of different pixels within a tile will converge with different speed, yielding the biasing problem. In this paper, firstly, a Balance-convergence method to remove biasing problem in tile-based BP is presented. Additionally, a novel reduced message-update method to remove redundant computational costs during message-update based on tile-based BP is introduced. Compared with the original BP and the leading hardware-oriented fast method, the proposed method can reduce additions by 30 times and 2 times respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental study on crack resistance property of fresh polypropylene fiber concrete
abstract: In this paper, through the observations experiments of plastic shrinkage cracking in 10 fiber reinforced concrete slabs constrained at the end under outdoor natural environment, and free shrinkage experiment under standard test method, the influence of polypropylene fiber length, fiber volume fraction and the fiber mixing way on the performance of fresh fiber reinforced concrete cracking was studied, and the performance of fiber reinforced concrete slabs with different mix proportion resisting early plastic shrinkage crack was evaluated. The test results about crack length, quantity and width show that, 3mm short fiber has good inhibitory effect on free drying shrinkage of concrete, while blending long and short fibers has the best inhibitory effect on the constrained plastic shrinkage and cracking of concrete. Low-volume content of fiber reinforced concrete also has a certain limit crack effect. Among them, the volume content of 0.2% of the concrete has the best crack resistance effect.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of content-based music retrieval for music identification
abstract: Over the past few years, digitized music in forms like MP3 has made a great impact on the way of acquiring and listening to music. Due to the advanced communication tools, the consumers may search and purchase their favorite music online without going to physical music stores. Consider that a user occasionally gets an unknown and preferred music episode, but she/he has no idea on how to identify the query terms to retrieve the music using traditional textual-based search engines. Thereupon content-based music retrieval for music identification serves as an adequate solution for the users to search the targeted music effectively and conveniently. In this paper, we present several methods and similarity functions designed to achieve the effective content-based music identification. In particular, we compare the performances of various similarity functions with different musical features under real environments. The experimental results on real music datasets reveal that the Hamming Distance can bring out very robust performance for content-based music identification in terms of accuracy. In addition to music identification, this paper with detailed empirical analysis also provides the researchers with insightful ideas in other real applications such as audio monitoring, musical copyright, etc.

articleTitle: A robust and fast video fingerprinting based on 3D-DCT and LSH
abstract: A video fingerprinting that extracts fingerprints from videos and finds other similar ones from a reference database, is used for media indexing, content retrieval and copyright management. In this paper, we attempt to extract spatial and temporal information of a video as its fingerprint by Three-dimension Discrete Cosine Transform (3D-DCT) and apply Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) to search the similar ones in the video fingerprint database. It combines the robustness of coefficients of 3D-DCT with the retrieval efficiency of LSH. This system can yield a high precision rate of 98.25% and a recall rate of 88.78%. Experimental results illustrate that our system outperforms existing methods in copy detection based on fingerprint.

articleTitle: Problems and countermeasures in the use of Computer Aid Instruction in Mandarin teaching
abstract: This paper is aimed at the problems in the use of Computer Aid Instruction in Mandarin teaching, and advances some countermeasures. It consist of two aspect: the first is to open up the scope of Computer Aid Instruction in Mandarin teaching; and the second is to excavate the function of Computer Aid Instruction in Mandarin teaching. We want to find a better way to develop Mandarin education.

articleTitle: Finite groups in which there are at most four noncentral conjugacy classes
abstract: In this paper, we classify the finite groups in which there are at most four noncentral conjugacy classes.

articleTitle: Fusion of multispectral image based on three channel non-separable wavelet filter banks
abstract: A construction method of three channels non-separable wavelet filter bank is presented and a multispectral image fusion method based on this kind of filter bank is proposed. The approximation images and the detail images of the multi-resolution pyramid decompositions are fused. The experiment results show that this method has good visual effect. The performance outperforms the IHS fusion method, the DWT fusion method and the IHS-DWT fusion method in preserving spectral quality and high spatial resolution information.

articleTitle: Shape recognition using a moment algorithm
abstract: At first we introduce Hu moment invariant. According to its higher computational complexity and higher time consuming, we introduce an improved Hu moment as we called boundary moment. This paper proves boundary moment invariants computed using the shape boundary only, which tremendously reduce computations compared to traditional Hu moment. Then we do experiments to recognize shape using boundary moment invariants and the result proves that the boundary moment invariants can be used as effective features in shape recognition.

articleTitle: PDE-based video image deblurring model and its parallel computation with multithreads
abstract: In recent years, the total variational model proposed by Rudin, Osher and Fatemi (ROF) has been often used in image restoration. As the numerical iterations increase, ROF model may produce the staircase effect while deblurring the noise effectively. Another fourth-order PDE model proposed by Lysaker, Lundervold and Tai (LLT) can protect more the fine image textures, but its deblurring result and boundary protection are lower effectively than ROF model. Combine these two models by using the weight function may create more advantages in remove the noise, enhence the boundary, protect the smooth region and fine texture. In this paper, we first analyze ROF model and its diffusion behavior, then combine ROF and LLT model to form an integrated model by choosing the weight parameter, detail the parallel implemenation with multithreads programming using OpenMP. Some experimental results show that this model has a better deblurring for remove the noise and protect the texture.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method of pavement and MATLAB simulation
abstract: This paper presents a evaluation method of the highway pavement performance. The highway pavement performance is affected by a variety of factors, the evaluations of which are subjective at the same time. Therefore, we propose a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, which can enable it that comprehensive evaluation of multiple factors is feasible. According to the highway pavement performance evaluation situation, a method based on MATLAB - FIS of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is presented for the national highway, which expounds the basic thought of the comprehensive evaluation method, chooses four major indexes influencing the pavement performance to be the evaluation factors, determines the membership functions and the fuzzy rules, establishes a model based on MATLAB - FIS of the fuzzy comprehensive assessment and evaluates the inspection data of Inner Mongolia highway asphalt pavement. Finally, we obtain the satisfactory results. Meanwhile, the calculation results of instances are in conformity with the analysis results of the PSI, MCI Model.

articleTitle: The baffle block effect of fluctuating pressure in hydraulic jump with low Froude number
abstract: In order to improve energy dissipation rate, decrease the length and height of stilling basin, the baffle blocks are applied in hydraulic jump with low Froude number (Fr≤4.5). The baffle block effect of fluctuating pressure in hydraulic jump with low Fr was studied by model tests. The results indicate that the frequency property of fluctuating pressure wasn't changed by baffle blocks, fluctuating pressure in hydraulic jump with low Fr presents presents typically low-frequency characteristic, and the dominant frequency is between 1HZ and 4HZ. After applying baffle block on apron, the time mean pressure is larger, the absolute value of maximum and minimum and Root Mean Square of fluctuating pressure is lower, maximum of turbulence strength and fluctuation strength coefficient is lower, and stilling basin apron is more stable.

articleTitle: Analysis of the critical thickness of water film for driving on road surface in rainy condition
abstract: Hydroplaning occurs when vehicles drive in rainy days. It is analyzed that the wheel forces with the water, furthermore, the conception of critical thickness of water film is brought forward, and the formula for calculating the critical thickness of water film on the pavement is derivative based on momentum theorem. Finally, the values of critical thickness of water film for different driving speeds are given, and it is proved that the formula is reliable by contrasting with the values from other experiential formula. The result affords calculating method for the control of safety problem of driving on road surface in rainy days.

articleTitle: Application of guided boring trenchless technology on pipeline cross railway
abstract: During the past few years, trenchless technologies have been gaining popularity in the area of existing buried utilities and structures due to economic and environmental factors. In addition, those technologies have been becoming more and more familiar to engineers and practitioners in the field as more projects are constructed. There is a summary of the more useful five trenchless technologies in this article: pipe jacking, pipe ramming, auger and guided boring and horizontal directional drilling. And an analysis of selecting the most suitable construction method for engineering geology and hydro geological conditions will be presented. Based on the theory, the project of the fiber optic cable pipe crossing Zhejiang-Jiangxi railway of Fengcheng city, Jiangxi Province is designed. The guided boring trenchless technology has been applied to the project. Practice shows that the project has achieved good social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Surface roughness measurement for castings based on wavelet energy
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel surface roughness measurement method for castings based on wavelet transform technique. The surfaces of castings appeared as random and isotropic textures in digital image. The method of assessing surface roughness is based on two-dimensional wavelet transforms, which are performed on gray-level images of cast surfaces. Wavelet transforms and decompositions are implemented for calculating the wavelet energy. Furthermore, high-frequency wavelet energy ratio (HFWER) is proposed and calculated as a feature to assess the surface roughness in frequency domain. Experimental results on casting specimens containing several groups of casting surface images showed that the proposed method is efficient.

articleTitle: On a class of new solutions to vacuum Einstein'S field equations
abstract: In this paper, we give a new class of solutions to the vacuum Einstein's field equations. This class of solutions possesses the naked physical singularity, i.e., no event horizon exists around the physical singularity. It includes our previous work and new results. Detailed calculations and analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Stylized rendering for virtual furniture layout
abstract: Virtual furniture layout is quite useful to facilitate the indoor decoration and can be categorized as an application of augmented reality (AR). It involves in the mixture of virtual objects into real world as well as the user interaction with virtual world. As a result, the unity between the virtual and real scenes is an important issue for such an application. Traditional AR systems aim to reduce their difference in terms of the photorealism, which is quite difficult for real-time systems. Instead, this paper improves the unity by taking advantage of the non-photorealism. First of all, virtual objects are rendered into the real scene using the simple illumination model. Then, a fast and efficient video stylization technique is employed to produce cartoon-like effect. We view the real video frames and the 3D image as a whole, avoiding the extraction of silhouette of 3D objects. Moreover, the line rendering and soft luminance quantization are guaranteed to preserve the temporal coherence. Lastly, the experimental results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Marotto's theorem-based chaotic pseudo-random number generator and performance analysis
abstract: Based on Marotto's theorem for discrete chaotic systems, this paper introduces a new 2-dimensional non autonomous discrete chaotic system. A chaotic pseudo-random number generator (CPNG) is designed based on the new system. Using the FIPS-140-2 tests verifies the random properties of pseudo-random sequences generated via the CPNG. The results showed that all pseudo-random sequences passed the tests. The confidence interval analysis showed that the CPNG can generate sound pseudo-random sequences.

articleTitle: Life cycle balance of building structures in Taiwan and substitution effect of wood structure
abstract: Materials of building construction have significant environmental impacts in terms of energy consumption and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions. This paper discusses environmental burdens of reinforced concrete structure, wood structure and steel structure in Taiwan from the construction phase and the material recovery phase. The outcomes show that wood structure has highly environmentally friendly potential than that reinforced concrete and steel structures.

articleTitle: Verification of elgamal algorithm cryptographic protocol using linear temporal logic
abstract: Now a day the dependency on internet and on its based-embedded system increases, there is need of correctness of communication and reliability over network A small fault in system cause heavy loss. It mainly causes non reliable channel communication. Adherence of Frame work or model is based on validation of Public key encryption (PKE) communication protocol used between user and provider. Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) is the tool used for finite state model checking. Using LTL for ElGamal public key Encryption Protocol (EG-PKE) is easy to examine & verify the concurrent state transition of system. With the assist of recognize LTL Rule we try to find verification on a formulated transition system.

Author Keywords: ElGamal public key Encryption Protocol Introduction

articleTitle: Evaluation of failure mechanics of giant thick loess landslide
abstract: Based on the analysis of the engineering geological conditions of the giant loess landslide, it was induced to slide again caused by slope-cut during the highway construction. The site investigation and study revealed that the stress inside the thick loess slope has been changed slowly, which resulted in tension fracture settlement in the crown, bedding slip in the middle part, compressive deformation in the foot of the body. Intermittent sliding characteristics and inherited damage are analyzed in detail. According to geological analysis, calculation and FEM simulation, the giant loess landslide is instable, especially on the condition of heavy rainfall. The road is still hazardous and active and effective treasures should be taken to prevent and control.

articleTitle: Central fitting distributions and extreme value distributions for prediction of high PM10 concentration
abstract: Central fitting distribution such as lognormal distribution can give a good result for fitting the mean concentration of air pollutants data. However, many researches find that it cannot precisely fit the high concentration region. Therefore, this research compares central fitting distribution (cfd) that is the lognormal distribution with the extreme value distributions (evd) that are Frechet and Gumbel distribution to fit the maximum daily PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> concentration in 2002, 2003 and 2004 data in Seberang Perai, Penang. Method of moments was used to estimate the distributions' parameters. Goodness of fit criteria was used in order to select distribution that gives the best fit to the data. Furthermore, the exceedences of a critical PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> concentration over the Malaysian Ambient Air Quality Guidelines (MAAQG) were estimated using the best distribution. The results show that the extreme value distribution gives better fit to the actual high PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> concentration than the central fitting distribution. The exceedences over the MAAQG were also successfully predicted by using this method.

articleTitle: Image enhancement based on wavelet transform with MATLAB
abstract: Bused on theory of wavelet transform, images are analyzed. On this basis, image enhancement is analyzed to apply with wavelet transform. Results are analyzed and compared with low-pass filtering and high-pass filtering of frequency domain method and linear filtering and non-linear filtering of space domain method, indicating better to improve the image to adopt wavelet transform.

articleTitle: Bulk acoustic waves in multilayer structures
abstract: A theoretical investigation of bulk acoustic waves in multilayer structures is presented. This investigation is based on a rigorous solution of wave equations with correct boundary conditions on all the layer surfaces. Obtained results give a possibility to calculate the film bulk acoustic wave resonators with arbitrary quantity of layers, including the resonators with Bragg reflector. A frequency response, a resonance frequency, a temperature coefficient of frequency and a spatial distribution of all the wave parameters are available for these calculations.

articleTitle: High-speed decoding of the (71, 36, 11) quadratic residue code
abstract: A high-speed and memory-efficient table lookup decoding algorithm (TLDA), called the syndrome and syndrome difference decoding algorithm (SSDDA), is developed to decode the long binary systematic (71, 36, 11) quadratic residue (QR) code. The essential point of the SSDDA is based on the property of the weight of syndrome and the weight of syndrome difference to reduce the memory size of the lookup table. The proposed algorithm generates a novel compact lookup table (CLT), which only consists of 7,806 syndromes and their corresponding error patterns. Consequently, the memory size of the proposed CLT is only about 38.39% of the lookup table proposed by Lin et al.

articleTitle: The Kansei Image research on the door closing sound of passerger's car
abstract: Sound which we may have heard every day is part of our life. However, it's often ignored. In the process of product design, designers can almost get the design features of human vision, so they can design product which is attractive and functional. Nevertheless the collocation of sounds is secondary and often neglected. Nowadays, due to people pay more attention to the design of a multi-sensory. How to offer the products more creative elements to satisfy the multiple senses of the user is one of the mainstreams toward future design. The research is focused on audition by using the closing sound of automobile's front door as case study we tried to explore the corresponding relationship between the changes of sound wave and perceptual knowledge. Furthermore, we concretely defined the relation between physical elements of sound and perception through numerical definition of the closed sound by using frequency, duration, amplitude, Peak width at half-height. Finally Kansei Image's equations were constructed by Multiple Regression Analysis. The results provided the basis of collection about the visual and auditory aspects of the automobile's Closing Sound.

articleTitle: Advance in research on groundwater vulnerability: A review
abstract: Groundwater vulnerability research has great significance for water environment protection and sustainable groundwater resource utilization. In this review, the formation and development of “groundwater vulnerability” concept, including intrinsic vulnerability and specific vulnerability, were introduced.
