The recent advance in groundwater vulnerability studies were also summarized with an emphasis on the evaluation methods as well as their advantages and disadvantages. It is important and urgent to set up new groundwater vulnerability models capable of evaluating both primary contamination-resistance abilities of vadose zone and characteristics of pollutants relevant to their migration and transformation in aquifer. The credibility and uncertainty of groundwater vulnerability evaluation results has attracted more and more attentions of government agencies and researchers and is becoming a hot topic.

articleTitle: Correction of Gauss Legendre quadrature over a triangle
abstract: Based on the remainder term for Gauss-Legendre quadrature rule, a correction formula for numerical integration over a triangle is proposed. The new formula increases the algebraic accuracy at least two-order in comparison with the original Gauss-Legendra quadrature rules, which were recently derived by Rathod et al. Results obtained with the correction formulae are compared with the existing formulae. It is shown that the correction formula has higher accuracy than the existing formulae. Thus it is of great use in many engineering applications.

articleTitle: The geometric structure of the bivariate q-normal distribution manifold
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the geometric structure of the bivariate g-normal distribution manifold (S) which consists of all bivariate g -normal probability density functions. By introducing g -operator and g -potential function, the curvature tensor of the manifold S is obtained. Meanwhile, we get the dual coordinate systems of S. Further, we investigate the geometric structures of its submanifolds, and give their dual coordinate systems and scalar curvatures. Using the g Kullback-Leibler divergence, projections are defined from the bivariate g -normal distribution manifold to its submanifolds. Finally, there is an example to illustrate our conclusions.

articleTitle: Less is more: Cropping to improve facial recognition with thermal images
abstract: Numerous studies have investigated the functionality of the human facial recognition mechanisms with aims to improve computer vision methodologies. Understanding these mechanisms is important for applications in computer vision, as one goal of researchers is to create automatic facial recognition systems to equal the robustness of the human facial recognition system. Work in the field of human facial recognition shows that humans are able to recognize faces under very challenging scenarios, including partial occlusion. However, most human facial recognition experiments are conducted in the visible and near-infrared spectrums. During human facial recognition experiments with thermal images conducted in the lab, we found that removing the lower face yields better recognition results than when using the entire face. These tests included standard facial recognition algorithms and the results showed Rank 1 Recognition improvements of 10-25%, depending on the amount of occlusion derived from certain anatomical landmarks.

articleTitle: The study of low carbon strategies for sustainable campus in Taiwan-Case of Taipei City campuses
abstract: This paper aims to compile the low carbon strategies adopted in all levels of schools through the methods of literature review, experts consulting and questionnaire survey. The general survey of Taipei City campuses comes to the conclusions that the aspects of "Management of Energy and Resource", "Learning, Publicizing and Further Education" and "Energy-saving of Building and Environment" are the main strategies adopted, and understand the different choices of strategies between all levels of schools.

articleTitle: Eco-efficiency evaluation of the water conservancy and hydropower project based on emergy analysis theory
abstract: The positive and negative effects of the water conservancy and hydropower projects are analyzed based on the emergy analysis theory. The indexes content of emergy yield ratio (EYR) and environment load ratio (ELR) are redefined. In order to analyze the ecological effects quantitatively, hydraulic eco efficiency index (HEI) is proposed to reflect its sustainable development performance. Case study shows that among the positive effects of Chinese water conservancy and hydropower engineering, hydropower, flood adjustment, water supply for industry, water supply for agriculture irrigation is the main contribution, accounting for 21.3%, 26.6%, 21.6% and 21.4%, respectively (2008). Both EYR and HEI show a downward trend, but the ELR is rising. These trends show that the ecological pressure on the environment is growing, although the water conservancy and hydropower project supply the positive effect output to us.

articleTitle: 3D human reconstruction from multi-image
abstract: In this paper, a method for 3D human model and skeleton reconstruction from multi-image was proposed. Firstly, the silhouettes of different views in the image space were projected back to a 3D plane and we could calculate the intersectional silhouettes from all those back-projections, then the corresponding points between two neighboring parallel planes were matched, so the mesh of 3D human model were reconstructed. Finally, the feature points on each image were matched with the joints in the generic skeleton model, then we got the rays starting from the camera's position and through the feature points in the image space. The problem of the joint reconstruction could be solved by finding a point whose sum of distance to the rays was the minimum. The experimental results show that this method is accurate and easy to implement.

articleTitle: The application of mathematical morphology in Vehicle identification technology
abstract: Traffic information collection technology is the basis to constructing the ITS common information platform, in which the most critical and complex part is the automatic detection technology to vehicles. In this paper, we focus on the mathematics morphology technology's application in vehicles images processing. Through reading a large number of documents, we can conclude that the image's geometric features usually can't be affected by external environment and learn that mathematical morphology in processing vehicles images under complex environment has obvious advantages. Through studying Vehicle identification based on morphology, the main contents are as follow: Noise filtering, adhesion target segmentation, image reconstruction, image matching, and other key technologies. In this paper, the image morphology in vehicle detection of specific applications was reviewed.

articleTitle: An analysis-by-synthesis method based on sparse representation for heterogeneous face biometrics
abstract: In recent years, single-mode face recognition has achieved great progress under the impetus of a variety of applications, and its recognition rate can reach as high as 99%. Heterogeneous face biometrics, namely face mapping between images captured in different spectral bands, has now become a hotspot. Our paper focuses on the problem of face recognition between registered visual (VIS) images and predicted near infrared (NIR) images, and proposes a new method, based on extant VIS and NIR images sets to synthesize corresponding VIS image by analyzing the imaging model of heterogeneous image pairs, thereby performing the eclectic face mapping. Experiments show that the synthesized images greatly reduce the difference between them, and face recognition based on it shows promising results.

articleTitle: Hardware implementation of FIR filter
abstract: This paper is based on the basic theory of FIR digital filters,It completed the FIR filter design based on programmable logic device-FPGA, hierarchical design, modular design is used in the paper, a distributed algorithm filter hardware design and its use QuartusII simulation software.

articleTitle: Variation of seismic response spectrum of slope reinforced with the copper piles suffered from liquefaction
abstract: In order to investigate the variation of the seismic response spectrum of slope reinforced with piles under the liquefaction of saturated subgrade, some acceleration sensors are used to record the seismic acceleration response of slope reinforced with stabilizing piles under the waterless condition and the saturated subgrade in the dynamic centrifuge modeling test, respectively. Then the different characteristics of the acceleration spectrum of seismic response are analyzed through the comparisons. The results prove that seismic response amplifies from bottom to top of the slope under the waterless condition, showing that seismic response is larger at the top of slope than that at the bottom of slope; however, seismic response of slope is restrained to a certain extent due to the liquefaction of saturated subgrade, so that seismic acceleration response of the soil mass of slope shall decrease at first with the increasing of elevation and then increase slightly. Moreover, due to the liquefaction, the low and intermediate frequency components of seismic response are reinforced to some extent, which reflects the reduction of global rigidity of the reinforced slope caused by liquefaction.

articleTitle: Period-Doubling bifurcation in discrete Hopfield neural network
abstract: A two-neuron model of a discrete Hopfield neural network is considered. The local stability is analyzed with the associated characteristic model. In order to study the dynamic behavior, the Period-Doubling bifurcation is examined. In the case of two neurons, one necessary condition for yielding the Period-Doubling bifurcation is found. In addition, the stability and direction of this bifurcation are determined by applying the normal form theory.

articleTitle: Study on Prince Edward river basin's water ecological carrying capacity based on water ecological district
abstract: With the coordinated development of water eco environment and socio-economy of the Prince Edward river Basin as the objective, the concept of water ecological carrying capacity of river basin and Evaluation index system was proposed. Based on the relationships between demographic, social economy, water resources, water environment and aquatic ecosystems, and the relationships of the water flow, water quality in the districts, the system dynamics simulation model and quantitative model for basin water ecological carrying capacity was established, using the combination method of systematic dynamics with membership degree. After the water ecological carrying capacity of 8 districts wore Calculated, this conclusion was obtained: the water ecological carrying capacity of Natural ecological zone (C Zone) is good (above 0.6), the reservoir ecological zones (E area) and mixed ecological zones (F area) followed by (above 0.4), agro-ecological zones (H, I zone), and urban ecology Area (D, G, J District) was the worst (above 0.3). According to the characteristics of each district, corresponding measures for the improvement of water ecological carrying capacity (water conservation, pollution control, adjust the industrial structure, etc.) wore proposed, whereby which providing the scientific basis for the implementation of the sustainable development strategy.

articleTitle: Traffic safety evaluation model for mountain road under bad weather based fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
abstract: Restricted by topography and geology conditions, traffic accidents often happen in mountain roads, especially under bad weather. So, a method is needed to evaluate the traffic safety of mountain road under bad weather. Through analyzing the factors that affect mountain road traffic safety in bad weather, the paper established traffic safety evaluation index system. The evaluation index system includes two layers evaluation indexes. There are 4 indexes in first layer, and 14 indexes in second layer. Then fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model was established by using fuzzy theory. At last, in order to prove the correctness of this model, the mountain road environment was supposed, and the model was used to evaluate the traffic safety of mountain road. The results showed that the model is validity.

articleTitle: A P2P HD Live Video Streaming system
abstract: Nowadays, the majority share of the Internet traffic is contributed by video streaming services. Due to the growth of Internet bandwidth, it is possible to provide HD live streaming services on the Internet which will be a trend in the near future. As the population of the users of HD live streaming services increases, the bandwidth will become a problem again. Centralized-based systems are not suitable for such services any more, and P2P architectures will be a possible solution. However, live services have strict constraints on playback delay and upload bandwidth. Conventional design principles for P2P systems need to be modified to fit the new situations. In this paper, we give an analysis on HD live streaming services and point out some unique design principles for such systems. Based on the principles, we proposed a system design for P2P HD live streaming systems. Also, a prototype is developed to demonstrate our design and be the platform for our future researches. Meanwhile, some implementation details are also introduced to facilitate and inspire future research works in the community.

articleTitle: Change detection of land use and land cover of the southeast coastal area in Fujian, China
abstract: Land use and land cover (LULC) can usually indicate the change of the eco-environment for one area. In this study, a knowledge based decision tree classification system based on the spectrums knowledge of ground objects and their spatial knowledge was developed for the research area, the southeast coastal area in Fujian province, China. The knowledge based classification system was built by using Spatial Modeling Language and ERDAS Macro Language provided by ERDAS IMAGINE software as secondary development languages. Two scenes of Landsat TM imagery acquired in 1986 and 2000, respectively, were classified into 12 classes by use of the system. Then the LULC change was detected by comparing the classification results from two different imagery data. The results reveal that large-scale changes of the LULC types represent the eco-environment degradation. By field checks, the classification output matched well with the reality (natural conditions) and can guide the further work within the research area.

articleTitle: A mechanism of information for collaborative e-Commerce
abstract: In the structure of Collaborative e-Commerce, information is the key for users to learn all sorts of information about people and system in this environment, which is also an important factor being considered in the process to materialize such a Collaborative e-Commerce environment. This paper presents the analysis of traits of information in Collaborative e-Commerce environment, its forming process and potential problems, construction the theoretical framework of collaborative commerce and development platform, collaborative commerce in the information presented in the specific application.

articleTitle: Application of modified Goodman contact element in numerical analysis
abstract: The Goodman element is widely used to simulate the contact of two different materials, however sometimes it causes large error in stress calculation and element embedding. In this paper, a further modified contact element is proposed, the better element has its own thickness, furthermore, when composed, the element normal connecting form is adopted as the changing mode associated with normal displacement: countless springs would be used as connection when normal displacement is less than thickness, or countless rigid connecting rods would be used. Meanwhile, by comparing the calculation results of horizontal displacement of an actual cutoff wall project using the two different methods with the actual measurement values, the new element has smaller error and is proved to be superior to the exiting Goodman element.

articleTitle: The effect of environment of different noise frequencies on human physiological responses
abstract: In order to understand the effect of environment of different noise frequencies on the change of human physiological responses, this study used Ryodoraku Measurement to measure the change in skin surface resistance to evaluate how four different noise frequencies, 125 Hz, 500 Hz, 2000 Hz and white noise affected the change in autonomic nervous response and the corresponding meridians. The experimental results of the comprehensive analysis found that, the human Heart Constrictor meridians, Heart meridians and Triple Heater meridians were related to pericardium, blood vessel and blood circulation system would be more easily affected by the stimulation of noise environment. In addition, under the stimulation of low-frequency noise, high-frequency noise, and white noise, the human Bladder meridians and Gall Bladder meridians related to ears, eyes, shoulder joints, digestive system and endocrine system could be influenced significantly.

articleTitle: The application of SPSS in empirical research of housing hedonic price
abstract: This paper introduces the application of SPSS in empirical research. Through estimate, test and regression analysis the housing hedonic price model of linear, logarithmic, half-logarithmic by SPSS, we obtained the housing hedonic price model of Shanghai.

articleTitle: Research on the technology of miniature zoom system
abstract: In resent years, with the improvement of optical process and the increase of new optical materials, many kinds of zoom systems have appeared and the same good imaging quality as the fixed-focus systems. As a result, they have been widely applied to many fields. In this thesis a negative compensation zoom system was designed. The optical design finally reaches the technical requirements. When the wave length is from 0.4358 to 0.6562μm, the focal length is from 30mm to 600mm and the variable time ratio is 20, the relative aperture is 1:5, the system length is less than 450mm. A small pressure angle, steady and smooth cam curve was designed by a new optimum method of zoom cam curve, which realized the design of miniature zoom system.

articleTitle: Evaluating surface roughness of castings using K-means clustering and watershed transform
abstract: Surface roughness is an important parameter for the machined parts such as grinding, milling, turning and casting. The conventional digital image processing methods have the capability of detecting the surface roughness of grinding, milling and turning parts. However, these methods can not be utilized to evaluate the surface roughness of castings in that there is no regular or periodic texture in the surface image of casting. Therefore, we proposed a simple but effective texture analysis method to evaluate surface roughness of castings in this paper. The proposed method is based on image partition and edge counting, which are implemented via K-means clustering or watershed transform. Several groups of experiments illustrated that the proposed method is feasible but promising as well.

articleTitle: Biorthonormal transfer-matrix renormalization-group method for general Markov random fields
abstract: We seek numerical calculations of partition functions of general Markov random fields (MRFs) by using the biorthonormal transfer-matrix renormalization-group (BTMRG) method. The BTMRG is a modification of the conventional TMRG, a variant of the density-matrix renormalization-group (DMRG), which automatically truncates the Hilbert space so that the properties of large systems can be precisely calculated while the dimensions of the renormalized transfer matrix remain constant. We apply the BTMRG to the decimation of the fundamental transfer matrix for general MRFs. Four binary 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order MRFs are selected for numerical simulations. Results of simulations show that all four models exhibit the phase transition phenomenon. This work shows that our BTMRG method is superior to the conventional TMRG in accuracy, computational speed, and in the possibility of treating a much larger system.

articleTitle: Multibeam seafloor topography-geomorphology integrated detection technology
abstract: If topography and geomorphology are asynchronously measured at different measuring points with a variety of sonar devices, a complex data fusion problem will be caused. In order to avoid this problem, a new technology is developed to the multi-subarray detection method which is used in multibeam bathymetry sonar. By doing this, it can obtain high quality seafloor topography and geomorphology at the same time. In this paper, the basic principle of topography and geomorphology detection is analyzed and discussed for the multi-subarray detection method. On this basis, the lake experimental data is processed. And the results prove that, it is effective to obtain high quality and high resolution topography and geomorphology estimation, and their integrated detection is achieved. So it is feasible for practical application.

articleTitle: Biquadric finite element method for parabolic integro-differential equations
abstract: Biquadric finite element approximation is established for parabolic integro-differential equations. Based on high accuracy analysis of the element, the superclose property is derived for semi-discrete scheme. Moreover, optimal error estimate is obtained by the interpolation technique instead of the Ritz-Volterra projection which is necessary for classical error estimates of finite element method. Finally, optimal error estimate is deduced for backward Euler discrete scheme.

articleTitle: Bifurcations and exact traveling wave solutions of nonlinear Schrödinger equation
abstract: Bifurcation phase portraits of traveling wave solution for nonlinear Schrodinger equation are given by using bifurcation theory of dynamical systems. Parametric representations of some exact traveling wave solutions of nonlinear Schrodinger equation are obtained.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of high-precision video extensometer based on camera calibration
abstract: Strian measurement is an important issue in the mechanics of materials. In order to develop high-precision measurement system of video extensometer, a measuring model of single-camera measuring object on a fixed plane is established . Based on this model, lens distortion can be corrected by camera calibration and the transformation relationship from the spatial location of object to pixel coordinates in the image can be obtained. Then with the help of image processing technologies, the measurement function of the system is realized. In addition, theoretical analysis and simulation experiments demonstrate the feasibility of single-camera measuring fixed plane as well as the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Visualization of weather-induced disaster warning information system using Google Earth API based on Mashup
abstract: The recent development of Geographical Information Science has facilitated its application on meteorological information services at high frequency. As a new pattern of system architecture, Mashup means to collect and aggregate distributed data and services from internet, so as to develop a new application. Among numerous types of Mashup application, geographical information Mashup is the most popular one. This paper proposes to employ Google Earth API, a provider of geographical information Mashup, into meteorological information services, and illustrate the approach and framework for aggregating resources from Google Earth API and local meteorological database into a B/S system. In the end, the framework is detailed in an application case, three-dimensional geographical information system of weather-induced disaster warning, which is featured by high visualization, high browsing speed and multi-user.

articleTitle: A media user behavior pattern analysis model based on improved swarm intelligence
abstract: With the development of network integration, media services' number is increasing and various forms of media service appear constantly. Users' self-selectivity of acquiring media service is greatly enhanced. This paper proposes a media user behavior pattern analysis model based on improved swarm intelligence, aiming to solve the problem that traditional media user behavior analysis method cannot satisfy the current operation needs. This model's effectiveness is verified by analyzing media users' actual behaviors, and the user pattern groups' behavior characteristics are summarized and explained to guide the actual operation.

articleTitle: The inquisitional research of indoor environmental quality in Taiwan aging-care-institutions.
abstract: Since 1993, the population 65 years-and-overs of the elderly in Taiwan is increasing both in absolute numbers and as a percentage of the total population. As estimate of the aging population by the Ministry of Interior Department, the aging population has risen to 10.4% of the total, and the aging-index-number is 61.5% in 1998. Although the rate of the aging population is lower than Europe, America and Japan, but it's still higher than others Asian countries. Along with the aging population is rising time to time and it marches toward aging society at the same time. To discuss the residential units of indoor environmental quality relationship issues with the elderly is becoming the considerable and demanded subject in the further. Therefore, the study of the diagnostic estimate will focus on the Public aging-care-institutions. In the study, ones will process on the diagnostic estimate of healthy indoor environmental quality and give the valuable suggestions to improve the control technique of indoor environment and create comfortable and high quality residential space. The study is utilized the standard diagnostic process of the indoor environmental quality; in addition, the questionnaire, investigation, and site measurement of indoor environmental quality are the ways we also apply for analyze the problems. In the processing, the diagnostic processes of the standardization building doctor will be utilized in the study as well. The items of measuring will partly give increasing or reducing by each case its indoor environmental problem; in order to helpfully assess the matters of indoor environment and process on the diagnosis and give the valuable suggestions to improve the indoor environmental quality.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of network on the Chinese youth and countermeasures
abstract: Along with the popularization and development of Network, there are vast of profound change on study, work and the life style. As major beneficiaries of this high-tech, young people do not only enjoy the convenience and fast the Internet brings, but also are influenced by it, which includes two sides positive and negative. This page focuses on the downside the Internet brings to Chinese youth, and analyzes the precautionary measures.

articleTitle: A multi-objective immune algorithm for human motion tracking
abstract: A crucial challenge in human body tracking is the high degrees of freedom (up to around 40) to be recovered. A method based on multi-objective optimization algorithm is presented here to tackle this problem. In our multi-objective optimization based human body tracking framework, tracking is considered as two functions' co-optimization problem where the aim is to optimize the matching functions between the model projection and the image observation. Experiments on 3D human motion tracking demonstrate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed tracking method.

articleTitle: The construction and application of digital building material experiment
abstract: As the guide of scientific theory, digital experiment used computer technology, communication technology and sensing technology comprehensively. And as the fundamental experiment of civil engineering specialty, the construction and application of digital building material experiment broke the operation limit of traditional civil engineering experiment in time, space and personnel scale, expanded the scope of experiment teaching, enhanced the effects of teaching, at the same time, made great innovation in network education experiment teaching.

articleTitle: The performance analysis of longitudinal finned heat pipe applying to air conditioning
abstract: Based on circular finned heat pipe has a big resistance and is easy to be deposited in the air-conditioning heat recovery system, Zhuang Chen et al [1] proposed to apply the separating longitudinal finned heat pipe to the air-conditioning heat recovery system. In this paper, the authors made a three-dimensional numerical simulation of a basic unit of 500 mm long longitudinal finned bundle and circular finned bundle using Fluent software. Through the comparison of heat transfer coefficient, power coefficient and other parameters, the authors conclude that the longitudinal finned heat pipe used in the air-conditioning heat recovery system has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Generalized L-R smash products and diagonal crossed products of multiplier Hopf algebras
abstract: In this paper we generalized the notion of L-R smash product and diagonal crossed product of multiplier Hopf algebras. Then we show the isomorphic relations of them.

articleTitle: Study on imaging and image recovering of a new concentric symmetrical synthetic aperture
abstract: Future space based imaging system require larger aperture sizes to keep pace with the demand for high spatial resolution, the cost and weight becomes increasingly prohibitive for large full aperture. A new concentric symmetrical synthetic aperture is thus presented in this paper at the first time-called the ring-sector aperture. It is a segmental structure and easy to be processed. The pupil function and the MTF distribution are given, and the optical performance is analyzed. The paper also generates image simulation for ring-sector aperture and full aperture. The image of ring-sector-aperture system becomes blurry because of the MTF loss in mid-frequency. The principle of image recovering with Wiener filter is presented, and the recovering results show that the contrast of ring-sector-aperture image can be improved even equivalence to the full aperture's. The ring-sector aperture is value to be researched and adopted.

articleTitle: A novel image encryption algorithm based on high-dimensional compound chaotic systems
abstract: A new image encryption scheme based on high-dimensional compound chaotic systems is proposed in this paper. The encryption system utilizes a 2D Logistic chaotic map to shuffle the pixel matrix of the plain image. Then a strong non-linear coupling structure combining hyper-chaos is constructed and different ways of encryption are chosen according to different areas to make gray-level transformation. Simulation experiment results and security analysis demonstrate that the proposed image algorithm has a large key space, and is very sensitive to initial values. Excellent confusion and diffusion properties are demonstrated in the proposed algorithm. Moreover, it can resist exhaustive attack, statistical attack and sensitive attack, etc.

articleTitle: Multicast routing algorithm based on improvement in energy consumption in mobile Ad hoc network
abstract: In this paper we consider the optimization of energy consumption in multicat routing in MANET. To avoid the generation of loops which occurs in the IMBM algorithm, combining the characteristics of MANET and the advantages of the multicast routing protocol based on tree structure, we propose a multicast routing algorithm that minimizes the energy consumption. By the algorithm we construct a broadcast tree which has a source node as root and has a path from the root to every destination node, and distribute proper energy among the nodes so that the total energy consumed in the tree is minimal. Experiments show that this algorithm is very effective on saving energy.

articleTitle: Research on seismic capacity of rowlock masonry by shaking table test
abstract: Rowlock cavity wall is a Chinese traditional masonry wall, which has been extensively used in rural areas of southern China such as Jiangsu, Hunan, Hubei, Zhejiang and Jiangxi Province. After the Wenchuan Earthquake in 2008, peoples began to focus on the seismic capacity of those large amount of rural residential houses built in rowlock cavity wall. To assess the existing houses, it's necessary to make clear the seismic shear capacity of rowlock cavity wall at first. Based on the report of General Seismic Investigation in Jiangsu Qidong, one 1/2-scale two-story rowlock cavity wall house model was built in Southeast University lab, and tested on the shaking table. The model bricks were split from original Eight-five bricks through electric saw, and each side length of model brick is about 1/2 of the side length of original Eight-five brick. During the shaking table test, three earthquake waves were used, and the maximum peak value of table acceleration was 178gal. The shaking table test results showed that those existing rowlock cavity wall houses in rural areas would collapse at the action of earthquake with maximum peak acceleration 125gal, which is defined as rarely earthquake in the zones belong to fortification intensity 6 in Code for Seismic Design of Buildings (GB50011-2001).

articleTitle: The application of data communication system based on Delphi in field of education
abstract: The article firstly discusses the design purpose and method of the data communication system based on the Delphi, secondly, utilized the typical Client /Server model, a point-to-point messaging platform in LAN has been achieved, which utilized the core of the program in Socket components (TcpServer and TcpClient) for the bottom of Communication network based on Delphi. The platform has achieved the basic function of sending and receiving messages at the Client and Server ends, lastly, from system testing, the platform has achieved good results. The system of the client also provides users with function of access to the local IP address, which facilitates the exchange of information between people greatly.

articleTitle: Multilinear commutators of Littlewood-Paley operator on herz-hardy spaces
abstract: The bounded properties for the multilinear commutators generated by Littlewood-Paley operator with Lipschitz function is discussed, and obtain that it is bounded on Herz-Hardy spaces.

articleTitle: A Study on barrier free facilities utilization and users consciousness in ShangHai
abstract: This paper objectively analyzes the existing problems of barrier - free facilities of transportation, metro line 3and 4 is a good case in point. We inquired into the users personal property, characteristics and other conditions by questionnaire surveys and field visits. Based on the experience of successfully implementing barrier -free facilities throughout the world, some strategies are suggested.

articleTitle: Existence of eight positive periodic solutions for two-patch ecosystem with harvesting and diffusion
abstract: The two-patch predator-prey system with diffusion and harvesting is concerned in this paper. By means of the coincidence degree theory and comparison theorem, we establish the existence of at least eight positive periodic solutions for this system. Further, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: Two novel composite kernels for relation extraction
abstract: Relation extraction aims at discovering relations between entities from free text, and it is a crucial part of information extraction. Recently, kernel methods have seen successfully applied in relation extraction. The paper proposes two novel composite kernels for relation extraction, namely linear and polynomial kernels, based on three individual kernels: an entity kernel that allows for structured features, a string kernel for parse tree, and Zelenko's parse tree kernel. In experiments, the kernels mentioned above are used in conjunction with Support Vector Machines for extracting person-affiliation relations from 500 sentences. In order to improve the training speed, trees parsed from Stanford Parser are pruned before using. Finally, the outcome shows that though linear composite kernel's precision (77.0%) and recall (82.2%) are not the highest, its F-measure with 79.4% significantly outperforms the best record, which is 72.6% of three previous kernels. This result indicates that the linear composite kernel performs better than the three individual kernels.

articleTitle: Development of a process model for urban growth simulation using cohort component method, cellular automata model and GIS/RS
abstract: This study developed a process model which includes three steps for urban growth simulation. A preprocessing step is required to classify three satellite images acquired in 1990, 2000, and 2009 into six land use types using remote sensing (RS) and geographic information system (GIS). The first step of the process model is to project the population using cohort component method for 2014. The second step is to quantify the corresponding amount of urban land demands based on a regression model between population and urban land use. The third step is to optimize the weighting values for six criteria using the weighted scenario method (WSM), cellular automata (CA) model, and GIS in order to make a grid-based optimal potential map. Two accuracy assessment methods were adopted to evaluate the accuracy of urban growth simulation, pixel by pixel comparison, and zonal statistics method, the latter of which was used to calculate the number of grid cells per zone of time distance. The comparison results show a good agreement between observed and simulated urban land use maps. Finally, the urban land use map for 2014 was simulated. This process model can be used to evaluate the spatial expansion phenomena and simulate urban growth.

articleTitle: Local orthogonal meshless method in electromagnetic numerical calculation
abstract: Orthogonal meshless method is based on an improved mobile least-squares approximation, IMLS approximate calculation of approximate have higher accuracy and efficiency than MLS, the system equation won't produce pathological; When structural orthogonal basis shape function derivative need to undertake trivial derived. The local orthogonal basis function has the same attributes as the primitive orthogonal basis function; its derivatives have much simpler expressions, higher efficiency. And it apply to electromagnetic field, the discrete model is established. Through numerical column proves the method feasibility and effectiveness.

Author Keywords: Local orthogonal basis functions Meshless method Introduction

articleTitle: Teacher development by e-learning: Building capacity toward the information society
abstract: E-learning has played an increasingly important role in supporting the economic and educational growth of many nations. It also offers opportunities for developing nations to enhance their educational and economic development. Worldwide there is growing demand for teachers who have the skills to prepare students to be successful in a technology-infused, knowledge-based society. E-learning can play a critical role in preparing a new generation of teachers, as well as upgrading the skills of the existing teaching force and pedagogies for learning. The presentation discusses the importance of including e-learning for teacher development as part of a national strategy for educational and economic development; its role in helping to meet the quantitative and qualitative demand for teachers; and the essential conditions that must be met for effective use of e-learning for teacher development.

articleTitle: Bright three-color continuous-variable entanglement produced by quasi-phase-matched third-harmonic generation
abstract: We presented a scheme to produce bright three-color continuous-variable (CV) entanglement by cascaded quasi-phase-matched sum-frequency processes. Second- and third-harmonic fields are generated by two sum-frequency processes,respectively. The fundamental, second-, and third-harmonic fields are CV entangled with each other by applying the necessary and sufficient CV entanglement criterion. The relations between the entanglement features of the three beams and nonlinear coupling parameters and damping rates are also discussed.

articleTitle: The Hilbert transform of the magnetic anomalies and the application in Inner Mongolia somewhere
abstract: Usually, the field measurements of magnetic prospecting is only observed for a parameter, the data obtained is relatively simple, as the multiple solutions of the geophysical interpretation, it increased the difficulty to the interpretation in complex geological conditions<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. This paper mainly discusses the use of Hilbert transform method calculated with the conversion between magnetic anomaly□T, □Zand□H, eninch the data content, enhance the accuracy of the interpretation. Theoretical model and the actual Data Interpretation of Inner work proved the accuracy and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The application of 3D GIS technology in Xiaolangdi hydraulic project safety monitoring
abstract: This article uses the 3D GIS technology to improve the situation of Xiaolangdi hydro-junction, in which the database platform, monitoring project and the expert system are isolated island information. With the three dimensional visualization technology carrying on the effective connection among them, it can supply the more direct technology platform for safety monitoring and excavate more valuable information.

articleTitle: Global existence of the solution and impulsive synchronization for reaction-diffusion system
abstract: In this paper, an impulsive predator-prey system with reaction-diffusion is investigated. Sufficient conditions are obtained for the global existence of solution for the impulsive system. By considering the equi-attractivity property of the impulsive error system, the impulsive synchronization of the predator-prey system is investigated, and the sufficient conditions leading to the equi-attractivity property are obtained.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of stochastic partial differential equations with delays and Poisson jumps
abstract: In this paper, we investigate a class of stochastic partial differential equations with delays and Poisson jumps. To the best of the author's knowledge, up to now, the exponential stability problem for this class of new systems has not been solved since Poisson jumps are considered. The main object of this paper is to fill the gap. We study the pth moment exponential stability for the considered system by using the fixed point theory. In particular, our results improve and generalize those results obtained in [1],[5].

articleTitle: Semantic Web application for e-commerce
abstract: More and more resources are becoming available on the Web, there is a growing need for infrastructures that, based on advertised descriptions, are able to semantically match demands with supplies. OWL-S is a sufficiently expressive and flexible service description language to be used not only in advertisements, but also in matchmaking queries, negotiation proposals and agreements. In this paper, We take a online bookstore as an example to present an OWL-S approach - fully compliant with the Semantic web vision and technologies - to extended matchmaking between demands and supplies in a semantic- enabled Electronic Marketplace.

articleTitle: Discussion on the tourism type construction planning of the new countryside
abstract: The current existing problems in the rural tourism planning were analyzed. The solution is proposed based on the research of the development of the tourism project, protection of the historical buildings, layout pattern of the countryside, advertisement and management of the tourism resource. And the tourism type construction planning of Panan country was presented as an example.

articleTitle: Study on the conservation measures and renovation technique for traditional architecture
abstract: The traditional architecture, represented by Suzhou control and protection architecture, is common in historical cities in China. The appropriate conservation measures and renovation techniques should be selected to maximize their retention and preservation, according to the historical and cultural background of the traditional architecture, building value, the natural environment basis and evolution.

articleTitle: Study on precise mobilization of civil transport resources based on GPS
abstract: Precise mobilization of civil transport resources is to implement the precise control for civil transport resources, in order to achieve real-time processing transportation needs, timely appropriate guarantee to ensure transportation needs for emergency rescue and disaster relief. This paper studies the forms and methods of organization for using GPS to implement precise mobilization of civil transport resources in order to reach the goal of resource conservation and lasting guarantee force.

articleTitle: Analysis of formation conditions of debris flows in the Himalaya Region
abstract: So far, there are many conclusions about the formation conditions of debris flows but most are qualitative analysis. On the basis of in-depth study of previous scientific research, this paper, combined with the actual situation of the debris flows in the Himalaya Region and selected quantitative classified indicators, using the canonical correlation analysis method based on fuzzy diagnosis, analyzes the disasters' data, interprets the formation mechanism of debris flow in the Himalayan region from a quantitative view and determines the controlling factors of disasters, which can provide some references for determining the weights in disaster assessment.

articleTitle: Higher order analytical approximate solutions of the mathematical pendulum
abstract: A new technique is suggested to find higher-order approximate solutions of nonlinear oscillators. A mathematical pendulum equation is used as an example to illustrate high accuracy of the obtained solutions even for large amplitudes. Comparison with the exact solution reveals that this modified method is very effective and convenient.

articleTitle: Fusion of multi-polarimetric SAR images using directionlets transform
abstract: An efficient SAR image fusion algorithm for multi - polarimetric images based on Directionlets transform is proposed. Directionlets transform is a new lattice-based multi-scale analysis anisotropic multi-directional wavelet transform. Firstly, several polarimetric images can be decomposed into low-frequency coefficients and high-frequency coefficients with multi-scales and multi-directions using the Directionlets transform. For the low-frequency coefficients, the average fusion method is used. For the each directional high frequency sub-band coefficients, the directive contrast and the larger value of region variance information measurement is used to select the better coefficients for fusion. At last the fused image can be obtained by utilizing inverse transform for fused Directionlets coefficients. Experimental results show that compared with traditional algorithm, the proposed algorithm can get better visual effect and the significant information of original image like textures and contour details is well maintained.

articleTitle: Temperature gradient of flat steel box girder in suspension bridge
abstract: Based on case engineering Runyang Bridge, the temperature gradient of flat steel box girder in suspension bridge was continuously observed. According to the analysis of measured datum, the temperature gradient on flat steel box girder was proposed. With three temperature gradient models (JTG D60-2004 specification, BS5400 specification and the temperature gradient which was proposed in this paper), the control sections stress was calculated by finite element program ANSYS. The calculated result indicates that the temperature gradient that was put forward in JTG D60-2004 specification and BS5400 specification for calculating stress of flat steel box girder was not suitable to apply to flat steel box girder and inclines to unsafe. The temperature gradient on flat steel box girder which was proposed in this paper was reasonable.

articleTitle: On the correlation between changes in LOD and earth-moon distance with VLBI observations
abstract: In this paper, Changes in length of day (ΔLOD) are obtained through the processing of the 2009.1-2010.11 VLBI data; the time series of distance of the Moon and Earth obtained from Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) ephemeris are calculated. Trend of ΔLOD and the Earth-to-Moon distance are removed, and the periods of them are calculated with spectral analysis. The correction between the Earth-to-Moon distance and the periodical components of ΔLOD extracted by wavelet analysis is analyzed.

Author Keywords: Distance of the Moon and Earth

articleTitle: Research on guiding design of subway platform
abstract: The platform is the landmark area in subway space. At present, the guiding design for way-finding in subway space is becoming more and more perfect, while the research on guiding design of subway platform is far from enough. Due to dense population and the growing tendency in indiscrimination of space layout, the traditional signage can't adapt to the more complex underground transport environment. Based on the analysis on existing problems of guiding design of subway platform, the environmental attribution of the platform space and the character of behavior, the guiding design methods of subway platform are proposed. The purpose is to enhance the identification of the platform and further improve guiding design of subway space.

articleTitle: The research of square internal circulation anaerobic reactor to treatmenting soybean protein wastewater
abstract: The square internal circulation anaerobic tank is square, reinforced concrete structure, compared with the traditional IC reactor, it has high insulation feature, good corrosion resistance, lower height, simple systemic internal structure, less water loss, small lift head, suitable for high concentrations of organic wastewater treatment and so on. When using the process based on the square IC reactor to treat the soybean protein wastewater, higher COD removal rate and greater volume flow can be achieved, while the running status reached to a certain range, a continued strong internal circulation was formed in the internal circulation pipe of the square reactor tanks. When the water quality and treatment systems reached the same level, the lifting cost of new reactor sharp decreased compared to the traditional IC reactor.

articleTitle: A posteriori error estimates of variational discretization and mixed finite element methods for integro-differential optimal control problems
abstract: In this paper, we study a posteriori error estimates of variational discretization and mixed finite element methods for optimal control problems governed by integro-differential equations. The state and the co-state are discretized by the lowest order Raviart-Thomas mixed finite element spaces and the control is not discretized. We derive a posteriori error estimates for the coupled state and control approximation.

articleTitle: An improved directtorque control technology study for permanent magnet synchronous motor
abstract: For the torque ripple and flux pulsation big shortcomings of direct torque control (DTC) for permanent-magnet synchronous-motor (PMSM), the peper proposed an improved direct torque control strategy. Based on the SVPWM of DTC method for PMSM, the paper proposed an improved DTC according to the flux linkage error space Vector modulation ( FESVM ). The paper analysed the working principle of the improved DTC strategy, and built the mathematical model and simulated in the Matlab/Simulink. Comparsion to common DTC strategy for PMSM, the improved DTC strategy could significantly reduce the torque ripple and flux pulsation, and the system performance could become better according to the simulation results. Therefore, the improved DTC method proved a new thought for PMSM control system study.

Author Keywords: flux linkage error space vector modulation

articleTitle: Parameter estimation using ECM algorithm in ARCH model
abstract: Based on ECM algorithm to estimate parameters under the censored data, the article has given an algorithm of logarithmic normal distribution under the random censored data. We know that ARCH model can be approximated as normally distributed. Parameter estimation using logarithm likelihood estimate Algorithm in ARCH model we have got its iterative formula. Finally, there has given examples using MATLAB to further explain the application of ECM algorithm in financial time series.

articleTitle: Some isometric operators on the Dirichlet space
abstract: In this paper, we characterized the isometric multiplication operator on the Dirichlet space D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> of the unit disk and the isometric composition operator on the Drichlet space D of the poly-disk. The isometric equivalence of two Toeplitz operators on the Dirichlet space had also been studied.

articleTitle: Study on the entry qualification and automated auditing techniques for the ontology of Internet medicine market
abstract: With the Internet medicine market continues to develop, the entry qualification and automated auditing techniques for the ontology of Internet medicine market play an increasingly important role in the market construction. This paper studies on the entry qualification system for the features of entry qualification for the ontology of Internet medicine market. This paper also proposes an automated auditing system which satisfies the access requirements of Internet medicine market with the combination of current popular techniques. These research works could play a positive role to the standardization of the Internet medicine market.

articleTitle: The expression of ‘Industrial elements’ in the transformation for old industrial buildings
abstract: “Industrial elements” is a unique symbol in industrial buildings and associated with industrial production. This thesis will take the expression of ‘Industrial elements’ in the transformation for old industrial buildings as the breakthrough point, represent the importance and the significance of ‘industrial element’ existing in rebuilding of the old industrial buildings. Based on the valuable materials, which were obtained via consulting the factory history for Changchun tractor plant and Changchun transmission shaft plant, mapping the site area, shooting and visiting on site etc., and sorted them in order, put forward the feasible proposal for rebuilding and the trend for reusing of the old buildings; introduce the specific expression way, the philosophy of design in details with regard to the ‘Industrial elements’ in the transformation for the idle buildings of Changchun tractor factor and Changchun transmission shaft plant, submit an rebuilding solution with local characteristic

articleTitle: Study on the situation of multi-campus universities
abstract: The main purpose of this paper was to discuss the disadvantages of multi-campus university, and find the way to change it. There are 3 main disadvantages of the multi-campus universities, the less exchanges between teachers and students, the time wasted on the way for teachers, the additional traffic costs for the universities and the environmental pollution caused by these additional traffic among campuses. This paper analysed the existing problems and provide some feasible methods to change this situation, that is to build some good kindergartens, primary schools, middle schools and some hospitals in suburbs to improve the fairness of medical conditions and equality of educational resources between large cities and its outer suburbs. When the teachers' children can receive good education and the teachers' family can get some good medical care in the suburbs that new campus in, then the teachers may be willing to suburban living and the 3 disadvantages can be changed.

articleTitle: Comparing media types and delivery methods on mobile terminals
abstract: If a user had a choice of watching the latest television news on the mobile phone, or listening to the news on the radio, or reading text news with the mobile, what would he choose? The project conducted three trials, in which mobile terminals were used in such a variety of situations that no single media type and no delivery method was able to fulfill all needs. Unlike previous studies, the results indicate that mobile television does not involve low commitment: The users did not usually do anything else while watching. Furthermore, just surfing around or viewing an arbitrary program flow seems not to be enough. Even though one of key motives of mobile television use is to kill time, people may want to kill time with content which is appropriate for that particular moment. Entertainment in mobile broadcast content was found problematic, because mobile viewing is typically short term and fragmentary; thus the users often missed the beginnings of episodes.

articleTitle: A digital watermarking algorithm using Singular Value Decomposition in wavelet domain
abstract: Digital image watermarking is a useful solution to the problem of information security, copyright and network security. In this paper, a new watermarking algorithm is propose based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and discrete wavelet transform (DWT). The algorithm uses a gray image as a watermark, increasing embedded information capacity. The algorithm can satisfy the transparence and robustness of the watermarking system very well. The experimental result based on this algorithm have shown that the watermarking is robust to the common signal processing techniques including JPEG compressing, adding noise, low pass filter, median filter, cropping and so on.

articleTitle: Simplified prediction of load deflection curve for RC beam strengthened by external steel plate
abstract: This paper presents the RC beams strengthened by external steel plate have been analyzed by modified Brason's equation to predict load-deflection curve. Estimation of the yielding of both steel plate and steel bar point in the load deflection curve is attained using the elementary procedures of strength of materials. But using the secant modulus concept determine cracked transformed section moment of inertia when after yielding of both steel plate and steel bar. The scope of the study is limited to RC beam strengthened by steel plates externally bonded to the tension face that exhibits the flexure mode of failure. Comparing calculated load-deflection responses with experimental data and finite element prediction reported in previous literature checked the accuracy of proposed procedure.

Author Keywords: RC beam strengthened by external steel plate

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of the Lotka-Volterra model
abstract: In this paper, we will consider the Lotka-Volterra model of two species communities. The asympotic behavior of the solutions will be analyzed; we are going to use the Matlab function ode-45 to numerically approximate the solution of the model.

articleTitle: On the application of architectural model making in the teaching of architectural design
abstract: With the development of society, the architectural model is demanded more and more, and the requirement is getting higher in the architectural market. In order to adapt to the social requests, architectural educators have been considering how to improve the ability that the students make the model. Combined with Architectural Design II, this essay introduces the utilized status of architectural model making in the courses of architectural design in China Three Gorges University.

articleTitle: Study on nitrogen removal efficiency of different aeration modes in oxidation ditch
abstract: Under the same condition of aeration, two different aeration modes were operated to treat municipal sewage in oxidation ditch: point aeration and step aeration. The former ran in a way of mixing 6 min and aerating 1 min alternately that was repeated four times in a cycle. The latter contained mixing 24 min and aerating 4 min in a cycle. The results show that the oxygen is dissolved more efficiently with longer Aerobic region in point aeration than in step aeration, while the oxygen utilization rate(for nitrifying) is higher in step aeration than point aeration. The nitrifying bacteria activity under the two aeration modes is 4.55 mgNH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N/gMLVSS.h and 4.56 mgNH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N/gMLVSS.h respectively. NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N concentration is below 5 mg/L with equal nitrification effect. COD removal efficiency is respectively 91.01% and 92.19% with COD of the effluents below 30 mg/L. But the elimination pathway of COD is unlike. COD is mainly used for denitrification in step aeration while only less organics is utilized for denitrification in point aeration where nitrogen removal efficiency is low and concentration of nitrate is high in the effluent.

articleTitle: Valence-band offset in ultra-thin HfO2 film on Si1−xGex/Si substrate
abstract: This paper presents the first-principles study of an ultra-thin HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> on SiGe/Si substrate. The strong stress in hafnia layer caused by lattice mismatch significantly deforms the structure in this layer, and alters the valence-band offset between HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SiGe. These phenomena should significantly affect the properties of CMOS devices associated with an ultra-thin HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> dielectric film.

articleTitle: Role of optical breakdown plasma in registration of a broadband THz radiation in ABCD detection scheme.
abstract: We develop a theoretical model for generation of second harmonics of a laser pulse in a low-density collisionless plasma through interaction of laser radiation with a THz pulse and applied external DC field. We obtain the expression for intensity of 2ω radiation which depends on the integral of THz field strength over duration of the probe pulse.

articleTitle: The analysis of the urbanisation and its driving forces in hangzhou based On ETM+ image
abstract: Urban expansion is always an important element of the urban issue. And the remote sensing technology is a powerful tool in extraction of urban areas and analysis of urban expansion. In this study ETM+ images are used to detect the land use change of the urban and urban fringe areas in Hangzhou. The directional flow and driving forces of the urban expansion are then analyzed to study its urbanization. The result shows a high expanding speed of urban area and diversified constructions in Hangzhou during the past decade.

articleTitle: An item-based collaborative filtering approach based on balanced rating prediction
abstract: As a widespread approach in recommender systems, item-based collaborative filtering can predict an active user's interest for a target item based on his interest and the ratings for those similar items to his visited items. As the effect of human's conformity psychology, an individual user's judgment usually tends to follow the general view. The majority of existing item-based collaborative filtering approaches emphasizes the personalized factor of recommendation separately, but ignores the user's general opinions about items. Aiming at this issue of unbalanced recommendation, this paper proposes a refined item-based collaborative filtering approach which employs a balanced rating prediction method incorporating an individual's personalized need with the general opinions. The experimental result shows an improvement in accuracy in contrast to the classic item-based collaborative filtering.

articleTitle: Computer-assisted college English teaching under the perspective of “embodied philosophy”
abstract: In the modern information age, computers, multimedia and various technologies influence people's learning to a very large degree. College English teaching is no exception. “College English Curriculum Requirements” issued by Ministry of Education emphasize the importance of applying modern information technology into college English teaching, changing the traditional teaching system and constructing the multimedia- and network-based teaching model. However, the mere application of these information technologies is far from enough. Some problems have already appeared. So it is very necessary to take some guiding theories into consideration. Embodied philosophy puts special stress on the spirit of “people first”, which brings important inspiration for college English teaching. Starting from the perspective of embodied philosophy, the paper explores the essence of English teaching. That is “interactive experience”, which can be divided into three parts: with what to experience, what to experience first and how to experience. It hopes to activate teachers' and students' thinking and experience, in order to make computer-assisted college English teaching more practical and effective.

articleTitle: Control high-order harmonic generation by molecular field-free alignment
abstract: The high-order harmonic generation (HHG) from aligned CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> molecules is investigated as a function of aligning laser intensity. Through controlling the molecular field-free alignment by varying the aligning laser intensity, the HHG process can be controlled. This phenomenon can be attributed to that the molecular HHG is dependent on the angle between the laser polarization and the internuclear axis, and the theoretical simulation is detailedly presented, which is consistent with the experimental result. This investigation is useful for the efficient harmonic generation from aligned molecules.

articleTitle: The rationality analysis of 2D finite element method in the calculation of asphalt pavement mechanical response
abstract: 2D finite element method (FEM) has been used in the asphalt pavement mechanics calculation. In order to analyze its rationality, elastic multilayer theory has been applied to analyze the asphalt pavement mechanical response under double circular vertical uniformly distributed load. Deflection, tensile stress on pavement bottom and compression strain on top of subgrade calculated based on elastic multilayer theory is compared with the results using 2D FEM. The analysis results show that deflection, tensile stress on pavement bottom and compression strain on top of subgrade computed by 2D FEM have discrepancy with the results by elastic multilayer theory. The discrepancy of maximum tensile stress between elastic multilayer theory and 2D FEM improves along with the increase of structural layer depth, but the two methods can get similar variation of the results. It is seen that applying 2D FEM without any analysis to calculate asphalt pavement mechanics is inaccurate and unreasonable.

Author Keywords: Compression strain on top of subgrade

articleTitle: Regions below of continuous maps on compact spaces
abstract: For a compact metric space X and L=[0, 1] or L=[0, 1], let ↓ C(X, L) denote the family of all regions below of continuous maps from X to L endowed with the topology induced by the Hausdorff metric of the metric space X×[0, 1]. In the present paper, the following result is proved: ↓ C(X, L) is homeomorphic to cο if and only if the set of all isolated points of X is not dense in X where c<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>={x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ϵ</sub>(-1,1)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup>: lim<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n→∞</sub>x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>=0}.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on adjustments and using of High-Definition camera
abstract: The High-Definition(short for HD) technology is the main direction of the TV technology development. As the material provider in TV system, the HD camera will be the trend to be widely used. There are many differences in using between HD camera and Standard Definition(short for SD) camera, such as focus point set, composition of the picture, PAINT menu set, etc. Meanwhile the experience can not be used directly and mutually. According to the filming scene and actual demands, the targeted adjustments will maximize the HD camera's performance and show the perfect picture effect, the photographer's pursuit.

articleTitle: The primary research of the junction box based seafloor observatory remote control system
abstract: Recognized as the third observation platform, seafloor observation system enables long term, continuous, real time, all weather and multitask scientific observation and research and makes its self-construction the most remarkable trend in international marine science and technology. China is now actively preparing its own East China Sea Seafloor Observation System, in the construction of which emerge some critical technological components to guarantee the entire efforts, namely how to monitor the working condition of seafloor equipments and how to control over their normal operation in accordance with the changing marine environment. In this paper we first discuss the hub role of junction box and how it offers the technical ideas for designing the junction box based seafloor observatory remote control system. Then we propose a client-server (C/S) architecture model to study and develop the junction box based seafloor observatory remote control system, of which the server end is the in situ junction box (serial server) and sensors connected to it while the client end is the shore switch control system at the offshore platform. In terms of communication protocol, we agree that the backbone between offshore platform and observing node junction box selects optical fiber communication based on TCP/IP protocol and the junction box subnet selects RS232/485/422 serial communication. Based on the previous discussion, we live the specific design for this remote control system into realization synthesizing Socket, component, multithreading and other related object oriented programming technologies. The realized seafloor observatory remote control system has been put into use in China's first Seafloor Observatory and has proved to function well in practical applications.

articleTitle: A hybrid video transmission distortion estimate model for multiview video coding
abstract: A hybrid estimate model for transmission distortions is proposed by analyzing characteristics of error propagation in multiview video coding (MVC). This model can well combine with the advantage of recursive optimal per-pixel estimate model and channel simulative estimate model. The transmission distortions of key frames and non-key frames can be estimated by channel simulative estimate model and recursive optimal per-pixel estimate model respectively. The estimation accuracy is demonstrated via simulation results for video transmission over packet loss channel. With a little computing complexity increase, the average estimation error is 15.91% for different intensity sequences at different packet loss rate, which illustrates that the transmission distortions can be estimated accurately and quickly by proposed model.

articleTitle: A fuzzy preservation-based total variation filter for removal of random-valued impulse noise
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy preservation-based total variation filter (FPTV) is proposed for removal of random-valued impulse noise. In our decision-based denoising scheme, Adaptive Center Weighted Median Filter (ACWMF) is firstly ameliorated by us to employ the variable window size technique to improve its detection ability especially in highly corrupted images. The improved ACWMF not only judge a pixel noisy or not, but also render the confidence coefficient (CF) for each pixel to evaluate its potential to be an impulse. Then, a function is designed with noise level p and CF as its arguments to determine pixel-wise the tradeoff between the smoothness term and the data fidelity term in total variation energy functional. After minimizing the energy functional, we obtain the restored image. Extensive simulation results show that our proposed method outperforms some representative algorithms, both in vision and quantitative measurements like peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and mean absolute error (MAE).

articleTitle: The response and strategy of Lower Yellow River to the reduced discharge
abstract: The flow entering into the Lower Yellow River (LYR) has reduced substantially since 1986 because of the operation of upstream reservoirs, the decrease of rainfall over the catchment and the increase of water demand for agriculture and industry. Accompanying the changes in inflow conditions, the river morphology of the LYR also has some changes. Using the improved Lane's balance equation, the paper gives a quantitative analysis for the channel length (slope), and based on the present problems in the LYR, proposed a new supplementary strategy of river training work to adapt to the changing discharge.

articleTitle: Urban traffic planning based on idea of Da Yu Successful Harnessing the Floods — Taking development of private cars in urban for example
abstract: Currently the rapid development of cars in urban, especially private cars, exerted on the urban traffic further pressure. It was very important for urban transport planning to adapt and grasp this change. Based on the idea of Da Yu Successful Harnessing the Floods and combined with the current development trend of private cars in urban in china, the impact on urban transport was analyzed in this article. Some strategies and measures related development were proposed by urban transport planning. These might provide some worthy references for current and future design of major urban traffic planning.

Author Keywords: Da Yu Successful Harnessing the Floods

articleTitle: FTIR measurements for structural probing of rare-earth sol-gel silica glass system co-doped with Al3+
abstract: The Al co-doping in silica matrix doped with rare earth (RE) namely Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Ho<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions have been studied. The Al co-doping enhances the emission properties of the Sol-Gel glass doped RE samples. FTIR measurements have been used in this study to probe the aluminum's behavior inside the silica network. The FTIR absorption bands 462.2, 810, 1103 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> of the Si-O-Si and 685, 786 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> of the Al-O bands have been used as principle absorption bands to explain the effect of increasing the Al :RE molar ratios, 4, 8, 10,as well as without Al co-dopant, on the doping process. The emission spectra of the prepared samples supported some concepts of the mechanism of aluminum action as co-dopant in the sol-gel silica matrices. The emission bands due to the (<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13/2</sub> →<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15/2</sub> ~nm) , ( <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>→<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> ~753 nm) and ( <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>→<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> ~619 nm) transitions of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Ho<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions, respectively , have been enhanced at Al :RE molar ratio of 10 comparing with 4 and 8. In contrast, the case of without Al co-doping shows strong quenched in these transitions.

articleTitle: BAC filtration - disinfection - sand filtration combination technology for handling risk of microorganism leak in O3-BAC process
abstract: The traditional ozone-biological activated carbon (O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC) water purification process, applied in the marsh and heated areas in the south of China, introduces a problem of microorganism leak which was observed in the effluent of BAC filter.
