A pilot plant of a new self-developed style "BAC filter-disinfection - sand filter" O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-BAC process technology, with a flow rate of 5-12 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h, was compared with the traditional process. The results showed: in new process, BAC filter was placed in the middle of sediment tank and sand filter(mid-positioning BAC filter). It was suitable to choose up-flow dual medium aerated BAC filter, and it continued to have the ability to adsorb dissolved micro-pollutants. There was no obvious difference between BAC filter and traditional process in the operation indices such as backwashing parameters and activated carbon abrasion rate, while the ability of offering oxygen and mass transfer rate and the function of nitrification and biodegradation were greatly enhanced. New process kills the leaked microorganism by ozone united with chlorine or only with chlorine , well solving the problem of microorganism leak in the traditional process. With two-stage filtration and influent turbidity of below 0.6 NTU, choosing micro-flocculation contact filtration process for the sand filtration, the turbidity of effluent can be controlled in a level of below 0.15 NTU, furthermore, it was still possible to lower the effluent turbidity by using smaller sand as filter media, enhancing the ability of withholding microorganism in sand filter.

articleTitle: Chaotic boundary crisis in the Duffing Van der Pol Vibro-imapct oscillator
abstract: This paper investigates the chaotic boundary crisis in the Duffing Van der Pol Vibro-impact oscillator by the generalized cell mapping method using diagraph. The previous reports have shown that a chaotic boundary crisis dues to the collision of a chaotic attractor with a saddle on its basin boundary. We study computationally the curves of stable and unstable manifolds for the period saddle on the basin boundary when the crisis parameter passes the critical value. Our results reveal that the boundary crisis is associated with the tangency of the stable and unstable manifolds of period saddle.

Author Keywords: Generalized Cell Mapping Method Using Diagraph

articleTitle: The carbon sequestration in post-agrogenic ecosystems of Russia
abstract: Abandoning of agricultural lands began in some regions of Russia since the end of XIX century. Our calculation shows, that the total area of abandoned lands since that time in Russia is approximately 71 mln ha. And almost at 65 mln ha of them (fallows) the process of the self-restoration of natural post-agrogenic ecosystems is very active. The accumulation of carbon in them (soil + vegetation) increases from the north to the south, reaches the maximum value in the zone of hardwood forests, and decreases again to a minimum level in the semidesert zone. The fallows (soil+ plants) presently accumulate about 64 million tons carbon annually (first of all in south taiga -34 mln tons), which is more than 25% of the total current industrial emission of carbon in Russia.

articleTitle: Fractional thermal systems
abstract: We investigate the fractional behavior of the integrators associated with a fractional diffusion equation in an interface, in two different geometries, a wall and a sphere, by means of a new relation between Caputo derivatives and non integer integrators. The behavior of such integrators is shown using Bode diagrams calculated for a limited spectral range. At high frequencies, the fractional behavior is approximated by a non integer order integrator. As a particular case we recover some recent results.

articleTitle: Study on urban modern agricultural geographical information system
abstract: The massive data and complex information sources made it extremely difficult for agricultural geographical information system to be developed. By adopting XML to collect the multiple and complicated information sources, an urban modern agricultural geographical information system based on J2EE technology was put forward. This system is targeted for the government administrative department, production base, companies, cooperative association and farmers, setting up a decision support system, where inquiry, analysis and countermeasures are made. The applications of WebGIS, ajax, flex, dhtmlx, spring technology were also discussed. We analyzed the requirement of the urban modern agricultural geographical information system; we designed the architecture for this system, the database and the modules for detailed functions using iServer java technology. We also implemented a centralized data management, a common geographical information system and decision-making support functions; this system fulfilled the functions of data collection, data processing, data storage, data maintenance, statistical analysis, map browse, inquiry and retrieval, decision-making analysis.

articleTitle: Pollination ecology and breeding system of Elaeagnus angustifolia
abstract: The pollination ecology and breeding system of Elaeagnus angustifolia were studied in introduced populations in the middle of Hexi Corridor region in Gansu province of northwest China. We applied five experimental treatments, natural pollination, hand cross-pollination treatment, hand self-pollination treatment, autogamy, agamospermy. None of the experimented flowers produced fruits except natural pollination and cross-pollination treatment. The results confirmed that E. angustifolia is a self-incompatible, non-apomictic species that can not produce seeds through self-pollination. Introduced honeybee (Apis mellifera) was the main pollinator of E. angustifolia in the middle of Hexi Corridor region.

articleTitle: An ensemble-based three-dimensional variational data assimilation scheme
abstract: A new ensemble-based three-dimensional variational data assimilation method (E-B3DVar) is presented. The analysis solution is obtained by minimization of a cost function that depends on a general nonlinear observation operator. The E B3DVar belongs to the class of deterministic ensemble filters, since no perturbed observations are employed. As in variational and ensemble data assimilation methods, the cost function is derived using a Gaussian probability density function framework. Like other ensemble data assimilation algorithms, the E-B3DVar produces an estimate of the analysis uncertainty (e.g., analysis error covariance). In addition to the common use of ensembles in calculation of the forecast error covariance, the ensembles in E-B3DVar are exploited to efficiently calculate the gradient of the cost function. The E-B3DVar method is well suited for use with highly nonlinear observation operators, for a small additional computational cost of minimization. The consistent treatment of nonlinear observation operators through optimization is an advantage of the E-B3DVar over other ensemble data assimilation algorithms. The method is directly applicable to most complex forecast models and observation operators. In this paper, the E-B3DVar method is applied to data assimilation indicates potential wider applications of this new E B3DVar method.

articleTitle: The study of up-and-down stiffness ratio of the transfer story of high-building structure
abstract: The paper studies on the problem of up-and-down stiffness ratio of transfer story, using a high-building structure as example. According to the definition of the up-and-stiffness ratio in Technical specification for concrete structure of tall building, under the situation of example, the paper makes a derivation on the formulae. With the results of derivation and the analysis of effects of shear-wall thickness on stiffness ratio, the paper puts forward some suggestion on design of transfer story.

articleTitle: A new method of video data optimization for motion estimation
abstract: Efficiency of motion estimation is affected by serious cache miss and cache split load. Firstly, the data to be used in the motion estimation process have poor spatial locality due to the layout format of video data. Secondly, the motion estimation process accesses memory irregularly and sometimes it accesses the data that spread across two cache lines. Irregular memory access pattern brings difficulties for a processor to pre-fetch data into the cache. The cache split load, on the other hand, forces the processor to load more data into the crowded cache. In this paper, a new layout format of video data, named overlapped tiled format, is proposed. The new format addressed the aforementioned two issues. By organizing the video data in the proposed way, the issue of cache split load is completely removed from the motion estimation process and the data cache miss is also greatly reduced. The full search motion estimation is speed up by 28% when organizing the video data in an overlapped tiled way.

articleTitle: Design of Gas fire-extinguishing control panel based on multi-sensor information fusion
abstract: Based on multi-sensor information fusion theory, a Gas fire-extinguishing control panel is introduced in this paper. The intelligent algorithm of neural network and fuzzy consequence is used to get the fire probability. According this principle, we designed an information fusion module which would send the probability to the main control panel to carry out the alarm and linkage. The practical application results indicate that the proposed method can effectively decrease the mistake rate of the fire detector and fire extinguisher.

articleTitle: A non-interior-point smoothing algorithm for the nonlinear complementarity problem with a P* function
abstract: A smoothing function is used to reformulate the P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</inf> nonlinear complementarity problem (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</inf> NCP) as a parameterized smooth equation which can be solved by a non-interior-point smoothing method. Under an assumption that the P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</inf> NCP has a nonempty solution set, the proposed algorithm is proved to be globally convergent and the iteration sequence generated by the proposed algorithm is bounded. Furthermore, this assumption is weaker than the ones used in most existing smoothing algorithms. Without any additional assumption, the solution obtained by the proposed algorithm is shown to be a maximally complementary solution of the P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</inf> NCP.

articleTitle: Integrated usability model for the multimedia mobile device development
abstract: The mobile devices have grown rapidly with the progresses of information technology those years. The mobile devices, such as i-Phone, i-Pad, Tablet PC and smart-phone, have become personal and business tools. Those devices are specially developed for mobile users on the basis of the conceptual design of personal digital assistant (PDA) long time ago, but the scopes of the usages extend much more extensive through integrated multimedia needs. This paper proposes a model called integrated usability model (IUM), derived from the technology acceptance model (TAM), to transfer the design criteria into the design guidelines. By using IUM, the developers for multimedia mobile device can use the conceptual indicators like mobile, integration and convenience to reduce the large-scale design factors and evaluate the capability and acceptance for the users. It turns out that the developers can speed up the design processes and avoid the repeated and time-consuming reworks. A mobile multimedia device development for the integrated graphic hand-sketch tablet is presented in this paper. This development uses IUM to reduce the design criteria and then transfer the result criteria into design guidelines. This paper demonstrates the practices of the multi-demand product design as the case validation of IUM.

articleTitle: Effects of different irrigation mode on water consumption and yield of rice in cold region of North China
abstract: The water consumption and yield of rice were studied in a paddy field in cold region of North China under intermittent irrigation (IT), moisture irrigation (MT) and continuous flooding irrigation conditions (CSF). The results showed that the total water consumption of rice under IT and MT was lower than that under CSF by 13.9% and 20.2%., respectively, and the ANOVA analysis showed that at the 0.05 level, the difference was significant. The actual yield of rice under IT and MT was respectively 9.4% and 12.7% higher than that under CSF, while the theoretical yield of rice under IT and MT was respectively 10.9% and 13.6% higher than that under CSF, and the difference was significant (P<0.05). And the research showed that IT and MT achieved to increase yield mainly through significant increasing effective panicles per plant. Compared with those under CSF, effective panicles per plant under IT and MT were increased by 9.3% and 9.7%, respectively. IT and MT are two kinds of water-saving irrigation modes suitable for the paddy fields in cold region in north China. Water-reducing and yield-increasing under MT were slightly better than those under IT, but the differences were not significant.

articleTitle: Analyze characteristics of sediment movement in Changjiang River Estuary under a typhoon storm by numerical simulation
abstract: A 2D integrative model about Changjiang River Estuary coupled with astronomic tide and storm surge is established by using the Delft3D software, and validated by field measured data. Based on the simulated bottom velocity of the coupling model, four widely used sediment incipient velocity formulas are chosen to compute the sediment incipient velocity under the combined forces of tidal currents and storm surges. The numerical results show that Dou Guoren's sediment incipient velocity formula is the most appropriate and suitable for the sediment transport in the Changjiang River Estuary.

articleTitle: An optimal replacement policy for the alpha series system with single vacation and delay repair
abstract: For the maintenance of repairable system of the alpha series, under the situation that the system. For the α-series process of the repairable system with a single vacation repairman and delay repair, this paper gives a replaced policy. Assume the damaged system can not be repaired as a new one and the repairmen can be repaired immediately in p probability and the repair is delayed in 1-p probability, under this situation, according to the α-series process, we get the average cost rate of the system under the policy N. And we also use a numerical example to illustrate the maintenance model mentioned in this paper.

articleTitle: Discussion on the infeasibility study of key projects
abstract: At present, number of feasibility study avoided infeasibility study deliberately. This paper tried to bring the infeasibility study as a procedure, which makes it a section in the earlier decision. By establishing a system online for comments on the decision of key projects, seeking for the opinions of infeasibility study of key projects, standardizing the procedure of the infeasibility study to be a fixed pattern of the system, to develop its ability in decision-making of the projects.

articleTitle: WFCMS: An excellent web content management system
abstract: WFCMS is an excellent CMS based on PHP and is an powerful tool to make website. This paper systematically introduces its principle, property and application from MVC standpoint. It provides a efficient tool to the webpage-makers and helps the the application developers to make a further study on CMS.

articleTitle: Research of geometric registration method for multi-modality image
abstract: To increases the efficiency of multi-modality medical image registration, a novel multiscale registration framework is proposed based upon an edge preserving total variation L1 norm scale space representation in this paper. Based on selecting edges and contours of an image according to the geometric size rather than the intensity values of the image features, the scale space is constructed, which ensures more meaningful spatial information for MI based registration. Moreover, an optimal estimation of the total variation L1 parameter is designed in this framework by training and minimizing the transformation offset between the images for automated registration. The new method is validated through simulated mono- and multimodal medical datasets with ground truth and temporal clinical studies from a combined PET/CT scanner.

articleTitle: Dual variables system analysis for plane elastic waves
abstract: Regarding displacement components and the corresponding stress components as dual variables, elastodynamic problems can be steered to Hamiltonian dual variables system. For normal incidence problems of simple harmonic plane elastic waves, the decoupling of P-, SV- and SH-waves corresponds to decomposition of dual equation, and as one-dimensional wave, each decoupled wave has the corresponding dual equation with same equation forms, analyzing and solving methods. Wave properties, analyzing and solving methods of plane elastic waves can be all embodied in dual variables system. The eigenvalue problems of dual equation can solve wave number, wave velocity and wave impedance of medium. The eigenvector expansion solutions of dual equation are suited to analysis of the reflection and transmission of elastic waves, the modal expansion solutions of dual equation are suited to the modal analysis of layer structure, and stratified media have the transfer matrix methods based on the transition form solutions of dual equation.

articleTitle: An efficient method for improving the performance of quantum boolean circuit synthesis algorithms
abstract: So far there are no synthesis algorithms that can find all the optimal quantum boolean circuits except an exhaustive algorithm. In this paper, we propose a method based on the divide and conquer approach which can significantly improve the performance of the existing synthesis algorithms to synthesize quantum boolean circuits. A quantum boolean circuit is first divided into two subcircuits. The subcircuit with fewer gates will input all possible combinations of m gates excluding those with the same function specification. The other subcircuit can be synthesized by using the existing algorithm. The two subcircuits are combined and then we can choose the most simplified quantum boolean circuit. According to the experimental results of all the 3-variable functions, we can see that the performance of the existing algorithms can be significantly improved by using our method. Therefore the synthesized quantum boolean circuits are much more simplified than previous results.

articleTitle: Steel tube - plate connected joint of large crossing transmission towers welding residual stress by numerical simulation
abstract: Steel tube plate connected joint is commonly used in large crossing transmission steel tower, however, in the welding process produced transient thermal stress and residual stress largely, and the large force is eliminated difficultly, so the welding is the main factors affecting the joint, and it is needed to research and analysis. Through the use of large finite element software ANSYS and the thermal coupling analysis method, the indirect method is also used, the life and death of nodes element technique is combined, the temperature field and stress field are numerically simulated, and the residual stress and deformation are analyzed, the residual stress and deformation of the distribution are obtained, so the certain reference value is provided on the actual engineering of the steel tube-plate connected joint.

articleTitle: The network coding based on synchronization in wireless mesh networks self-similar traffic
abstract: The wireless mesh networks traffic is of self-similarity and the network performance is degraded by self-similar traffic. Network coding is a new technology which improves networks performance. In this paper, an algorithm was presented that used network coding to reduce the queue length and the delay time when self-similar traffic was occurred. The algorithm was based on synchronization after data packets are classified by destination address and lengths. Comprehensive simulations and results show that the delay time and queue length is shorter.

articleTitle: Thermal properties of Aluminum&PVC co-extrusion sliding window
abstract: As a result of economic grows and human activity, environmental problems such as global warming, energy crisis, become severe. Windows, which is supposed to be the pivotal part of energy conservation, certainly gets more and more attention. In this paper, a new series of sliding window that are ideal for building energy conservation will be introduced and their thermal properties will be simulated by computer software, which we expect would be helpful to the architects and other researchers in the future.

articleTitle: Numerical method for the influence of excavation of foundation pit on surrounding pipeline
abstract: The finite difference method is used to analyze influence of depth excavation on the underground pipeline around the foundation pits of Fuming road station in Ningbo urban rail transit project construction. Soil reinforcement in passive zone is considered in this paper. Based on assumption of plane strain, calculation is carried out for 11 steps excavation in the most dangerous section. Influence of the excavation on horizontal displacement, stress of underground pipeline is discussed. Some valuable conclusions for construction practice are also drawn from the analysis. The results of this paper can provide a reference for the design, construction and protection of the underground pipeline in Ningbo city.

articleTitle: Decay rate of solutions of linear generalized Benjamin-Bona-Mahony-Burgers equation in multi dimensions
abstract: We study the pointwise estimate of solution to the Cauchy problem for the linear generalized Benjamin-Bona-Mahony-Burgers equation in multi dimensions. Through the explicit analysis of the Green function, we obtain the large time behavior of our solution.

articleTitle: Research on the license plate position algorithm in complicated scenes
abstract: The license plate location plays an important role in the License Plate Recognition (LPR). According to the vertical projection and the morphological operations, this paper proposes a kind of locating method based on binary image in order to obtain accurate location of vehicle plate quickly under complex background. First, this method carries out preprocessing such as the color image grays processing, the binarization, filtering and noise abatement. Then the projection approach based on texture feature of license plate character is adopted to realize the rough location. On this basis, the up-down and left-right boundary of the car license are all examined accurately in accordance with the projection and the morphological operations. Experimental results show that this method is excellent in accuracy with a rapid speed and is great in the robustness.

articleTitle: Poem as a design language
abstract: The character of poem is to discover the world from the viewpoint of aesthetics. When the poem is used as a design language. its character will be introduce into the design and the design process is translated into a process of seeking after poetic-images. constructing poetic-realm and designing follow the poetic-realm. Meanwhile, it will redound to reveal Chinese culture in the design because the poem is the typical feature and important expression way of Chinese culture. In designing the Huangxing commercial pedestrian Street in Changsha, the designer epurate instills poetry-images from local geography and culture, then integrates them into a poetry-realm, and design following it. In conclusion, the poem not only be a designing way, but more important, a way to represent the glamour of Chinese culture and a kind of interpretation to the common idea of the Orient and the Occident for Poetic Dwelling.

articleTitle: Application of mutual information key frame extraction method in the teaching video retrieval
abstract: With the development of computer technology, teaching video data grows exponentially. How to rapidly capture the wanted video data at the sea video database is the currently hot research topic. This paper put forward to a method of key frame extraction based on mutual information for teaching content-based video analysis and retrieval. Experiments show that this proposed approach can make a good representation for video contents.

articleTitle: Transformation of the prandtl solution into new solutions of ideal plasticity
abstract: New exact solutions of a system of 2-dimentional ideal plasticity equations are constructed from the well-known Prandtl solution using point transformations. A mechanical interpretation of the obtained solutions is discussed.

articleTitle: Types and characteristics of cultural landscape in traditional village
abstract: With the modern development of heritage protection, urbanization brings the lost to the rural culture landscape and modern society desire to the protection of the rural culture landscape, the rural culture landscape becomes the hot spot among the scholars. This paper starts from the natural and human elements composing of rural culture landscape, discusses the types both in material and non-material landscape of rural culture landscape, and summarizes six basic characteristics of traditional rural culture landscape in China: universality and complexity, regional characteristics, inheritance, natural dependence, relative stability, introversion and openness. It is in order to guide better protection of traditional rural culture landscape, and provide a reference for the research of traditional rural culture landscape.

articleTitle: Uniqueness theorem for a nonlinear parabolic inverse problem
abstract: In this paper, a uniqueness theorem for a nonlinear parabolic inverse problem was proved, that is, the nonlinear diffusion coefficient of a multidimensional nonlinear parabolic equation can be identified under certain conditions. Our approach is based on a kind of integral estimate for free boundary problem used in Cannon and Yin [3].

articleTitle: Research on target detection algorithms in optical-electronic imaging
abstract: Several methods have been designed and developed for target detection. In order to verify the target detection algorithms for the photoelectric images, and compare the advantages and disadvantages between different algorithms, the target tracking algorithms verification platform was designed and implemented. This system consist of video source processing module, algorithm pretreating module, target segmentation module, target detection and target tracking module. Design the interface between modules for more implantable. Based on this system, target detection algorithms can be easily developed on PC without hardware support.

articleTitle: Model and parameter sensitivity analysis for galloping reliability assessment of long-span continuous rigid-frame bridges during construction
abstract: During the cantilever construction stage, bridge galloping stability problem caused by wind load cannot be ignored because the structure stiffness is small. Thus, it is necessary to study galloping reliability assessment of long-span continuous rigid-frame bridge. Taking Beishan bridge as an example in the paper, the occurrence of galloping is firstly analyzed qualitatively by wind tunnel test. Then, with the galloping critical wind velocity determined by wind tunnel test as structure resistance and stochastic wind speed at the site of the bridge as load effect, an probability evaluation model for galloping reliability assessment of long-span continuous rigid-frame bridge is established based on the existing structure reliability theory. In the end, the galloping reliability assessment and parametric sensitivity for Beishan bridge are given.

articleTitle: The application of Multisim in power electronic technology
abstract: Based on brief introduction of the characteristics of power electronic technology and Multisim. The application of Multisim is given with PWM for example. Practice shows that the introduction of Multisim raise the student's enthusiasm. The class effect is good.

articleTitle: Simulation of real water in 3D animation
abstract: Realistic simulation of the water surface is the focus of the study for the developers to display the reconstruction of channel, virtual environment, virtual naval and design a variety of games software, it has a high research value in computer graphics and computer-aided design and virtual reality. The simulation of the water effects in different circumstances by demonstrating the effect of reflection, refraction, light intensity fully and integrating the texture map and dynamic texture technology can greatly enhance the scene authenticity. The paper studies the realization of real water surface in 3D animation, including the interface of 3ds max software and the fluid software RealFlow, the key technology and parameter sets of creating RealWave, RW Splash, RW Particles emitters, some daemons and constraints, describes methods of creating water surface modeling, generating waves, adding spray and generating the trailing of boat sailing and foam billowing effects. The satisfactory conclusion is achieved at run time and memory storage space occupied by these methods.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical System security studies and research
abstract: The technology of Cyber-Physical System has attracted highly attention of academia, industry, and news media. There are still many open issues in the definition, architectures system models, security architecture of Cyber-Physical System. Define Cyber-Physical System and its meaning firstly, and then introduce the architecture and the progress of Cyber-Physical System research; and also analysis security services of CPS based on the time and space scales; lastly put forward the CPS system security architecture and detailed analysis of the layers of security threats and discuss along with possible solutions.

articleTitle: Design of reader device for radio frequency Card based on microcontroller unit STC89C52
abstract: The contactless IC card becomes the potential biggest new armed forces to be subject to the domestic and foreign fields the attention in the IC card by its non-machinery to maintain, wears easily, convenience used and so on merits . The microcontroller unit STC89C52 is used, one kind of reader is designed, it including two parts:the hardware and the software. The hardware including the microcontroller unit, the radio frequency cards reader module, the antenna, the radio frequency card, the serial communication connection, the keyboard, LCD, serial EEPROM and so on. The software including the master program, reader subroutine, display subroutine and so on. The source program is writed with C or the assembly language, it is compiled on the Keil uvision3 platform, after throughing and it is downloads to the microcontroller unit STC89C52, this microcontroller unit and other primary device is welding on the PCB board, and the Mifare card is laid aside in the antenna area coverage, the serial port is connects better, puts through the power source, may carry on "the data reader" and so on operations, It indicated that has achieved the design requirements.

articleTitle: Medical Image Retrieval based on co-occurrence martix and edge histogram
abstract: More and more techniques about Medical Image Retrieval are used in Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD). How to extract image features which reflect the high level semantics of an image is very important in Content Based Image Retrieval (CBIR). In accordance with this issue, there proposed a method using co occurrence matrix to extract texture feature and edge histogram to extract shape feature of medical images in this paper. Then Euclidean distance is used for medical image retrieval. Results of experimentation showed that the proposed algorithm has been applied to medical image retrieval with promising effect.

articleTitle: CH-SIFT: A local kernel color histogram SIFT based descriptor
abstract: This paper presents a novel method for extracting distinctive invariant features from color images that can be used to perform reliable matching between different views of an object or scene. The features are invariant to image scale and rotation, and also to illumination changes because of using a color kernel histogram descriptor incorporating with a classic SIFT descriptor. The method is compared with SIFT, SURF and CSIFT and is shown that the accuracy of proposed method is better than others by testing all of them on the ALOI database.

articleTitle: New feature selection for neighbor embedding based super-resolution
abstract: Neighbor embedding based super-resolution uses a manifold learning based on local linear embedding to estimate a high-resolution image from an input low-resolution image and a training image set. A novel feature selection combing norm luminance and stationary wavelet transform coefficients for neighbor embedding based super-resolution (NLSC-NE) is proposed. The norm luminance represents the low-frequency information or global structure, while the SWT coefficients carry high-frequency information of luminance value variations. Experiments show that compared with several existing feature selection methods, the new feature combination can capture more details and preserve edges better. The proposed algorithm improves the super-resolution performance both in subjective and objective assessments.

articleTitle: Study on energy-saving composite wall plate of husk mortar
abstract: This article discusses the advantages and disadvantages of various energy-saving wall panel at present in China and introduces the authors' research and devotion on the husk mortar wall plate, which could be regarded as perfect because of its characters of energy-saving, environmental protection, recycling, economy, industrialization. Its performance of material, energy-saving and fire-resistance has passed the tests by the professional institutions. This product has obtained the national patent, and Heilongjiang provincial certification of energy-saving products. This panel is becoming a new ideal choice of ecological, environmental protected and energy saving wall for the construction industry.

articleTitle: Automatic video object segmentation algorithm based on background reconstruction
abstract: An automatic video object segmentation algorithm based on background reconstruction is proposed in this paper. First, HOS (Higher Order Statistics) is used to automatically separate the moving areas from background. The initial object mask is extracted, and the corresponding initial background is also derived. Second, the background is reconstructed using forecasting theory. Finally, the video object is extracted by combining the frame difference mask and background subtraction mask. Furthermore, morphological reconstruction algorithm is also used to eliminate shadow.

articleTitle: The face detection system based on GPU+CPU desktop cluster
abstract: As an important research topic of the pattern recognition and machine vision, the face detection technology has been studied widely in the application area such as the face recognition, new human-computer interaction, information security etc. For these applications have the limitation of the real-time, how to accelerate the speed of the face detection has always been an important topic. In this paper, we developed a single GPU+CPU desktop face detection system which adopts the algorithm of Viola and Jones that is based on the Adaboost learning system, and uses the high data-parallel computing power and the high internal data bandwidth of GPU to achieve the thread-level parallelism. Our experimental results indicate that our system running on a NVIDIA Gefoce GTX260 graphics card could achieve the speed of 12 fps and the detection rate of 92%.

articleTitle: Experimental study on ultimate bearing capacity of perfobond rib shear connectors
abstract: This paper describes the influencing factors of the ultimate bearing capacity of perfobond rib shear connectors. Three types of failure modes for perfobond rib shear connectors with perforated rebar are summarized from previous experiments, and the shear failure of perforated rebar completely contributes to the ultimate bearing capacity. 33 specimens of perfobond rib shear connectors were tested in the static loading test with different sizes of perfobond rib holes, perforated rebar and concrete strengths. The influencing factors were studied based on test results. It is shown that the size and strength of perforated rebar significantly influence the ultimate bearing capacity of perfobond rib shear connectors with perforated rebar while the sizes and strength of concrete dowels have a minimal influence. In addition, the sizes and strength of transversal rebar have considerable influences on the ultimate bearing capacity, which are more significant than that shown in existing formulas.

articleTitle: Research on automatic detection of fake car-logo based on cloud-computing
abstract: The vehicle information detected by monitoring node is not consistent with the one in databases sometimes in the vehicle management. On the other hand, different monitor nodes may detect the same car-logo, in the case of which it is a fake one. This is harmful to the daily highway orders. The paper integrated the vehicle detection and recognition with the cloud-computing in public security service of China. A cloud computing platform built upon the police network is able to provide the monitoring nodes all over the country with supercomputing and storing services. Therefore, it can achieve automatic detection, which is pratically helpful to maintain the daily highway orders.

articleTitle: An new method for image inpainting using wavelets
abstract: In this paper, we present a new technique for image inpainting using wavelets. Firstly the damaged area is roughly resorted by the fast marching inpainting method in spatial domain. Then the image is projected onto the wavelet domain, the wavelet coefficient corresponding to the damaged block is revalued based upon the known coefficient of its neighborhood in detail subband, while the wavelet approximation is restored by fast marching inpainting method. An inverse wavelet transform is carried out to get an image in spatial domain. This procedure is repeated in several times and the image is projected onto wavelet domain and spatial domain alternately with being applied suitable constraints in each domain. The method iteratively converges to an image with the damaged area being restored. Our experimental results show that the resulting restored area is homogeneous with its surrounding and the inpainting speed is quite fast.

articleTitle: Study of the contact forces and grain size distribution during grain crushing
abstract: In this paper, the contact forces and the grain size distribution during the fragmentation process of two-dimensional grains under the applied pressure are studied through computer simulation method based on single-particle breakage model. Simulation results demonstrate that the events of the grain breakage only happen in some specific area of the crushing system. The ultimate grain size distribution follows a power-law distribution with a fractal dimension of about 1.1. The distribution of the major principal stress indicates that most of the major principal stresses are distributed in the vicinity of the average of the major principal stress in the system. The force chain topologies indicate the characteristics of the aggregation effects of the contact forces.

articleTitle: A blind separation algorithm of speech signal based on spatial cues
abstract: Based on spatial cues, a blind separation algorithm of speech signal was proposed. In time-frequency domain, extract the spatial cues of speech signal, which are ITD and ILD, then construct the 2D diagram by distribution density of ITD and ILD. Next, mark the time-frequency binary masking and using this technique separate the source in time-frequency domain. Finally, I-STFT is used to transform the separated source back to time domain, and realize the blind separation algorithm of speech signal. To summarize, the proposed algorithm will give a new prospect to the research filed of blind separation of speech.

articleTitle: Research on image dehazing algorithms based on physical model
abstract: Image dehazing is an important problem of common concern in image processing and computer vision areas. Recently, most researchers have adopted physical model based image dehazing to remove haze, in which dark channel prior law has achieved very good results in dealing with single images of outdoor scenes for image dehazing. Applying the theory of dark channel prior to estimate the atmosphere light A is a reliable method. Based on these, this paper studies five typical dehazing algorithms based on physical model and compares the advantages and disadvantages of these algorithms through a plenty of simulation experiments. It is some reference value to the researches in this filed with our studies.

articleTitle: Research of communication mechanism in CNC system based on EtherCAT
abstract: EtherCAT (Ethernet for Control Automation Technology) is a type of real-time industrial Ethernet protocol for date communication in automation control system, which is used in the pure-soft open CNC system communication. In this solution named ADX CNC, CNC system is the master station and communicates data through the NIC of Industrial PC with slave stations without any other cards. To assure the real-time data communication, RTX (Real-Time Extension) is used as the environment, in which the EtherCAT function is embedded through developing special NIC driver. In addition, slave station device description file and EtherCAT date frame filter were developed to fulfill the communication. It proves that ADX CNC has excellent perform and good developed prospects based on the application in the actual three axises machining center.

articleTitle: A research and model of host-firewall based on Windows Hook technology
abstract: It researches and presents a technology and a model of a creative host-firewall on Windows platform, which adopts the technology of Windows Hook in this paper. It makes a deep research in the technology of TDI Hook and NDIS Hook technologies, which are used to consist the core of this research and model. Moreover, it discuss the framework of WDM driver,such as driver objection, IRP structure and the relation between layer-driver and I/O stack. It also adopt a appropriate method and measurable experiment to evaluate this model. The result of the experiment verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Image analysis using radial Fourier-Chebyshev moments
abstract: A new set of radial orthogonal moment functions were presented based on the discrete Fourier functions and the discrete Chebyshev polynomials, which can be effectively used in the image analysis. The proposed moments take a new sampling method that overcomes the default of classical method. In addition, a new discrete orthogonal system is constructed. The experimental results show that the new radial moments are superior to the conventional moments in image reconstruction and computing efficiency.

articleTitle: A low complexity calibration method of gain and phase error for arrays with arbitrary geometry
abstract: Gain and phase error calibration of array elements is important in engineering practice.In this paper , a low complexity calibration method of gain and phase error for arrays with arbitrary geometry was analysised. In the far field,using a single sourec with exact orientation, the method computs the gain and phase error according to the first column of the covariance matrix of received data without eigen value decomposition. The method can obtain the relatively gain and phase errors of each sensor and has low computational burden and high estimation precision without multidimensinal nonlinear search and an iterative procedure.The validness of the method was performed by computer simulation results on 8-element uniform circular array.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of wireless sensor network management based on SNMP
abstract: Aiming at the advantages of traditional network management in SNMP, combined with the characteristics of wireless sensor network itself. A method of wireless sensor network management based on SNMP is gived. That wireless sensor network is abstracted as a virtual device as SNMP managed node, to achieve this wireless network management from the system level. Integrated configuration, operations and maintenance functionality in a traditional way. Adapting to technology of wireless sensor network bases on the protocol 802.15.4/ZigBee and the Embedded System, a ZigBee wireless sensor network management based on SNMP is designed and realized. Described the composing of the system, working principle and the function of each parts.

articleTitle: A CAVLC embedded method for Audio-Video Synchronization Coding based on H.264
abstract: This paper proposes a new Audio-Video Synchronization Coding algorithm on the latest H.264/AVC video coding standard. The audio information is only embedded into the last non-zero and non-trailing coefficient during the CAVLC (Context Adaptive Variable Length Coding) process and can be extracted from the video stream at the receiver terminal without distortion. This method is efficient with low computational complexity. And the experimental results show that it can arrive synchronization effectively with little stream bit rate increase and quality degradation.

articleTitle: Automatic video thumbnail selection
abstract: A practical system named automatic video thumbnail selection system is proposed for video sharing sites in this paper. It aims to automatically select a best thumbnail among several extracted thumbnails for a video. To achieve this, video thumbnail features including high-level and low-level visual information are proposed and the corresponding scores are calculated firstly. Then a weighting method is adopted to combine all scores of features together for final decision. We also define how to measure the accuracy of thumbnail selection methods and show that our proposal is fast and precise for automatic thumbnail selection through experiments.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection using subspace band section based RX algorithm
abstract: Large amount of spectral wavebands of hyperspectral remote sensing data provide an abundant and valuable information for classification and detection, but at the same time, this will lead to redundancy and complexity of the data. In this paper, we proposed a subspace band section based RX algorithm for hyperspectral imagery (HSI) anomaly detection. Firstly, the adaptive subspace decomposition (ASD) algorithm divides the HSI data of high dimension to subsets of low dimension according to the correlation between spectral wavebands. Then principle component analysis (PCA) is used in each subspace to select certain principle components for RX detection. At last, fuse the results of each subspace and get the anomaly elements through a certain threshold. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve high detection performance.

articleTitle: Study and application of translation invariant wavelet de-noising for blasting seismic signals
abstract: The traditional wavelet transform threshold de-noising method might produce the artifacts on discontinuities of blasting seismic signals because the wavelet is short of translation invariance. Firstly, the translation invariant wavelet transform de-noising method performs the cycle translation for blasting seismic signals to be analyzed. Secondly the soft or hard threshold is used to shrink the wavelet coefficient of the signals and reconstruct the signals. Lastly, using the inverse cycle translation, performing more translating-denoising-translating and averaging the obtained results, consequently the translation dependence of wavelet basis is eliminated. The method can not only effectively suppress Psuedo-Gibbs phenomenon in blasting seismic signals, but also diminish Mean Square Error(MSE) between the original blasting seismic signals and the estimated blasting seismic signals. It proves theoretically and practically that it is more effective to de-noise for blasting seismic signals.

articleTitle: Application and analysis on quantitative evaluation of hand vein image quality
abstract: Recognition of hand vein is becoming a research focus in biological recognition field, due to its particular advantage of uniqueness and livingness. In this study, images of hand vein were obtained by near-infrared camera with hand illuminated by near-infrared light source. The acquisition of clear vein image is an important premise for recognition. In the paper, we propose a quantitative evaluation method of image quality based on two spatial indicators, i.e. the mean gray and gray variance, and then study the relationship between the quantitative image scores and the drive current of near-infrared light source. It shows the relationship between the drive current and the evaluation score is quadratic parabolic, and the optimal the drive current of the near-infrared light source is obtained. This work provides a good theoretical basis for the design of image acquisition system with the automatic regulation of hand vein image quality.

articleTitle: Influence of discontinuities on post-peak behavior of rock in uniaxial compressive test by numerical study
abstract: Post-peak behavior of the rock mass is an important characteristic to evaluate the stability of underground infrastructures and the violence of rock failure. In the field, there are always various types of discontinuities in the rock mass. With the numerical code, RFPA, a series of unconfined compressive tests on the rock specimens containing discontinuities with different orientations and numbers were conducted to analyze their influences on the post-peak behavior of rock. The post-peak moduli of the specimens under different tests were estimated. Comparing the failure modes, stress-strain curves, post-peak moduli and accumulated AE events during the tests, several useful insights were obtained.

articleTitle: Survey on the technology of image processing based on DCT compressed domain
abstract: Many image data are usually archived and transmitted in the compressed form[1], for example, JPEG. Traditionally, manipulating the JPEG image must fully decompress first. Because the traditional method is not efficient, it can not satisfy the requirements of real-time system. so, studying the technology of image processing based on DCT compressed domain is urgent. This paper describes the JPEG compressed algorithm, the method of DCT compressed domain image processing and the location of the image processing in DCT compressed domain.

articleTitle: Pseudo almost automorphic solutions to semilinear differential equations
abstract: In this paper we study the semilinear differential equation x'(t) = Ax(t) + f(t, x(t)),t ∈ R in Banach spaces, where A is a (an) bounded (unbounded) linear operator. Applying the theory of dissipative operator, the theory of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-semigroups and Banach contraction principle, we establish the existence and uniqueness of a bounded pseudo almost automorphic solution of the problem under conditions.

articleTitle: Eyeglasses try-on based on improved poisson equations
abstract: In this paper we propose an image-based eyeglasses try-on method, which can be used in e-commerce. The proposed method combines an improved active shape model feature extration algorithm with an image composition algorithm, producing a natural facial image with eyeglasses specified by users. To preserve the color fidelity of the eyeglasses on the resulting image, a new variational model was proposed. The output image was obtained by solving the modified Poisson equations. Experimental results show that the eyeglasses image was blended into the facial image seamlessly, producing natural eyeglasses try-on effects.

articleTitle: Technical reasons analysis about a collapse accident of a new-building highway super large bridge pier formwork
abstract: March 12, 2011, a newly built highway's super large bridge's pier formwork collapse has happened, and three workers have been killed. Three technological personnel have made a thorough survey on the spot, and the relevant staffs have been inquired. The following aspects have been calculated and analyzed including the connect strength of bolts in the two semicircular formworks' connection, the compressive strength of the connected holes, the connection holes' shear strength, the shapes of holes and bolt connection technique. The technicians consider that in the pouring of concrete, the temperature is relatively low and increase the fixed time at the beginning of the concrete, together with casting speed is faster, and cause the new pouring concrete lateral pressure increased. The formwork bottom bolts have not glibly been connected, bolt hole connecting there is relatively large deformations, and the effective compressive-cut areas have been reduced. When the compressive and shear strength of one hole cannot meet the requirements, the connection hole is destructed by compressive stress and shear stress, the whole bolt is pulled out from the hole, then the load of the bolt transfer to the nearest bolt, which leading to the closest bolt or be pulled out on the whole, or be pulled apart, to generate a domino effect, the concrete pouring out at that time. Because concrete releasing from the single formwork's bottom, producing level force to another half steel formwork, causing the formwork produce displacement, and the formwork fall due to the instability. Finally corresponding prevention measures are put forward; these have certain reference value to prevent similar accidents.

articleTitle: Vision device to support independent life for people with serious disability
abstract: Persons suffering from intractable disease like ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis) and spinal cord injured present symptoms of muscular deteriorations. These patients are often obliged to use artificial respirators once the breathing action becomes impossible. It is important to understand that using the artificial respirator means that uttering voice becomes impossible. For human being talking and discussing with friends using voice is necessary to enjoy his life with family and friends. In order to support their communication, a vision input device to use vision is proposed. A distinct advantage of this vision device is that the devices can be settled apart from the bed of the patient. The device is developed for patients who have ability to move his head intentionally.

articleTitle: An improved mean-shift tracking algorithm with spatial-color feature and new similarity measure
abstract: The mean-shift algorithm has achieved considerable success in object tracking due to its simplicity and robustness. However, the lack of spatial information often leads to false positives of the color based tracker when the background has a similar color style. Furthermore, the classical similarity measures are not very discriminative. In this paper, an improved mean-shift tracking algorithm with spatial-color feature and a new similarity measure function is proposed. This leads to a very efficient and robust nonparametric spatial-color feature tracking algorithm. The algorithm is tested on image sequences and shown to achieve robust and reliable frame-rate tracking.

articleTitle: Construction of the geological disaster real-time monitoring demonstration station in Wushan County
abstract: Real-time monitoring can achieve of automatic continuous monitoring data collection, and the first time in the information will reach the decision-making for analysis, so as to avoid times squandered which cause serious bad consequences. Therefore that have been regarded by more and more people and become the inevitable trend of monitoring of the geological disaster. The research results are systematically summed up of the Research and Demonstration about Technology & Method on Geologic Hazard Monitoring and Prewarning of the Ministry of Land and Resources P.R.C, introduce the building process of the system of the demonstration, which would provide reference of similar system building.

articleTitle: A face super-resolution method based on illumination invariant feature
abstract: Human faces in surveillance video images usually have low resolution and poor quality. They need to be reconstructed in super-resolution for identification. The traditional subspace-based face super-resolution algorithms are sensitive to light. For solving the problem, this paper proposes a face super-resolution method based on illumination invariant feature. The method firstly extracts the illumination invariant features of an input low resolution image by using adaptive L1-L2 total variation model and self-quotient image in logarithmic domain. Then it projects the feature onto non-negative basis obtained by Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) in face image database. Finally it reconstructs the high resolution face images under the framework of Maximum A Posteriori(MAP) probability. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the compared methods both in subjective and objective quality under poor light conditions.

articleTitle: Experimental research on axial compression performance of square section concrete column confined by FRP
abstract: To Study the axial compression performance of FRP confining concrete square section column through sixteen groups columns subjected to axial loading; various design parameters, such as types of FRP, amounts of FRP sheets, width of straps and spacing of straps, have been considered. The results are: The axial compressive strength and ductility performance of concrete square section wrapped by FRP sheets or FRP straps have all increased to a certain degree.

articleTitle: Feasibility of RTK used for mining subsidence in mountainous areas
abstract: The most direct and reliable method of studying the exploitation of mountainous areas which influenced under mining is to obtain field data through establishing mountainous surface movement observation station. In order to research the feasibility of RTK applied for mountainous surface movement observation station, The basic principle of RTK measurement was introduced, the feasibility of RTK applied for mountainous surface movement observation station was explored combed with the advantages of RTK and the monitoring requirement for mountainous surface movement observation station. And for a coal mine an example, it was proved that RTK technology used for mountainous surface movement observation station was entirely feasible through establishing mountainous surface movement observation station and juxtaposing the results of RTK and static GPS.

articleTitle: Software and hardware design and implementation of LED display system of stadium big screen
abstract: This paper introduced main ideas of hardware and software design and specific methods of realization of LED screen display system in detail Extract computer CRT digital video by and convert signal from video signal to the LED display CRT signal by circuit implementation, and driving circuits receive LED display signals after conversion, and assign them to LED dot matrix corresponding to pixel, and drive the LED screen to display in real time. We give specific compacted method of using software to realize interactive function of big screen score display by AUTHERWARE multimedia production. Through the practical engineering application, the system showed that it has simple structure, easy maintenance, detection and price ratio is high, and has a strong market competitive power.

articleTitle: A new class of impulsive integral inequalities and its application
abstract: In this paper, we establish a new class of integral inequalities for discontinuous functions, the right hand of the inequalities also contain nonlinear compound functions of the unknown function. We give the estimation of upper bound of the unknown function by analysis technique and mathematics induction method. Finally, we show the usefulness of our results in investigating the estimation of solutions of impulsive differential system.

articleTitle: Plastic failure analysis for Qianjiangping Landslide under the influence of Three Gorges Reservoir normal operation and heavy rainfall
abstract: 3D FEM and plastic failure analysises are given for the neonatal landslide—Qianjiangping Landslide applied Three Gorges Reservoir water level and rainfall which happened after the first sluice in Three Gorges Reservoir, conclusions are better for the impact of rainfall and water level changes on landslide.

articleTitle: The Study for selecting the consignment performance of E-learning of technology college
abstract: The outsourcing of the electronic learning (E-learning) systems in technology college in Taiwan, it will allow the education's department to focus on its core business and thus helps it to become more competitive. This article intends to establish a set of indexes for evaluating outsourced e-learning systems in terms of three aspects, i.e. supply, demand and supervision. We then apply Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to collect opinions of related decision groups and adopt TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution) for the evaluation and ranking of the e-learning system providers. A technology college is selected to serve as an example.

Author Keywords: Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: An audio-visual objective quality model based on BP neutral network
abstract: This article proposes an audio-visual objective quality model, which is adaptive to the content changes. The major disadvantage of most existing models is that there is no unified model to evaluate the quality according to the content. So we firstly extracted the audio and video features and the correlation of the audio and video. Then we used BP neutral network to build the model, and used the subjective test to train and verify the model. The result of the test shows that this model is better than the second-order model.

articleTitle: Butterworth filter and Sobel edge detection to image
abstract: This paper discuss the detection Sobel edge detection prohibit of operator ,The edge detection operator effect solve the problem of positioning. Using the high-pass Butter worth filter and Sobel edge detection operator, which effectively solve this problem. We use DSP programming environment to verify the feasibility of the method and experimental results verify the proposed this method is very effective.

articleTitle: The study on the application of RFID- based mobile payment to the Internet of Things
abstract: This paper, putting the RFID-based mobile phone as the future terminal of the Internet of Things and considering varieties of technical indicators, compares and analyses three solutions to the credit card payment of mobile phone, and then gives the selective recommendation.

articleTitle: Research of bird's-eye panoramic view for vehicle parking
abstract: This paper proposed a method to integrate multiple images from a video captured by the camera sticked on the back of a vehicle. The integration can be performed in real time. The image integration consists of two steps: Perspective transform and stitching. First, do camera calibration to get the intrinsic parameters and extrinsic parameters with camera calibration and get the birds-eye view of each image. Then detect the line of each image using Hough Transform. After gained the line histogram, gets the rotation angle between two images using minimum cross-correlation of line histogram. Use minimum cross-correlation of binary images to get the transform pixel in horizontal direction and vertical direction. Do spatial transform for one image to gain the images' coordinate in the same coordinate system. Add two images with different weight to get stitching image.

articleTitle: Cooperative relay assignment in wireless networks
abstract: Cooperative communication is shown to be a promising technology to significantly increase the transmission rate of wireless network. However, most of the existing results on relay assignment problem with multiple source-destination pairs are limited to assign each single pair at most one cooperative relay node. Moreover, for a given pair, the rate gain obtained by employing multiple cooperative relay nodes for cooperative communication may be greater than that can be obtained by selecting only a single cooperative relay node. Therefore, this paper studies the cooperative relay node assignment problem in a network environment, where multiple source-destination pairs compete for the same pool of cooperative relay nodes and each pair can employ multiple cooperative relay nodes for cooperative communication to maximize the minimum rate among all pairs. We first formulate this problem into a 0–1 non-linear integer program and then develop a polynomial-time approximation algorithm to solve this problem. This approximation algorithm iteratively increases the rate of the pair with minimum rate among all pairs and can achieve the approximation ratio of Δ, where Δ is the maximum number of neighbor cooperative relay nodes for each source node in the network. The simulation results show that this algorithm can increase the network performance by about 56% and 65% comparing with ORA and NCR schemes respectively.

articleTitle: The mathematic magic of Photoshop blend modes for image processing
abstract: Adobe Photoshop is usually the first option for most of designers and photographers when they need to process images. When they enhance their images using Photoshop, the blend modes offer incredible creative options for them. But not all of them know well about the concepts which are not always intuitive, and they are not always clear when to use what tool and how to use it effectively. This paper talks about mathematic foundation behind the blend modes. Only knows well about the ways that Photoshop processing the images, the usage of blend modes could become more and more convenient.

articleTitle: Positioning system for miners based on RFID
abstract: Mine accidents occur frequently recently. The situation under mine is very complicated. So it is very difficult to rescue the miners when accident happens. If we can determine the accurate position of miners under mine, the casualty rate will be decreased greatly. So the positioning problem of miners is an urgent task during the coal mining processing. Many schemes are proposed, but ineffectively. Our system use advanced Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) to tracking and positioning the miners. Once the accident occurs, we can find the miners with the fastest speed. So we can limit the casualties at the lowest line.

articleTitle: An improved mean shift algorithm for object tracking
abstract: MeanShift algorithm is a popular method for searching for local extreme value in the density distribution of a set of data. Traditional MeanShift object tracking algorithm mainly uses a single histogram to describe the color characteristics of an object, and the detection precision and stability are not good enough in a complex background due to its lacking of spatial information of pixel colors. As for this defect, this paper presents a new method combined with distribution information of space to reduce the effect of image flaws by setting a weight to pixels, on the basis of the distance from the center point of target to the current point. The experiment results show that our method promotes the tracking accuracy of moving object under a complicated environment and has better stability.

articleTitle: Triaxial tests research on strength properties of the polypropylene fiber reinforced soil
abstract: Conventional triaxial compression tests were carried in order to study the strength effect and mechanism on fiber reinforced soil of the length and content for polypropylene fiber, and different length of the polypropylene fiber (6mm, 12mm, 19mm) were added to the sand clay with the popropertion of 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.3%, 0.4% respectively according to the weight. It is concluded from tests that the strength and the overall stability of the polypropylene fiber soil increase obviously compared to plain soil. In addition, strength will improve with the increase of fiber contents firstly and then drop and it will give play to effect of the fiber reinforcement when the content is 0.3%. At the same time, the effect of the different fiber length isn't identical even through the content is same. The main reason is that the joint action between occlusive friction and force of space constraint after the net structures are formed because of the bending fiber and uniformly soil.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study of the acoustic wave propagation in a drilling mud invasion borehole
abstract: A theoretical borehole model based on Biot's theory on acoustic wave propagation in a fluid-saturated formation has been established for modeling acoustic logging response influenced by drilling mud invasion. The acoustic wave propagation equation has been solved with the potential function methods in the axial-symmetrical column coordinates system for simulating the real formation. The logging responses of the borehole fluid, the logging tool and the formation are considered respectively. The analytical solution of the acoustic field in borehole fluid and formation are all obtained. Two typical invasion profiles are considered for the numerical calculation. The acoustic wave velocity and waveform are discussed based on the numerical calculation for a monopole point source with the real axis integral method. A simple computation example validates the program. The result shows that the model can simulate the acoustic propagation in a fluid filled formation invaded by the drilling mud.

articleTitle: Shortcut nitrification at different temperature and ammonia concentration
abstract: A sequencing batch reactor was employed to treat high ammonia concentration wastewater and investigate the shortcut nitrification rates under different temperature and ammonia concentration conditions. During the start-up stage SRT and temperature were set at 12d and room temperature, and complete shortcut nitrification was achieved on 56d.The effect of temperature and ammonia concentration on ammonia oxidation rate, nitrite production rate was studied under the different ammonia concentration, as temperature was kept at 20, 25, 30, 35°C.The results showed that the optimal temperature was 30°C based on ammonia oxidation rate and sludge system. With temperature 30°C, the maximum ammonia oxidation rate was achieved and to be 28.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>·mgNH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N·h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> mgMLSS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> under ammonia concentration of 100 mg NH4 -N/L.With the increase of ammonia concentration, the sludge system had a better adaptability and resilience under shock loading of ammonia.

articleTitle: Embedded implementation of barcode recognition system in ammeter image
abstract: A barcode recognition system in an ammeter image was designed and implemented in this paper, it was the key part of ammeter information acquisition system. The embedded platform used in this paper was UT-S3C6410. Our system consists of three parts: Image input module, barcode image recognition module and data process module. Image input module could work in two modes-files and field shooting, barcode image recognition module include barcode image location, barcode recognition and image processing, the data processing block mainly for data validation, matching and preservation work. The results showed that the proposed system have a good performance to recognize the barcode in an ammeter image. The system in this paper can be directly applied to the ammeter image information acquisition system.

articleTitle: Analysis of JPEG encoder for image compression
abstract: This paper covers analysis of JPEG standard which is based on discrete cosine transform(DCT). In the standard, the procedure, DCT, played the important role of separating information by different frequencies. Compression was achieved by quantization and coding. There were common fast DCT algorithms analyzed. These could be contribution in efficient JPEG encoder. The other procedures, quantization and coding, were demonstrated and the processings of the last two procedures are mainly achieved based on standard processing table. Therefore, enhancing the efficiency of JPEG codec is hardly to develop the algorithm of quantization and coding. At last, the compression encoder was established based on JPEG, and the performance of compressed image was presented at last.

articleTitle: Algebraic solution to a constrained rectilinear minimax location problem on the plane
abstract: We consider a constrained minimax single facility location problem on the plane with rectilinear distance. The feasible set of location points is restricted to rectangles with sides oriented at a 45 degrees angle to the axes of Cartesian co ordinates. To solve the problem, an algebraic approach based on an extremal property of eigenvalues of irreducible matrices in idempotent algebra is applied. A new algebraic solution is given that reduces the problem to finding eigenvalues and eigenvectors of appropriately defined matrices.

articleTitle: Establishment and application of the information management system model for regional water resources
abstract: A regional resource information management system was developed to improve the water utilization and distribution in regional water systems. This paper took Langao village of Longkou city as an example to optimize allocation of water resources. The system integrates rainfall amount frequency analysis model, industrial, living and ecological environment water demand real-time forecast model, water resources supply and demand balance analysis model, surface water and ground water conjunctive operation model. It was found that the model can reasonable allocate regional water resources, and relieve the contradictions between supply and demand in space and time. The model provides us a new method and thought for evaluating of water resources sustainable utilization.

articleTitle: Adaptive segmentation of plant images, an integration of color space features and self-organizing maps
abstract: We developed an adaptive learning for segmentation of plant images into plant and non-plant regions. In this study, we used Kohonen's self organizing map (SOM) algorithm for segmentation of plant images using image series of two complexity levels; images taken in a controlled environment of plant facility and also images taken in the field. Nine color features of three color models of normalized Red Green Blue (RGB), Hue Saturation and Intensity (HSI) and L*a*b* made up the feature map. The results showed good performance for the images with less complexity. However, for images with higher complexity where there are more regions with similar color pattern, the method produces some noise.

articleTitle: Improved removal method of scratches in video sequences
abstract: In the old film material, there are a lot of vertical or horizontal scratches, and most of them are vertical. In this paper, an removal method of scratches in video sequences based on special information is presented, for the time continuity of the scratch is strong and the correlation in both ends of the vertical or horizontal scratches is weak, eight neighborhoods of the target pixel for reference are repositioned to ensure the correlation, thus improving the repair effect while reducing the impact of noises and the pixels in cosine variational regions to the result of restoration, and thus, improving the effect of the restoration while strengthening the stability. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective for removal of scratches in video sequences of old film material. At the same time, it could be applied in automatically restoration system of the video sequence.

articleTitle: High gain avalanche photodiode (APD) arrays in flow cytometer opitical system
abstract: The basic principles of flow cytometer are introduced, on the basis of diode pump solid state laser (532 nm) as a excitation source and a high gain avalanche photodiode (APD) arrays as a light detector, a verification opitical system is built. Then, Spherotech Rainbow Calibration Particle RCP-30-5A is used to evaluate the performance of the opitical system, the fluorescence PE signal histogram of RCP-30-5A microshphere shows that the number of individual peaks is close to eight, which is close to the world advanced level.

articleTitle: The study of integrating PDA mobile learning device into the arts and Humanities Learning Curriculum for elementary schools—Mobile digital learning space
abstract: With advances in mobile technology and multimedia, the mobile device has been recently applied to the museum guiding system. One example is the mobile digital learning space, an outcome of National Palace Museum project. This study introduces the mobile digital learning space, and discusses the satisfaction of elementary school students and their cognitive learning achievement. This study collected data from the cognitive test and questionnaires. There were 106 participations of 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> and 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> elementary students. The analysis of this study revealed that the PDA mobile learning device could effectively support the Arts and Humanities Learning Curriculum. The PDA mobile learning device could offer more opportunities for active learning. The students showed high interests of the PDA mobile learning device.

articleTitle: Projection of shape features for 3D model retrieval
abstract: In this paper, the combination of different projected shape features is proposed for 3D model retrieval. The projection features include the elevation value (depth), the radial distance, and the angle of a surface mesh.
